title: RAIN: Region-Aware Inversion Network for Semantic Watermark Extraction
summary: Semantic watermarks for diffusion models embed ownership information into the generative process while preserving perceptual quality, but Gaussian-Shading extraction conventionally requires multi-step diffusion inversion to recover the initial noise. Recent one-step methods show that this cost can be reduced substantially. We study this problem through extended flow matching and conditional regression. The key observation is that, near the high-SNR image endpoint, recovering a useful noise statistic given by the first-step output of the extended flow matching in the high-SNR regime is much simpler than reconstructing the full inverse trajectory, and Gaussian Shading only requires the recovered latent to remain in the correct watermark decision region. Based on this observation, we propose a lightweight, prompt-free extractor that decomposes endpoint recovery into an image-like anchor and a noise-oriented residual, which increases the capability of the model to utilize GPU parallel computation. The resulting method avoids iterative inversion and repeated evaluation of a diffusion-scale U-Net, providing an efficient one-step extraction pipeline with a concise theoretical interpretation. The computational cost of extracting noise is lower than that of both OSI and FARI. The github repo is there: https://github.com/TheLovesOfLadyPurple/RAIN-lightweight-NN-for-one-step-semantic-watermark-extraction

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量、免提示词的一步式语义水印提取器，将端点恢复分解为图像锚点与噪声残差，避免迭代反演与重复U-Net评估。
AI.motivation: Gaussian-Shading 语义水印提取传统上依赖多步扩散反演以恢复初始噪声，计算开销大；虽已有一步方法降低该成本，但仍需进一步高效化。
AI.method: 从扩展流匹配与条件回归视角研究该问题。核心观察：在高信噪比图像端点附近，直接恢复扩展流匹配第一步输出所给的有用噪声统计量，比重建完整逆轨迹简单得多，且高斯着色仅要求恢复潜变量落在正确的水印决策区域内。据此设计轻量、免提示词提取器，把端点恢复分解为图像式锚点与噪声导向残差，提升GPU并行利用能力，避免迭代反演和扩散规模U-Net的重复评估。
AI.result: 实现高效的一步式提取流程，具备简洁的理论解释；提取噪声的计算成本低于OSI与FARI。
AI.conclusion: 在高信噪比端点处进行条件回归可直接恢复水印决策所需的噪声统计量，从而以一步推理替代多步反演，在保证提取有效性的同时显著降低计算成本。

title: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
summary: Recent work extends recursive self-improvement (RSI) to agent harnesses for long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, enabling agents to improve execution mechanisms from experience. However, generalizable harness RSI remains challenging. First, evolving harnesses on evaluation benchmarks or their subsets makes it difficult to distinguish reusable improvements from benchmark-specific adaptation. Second, single-trajectory updates can conflate systematic harness deficiencies with instance-specific reasoning and solution details, producing modifications that transfer poorly to unseen tasks. Third, localizing recurring behavioral deficiencies within monolithic harnesses is difficult, while whole-harness optimization can entangle unrelated mechanisms and complicate attribution and validation. We propose ModularRSI, a benchmark-disjoint, contrastive, and modular framework for generalizable harness evolution. ModularRSI contrasts successful and failed trajectories for the same task and aggregates evidence across tasks to identify recurring behavioral deficiencies. It decomposes the evolvable harness into five functional modules: Agent Loop, Tool Use, Observation Management, Context Management, and Task Completion Detection. Each module evolves independently within a restricted modification scope, followed by an integration stage that combines the evolved modules into a unified harness and resolves potential conflicts. To support benchmark-disjoint evolution, we curate 2,000 executable evolution tasks from external sources that are disjoint from downstream evaluation benchmarks. Experiments on TB2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified show consistent improvements on unseen in-domain and cross-domain tasks, with the evolved harness also transferring across different foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出ModularRSI框架，实现可泛化的harness递归自我改进：通过基准不相交的任务集、成功/失败轨迹对比和五模块分解独立演化，在TB2.0与SWE-Bench Verified上取得一致的跨任务、跨模型迁移提升。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将递归自我改进（RSI）扩展到面向长时程编码与终端任务的agent harness，使agent能从经验中改进执行机制，但可泛化的harness RSI仍面临三个难题：其一，在评测基准或其子集上演化harness，难以区分可复用改进与针对基准的特定适配；其二，基于单条轨迹的更新会把系统性的harness缺陷与实例特有的推理、解法细节混为一谈，导致修改难以迁移到未见任务；其三，在单体式harness中定位反复出现的行为缺陷很困难，而整体harness优化会纠缠无关机制，使归因与验证复杂化。
AI.method: ModularRSI是一个基准不相交、对比式、模块化的harness演化框架。对比层面，它对同一任务的成功与失败轨迹进行对比，并跨任务聚合证据以识别反复出现的行为缺陷。模块化层面，它将可演化的harness分解为五个功能模块：Agent Loop、Tool Use、Observation Management、Context Management和Task Completion Detection，每个模块在受限修改范围内独立演化，之后经集成阶段合并为统一harness并解决潜在冲突。为支持基准不相交的演化，作者从外部来源构建了2000个可执行的演化任务，与下游评测基准不相交。
AI.result: 在TB2.0和SWE-Bench Verified上的实验显示，在未见过的同域与跨域任务上均取得一致提升，且演化后的harness可在不同基础模型之间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 基准不相交、对比式、模块化的harness演化能够识别可复用的系统性改进，缓解基准过拟合与单轨迹噪声问题，并提升向未见任务及不同基础模型的泛化能力。

title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
summary: Recursive self-improvement is becoming essential for autonomous AI agents, whose progress depends on discovering high-value solutions across complex domains. Effective exploration drives this process, yet managing and improving exploration strategies remains a major bottleneck. Current systems face a fundamental dilemma: fixed strategies fail to adapt as search spaces scale, while online policy optimization must navigate vast meta-search spaces under delayed, expensive feedback from long-horizon rollouts. We introduce \textsc{Dream-RSI}, a framework for scalable, recursively self-improving exploration. A lightweight orchestration layer makes exploration explicit and programmable while leaving the underlying base agent unchanged. Our key insight is that accumulated discovery history can act as a replay simulator over the realized search space. By dreaming within this simulator built from historical discovery trees, \textsc{Dream-RSI} obtains immediate, low-cost off-policy feedback to evaluate and refine exploration policies without repeated, expensive online evaluation. The improved policy is then redeployed online to drive further discovery, continuously expanding the simulator pool in a self-improving loop. Across 9 tasks in 4 domains, \textsc{Dream-RSI} achieves competitive quality and improves discovery efficiency in several settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dream-RSI 框架，将历史发现树构建成回放模拟器，通过离线"做梦"式反馈高效改进探索策略，实现可扩展的递归自我改进探索。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进对自主 AI 智能体日益重要，其进展依赖在复杂领域中探索高价值解。但探索策略的管理与改进是主要瓶颈：固定策略在搜索空间扩大时无法适应，而在线策略优化需在庞大元搜索空间中应对长时程 rollout 带来的延迟且昂贵的反馈。
AI.method: Dream-RSI 采用轻量编排层使探索显式化、可编程化，同时保持底层基础智能体不变。核心思路是将累积的发现历史视为已实现搜索空间上的回放模拟器；在该模拟器中"做梦"，从历史发现树获取即时、低成本的离线（off-policy）反馈，用于评估和改进探索策略，避免重复昂贵的在线评估。改进后的策略再部署到线上驱动进一步发现，持续扩充模拟器池，形成自我改进闭环。
AI.result: 在 4 个领域的 9 项任务上，Dream-RSI 达到有竞争力的质量，并在多种设置下提升发现效率。
AI.conclusion: Dream-RSI 通过历史发现树构建回放模拟器实现离线策略改进，为递归自我改进型探索提供了可扩展、低成本的解决路径，并在多领域任务中验证了有效性与效率优势。

title: One Example Is Enough to Pass Fairness Benchmarks: Rethinking Fairness Evaluation for Aligned LLMs
summary: Warning: This submission studies stereotypes and biases, and contains toxic and offensive examples, used for illustration purposes only. Fairness benchmarks such as BBQ have become the de facto standard for fairness evaluation across major model families. We argue that these benchmarks are too easy to support their role: training Qwen 2.5 7B Base with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a single BBQ example, or placing that example in context as a one-shot demonstration for in-context learning (ICL), lifts mean BBQ accuracy from 79.9% to 92.9% and 99.0%, respectively, closing 80% of the gap to its large-scale RLHF counterpart (96.1%) with GRPO, and surpassing it with ICL. These effects generalize across model families. A cross-conditioning analysis shows the improvement is carried by the reasoning traces generated by the model, and one example suffices to elicit a category-agnostic ``missing evidence'' reasoning pattern. We argue that BBQ-style multiple-choice abstention benchmarks measure a single structural cue, and a model that solves them does not thereby become fair. We call for evaluation suites that cover a broader spectrum of fairness alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文论证BBQ等公平性基准过于简单：单个示例经GRPO训练或作为ICL演示即可将Qwen 2.5 7B Base的BBQ平均准确率从79.9%分别提升至92.9%和99.0%，跨模型家族泛化，说明该类基准仅测量单一结构性线索，不足以反映模型的公平对齐水平。
AI.motivation: BBQ等公平性基准已成为评估主流模型家族公平性的既成标准，但作者认为这些基准过于容易，无法支撑其作为公平性评测核心工具的角色，因此需要检验其真实难度与所测量的能力。
AI.method: 仅使用一个BBQ示例，对Qwen 2.5 7B Base进行GRPO训练，或将该示例作为单样本演示进行ICL。通过跨条件分析（cross-conditioning）考察提升来源是否由模型生成的推理轨迹承载，并检验提升是否能跨模型家族泛化。
AI.result: GRPO将BBQ平均准确率从79.9%提升至92.9%，ICL提升至99.0%，分别缩小了与大规规模RLHF模型（96.1%）之间80%的差距，并在ICL设定下超过该模型。提升在不同模型家族间泛化；单个示例即可诱发与类别无关的"缺失证据"（missing evidence）推理模式，且改进由模型自身生成的推理轨迹所承载。
AI.conclusion: BBQ式多项选择弃答（abstention）基准实际上只测量单一结构性线索，模型解决该基准并不意味着其真正变得公平。作者呼吁构建覆盖更广泛公平对齐谱系的评测套件，以更全面地评估公平性。

title: Proximal-Only Transmission Matrix Recovery of an Arbitrarily Deformed Graded-Index Multimode Fiber
summary: The multimode fiber is among the thinnest imaging conduits available, carrying hundreds to thousands of spatial modes through a cross-section comparable to a human hair, but its endoscopic capabilities are currently limited by the sensitivity of the transmission matrix to the fiber's deformed state. Proximal-only recovery of the fiber's transmission matrix is an appealing approach for enabling general use multimode fiber endoscopy, and within the last decade, machine learning techniques have been applied to both single-ended and double-ended transmission matrix recovery tasks. We present a new approach to this interdisciplinary problem and show that neural networks can generalize to recover transmission matrices of an arbitrarily deformed graded-index multimode fiber from proximal measurements alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新方法，证明神经网络可仅凭近端测量，泛化重建任意形变渐变折射率多模光纤的传输矩阵，从而推进通用多模光纤内窥镜成像。
AI.motivation: 多模光纤是极细的成像通道，能以发丝级截面承载数百至数千个空间模式；但其内窥成像能力受限于传输矩阵对光纤形变状态高度敏感。仅用近端信息恢复传输矩阵，是实现通用多模光纤内窥镜的理想途径。
AI.method: 针对这一跨学科问题，作者提出新框架，利用神经网络从单端（近端）测量中学习并泛化，重建任意形变渐变折射率多模光纤的传输矩阵。文中将该任务置于近十年机器学习用于单端与双端传输矩阵恢复的研究脉络中。
AI.result: 神经网络能够泛化，仅基于近端测量即可恢复任意形变渐变折射率多模光纤的传输矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明神经网络为纯近端传输矩阵重建提供了可行路径，有望突破形变敏感性限制，推动通用多模光纤内窥镜的实际应用。

title: AgentKV: Phase-Aware KV Eviction for Agentic LLMs
summary: Agentic serving can consume orders of magnitude more tokens than chatbot workloads, stressing both KV-cache capacity and decode-time bandwidth. Most KV-eviction methods score cached keys against representative queries drawn from the most recent tokens, assuming future attention resembles recent attention. We show that agentic generation violates this assumption: future queries form a mixture over think, act, tool, and others phases, and principal-angle analysis shows these components occupy measurably different query subspaces, so recency representatives systematically undervalue keys that upcoming phases will need. We propose AGENTKV, which maintains a small query buffer per phase and scores cached keys against their union. We further implement AGENTKV in a persistent multi-turn serving path that carries compressed KV state across turns and compacts retained KV pages online. Across two models, six task domains, and three KV budgets each, AGENTKV improves task score by 5.5 points on average over R-KV and 5.3 over Tri-attention. Relative to upstream full-KV SGLang, AGENTKV improves output-token throughput by up to 1.80x. Code: https://github.com/LiuTaowen-Tony/agentkv.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AGENTKV，一种面向 agentic 场景的 KV 缓存淘汰方法：按 think/act/tool 等阶段维护小型 query 缓冲区，用多阶段 query 并集对缓存键打分，并在多轮持久化服务路径中跨轮携带压缩 KV、在线压缩保留页。实验表明其任务分和吞吐均优于基线。
AI.motivation: Agentic serving 的 token 消耗比 chatbot 高出多个数量级，给 KV-cache 容量和解码带宽带来巨大压力。现有 KV 淘汰方法假设未来注意力与近期注意力相似，以最近 token 的代表性 query 对缓存键打分；但 agentic 生成的未来 query 是 think、act、tool 等阶段的混合分布，主角度分析显示各阶段占据可测的不同 query 子空间，因此基于近因的代表会系统性低估未来阶段所需键的价值。
AI.method: 提出 AGENTKV：为每个阶段维护一个小型 query 缓冲区，对缓存键按各阶段 query 的并集进行打分；并实现于持久化多轮服务路径中，跨轮携带压缩后的 KV 状态，并对保留的 KV 页进行在线压缩。
AI.result: 在两个模型、六个任务域、每种三种 KV 预算下，AGENTKV 相比 R-KV 平均提升任务得分 5.5 分，相比 Tri-attention 提升 5.3 分；相对上游 full-KV 的 SGLang，输出 token 吞吐最高提升 1.80 倍。
AI.conclusion: AGENTKV 通过阶段感知的多 query 打分与多轮持久化 KV 管理，缓解了 agentic 生成中近因假设失效导致的键价值低估问题，在任务表现和吞吐上均取得一致收益，说明按生成阶段区分 query 子空间是提升 agentic 服务 KV 效率的有效方向。

title: MedVA: An End-to-End Neuro-Symbolic Agentic System for Medical Volume Visualization
summary: Medical volume visualization requires selecting regions of interest (ROIs) and carefully controlling their relative visual emphasis according to a given clinical intent. Implementing these decisions in conventional workflows demands substantial clinical and visualization expertise and often involves trial-and-error optimization. Recent agentic systems have introduced natural-language interaction and autonomous visualization operations but largely rely on MLLM-based inference throughout the workflow. Although MLLMs encode broad medical knowledge and provide strong reasoning capabilities, such inference may be suboptimal for medical volume visualization, potentially leading to clinically incomplete interpretations of user requests and unreliable ROI identification and visualization optimization. In this work, we present MedVA, an end-to-end neuro-symbolic agentic system for medical volume visualization that addresses these limitations through three complementary agents. The neuro-symbolic intent formulation agent refines MLLM-based interpretations of natural-language requests through symbolic reasoning over established clinical knowledge, which provides more complete, clinically grounded ROI specifications than MLLM-only reasoning. The multi-model ROI identification agent directly identifies semantically specified ROIs in the original volume by leveraging complementary large-scale pretrained medical segmentation models. The objective-driven visualization optimization agent explicitly evaluates ROI visibility and occlusion in the original volume using a volume-based visibility objective. Extensive agent-level and system-level evaluations across diverse medical datasets and interaction scenarios support the effectiveness of the individual agents. A formative user study further indicates high usability and practical value among users with different levels of expertise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedVA，一个用于医学体数据可视化的端到端神经符号智能体系统，通过意图表述、ROI识别与可视化优化三个互补智能体，缓解纯MLLM推理在临床解释与ROI定位上的不足。
AI.motivation: 医学体绘制需要依据临床意图选择感兴趣区域（ROI）并控制其相对视觉强调，传统流程依赖大量临床与可视化专业知识且需反复试错。现有智能体系统虽引入自然语言交互与自主可视化操作，但整体依赖MLLM推理；MLLM虽具备医学知识与推理能力，却在医学体可视化任务中易产生临床不完整的请求理解以及不可靠的ROI识别与可视化优化。
AI.method: MedVA采用神经符号架构，包含三个互补智能体：（1）神经符号意图表述智能体，在MLLM解释基础上引入既定临床知识的符号推理，生成更完整、临床可依据的ROI规范；（2）多模型ROI识别智能体，利用互补的大规模预训练医学分割模型，直接在原始体数据中定位语义指定的ROI；（3）目标驱动的可视化优化智能体，基于体数据的可见性目标函数，显式评估ROI在原体数据中的可见性与遮挡情况。
AI.result: 在多种医学数据集与交互场景下开展了智能体级与系统级评估，验证了各组成智能体的有效性；形成性用户研究进一步表明，该系统在不同专业水平用户中均具有较高可用性与实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将符号推理、多模型医学分割与显式可见性优化相结合，可有效弥补纯MLLM推理在医学体可视化中的局限，为面向临床意图的ROI定位与视觉强调控制提供可行且易用的端到端方案。

title: PeerPen: AI-Assisted Writing for Online Mental Health Peer Support
summary: Online mental health communities thrive on peer support, yet those who volunteer to help often lack formal training and may struggle to articulate supportive responses. AI co-writing could lower this barrier; however, peer support derives much of its value from being perceived as personal, raising questions around authorship, ownership, and trust. We built PeerPen, a writing assistance tool embedded within a Reddit-like interface, supporting two main features: draft generation and revision of user-written responses. Through semi-structured interviews with 15 participants, we find that PeerPen reduced the burden of composing responses and increased confidence in offering support. Participants wanted AI to assist their writing without taking over authorship and anticipated tensions around authenticity and trust. Such assistance could make authorship uncertain even for responses written without it, weakening trust across the community. We contribute design implications for AI writing assistance that scaffolds supportive communication, preserves authorship, and accounts for community-level trust.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了嵌入Reddit风格界面的AI写作辅助工具PeerPen，支持回复草稿生成与用户回复修订两项功能；通过对15名参与者的半结构化访谈发现，该工具降低了撰写支持性回复的负担并提升了提供支持的信心，但参与者希望AI辅助而不代笔，同时对真实性与信任产生担忧，且这种辅助可能使未使用AI的回复也面临作者身份的不确定，进而削弱社区整体信任。
AI.motivation: 在线心理健康社区依赖同伴支持，但志愿提供帮助者往往缺乏正式训练，难以组织出恰当的支持性回应。AI协同写作有望降低这一门槛，但同伴支持的价值很大程度上来自"被感知为个人化"，这引出作者身份、归属与信任等问题。
AI.method: 研究者开发了PeerPen——一个嵌入类Reddit界面中的写作辅助工具，主要支持两项功能：草稿生成（draft generation）与对用户自撰回复的修订（revision）。随后对15名参与者开展半结构化访谈。
AI.result: PeerPen降低了撰写回复的负担，并提升了参与者提供支持的信心；参与者期望AI辅助写作而非取代作者身份，并预见到真实性与信任方面的张力。即使对于未使用AI撰写的回复，这类辅助也可能使作者身份变得不确定，从而削弱整个社区的信任。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了面向AI写作辅助的设计启示：应以支架式方式促进支持性沟通、保留作者身份，并考虑社区层面的信任影响。

title: Forty Shades of Blue: Quality-Diversity Alignment via Mode-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: A notable byproduct of LLM alignment training is mode collapse: the progressive loss of output diversity that narrows a model's expressivity at inference time. This degradation is especially limiting for applications requiring open-ended exploration and pluralistic perspectives, such as scientific ideation and creative writing. We present MoDA (Mode-conditioned Diversity Alignment), an online post-training RL algorithm that jointly optimizes generation quality and diversity, inspired by the coordination perspective in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). MoDA trains a single shared LLM policy conditioned on abstract numbered roles, where each role acts as an agent competing to produce outputs distinct from the others. This formulation encourages mode-conditioned agents to explore complementary regions of the high-quality output space without requiring hand-crafted personas or architectural modifications. MoDA employs a prompt-adaptive quality gating mechanism that calibrates a reference quality threshold and grants diversity rewards only to responses that meet the threshold, preventing reward-hacking behaviors that compromise response quality. To study quality-diversity tradeoffs, we evaluate MoDA on a comprehensive suite of benchmarks spanning seven general capability tasks and four domain-specific diversity tasks in scientific ideation and creative writing. MoDA improves SBERT diversity by 265% on the Infinite-Chat held-out prompts, while increasing average general capability pass@1 by 10.3% over the Qwen3-8B baseline. Compared with the strongest DivPO baseline, MoDA improves SBERT diversity from 0.274 to 0.482 (+75.9%) and E-Vendi from 2.86 to 4.4 (+53.8%), while improving average general capability pass@1 by 7.0%. Overall, MoDA provides a drop-in alternative to standard post-training methods that preserves and expands the model's expressive output space while improving quality.

AI.tldr: 提出MoDA——一种基于多智能体强化学习协调视角的在线RL后训练算法，通过角色条件化策略与质量门控机制联合优化生成质量与多样性，在保持并提升通用能力的同时显著扩大输出多样性。
AI.motivation: LLM对齐训练带来模式坍塌（mode collapse），输出多样性渐进流失，削弱模型表达的丰富性。此问题在需要开放式探索与多元视角的任务（如科学构思、创意写作）中尤为突出，而标准后训练方法往往以牺牲多样性换取质量。
AI.method: MoDA将单一共享LLM策略条件化于抽象编号角色上，每个角色视为一个智能体，相互竞争产生彼此不同的输出，从而激励各模式条件化智能体探索高质量输出空间的互补区域，无需人工设计人格提示或修改模型架构。同时引入提示自适应质量门控机制：校准参考质量阈值，仅对达到阈值的回复给予多样性奖励，抑制以牺牲质量换取多样性的reward hacking。采用在线后训练RL框架。
AI.result: 在涵盖七项通用能力任务与四项领域多样性任务（科学构思、创意写作）的基准上评估。在Infinite-Chat留出提示上SBERT多样性提升265%，平均通用能力pass@1较Qwen3-8B基线提升10.3%；相较最强基线DivPO，SBERT多样性由0.274升至0.482（+75.9%），E-Vendi由2.86升至4.4（+53.8%），同时平均通用能力pass@1提升7.0%。
AI.conclusion: MoDA可作为标准后训练方法的即插即用替代方案，在提升生成质量的同时保留并扩展模型的表达性输出空间，有效缓解对齐带来的模式坍塌问题。

title: What Makes a 3D Scene Editable? A Factorized Benchmark of Fidelity, Locality, Consistency, and Preservation
summary: Neural 3D scene editing is often evaluated by semantic alignment alone, although a convincing result may alter unrelated content or become inconsistent across views. We introduce EditBench3D, a representation-agnostic benchmark that treats editing as controlled information replacement. It evaluates four complementary properties: instruction fidelity, spatial locality, cross-view consistency, and preservation of non-target content. The protocol combines visibility-aware 3D target supports, paired descriptions, held-out cameras, and five edit families covering appearance, material, geometry, and object-level changes. We evaluate eight representative NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, hybrid, and proxy-based editors on 240 scene-edit pairs. The study shows that semantic fidelity is only weakly associated with the other editing properties, and that no single method is optimal across all dimensions. Explicit Gaussian editors offer a strong overall balance, whereas direct proxy manipulation provides the most conservative edits at the cost of open-ended fidelity. These findings support reporting editability as a multi-objective profile rather than a single semantic score.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EditBench3D，一个与表示无关的神经3D场景编辑基准，将编辑视为受控信息替换，并从四个维度评估八种代表性编辑器在240个场景-编辑对上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有神经3D场景编辑评测多仅依赖语义对齐，但一个看似令人信服的结果可能改变无关内容或在多视角间不一致，因此需要更全面、可控的评测框架。
AI.method: 提出与表示无关的基准 EditBench3D，采用可见性感知的3D目标支持、配对描述、留出相机以及涵盖外观、材质、几何和对象级变化的五类编辑族，对八种代表性编辑器（NeRF、3D高斯泼溅、混合与代理方法）在240个场景-编辑对上进行评测。
AI.result: 实验表明语义保真度与其他编辑属性仅弱相关，且没有单一方法在所有维度上最优；显式高斯编辑器整体平衡性较好，而直接代理操作编辑最保守但开放式保真度受限。
AI.conclusion: 应将可编辑性作为多目标画像而非单一语义分数来报告。

title: Geometric Signatures of Conceptual Reorganization: A Counterfactual Embedding Framework for Detecting Scientific Revolutions
summary: We introduce document embedding geometry as a quantitative observable of conceptual reorganization and develop a counterfactual ablation framework for measuring how individual concepts influence the organization of scientific knowledge, providing a quantitative framework for detecting scientific revolutions. The observable is defined by the geometric perturbation induced when removing documents associated with a candidate concept from the embedding space before and after its historical emergence. Statistical validation is performed using five historical case studies spanning physics, mathematics, and machine learning: special relativity, Gödel's incompleteness theorems, the Higgs mechanism, deep learning, and the attention mechanism underlying transformer architectures. Across the historical case studies, the framework identifies measurable geometric signatures associated with conceptual reorganization, while the validation studies expose important limitations arising from document assignment and sparse historical data. These results establish embedding geometry as a medium for quantifying conceptual reorganization, providing a new approach for studying how scientific fields restructure over time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"文档嵌入几何"作为概念重组的定量可观测量，并构建反事实消融框架，衡量单个概念如何影响科学知识的组织，从而为检测科学革命提供定量手段。
AI.motivation: 科学革命或概念重组通常只能定性描述，缺乏可量化的观测指标；作者希望找到一种能够客观刻画科学知识组织方式变化的定量手段。
AI.method: 定义可观测量为：在候选概念历史出现前后，从嵌入空间中移除与该概念相关文档所引起的几何扰动；并据此设计反事实消融框架，通过五个历史案例（狭义相对论、哥德尔不完备定理、希格斯机制、深度学习、Transformer中的注意力机制）进行统计验证。
AI.result: 在各历史案例中，框架均识别出与概念重组相关的可测量几何特征；同时验证研究也暴露出由文档归属分配和稀疏历史数据带来的重要局限。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入几何可作为量化概念重组的媒介，为研究科学领域如何随时间重构提供了新路径。

title: ThreshGuide: Class-Aware Labeled-Guided Thresholding for Semi-Supervised 3D Abdominal Multi-Organ Segmentation
summary: Pseudo-labeling is a strong paradigm for semi-supervised medical image segmentation, yet its effectiveness is highly sensitive to confidence thresholding. In abdominal multi-organ segmentation, a fixed global threshold is particularly suboptimal because organ classes differ substantially in size, appearance, and learning difficulty. In this work, we propose ThreshGuide, a class-aware threshold adaptation framework that uses labeled data to guide pseudo-label selection on unlabeled data. Built upon a standard teacher-student architecture, the teacher model evaluates labeled samples during training to estimate class-aware threshold targets by maximizing an error-aware F\b{eta} criterion that balances precision and coverage. These targets are then smoothed with an exponential moving average (EMA) and used to filter unlabeled voxels in a class-dependent manner. Experiments on FLARE2022 and AMOS2022 show that ThreshGuide performs competitively overall, yielding clear improvements specifically on hard-to-learn organs.

AI.tldr: 提出ThreshGuide：一种面向类别感知阈值自适应的半监督医学图像分割框架，利用标注数据引导无标注数据的伪标签筛选，在FLARE2022与AMOS2022上对难学器官取得明显改进。
AI.motivation: 伪标签在半监督医学图像分割中效果显著，但对置信度阈值高度敏感。腹部多器官分割中各器官类别在尺寸、外观与学习难度上差异很大，单一全局固定阈值难以适配所有类别，容易造成难学器官的伪标签筛选次优。
AI.method: 基于标准教师-学生架构。教师模型在训练中评估有标注样本，通过最大化兼顾精确率与覆盖率的误差感知F-beta准则，估计类别感知的阈值目标；再用指数移动平均（EMA）对这些阈值目标进行平滑，最终按类别对无标注体素进行伪标签过滤，实现类别相关的阈值自适应。
AI.result: 在FLARE2022和AMOS2022数据集上整体表现具有竞争力，尤其在难学器官上取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 以标注数据指导、按类别自适应调整伪标签阈值的策略，可有效缓解固定全局阈值在多器官分割中的局限，提升难学器官的分割性能。

title: Can We Triage LLM Translation Errors in Classical Texts Without Human References? Source Novelty, GEMBA Scoring, and Budgeted Review through Pali-to-English Translation
comment: Preprint. This article has not yet been peer reviewed
summary: As large language models become capable translators of classical texts, a key challenge is deciding which outputs need expert review when no human reference exists. This study tests reference-free error triage through Pali-to-English translation. Three LLMs translated 15,493 passages. Five signals were compared: source novelty, source-candidate embedding distance, peer-translation disagreement, English-to-Pali backtranslation, and no-reference GEMBA scoring. Signals were calibrated on a 3,000-item reference-informed LLM-adjudicated sample and checked against a 500-item author-adjudicated anchor. Human references supported calibration and validation only; they were never used to compute the risk signals. Source novelty was a useful source-side risk prior but not a per-candidate error detector. Peer disagreement and backtranslation provided secondary signal. The strongest method was no-reference GEMBA scoring by a panel of models generally regarded as stronger than the translators: reviewing the top 10% by GEMBA risk captured 81.6% of panel-major errors in the calibration set. GEMBA also remained the best reference-free signal against the author anchor. A same-tier panel, with self-scoring excluded, remained useful but performed worse, indicating that evaluator strength matters beyond the prompt alone. A budgeted workflow is proposed, combining source novelty, peer disagreement, and stronger candidate-aware judging to allocate human review. Transfer to other classical languages, including Latin, Ancient Greek, and Sanskrit, remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过巴利语-英语翻译任务，测试在无人工参考译文条件下进行错误分流的可行性，发现由更强模型组成的无参考GEMBA评分面板是最有效的风险信号。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已能翻译古典文本，但在缺乏人工参考译文时，如何判断哪些输出需要专家复核成为关键难题，因此需要评估无参考条件下的错误分流方法。
AI.method: 三个大语言模型翻译了15,493个段落，比较五种信号：源文本新颖度、源文本-候选译文的嵌入距离、同伴译文分歧度、英译巴利语反向翻译，以及无参考GEMBA评分。信号在3,000条由LLM基于参考裁决的样本上校准，并在500条作者裁决的锚定样本上验证；人工参考仅用于校准与验证，从未参与风险信号计算。
AI.result: 源文本新颖度是有用的源端风险先验，但并非逐候选错误检测器；同伴分歧与反向翻译提供次级信号。最强方法是由公认为更强模型组成的面板进行无参考GEMBA评分：按GEMBA风险审核前10%可捕获校准集中81.6%的面板多数错误，且在作者锚定样本上仍是最佳无参考信号。排除自评分的同级面板仍有效但表现更差，说明评估者能力本身也影响效果。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种预算受限的工作流，结合源文本新颖度、同伴分歧与更强的候选感知评判来分配人工复核资源；该方法向拉丁语、古希腊语和梵语等其他古典语言的迁移性仍有待检验。

title: MoVT: Video-Augmented Motion Tokenizer for Text-to-Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven 3D human motion generation models face significant challenges in responding to diverse and unconstrained textual prompts, primarily due to the limited availability of 3D motion training data. To address this, we introduce MoVT, a novel framework that effectively leverages the extensive range of human action videos to enhance text-to-motion generation. At the core of our approach is the cross-modal augmented motion tokenizer, which projects discrete 3D motion tokens into the 2D domain. This projection allows us to enrich the motion codebook with complex, real-world motion patterns derived from videos. The enriched discrete tokens are then mapped back to the 3D domain, resulting in aligned 3D and 2D codebooks with an enhanced capacity to represent intricate motions. These enhanced codebooks are integrated into a generative masked transformer, which predicts masked motion token indices in a modality-agnostic manner. This enables the use of text-index pairs, generated from the 2D codebook and annotated motion videos, to further enhance the generator. Extensive empirical evaluations show that MoVT performs favorably against prior state-of-the-art methods across multiple key metrics.

AI.tldr: MoVT：利用人体动作视频增强文本到3D动作生成，通过跨模态增强动作分词器对齐2D/3D码本，并用掩码Transformer实现模态无关生成。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动的3D人体动作生成在面对多样、无约束文本提示时表现不足，核心瓶颈是3D动作训练数据稀缺。作者希望利用大量易获得的人体动作视频来弥补这一数据缺口。
AI.method: 提出MoVT框架。核心为跨模态增强动作分词器，将离散3D动作token投影到2D域，用视频中复杂真实动作模式丰富动作码本，再映射回3D域，得到对齐且表达能力更强的3D-2D码本。增强码本接入生成式掩码Transformer，以模态无关方式预测被掩码的动作token索引，从而可利用由2D码本与标注视频生成的文本-索引对进一步训练生成器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MoVT在多个关键指标上优于此前的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨模态码本对齐与掩码生成，MoVT有效借助视频数据提升文本到3D动作生成能力，验证了利用2D动作视频缓解3D数据稀缺的可行性。

title: A Corpus-Aligned Uthmani-to-Standard Quranic Word Mapping and a Deterministic Recitation Validator
comment: 6 pages, 4 tables. Dataset, code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/NightPrinceY/muslim-quran-validator
summary: Quranic text is distributed in two orthographic forms that are byte-level distinct: the Uthmani script used in every printed mushaf, and the Standard (Imla'i) Arabic form that every mainstream Arabic NLP tool is built for. The gap is concentrated in one Unicode character, U+0670 (superscript alef), which appears in some of the most frequently recited words in the Quran and is silently mishandled by general-purpose Arabic normalizers. We release a 2,290-pair, corpus-aligned Uthmani-to-Standard word mapping constructed by aligning the complete 6,236-verse Quran across both orthographic forms, together with a seven-step text normalization pipeline built on it. Normalizing both forms of all 6,236 verses through that pipeline yields identical strings for 90.9% of verses, and we characterize the residual divergence rather than assert that it is closed. On top of the normalized text, we build a deterministic, LLM-free Quranic recitation validator using a four-layer verse-matching search (exact, morphological, relaxed, fuzzy) and word-error-rate-graded feedback across five severity tiers. The validator scores 98.4% (122/124) on a 124-case suite emitted by the released test harness, and both failures share one mechanism: a single substitution error can make a different verse an exact match. A full-corpus census additionally quantifies an inherent text-only ambiguity affecting 16.5% of verses, and on 34 recitation transcripts drawn from a deployed Arabic ASR system the validator identifies the correct verse in every case. We release the mapping, the script that builds it, the validator, and the evaluation harness under open licenses; every number in this paper except the deployment measurement, whose transcripts are not ours to publish, is reproduced by running them.

AI.tldr: 论文发布2,290对奥斯曼体—标准体词映射与七步归一化流水线，使6,236节经文中90.9%两种正字法归一化结果完全一致；并构建无LLM的诵经校验器，测试集得分98.4%（122/124），全经普查量化16.5%节次存在固有纯文本歧义。
AI.motivation: 古兰经文本以两种字节级不同的正字法形式存在：印刷经书使用的奥斯曼体（Uthmani）与主流阿拉伯语NLP工具支持的标准（Imla'i）体。二者差异集中于Unicode字符U+0670（上标alef），该字符出现在部分最高频诵读词中，却被通用阿拉伯语归一化器静默错误处理，形成工具适配缺口。
AI.method: 通过对齐同一6,236节古兰经的两种正字法形式，构建2,290对语料对齐的奥斯曼体—标准体词映射，并基于此设计七步文本归一化流水线。在归一化文本之上，构建确定性、不依赖LLM的诵经校验器，采用四层节次匹配搜索（精确、形态、松弛、模糊）与五级严重度分层的词错误率评分反馈。
AI.result: 两种形式经归一化后90.9%节次字符串完全一致，并刻画其余分歧而非宣称已闭合；校验器在124例测试套件上得分98.4%（122/124），两例失败共享同一机制：单次替换错误可使另一节次成为精确匹配；全经普查量化16.5%节次受固有纯文本歧义影响；在来自已部署阿拉伯语ASR系统的34份诵经转写中，校验器全部识别出正确节次。
AI.conclusion: 研究以开放许可发布词映射、构建脚本、校验器与评测框架，除因转写不便公开的部署测量外，论文所有数值均可通过运行所发布工具复现；研究定位为刻画而非消除两种正字法间的残余分歧。

title: Online Language Adaptive Sampling for Better Distributed Cross-lingual Gains
summary: Realignment is a promising approach for improving the cross-lingual transfer ability of multilingual language models, particularly for extremely low-resource languages (LRLs). However, existing realignment methods rely on uniform and random sampling of parallel sentences across languages, which may be suboptimal under limited batch sizes. In practice, models may benefit from seeing certain languages more frequently, especially those that are poorly aligned, and the optimal distribution can evolve throughout training. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective adaptive sampling strategy that assigns trainable sampling probabilities to each language. Languages that contribute more to the realignment loss are sampled more frequently in subsequent batches, and the optimal distribution can evolve throughout training. Our method employs an inner-outer optimization loop with a small overhead, leading to consistent performance improvements and, more importantly, distributing the gains across languages. We observed a $+0.67$ average performance increase on all tasks with XLM-R, and $+0.60$ with Gemma 2 9B compared with uniform realignment. Furthermore, our method is robust across different models. Code available at https://github.com/felixgaschi/multilingual-alignment-and-transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应采样策略改进多语言模型的跨语言对齐(realignment),按语言贡献动态调整采样概率,在极低资源语言上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有realignment方法在所有语言上采用均匀、随机的并行句采样,在有限batch size下可能次优;实际上对齐较差的语言需要被更频繁采样,且最优分布会随训练演化。
AI.method: 为每种语言分配可训练的采样概率,对realignment损失贡献更大的语言在后续batch中被更频繁采样;采用内外层优化循环(inner-outer optimization),仅带来少量额外开销。
AI.result: XLM-R上所有任务平均提升+0.67,Gemma 2 9B上提升+0.60(相比均匀realignment);收益能跨语言均匀分配,且方法对不同模型具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应采样可有效改善多语言模型的跨语言迁移能力,尤其惠及极低资源语言,且实现简单、开销小、可推广。

title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
summary: We present PhysBrain 1.5, a unified model for understanding physical environments, generating actions, and predicting future states. Motivated by the physical loop of observation, interaction, and environmental change, we bring these capabilities into a common learning framework. Starting from a general vision--language model, we encode language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete sequences and jointly optimize them with autoregressive next-token prediction. Pre-training draws its embodied supervision entirely from human interaction videos, using task-centered episodes to pair semantic and spatial context with recovered motion and subsequent observations. We then adapt the model through supervised fine-tuning on a mixture of human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and simulated experience. Across 28 embodied understanding benchmarks, our 8B model achieves an average score of 72.5, setting a new open-source state of the art and performing on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-6-Astra and Gemini 3.6 Flash. It achieves the best open-source results on 14 benchmarks while retaining general multimodal capabilities. Beyond these understanding evaluations, qualitative examples show the model's ability to produce end-effector trajectories and predict future scenes through spatially aligned RGB, depth, and robot-mask outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysBrain 1.5 统一模型，将语言、末端执行器运动与稠密视觉目标编码为离散序列，用自回归下一词预测联合优化，仅用人类交互视频预训练，8B 模型在 28 个具身理解基准上均分 72.5，开源 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 受"观察—交互—环境改变"这一物理闭环启发，作者希望把环境理解、动作生成与未来状态预测三类能力纳入统一学习框架，并解决具身监督数据稀缺问题（仅依赖人类交互视频获取监督信号）。
AI.method: 以通用视觉-语言模型为起点，将语言回复、末端执行器运动、稠密视觉目标统一编码为离散 token 序列，通过自回归下一 token 预测联合优化；预训练从人类交互视频中以"任务为中心"的片段配对语义/空间上下文与恢复出的运动及后续观测；再用人类演示、机器人轨迹与仿真经验的混合数据进行监督微调。
AI.result: 在 28 个具身理解基准上平均分 72.5，刷新开源 SOTA，与 GPT-6-Astra、Gemini 3.6 Flash 等领先闭源模型持平；在 14 个基准上取得最佳开源结果，同时保留通用多模态能力；定性示例显示模型可生成末端执行器轨迹，并通过空间对齐的 RGB、深度与机器人掩码输出预测未来场景。
AI.conclusion: 将理解、动作生成与未来状态预测统一为离散序列建模任务，可由人类视频预训练加混合数据微调实现，验证了该框架在具身理解与预测上的有效性与通用性。

title: Converting Sequenced Fuzzy Cognitive Maps to Causal Virtual Worlds with Large Video Generators
comment: 9 Figures. For the generated FCM Dolphin-Shark video, see https://sipi.usc.edu/~kosko/FCM-Dolphin-Shark-Video-SMC-2026.mp4
summary: We show how users can create and manipulate causal virtual worlds with large-language-model (LLM) and large-video-model agents. The approach uses feedback fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) both to model the granular causal structure of the virtual world and to guide its causal evolution. The local causal rules are partial or fuzzy while the FCM's feedback structure produces global equilibria that define causal scenarios. A sequence of \emph{dynamical} meta-rules of the form ``If $\mathcal{A}$ then $\mathcal{B}$" define the causal scenes of the virtual-world video. The if-part causal pattern $\mathcal{A}$ perturbs the FCM's virtual world at the user's or agent's discretion. The FCM's transient feedback dynamics define the meta-rule's causal arrow of implication. The then-part $\mathcal{B}$ is the resulting equilibrium attractor such as a FCM limit cycle or fixed point. Our algorithm extracts these meta-rules from the FCM and guides the LLM agent to write a script based on the FCM meta-rule sequence. The large video generator converts the meta-rule into a video scene in accord with the flow of the dynamics. We applied the agent-based technique to a simple FCM that describes an undersea world of dolphins and sharks. Google's Gemini 3.1 generated the script and Google's Veo 3.1 generated the dolphin-shark video. The approach is general and can scale by mixing larger FCMs and AI agents to produce more immersive virtual worlds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用反馈模糊认知图（FCM）建模虚拟世界的因果结构与演化，并结合大语言模型和大视频模型智能体，自动生成因果虚拟世界视频。
AI.motivation: 现有虚拟世界生成方法往往缺乏细粒度的因果结构建模，难以刻画由局部模糊规则涌现出的全局因果场景。本文希望借助FCM的反馈动力学来表征因果演化，并利用LLM与视频生成智能体将这种因果结构自动转化为可交互、可扩展的沉浸式虚拟世界。
AI.method: 以反馈FCM同时建模虚拟世界的细粒度因果结构并引导其因果演化，局部因果规则为部分或模糊规则，反馈结构产生界定因果场景的全局均衡。用形如"If A then B"的动力学元规则序列定义虚拟世界视频的因果场景：if部分因果模式A扰动FCM虚拟世界，FCM的瞬态反馈动力学构成元规则的因果蕴含箭头，then部分B为结果均衡吸引子（如极限环或不动点）。算法从FCM中提取这些元规则，引导LLM智能体据此编写脚本，再由大视频生成器按动力学流将元规则转换为视频场景。
AI.result: 将该基于智能体的方法应用于一个描述海豚与鲨鱼的海底世界简单FCM，由Google的Gemini 3.1生成脚本、Veo 3.1生成海豚-鲨鱼视频，验证了方法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法具有通用性，可通过混合更大规模的FCM与AI智能体进行扩展，以生成更具沉浸感的虚拟世界。

title: Biomedical Reference Generation Remains Unreliable across 26 Large Language Models
summary: Background. Large language models are increasingly used to help write biomedical text but may fabricate references to nonexistent work. How often large language models do so is not well characterized. Methods. We prompted 26 language models from eight developers (2023 to 2026) to supply a missing reference for each of 69 biomedical passages across ten domains. References were classified as verifiable (real paper with a resolving identifier), partial matches (real paper without a resolving identifier), fabricated (no matching indexed paper), or declined (the model refused to supply a reference). A reference was considered correct in every evaluated bibliographic field only when it was verifiable and its journal, year, and listed authors matched those of the cited paper. Results. Fabrication ranged from 10.2% (Claude Opus 4.8, which declined 52.1% of prompts) to 98.4% (Ministral 3B, which produced no verifiable reference). Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 produced similar proportions of verifiable references (77.6% and 76.6%) but named authors correctly in 78.7% and 28.7% of author-evaluable verifiable references, respectively, and were correct in every evaluated field in 54.6% and 19.9% of responses. GPT-5.5 was correct in every field in 48.1%. Across all models, 55.4% of responses were fabricated and 14.9% were correct in every field. Among the five tested models first released in 2026, the corresponding proportions were 35.3% and 31.8%, respectively. Conclusions. Fabrication remained common, and no model was correct in every evaluated bibliographic field in more than 54.6% of responses. Models that identify real papers may still misstate their metadata, so references produced with model assistance require verification before use.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评测了8家开发商的26个大语言模型为69段生物医学文本补充参考文献的表现。整体上55.4%的响应属于捏造，仅14.9%在所有被评字段上完全正确。即使在能给出真实文献的模型中，著录元数据（期刊、年份、作者）也常出错，因此模型生成的参考文献必须经人工核验。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被日益广泛用于辅助撰写生物医学文本，但其可能捏造不存在的文献；此类"文献幻觉"的发生频率此前缺乏系统、量化的刻画，亟需跨模型、跨时间的大规模评估以明确风险程度。
AI.method: 从8家开发商选取2023至2026年间发布的26个语言模型；针对涵盖10个领域的69段生物医学文本，逐一提示模型补全缺失的参考文献。将输出归类为：可验证（真实文献且标识符可解析）、部分匹配（真实文献但标识符不可解析）、捏造（无对应索引文献）、拒答。仅当文献可验证且期刊、年份、所列作者均与被引文献一致时，才判定为在所有被评字段上正确。
AI.result: 捏造率从10.2%（Claude Opus 4.8，但拒答率达52.1%）到98.4%（Ministral 3B，未产出任何可验证文献）。Claude Opus 4.6与Claude Sonnet 4.5的可验证文献比例相近（77.6%对76.6%），但在可评估作者的记录中作者姓名正确率分别为78.7%和28.7%，全字段正确率分别为54.6%和19.9%；GPT-5.5全字段正确率为48.1%。总体看，55.4%的响应为捏造，14.9%全字段正确；2026年首批发布的5个模型对应比例为35.3%和31.8%。
AI.conclusion: 文献捏造仍普遍存在，且没有任何模型在全字段正确率上超过54.6%。即便模型能识别真实文献，也可能错误陈述其著录元数据。模型辅助生成的参考文献在使用前必须经过核验。

title: Typhoon ASR Streaming: Steerable Low-Latency Thai Speech Recognition with Real-Time Shallow Fusion
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to IEEE SLT 2026 (Demo Track)
summary: Open Thai automatic speech recognition (ASR) is dominated by offline, Whisper-based models that read the whole utterance before transcribing, ruling out low-latency uses such as live captioning and voice agents. We present a deployable system for streaming Thai ASR that lets a user steer its vocabulary at decode time, without retraining. A widely used open Thai model, trained with full context, collapses when run as a true stream; we restore streaming with a cache-aware encoder, by converting it or adapting a natively streaming one, and add a shallow-fusion layer that re-ranks candidates inside the streaming decoder with a GPU n-gram language model and phrase boosting. Across two Thai benchmarks and two model sizes, the streaming models stay usable where the full-context model fails, cutting character error rate 4.3-4.5x at a one-second look-ahead while running faster than real time. Decode-time steering then lifts keyword recall from 16.6% to 20.7% at no accuracy cost and negligible overhead; most of the gain comes from an n-gram over ordinary training transcripts, which resolves the written form of code-switched words the model hears but spells inconsistently, with phrase boosting adding targeted control over rare domain terms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可部署的泰语流式ASR系统：将基于Whisper的泰语模型转为缓存感知的流式编码器或改用原生流式模型，并在流式解码器中加入浅融合层，实现了1秒前瞻下的低延迟识别（CER降低4.3–4.5倍，速度快于实时），还支持解码时的词汇调控（关键词召回从16.6%升至20.7%）。
AI.motivation: 开源泰语ASR以离线Whisper类模型为主，需读完整句才能转写，无法满足实时字幕、语音助手等低延迟场景需求；且现有模型训练时用全上下文，直接流式运行会崩溃，同时用户无法在解码时定制词汇。
AI.method: 通过缓存感知的编码器恢复流式能力（将全上下文模型转换或改用原生流式模型），并在流式解码器中加入浅融合层，使用GPU n-gram语言模型与短语增强对候选结果重排序，实现无需重训练的解码时词汇调控。
AI.result: 在两个泰语基准和两种模型规模上，流式模型在1秒前瞻下仍可用（全上下文模型则失败），字符错误率降低4.3–4.5倍且运行快于实时；解码时调控将关键词召回从16.6%提升至20.7%，无精度损失、开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 流式泰语ASR可在低延迟条件下稳定工作，且解码时词汇调控有效，其收益主要来自基于普通训练转写文本的n-gram（解决代码转换词的书写不一致问题），短语增强则对罕见领域术语提供针对性控制。

title: MTAC-IFBench: Benchmarking Instruction-Following in Multi-Turn Agentic Coding
summary: Recently, the rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has reshaped software engineering by enabling autonomous code agents that plan, execute, and utilize external tools iteratively to tackle complex tasks. Beyond achieving functional correctness, these agents must faithfully follow process instructions and constraints throughout the development lifecycle. However, existing benchmarks typically focus on final functional correctness or confine instruction-following evaluation to single-turn, general chat or simple code generation scenarios, leaving instruction-following in multi-turn agentic coding underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose MTAC-IFBench, a comprehensive benchmark for this critical capability. It features multi-turn progressive software development instructions with diverse constraints spanning 6 primary and 18 secondary categories. With an average of 7.04 turns and 91.33 constraints per instance, it poses a rigorous challenge to current LLMs. To make the evaluation reliable, we construct a checklist for each constraint and functional requirement, and integrate verification scripts and judge agents to verify each checklist item. MTAC-IFBench identifies significant deficiencies in existing code agents in multi-turn instruction-following, with their performance degrading rapidly as the interaction session grows longer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MTAC-IFBench，一个面向多轮智能体编码的指令遵循能力评测基准，平均每实例7.04轮、91.33条约束，覆盖6大主类与18个子类约束，揭示现有代码智能体在长会话中指令遵循性能快速下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多关注最终功能正确性，或将指令遵循评估局限于单轮、通用对话或简单代码生成场景，忽视了多轮智能体编码中贯穿开发生命周期的过程指令与约束遵循能力。
AI.method: 构建MTAC-IFBench：设计多轮渐进式软件开发指令，涵盖6主类18子类约束；为每条约束与功能需求生成检查清单，并结合验证脚本与评判智能体逐项核验，以保证评测可靠性。
AI.result: 基准平均每实例7.04轮交互、91.33条约束，对当前大模型构成严格挑战；实验表明现有代码智能体在多轮指令遵循上存在显著不足，且随会话轮次增加性能迅速退化。
AI.conclusion: 多轮智能体编码的指令遵循是被低估但关键的能力维度，MTAC-IFBench为可靠评测该能力提供了系统性方案，并暴露了现有代码智能体的明显短板。

title: Intelligence Under Time Constraints: Rethinking Test-Time Compute
summary: Intelligence under time constraints requires deciding not only how much to compute, but when computation is worth starting. We study this problem in streaming interactions, where evidence arrives incrementally and may be revised. Early computation has more time to finish but rests on incomplete evidence; waiting improves information while shrinking computational slack. We call this the information-slack dilemma. We take the evidence-dependent computational job as the unit of analysis: when to start it, what supports its result, and when that result can be committed. Advance computation is valuable only insofar as its benefits survive the costs of verification, invalidation, and recovery. This applies to grounded incremental processing and reusable preparation as well as future-dependent speculation. We propose a research agenda on computation under evolving evidence, prioritizing selective recovery under controlled evidence revisions. Evaluation should separate earlier-execution effects, deployment value against a full-input alternative, and the added value of predictive policies, while accounting for shared-resource costs. The objective is not maximal advance computation, but more trustworthy, on-time responses within a declared resource envelope.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出"信息-余量困境"：流式交互中提前计算可赢得时间但依赖不完整证据，等待则信息更好但计算余量缩小。作者以"证据依赖型计算任务"为分析单元（何时启动、结果由何支撑、何时可提交），强调提前计算的价值取决于其收益能否覆盖验证、失效与恢复成本，并提出以"受控证据修正下的选择性恢复"为优先的研究议程，主张评估应区分提前执行效应、相对全输入方案的部署价值及预测策略的增量价值。
AI.motivation: 在时间约束下运行的智能系统不仅要决定"算多少"，还要决定"何时开始算"。流式交互中证据逐步到达且可能被修订：早算时间充裕但证据不全，晚算信息更充分但计算余量被压缩，形成信息与计算资源之间的核心张力（信息-余量困境），而现有研究缺乏对这一启动时机问题的统一刻画与评估框架。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/议程类论文，而非提出具体算法。其方法为概念化建模：以"证据依赖型计算任务"为单位，围绕三个问题展开——何时启动计算、结果由何种证据支撑、结果何时可被提交（commit）。在此基础上把提前计算视为一种投资，要求其收益能覆盖验证（verification）、失效（invalidation）与恢复（recovery）三类成本，并据此将已有实践（有依据的增量处理、可复用的预处理、面向未来的推测执行）统一到同一分析框架下。
AI.result: 论文给出的是研究议程而非实验数据。核心论断包括：提前计算并非越多越好，其价值取决于收益能否在验证、失效与恢复成本之后仍然存活；因此应优先研究"受控证据修正下的选择性恢复"机制。在评估层面，提出三类应被分离测量的效应：早期执行本身带来的效应、相对"等待全部输入"基线方案的部署价值、以及预测性策略相对于非预测策略的增量价值，同时必须计入共享资源带来的成本与外部性。
AI.conclusion: 目标不是最大化提前计算量，而是在明确声明的资源包络内实现更可信、更准时的响应。该摘要为流式场景下的计算调度提供了统一术语与分析维度，将研究重心从"抢先算"转向"算得值、算得住、算得可恢复"，并强调评估需可分解、可比较、可归因。

title: ABSOL: Aggregated Bayesian Subsampling Orchestrated with LLMs
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as natural-language interfaces to structured data, yet they remain unreliable when answers require consistent evidence conditioning, dependency-aware reasoning, and uncertainty estimation. Bayesian networks provide an explicit probabilistic reasoning layer, but learning useful structures from data remains costly and fragile at scale. We introduce ABSOL, a hybrid LLM-guided Bayesian network structure-learning framework that uses LLMs as bounded semantic guides. Across five discrete BN benchmarks spanning 27 to 1041 nodes, ABSOL is the only evaluated method to produce a viable graph on every benchmark, and achieves the highest Edge F_1 on every benchmark larger than 27 nodes with GPT-5.4. The four LLM augmentations, which contribute complementary semantic evidence to the statistical backbone, improve Edge F_1 over the non-LLM aggregation backbone by +0.23 on average. Complementary post-hoc refinement experiments suggest that these gains depend in part on limiting the LLM's authority over the final structure. Together, these results show that language-derived semantic knowledge can substantially improve scalable probabilistic structure learning when used as bounded guidance within a statistically grounded reasoning pipeline. The code for ABSOL is available at github.com/megagonlabs/absol-bn.

AI.tldr: ABSOL 是一个由 LLM 引导的贝叶斯网络结构学习框架，将 LLM 作为"受限语义指导"，在五个离散 BN 基准上均生成可用图，并在大于 27 个节点的基准上取得最高 Edge F1。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为结构化数据的自然语言接口时，在需要一致证据条件化、依赖感知推理和不确定性估计的场景下仍不可靠。贝叶斯网络可提供显式概率推理层，但从数据中学习有用结构在大规模下成本高且脆弱。作者希望结合语言语义知识与统计学习，提升可扩展的 BN 结构学习。
AI.method: 提出 ABSOL 混合框架，以 LLM 作为有界的语义指南，向统计骨干网络注入语义证据。框架包含四种 LLM 增强方式，为统计聚合主干提供互补的语义证据；并进行事后细化（post-hoc refinement）实验以检验 LLM 权限边界的影响。评估覆盖五个离散 BN 基准，节点规模从 27 到 1041。
AI.result: ABSOL 是唯一在全部基准上都能生成可行图的受评方法；在使用 GPT-5.4 时，在每一个大于 27 节点的基准上取得最高 Edge F1。四种 LLM 增强相比非 LLM 聚合主干平均提升 Edge F1 约 +0.23。事后细化实验表明，这些收益部分依赖于限制 LLM 对最终结构的决定权。
AI.conclusion: 语言衍生的语义知识在以"受限指导"形式嵌入且统计基础的推理流程中时，能够显著改善可扩展的概率结构学习。代码已开源（github.com/megagonlabs/absol-bn）。

title: G-ray: Ray-Level Relative Geometric Position Encoding in Multi-View Vision Transformers under Camera Heterogeneity
comment: 26 pages, 13 figures, 14 tables. Supplementary material included in the appendix. Project page: https://g-ray-project.github.io/
summary: We study relative position encoding for multi-view vision Transformers under camera heterogeneity, including varying fields of view (FoVs) or projection models. Existing rotary relative position encodings commonly use image-plane positional coordinates, producing projection-dependent relative phases and inconsistent geometric cues for cross-projection attention. We introduce G-ray, a ray-level relative position encoding whose rotary phases are parameterized by camera-local ray angles. The same camera-local ray pair induces the same relative phase across projections, providing projection-invariant positional consistency. G-ray can be used directly or integrated with existing encodings, retaining complementary geometric cues without additional learned parameters. We validate G-ray in three host encodings, RoPE, GTA, and RayRoPE, across 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis (NVS). Across three heterogeneous 3D reconstruction benchmarks at 50 views, G-ray leads all six averaged metrics and reduces mean pointmap relative error by 45.8% over MapAnything, with calibration supplied to both. Trained exclusively on homogeneous pinhole images, the 3D reconstruction model handles mixed pinhole and non-pinhole inputs without retraining and remains competitive on homogeneous pinhole 3D reconstruction protocols. For NVS, GTA and RayRoPE improve with G-ray under joint viewpoint and FoV variation. The project's webpage is available at https://g-ray-project.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 G-ray：以相机局部射线角参数化旋转相位的射线级相对位置编码，实现跨投影不变的几何一致性，可即插即用集成到现有编码中，在异构相机多视图 3D 重建与 NVS 上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 多视图视觉 Transformer 面临相机异构（不同视场角或投影模型）问题。现有旋转式相对位置编码基于图像平面坐标，导致跨投影注意力中相对相位依赖投影方式、几何线索不一致。作者希望获得一种投影不变的相对位置表示，使同一相机局部射线对在不同投影下产生相同相对相位。
AI.method: 提出 G-ray，一种射线级相对位置编码：其旋转相位由相机局部射线角度参数化，因此同一相机局部射线对在任意投影下诱导相同的相对相位，具备投影不变的位置一致性。G-ray 既可直接使用，也可与现有编码（RoPE、GTA、RayRoPE）组合，保留互补几何线索且不引入额外可学习参数。在三种宿主编码、3D 重建与 NVS 任务上验证。
AI.result: 在三个异构 3D 重建基准（50 视角）上，G-ray 在全部六项平均指标中领先，相比 MapAnything（双方均提供标定）将平均 pointmap 相对误差降低 45.8%。仅在均匀针孔图像上训练的 3D 重建模型，无需重训练即可处理针孔与非针孔混合输入，并在均匀针孔协议上保持竞争力。对于 NVS，GTA 与 RayRoPE 在视角与 FoV 联合变化下经 G-ray 均有提升。
AI.conclusion: G-ray 通过射线角参数化旋转相位，实现了投影不变的相对位置编码，可无缝集成到现有编码中且不增加参数，显著提升异构相机多视图 3D 重建与 NVS 性能，并展现出良好的跨投影泛化能力。

title: SALUTE: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for the Defense Domain
summary: Defense is a knowledge-intensive domain that requires precise understanding of specialized terminology, doctrinal concepts, operational procedures, and evolving military events. Although recent work has explored language technologies for military applications, existing efforts remain fragmented: they are often task-specific, rely on limited adaptation pipelines, or lack comprehensive defense-domain evaluation. In this paper, we present SALUTE, an end-to-end framework for benchmarking and adapting LLMs for the defense domain. SALUTE integrates Salute-Corpus, a curated corpus from open-access U.S. military doctrine and government documents; Salute-Conv, a grounded instruction dataset from doctrinal sources and decade-long defense news; Salute-Pref, a defense-aware preference dataset; and Salute-Bench, a rigorously filtered benchmark for evaluating defense-domain understanding and reasoning over doctrine and defense news. Based on these resources, we train Salute-LLM through multi-stage post-training with continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and preference alignment. Extensive experiments show that Salute-LLM achieves strong defense-domain performance while retaining competitive general capabilities, demonstrating the effectiveness of SALUTE as an end-to-end framework for defense-domain LLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALUTE，一个面向国防领域大语言模型评测与适配的端到端框架，整合语料、指令、偏好与基准四类资源，并通过多阶段后训练得到Salute-LLM。
AI.motivation: 国防领域知识密集，需精确理解专业术语、条令概念与作战流程；现有军事语言技术研究较为碎片化，多为任务特定、适配流程有限，且缺乏全面的国防领域评测。
AI.method: SALUTE整合四个资源：Salute-Corpus（来自公开美国军事条令与政府文档的精选语料）、Salute-Conv（基于条令来源与十年国防新闻的接地指令数据集）、Salute-Pref（国防感知偏好数据集）、Salute-Bench（严格过滤的基准，评测条令与国防新闻的理解与推理）。基于此，采用持续预训练、监督微调与偏好对齐的多阶段后训练训练Salute-LLM。
AI.result: 大量实验表明Salute-LLM在国防领域取得强劲性能，同时保持有竞争力的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: SALUTE可作为国防领域LLM适配的有效端到端框架。

title: TwinICL: Diagnosing Multimodal In-Context Learning through Paired Counterfactuals
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables models to infer tasks from demonstrations, but existing benchmarks generally lack matched text and image versions needed to compare ICL performance across modalities. We introduce TwinICL, a procedurally generated benchmark providing such pairs for controlled comparison. Across six open-weight models and 38 tasks, multimodal ICL consistently underperforms text-only ICL, with gaps varying by task family. To test whether this gap can be recovered, we target visual access, task framing, and reasoning through three interventions. Their combination recovers strong multimodal ICL performance on a diagnostic subset, despite limited or inconsistent individual effects. To distinguish difficulties in executing tasks from those in inferring them, we evaluate models with explicit task instructions, revealing a modality gap even when the task is known. We then examine how adding demonstration inputs and outputs reshapes this gap, highlighting demonstrations' dual role as additional context to process and evidence about the task. The dataset is available at https://github.com/lab-flair/TwinICL.

AI.tldr: TwinICL：程序化生成的配对文本-图像基准，用于受控比较跨模态ICL。多模态ICL在6个模型、38个任务上普遍弱于纯文本ICL。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL基准缺乏配对的文本与图像版本，无法在同一任务上受控比较跨模态ICL表现，因此难以判断模态差异的来源。
AI.method: 构建TwinICL程序化基准，提供文本-图像配对版本；在6个开源权重模型、38个任务上评测；针对视觉可及性、任务框架、推理三个方面设计三种干预；并利用显式任务指令区分"执行任务"与"推断任务"的困难；进一步分析添加演示输入/输出对模态差距的影响。
AI.result: 多模态ICL一致弱于纯文本ICL，差距随任务族变化；单项干预效果有限或不一致，但三者组合在诊断子集上可恢复较强的多模态ICL表现；即使给出显式任务指令，仍存在模态差距；演示的输入与输出会重塑该差距。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态ICL差距不仅源于任务推断困难，也存在于任务已知的执行阶段；演示兼具"额外上下文"与"任务证据"的双重角色；组合式干预可部分弥合差距。数据集已开源。

title: Pick Your Poison: Learning to Select Poison Sets for Stronger LLM Backdoor Attacks
summary: Backdoor poisoning attacks add poisoned examples to otherwise-clean finetuning data, pairing a trigger with a target behavior that the model learns to produce when the trigger appears. Existing evaluations typically fix the number of poisoned examples and sample them at random from a candidate pool. We show that this can severely underestimate worst-case vulnerability: across three LLaMA-3-8B backdoor settings, holding the model, clean data, and poison count fixed, attack success ranges from 3% to 80% depending only on which poison set is chosen. We formalize poison selection as oracle-budgeted set optimization and introduce SAILS (Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection), which learns a set scorer from a few hundred finetune-and-evaluate runs, ranks millions of candidate sets, and audits only a small shortlist. SAILS improves held-out attack success by 30 percentage points on average over the strongest influence baselines, transfers from small-scale to full-scale finetuning, and extends to code-generation, agentic, and API-only backdoors.

AI.tldr: 现有后门投毒评估固定毒样本数量并随机采样，严重低估最坏情况脆弱性（ASR 3%–80%）。本文将毒样本选择形式化为 oracle 预算受限的集合优化，提出 SAILS 方法，在多项设定下将留出攻击成功率平均提升 30 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 以往后门投毒攻击评估通常固定投毒样本数量，并从候选池中随机采样。作者发现这种做法的缺陷：在模型、干净数据、投毒数量均固定时，仅因所选毒样本集合不同，攻击成功率就从 3% 变化到 80%，说明随机采样会严重低估最坏情况下的脆弱性，因此需要一个能主动搜索高危毒样本集合的评估框架。
AI.method: 将毒样本选择形式化为 oracle 预算受限的集合优化问题（oracle-budgeted set optimization），并提出 SAILS（Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection）。SAILS 通过数百次微调-评估运行学习一个集合打分器（set scorer），用以对百万级候选集合排序，并仅对少量候选短名单进行真实审计。
AI.result: 在三个 LLaMA-3-8B 后门设定下，SAILS 相比最强的影响函数（influence）基线，将留出（held-out）攻击成功率平均提升 30 个百分点；方法可从较小规模迁移到全规模微调，并可扩展到代码生成、智能体（agentic）及仅 API 可访问的后门场景。
AI.conclusion: 随机采样毒样本会显著低估后门脆弱性；将毒样本选择视为集合优化问题并采用 SAILS 主动搜索，可更真实地揭示最坏情况风险，且具备良好的可迁移性与场景通用性。

title: Tele360: Real-Time Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction from Sparse Unposed Cameras
summary: Live free-viewpoint visualization of real humans is critical for immersive communication and interactive digital experiences. Existing methods either rely on computationally expensive optimization or require calibrated cameras and low-resolution inputs, making real-time high-resolution deployment impractical. In this work, we present Tele360, the first real-time feed-forward system for dynamic human reconstruction and live free-viewpoint visualization from sparse, unposed RGB streams. Our system jointly estimates camera poses and reconstructs a dynamic 3D Gaussian representation for each time instance in a single forward pass. To achieve this, we start by designing a lightweight sparsity-aware multi-view transformer backbone that tokenizes foreground human regions while preserving global context through a shared scene token. We then employ a fully transformer-based Gaussian decoder to mitigate convolution-induced over-smoothing while keeping decoding sparse and efficient. In addition, we introduce a hybrid feature pyramid that injects multi-scale appearance cues into geometry prediction. We further introduce a lightweight differentiable Levenberg-Marquardt camera refinement layer to enhance multi-view consistency and geometric alignment. Moreover, to stabilize learning under sparse, unposed inputs, we transfer multi-view geometry priors from a large visual-geometry foundation model via teacher-student distillation. Finally, the predicted Gaussian maps are streamed with video codecs to remote devices for interactive free-viewpoint rendering. Extensive experiments show that Tele360 achieves state-of-the-art visual quality on studio benchmarks while supporting real-time 2K input-to-rendering at over 25 FPS on a single consumer GPU. Additional captured sequences illustrate its performance across varied subjects, clothing, and motions under our multi-camera setup.

AI.tldr: Tele360 是首个面向稀疏、无位姿 RGB 流的实时前馈动态人体重建与自由视点可视化系统，在单张消费级 GPU 上实现 2K 输入到渲染超过 25 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有动态人体自由视点方法要么依赖高开销优化，要么需要标定相机与低分辨率输入，难以实现实时高分辨率部署；沉浸式通信与交互数字体验对实时高分辨率自由视点可视化有迫切需求。
AI.method: 提出轻量稀疏感知多视角 Transformer 主干，对前景人体区域进行 token 化并通过共享场景 token 保留全局上下文；采用全 Transformer 高斯解码器避免卷积过平滑并保持稀疏高效；设计混合特征金字塔注入多尺度外观线索；引入轻量可微 Levenberg-Marquardt 相机细化层提升多视角一致性与几何对齐；通过教师-学生蒸馏从大规模视觉-几何基础模型迁移多视角几何先验；预测的高斯图经视频编解码器流式传输至远端设备进行交互渲染。
AI.result: 在工作室基准上取得当前最优视觉质量，支持单张消费级 GPU 上 2K 输入到渲染的实时性能（超过 25 FPS）；额外采集序列验证了在多相机设置下对不同受试者、服装与动作的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: Tele360 将相机位姿估计与动态 3D 高斯表示重建统一于单次前向传播，首次实现稀疏无位姿输入下的实时高分辨率自由视点人体可视化，兼具高质量与实时性，适用于沉浸式通信与交互应用。

title: MoARa: Module-Aware Rank Allocation and Structure-Preserving Decomposition for Low-Rank LLM Pre-training
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 30 pages, 16 figures
summary: Low-rank gradient projection reduces the optimizer-state memory cost of large language model (LLM) pretraining, but the steps and wall-clock time needed to reach a target quality remain a meaningful axis for improvement. We attribute this to two design choices in existing methods: the projection-rank budget is allocated uniformly across Transformer modules with heterogeneous projection sensitivity, and projecting a raw gradient attenuates its magnitude and direction jointly. We propose MoARa, which combines a static profiling-based module-aware projection-rank allocation with a block-wise magnitude-direction decomposition; the default block size is set in the neighborhood of the attention head dimension. Across five Transformer architectures spanning Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek at 300M to 7B scales, GaLore with MoARa reaches standard GaLore's final perplexity in 37% fewer steps and 34% less wall-clock time on Llama 2 7B, with only 0.2% peak reserved memory overhead under standard graph compilation. Across the six low-rank pretraining methods we evaluate, module-aware rank allocation alone delivers directionally consistent step reductions on all six. On compatible hosts, the two-component design reaches up to 41.7% step reduction and 37.1% wall-clock reduction.

AI.tldr: MoARa通过模块感知的投影秩分配与块状幅度-方向分解，加速低秩梯度投影优化器（GaLore）的LLM预训练，在Llama 2 7B上减少37%步数与34%墙钟时间，峰值预留内存仅增加0.2%。
AI.motivation: 低秩梯度投影（如GaLore）降低了大语言模型预训练的优化器状态内存开销，但达到目标质量所需的步数与墙钟时间仍有改进空间。作者将瓶颈归因于两个设计缺陷：(1) 现有方法在投影秩预算上对各模块均匀分配，而不同Transformer模块对投影的敏感性是异质的；(2) 直接投影原始梯度会同时衰减其幅度与方向。
AI.method: 提出MoARa，包含两个组件：(1) 基于静态剖析（profiling）的模块感知投影秩分配；(2) 块状的幅度-方向分解（block-wise magnitude-direction decomposition），默认块大小设在注意力头维度附近。该方法作为插件与GaLore结合使用。
AI.result: 在覆盖Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek的5种Transformer架构、300M至7B规模上验证：GaLore+MoARa在Llama 2 7B上以少37%的步数和34%的墙钟时间达到标准GaLore的最终困惑度，标准图编译下峰值预留内存开销仅0.2%。在评估的6种低秩预训练方法中，仅模块感知秩分配一项即可在全部6种上带来方向一致的步数减少。在兼容主机上，双组件设计最高实现41.7%步数减少与37.1%墙钟时间减少。
AI.conclusion: 模块感知秩分配与块状幅度-方向分解是加速低秩梯度投影预训练的两个有效且互补的设计，可在极小内存开销下显著提升收敛效率，且模块感知秩分配具有良好的跨方法通用性。

title: The average-farmer illusion in language-model simulations of agricultural decisions
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly used as synthetic people in surveys and social simulations, yet their apparent realism is often judged from population averages or distributional similarity. We tested what such evidence actually establishes by comparing Claude, Codex and Kimi under four prespecified prompt designs with matched farmer decisions from China and four African countries. Some configurations reproduced observed means and adoption rates. However, their person-level predictions were weak; their decisions clustered around typical values and policy-relevant extremes were largely missing. Most strikingly, a simple generator fitted only to the observed marginal dis- tribution, and given no information about any farmer, achieved greater distributional similarity than every language-model configuration. Prompt additions produced conditional gains rather than uni- versal improvement: results varied with model, outcome, population and validation target. We call this the average-farmer illusion: a synthetic population can look realistic while failing to repro- duce who does what or how behaviour varies. We provide a claim-matched validation framework and reusable modular prompts that turn prompt construction into an auditable experimental process. Population-level resemblance should therefore be treated as the start of validation, not as evidence of individual simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文检验语言模型"合成人群"的真实性证据，发现群体均值层面的相似性并不代表个体层面模拟有效，提出"平均农民幻觉"概念及匹配声明的验证框架。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体日益被用作调查与社会模拟中的"合成人"，但其真实性通常仅凭总体均值或分布相似性来评判。作者希望厘清这类证据究竟能证明什么，即群体层面的相似性是否足以支撑个体层面的模拟有效性。
AI.method: 采用四个预先设定的提示设计，将 Claude、Codex 和 Kimi 三种模型与中国及四个非洲国家的真实农民决策进行配对比较；同时构建一个仅拟合观测边际分布的简单生成器作为基准，且不向其提供任何农民个体信息，用于对照。
AI.result: 部分配置能复现观测均值与采纳率，但个体层面预测能力弱，决策向典型值聚集、政策相关极端值大量缺失。最显著的是，仅拟合边际分布的简单生成器在分布相似性上超过所有语言模型配置。提示词增补带来的是条件性增益而非普遍改进，结果随模型、结局、人群和验证目标而变化。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出"平均农民幻觉"概念：合成人群可表面逼真却无法复现"谁做什么"及行为变异。据此呼吁将群体层面相似性视为验证的起点而非个体模拟有效的证据，并提供匹配声明的验证框架与可复用的模块化提示词，使提示构建成为可审计的实验过程。

title: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall: Prompt Echoing in Small Instruct Language Models
summary: Prompt echoing is a recognized failure mode of instruct language models, in which a model instead of generating a response, mirrors the provided prompt, even though it did not receive a specific instruction to do so. Is this phenomenon a sign of the model leaking the content of its training dataset, or is it rather caused by a misaligned behavior of the internal induction/copying mechanisms? We investigate prompt echoing small language models from different families (Gemma, Llama, Qwen, SmolLM and OLMo) and show that echoing prompts are likely to have partial overlap with the training dataset but the phenomenon is primarily driven by the model's induction heads.

AI.tldr: 提示回显（prompt echoing）是instruct语言模型的一种失败模式，模型在未收到复制指令时复述提示内容。研究表明该现象主要源于模型内部归纳/复制机制（归纳头）的失调，而非训练数据泄露。
AI.motivation: 探究提示回显现象的成因：究竟是模型泄露训练数据内容，还是内部归纳/复制机制失调所致，以厘清其机理来源。
AI.method: 对来自不同家族的small language models（Gemma、Llama、Qwen、SmolLM、OLMo）的提示回显现象进行了考察与分析。
AI.result: 回显的提示与训练数据可能存在部分重叠，但该现象主要由模型的归纳头（induction heads）驱动。
AI.conclusion: 提示回显并非主要由训练数据泄露引起，而主要是内部归纳/复制机制失调的行为表现，归因于induction heads。

title: Not All Prompts Are Equal: Exploration-Guided Prompt Scaffolding for Multimodal Reinforcement Post-Training
summary: Training prompts in online reinforcement learning (RL) differ substantially in how informative they are for the current policy: some are already saturated while others are too difficult to yield reliable learning signals, yet both receive equal rollout budget under standard training. We propose an exploration-guided prompt scaffolding framework that adapts the training prompt distribution dynamically throughout RL post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Central to our approach is the $\textit{Exploration Potential Score} (EPS)$, a lightweight rollout-based proxy for prompt utility derived from KL-regularized policy improvement theory, computable directly from on-policy rollout statistics without additional overhead. Rather than discarding low-utility prompts, we use a teacher model to generate scaffolded rewrites that preserve the original task intent while making subsequent training more informative, reframing teacher supervision as training-data refinement rather than output imitation. Integrated with GRPO on Geo3K and MMK12, our method consistently outperforms the baseline on both in-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks, achieving up to 9.7\% relative improvement in-domain and gains of 11.5\% on MathVision and 11.1\% on MMMU-Pro.

AI.tldr: 本文提出探索引导的提示脚手架框架，利用基于KL正则化策略改进理论的探索潜力分数（EPS）动态调整MLLM强化学习后训练中的提示分布，对低效用提示进行脚手架式重写而非丢弃，在Geo3K和MMK12上结合GRPO训练取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习中不同训练提示对当前策略的信息量差异显著：部分提示已饱和，部分过难而无法提供可靠学习信号，但标准训练对它们分配相同的采样预算，导致训练效率低下。
AI.method: 提出探索引导的提示脚手架框架，在MLLM的RL后训练过程中动态调整训练提示分布。核心是探索潜力分数（EPS），一种基于KL正则化策略改进理论的轻量级rollout代理指标，可直接从同策略rollout统计量计算，无额外开销。对低效用提示不丢弃，而是用教师模型生成脚手架式重写，保留原始任务意图同时使后续训练更具信息量，将教师监督重新定位为训练数据精炼而非输出模仿。与GRPO集成。
AI.result: 在Geo3K和MMK12上结合GRPO，方法在域内和分布外基准上均持续优于基线，域内相对提升最高达9.7%，MathVision提升11.5%，MMMU-Pro提升11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过EPS动态筛选与脚手架式重写低效用提示，可有效提升MLLM强化学习后训练的数据利用效率与泛化性能，教师监督作为数据精炼的方式优于传统输出模仿。

title: Salesforce Koa: An Enterprise Language Model for Agentic Tool Use
summary: We present Salesforce Koa, an enterprise language model built by post-training the open-weight Nemotron-3-Super-120B foundation model with reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and deployed in FP8 for production. Koa is trained only on public and synthetically generated data, and specialized for the agentic tool use that enterprise workflows demand: routing a request to the correct action, invoking the right tool with valid arguments, and completing multi-turn business tasks. The distinctive component of our pipeline is specification-driven task construction: declarative Agent Script specifications are expanded into persona-conditioned multi-turn environments whose rewards are grounded in successful tool use. Applied to enterprise CRM specifications, the same pipeline produces the in-domain training distribution on which Koa is specialized. On CRMAgentBench and the human-labeled production tool-calling set, Koa outperforms both its untuned open-weight base and GPT-4.1 and is competitive with the strongest frontier models. It reaches 87% Task Success Rate on CRMAgentBench (vs. GPT-4.1 at 82% and the base at 79%), is at or near the top of every metric on the human-labeled portion of an internal production benchmark, and preserves the base model's general capability on public benchmarks (Tau2Bench, BFCL). A controlled comparison with architecture and RL recipe held fixed shows that the additional in-domain RL stage improves argument accuracy and full tool-call success on the human-labeled enterprise benchmark.

AI.tldr: Salesforce Koa 是基于开源 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 经 GRPO 强化学习后训练、以 FP8 部署的企业级语言模型，专精于智能体工具调用，在多轮企业任务上超越未调优基座与 GPT-4.1。
AI.motivation: 企业工作流要求模型具备智能体工具使用能力：将请求路由至正确动作、以有效参数调用正确工具并完成多轮业务任务；而通用基座模型在此类场景上表现不足。作者希望在仅使用公开及合成数据的前提下，构建专门面向企业工具调用的高性能模型。
AI.method: 以开源 Nemotron-3-Super-120B 为基座，采用 GRPO 强化学习进行后训练，生产环境以 FP8 部署。核心创新为"规范驱动的任务构建"：将声明式 Agent Script 规范扩展为带有角色（persona）条件的多轮环境，奖励信号以工具调用是否成功为依据；将该流水线应用于企业 CRM 规范，生成 Koa 专精训练所用的域内数据分布，并额外加入域内 RL 阶段。
AI.result: 在 CRMAgentBench 上达到 87% 任务成功率（GPT-4.1 为 82%，基座为 79%）；在人工标注的生产工具调用集上，于内部生产基准的人工标注部分中各项指标均处于或接近首位；在 Tau2Bench、BFCL 等公开基准上保持基座模型的通用能力。在架构与 RL 配方固定不变的受控对比中，额外的域内 RL 阶段提升了参数准确率与完整工具调用成功率。
AI.conclusion: 规范驱动的任务构建结合 GRPO 后训练，可在仅用公开与合成数据、且不损失通用能力的条件下，显著提升企业智能体工具调用性能，Koa 已具备与最强前沿模型竞争的水平并可投入生产部署。

title: DA-DLM: Explicitly Modeling Token Dependencies in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked sequence, independently predicting multiple tokens at each step. This conditional independence discards inter-token dependencies and degrades coherence-an issue that parallels the multi-modality problem in Non-Autoregressive Translation (NAT). Drawing on the Directed Acyclic Transformer (DAT), which tackles this problem in NAT via a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG), we propose DA-DLM, a model that adapts DAG-based dependency modeling to DLMs' iterative setting through a position-oriented DAG design. The position-oriented DAG binds node groups to fixed output positions so that tokens fixed in earlier steps anchor neighboring predictions via learned transitions, and evolves with denoising to focus on remaining uncertainty as anchors accumulate. On language modeling, open-ended generation, and summarization, DA-DLM consistently outperforms Block Diffusion, especially under fewer denoising steps, and matches autoregressive models while preserving the parallel generation advantage. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/jipy0222/DA-DLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DA-DLM，将基于有向无环图（DAG）的依赖建模引入扩散语言模型（DLM）的迭代去噪框架，缓解条件独立假设导致的连贯性下降问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在每一步独立并行预测多个token，条件独立性丢弃了token间依赖，降低文本连贯性，此问题与非自回归翻译（NAT）中的多模态问题类似。
AI.method: 借鉴解决NAT多模态问题的Directed Acyclic Transformer（DAT），设计位置导向的DAG结构：将节点组绑定到固定输出位置，使先前步骤固定的token通过可学习转移为邻近预测提供锚定，并随去噪过程演化，逐步聚焦于剩余不确定性。
AI.result: 在语言建模、开放式生成和摘要任务上，DA-DLM持续优于Block Diffusion，尤其在去噪步数较少时优势明显，并能匹配自回归模型性能，同时保留并行生成优势。
AI.conclusion: 将DAG依赖建模适配到扩散语言模型的迭代设定可有效提升连贯性与生成质量，在保持并行生成效率的同时缩小与自回归模型的差距。

title: Translating the Translator: Decomposing the Cost of English-Forced Inter-Agent Communication
comment: Accepted at The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at EMNLP 2026
summary: Multi-agent LLM architectures, such as LangChain and AutoGen, largely assume English as the lingua franca for internal inter-agent communication, even when the end-user task is non-English. We fill this gap by evaluating a two-agent extraction-answer core, with an additional back-translation agent in the English-forced condition, across four typologically diverse languages (Hindi, Chinese, Spanish, Arabic; n = 300 per language) using the Aya-23-8B model. We compare a native-language pipeline to an English-forced one (which incorporates a final back-translation step from English to the user's language). We discover a statistically significant English-Forcing Tax (surviving a strict Bonferroni correction) that isolates the cost of English routing from general multi-agent orchestration overhead. Forcing inter-agent communication through English reduces Exact Match accuracy by 13.0 percentage points (Spanish) up to 30.6 percentage points (Hindi) compared to native-language multi-agent execution. Using chrF scores as a diagnostic measure of English-reference lexical overlap, we find that lower overlap is strongly associated with pipeline failure, consistent with translation loss being an important contributor to the observed performance drop. These findings suggest a compelling case for native-language routing in agent frameworks when the source and target languages are typologically distant, reducing a compounding translation tax.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估多智能体LLM架构中"强制英语路由"对非英语任务的性能影响，发现存在显著的"英语强制税"。
AI.motivation: 现有LangChain、AutoGen等多智能体LLM架构默认以英语作为智能体间通信的通用语言，即使终端用户任务是non-English的，这一假设尚未得到系统性评估。
AI.method: 采用Aya-23-8B模型，构建两智能体提取-回答核心架构（英语强制条件下额外加一个回译智能体），覆盖四种类型学差异大的语言（印地语、中文、西班牙语、阿拉伯语，每种n=300），对比母语管道与英语强制管道。
AI.result: 发现统计显著的"英语强制税"（通过严格的Bonferroni校正），强制英语通信使Exact Match准确率下降13.0个百分点（西班牙语）至30.6个百分点（印地语）。chrF分数显示英语参照词汇重叠越低与管道失败强相关，表明翻译损失是性能下降的重要成因。
AI.conclusion: 当源语言与目标语言类型学距离较远时，智能体框架宜采用母语路由，以减少复合翻译税。

title: Beyond the Survey: A Systematic Empirical Study of Detection and Association in Visual MOT
comment: Accepted for publication in Artificial Intelligence Review
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive experimental evaluation and detailed analysis of state-of-the-art multi-object tracking algorithms, with an emphasis on quantifying the individual contributions of detection and association components to overall tracking performance. Unlike existing surveys that primarily offer theoretical categorizations or taxonomies of tracking methods, our work adopts a rigorous experimental perspective grounded in publicly available implementations, providing practical guidance for researchers and practitioners in method selection and system design. We introduce a unified pipeline diagram that consolidates the core components across the two main branches of visual multi-object tracking: tracking-by-detection and end-to-end deep learning paradigms, and systematically analyze the object detection, feature extraction, and data association modules. Through extensive empirical studies on standard benchmarks, including MOT16, MOT17, MOT20, SportsMOT, DanceTrack, and CrowdTrack datasets, we reveal critical insights: (1) detection quality dominates association strategy performance, with detector improvements yielding more than 10% gains compared to less than 5% from refined association strategies; (2) modern deep learning detectors paired with specialized re-identification models significantly outperform joint detection and embedding approaches; and (3) transformer-based end-to-end methods exhibit greater robustness to detection quality variations but at a substantial computational cost. Our findings from extensive experiments provide key insights into component-level effects in MOT, particularly the dominant influence of detection quality relative to association, while offering practical insights for designing and optimizing MOT systems under varying performance and robustness requirements. Code and experimental setups are available at github.com/linh-gist/VisualMOT.

AI.tldr: 本文对多目标跟踪(MOT)算法进行了统一实验评估，量化检测与关联组件对跟踪性能的独立贡献，得出"检测质量主导关联策略表现"等关键结论。
AI.motivation: 现有MOT综述多停留在理论分类与分类学层面，缺乏基于公开实现的可复现实验对比，难以为方法选择与系统设计提供实践指导；同时检测与关联组件对整体跟踪性能的各自贡献尚未被系统量化。
AI.method: 采用统一的实验视角，提出统一pipeline图整合tracking-by-detection与端到端深度学习两大分支的核心组件，系统剖析目标检测、特征提取与数据关联模块；在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20、SportsMOT、DanceTrack、CrowdTrack等标准基准上开展大规模实证研究，基于公开实现进行对比分析。
AI.result: (1) 检测质量主导关联策略性能，检测器改进带来超过10%的提升，而精细化关联策略提升不足5%；(2) 现代深度学习检测器搭配专用ReID模型显著优于联合检测与嵌入方法；(3) 基于Transformer的端到端方法对检测质量变化鲁棒性更强，但计算开销显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了MOT中组件级效应的关键规律，尤其是检测质量相对于数据关联的主导性影响，并为在多样性能与鲁棒性需求下设计与优化MOT系统提供了实践指导；代码与实验配置已开源。

title: OpenAI4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
summary: AI co-scientists could accelerate computational research, but over a long-running study the workflow also has to stay inspectable, resumable and reproducible, which requires persistent computational state and provenance. Here we present OpenAI4S, an open-source scientific research agent built around the principle of \emph{Code as Action, Science as Sessions}. OpenAI4S combines a persistent computing runtime with research-session management: orchestration is handled through structured tool calls, while scientific actions are represented as complete code cells executed in persistent Python and R kernels. An append-only Action Ledger, per-cell execution records, versioned artifacts, environment records, and workspace checkpoints preserve how results were produced and support session recovery, branching, and extension. Configurable sandboxing, permission controls, and code and trajectory screening provide complementary safeguards. We evaluate OpenAI4S on 36 research scenarios spanning retrosynthesis, molecular dynamics, protein binder design, protein mutation, catalyst screening, and mineral spectroscopy, measuring scientific task accuracy, workflow completeness, and reproducibility of the resulting repositories. OpenAI4S achieves an overall score of 7.83, compared with 5.7--6.4 for a general-purpose coding harness evaluated with three frontier models, with the largest gains on long-horizon and computation-intensive workflows. These results suggest that integrating persistent execution with session-level provenance can improve the reliability of AI-assisted scientific workflows. Environment specification and full rerunnability remain weak for every evaluated system, ours included, so reproducibility is still an open problem for scientific agents. The system is available under the MIT license at \href{https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}{github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/OpenAI4S}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenAI4S——一个基于"Code as Action, Science as Sessions"原则的开源科研智能体，通过持久化计算运行时与会话级溯源机制提升AI辅助科研工作流的可靠性与可复现性。
AI.motivation: AI共同科学家可加速计算型研究，但长周期研究要求工作流保持可审查、可恢复、可复现，这需要持久化的计算状态与溯源信息。现有系统在长期运行与可复现性方面存在不足。
AI.method: OpenAI4S结合持久化计算运行时与研究会话管理：通过结构化工具调用进行编排，科学操作表示为在持久化Python和R内核中执行的完整代码单元。采用仅追加Action Ledger、逐单元执行记录、版本化产物、环境记录与工作区检查点来保留结果生成过程，支持会话恢复、分支与扩展；并配置可调沙箱、权限控制及代码与轨迹筛选作为保障。
AI.result: 在涵盖逆合成、分子动力学、蛋白结合体设计、蛋白突变、催化剂筛选和矿物光谱等36个研究场景上评估，测量科学任务准确性、工作流完整性与仓库可复现性。OpenAI4S总体得分7.83，而通用编程框架配合三个前沿模型得分为5.7–6.4，在长周期与计算密集型工作流上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 将持久化执行与会话级溯源整合可提升AI辅助科研工作流的可靠性。但环境规范与完全可重跑性对所有评估系统（包括本文系统）仍是薄弱环节，可复现性对科学智能体而言仍是未解问题。系统以MIT许可开源。

title: LG-VLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Framework with LangGraph State Orchestration
summary: Continuous-environment vision-and-language navigation (VLN-CE) requires interpreting natural-language instructions in unseen 3D environments and executing continuous low-level actions. Existing methods often depend on LiDAR, panoramic cameras, or extra sensors; separate geometric-mapping and semantic-navigation visual representations can cause long-trajectory spatial-semantic inconsistencies. We propose LG-VLN, a monocular zero-shot framework with shared visual features and LangGraph-based state orchestration. An online feed-forward 3D reconstruction network predicts depth, camera poses, and dense point clouds for agent-pose estimation and global map fusion. Geometry and navigation share dense CleanDIFT features: semantic consistency rejects incorrect inter-frame correspondences, while target-instance constraints define visual references whose similarity combines with local BLIP-2 image-text relevance to form a semantic value map. LangGraph represents instruction parsing, geometric perception, semantic value updates, path planning, action execution, and failure recovery as a directed state graph with conditional transitions, persistent state, and modular recovery mechanisms. On a fixed 550-episode subset of the R2R-CE val-unseen split, LG-VLN achieves 21.3% success and 12.1% success weighted by path length. Ablations show shared semantic features improve navigation, further boosted by combining visual similarity and image-text relevance. Results establish shared visual representations and explicit state orchestration as effective for zero-shot VLN-CE using monocular RGB alone. Code will be publicly released for reproducibility.
