AI.tldr: LG-VLN是一个单目零样本VLN-CE框架，共享CleanDIFT视觉特征并利用LangGraph进行状态编排，在R2R-CE val-unseen子集上达到21.3%成功率和12.1% SPL。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN-CE方法依赖LiDAR、全景相机或额外传感器，且几何建图与语义导航使用分离的视觉表征，导致长轨迹上的空间-语义不一致。作者希望仅用单目RGB实现零样本VLN-CE。
AI.method: 在线前馈3D重建网络预测深度、相机位姿和稠密点云，用于智能体位姿估计与全局地图融合；几何与导航共享稠密CleanDIFT特征，通过语义一致性剔除错误帧间对应关系，并以目标实例约束定义视觉参考，将相似度与局部BLIP-2图文相关性结合形成语义价值图；用LangGraph将指令解析、几何感知、语义价值更新、路径规划、动作执行和失败恢复建模为带条件转移、持久状态和模块化恢复机制的有向状态图。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE val-unseen固定550回合子集上，成功率为21.3%，SPL为12.1%。消融实验表明共享语义特征可提升导航性能，结合视觉相似度与图文相关性后进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，共享视觉表征与显式状态编排对仅用单目RGB的零样本VLN-CE是有效的，代码将公开以保证可复现性。

title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 in the Wild: A Launch-Period Dataset and Detector Evaluation
summary: An image tool can change its underlying generator while retaining its public name, making version attribution from online posts ambiguous. We study this problem after the ChatGPT Images 2.5 launch. Our frozen collection contains 3,478 images from 2,440 posts across 8 sources. Recorded posting times fall within the first 51.1 hours after the announcement. It records three attribution tiers and retains standalone images after image-form filtering and targeted review. Caption claims and host records provide admission evidence, not independently verified generator identity. The observed content profile depends on the source mixture: NightCafe supplies 39.0% of images but 77.0% of CLIP-assigned fantasy scenes. We then evaluate six frozen detectors at thresholds calibrated to a 5% flag rate on reference photographs. Collection flag rates range from 3.7 to 56.4%, falling 42-81 percentage points below GenImage recall. Held-out artwork false-positive rates range from 1.5 to 96.5%, so a higher collection flag rate does not by itself establish better detection. An exploratory X-only comparison with our April collection finds a higher September flag rate for Effort, and a suggestive difference for DoU, under fixed-threshold post-clustered bootstrap intervals. Attribution, content and processing differences prevent a causal interpretation of these contrasts. The collection supports analysis of reported model use during a product transition, with source and attribution evidence retained for interpretation. The collection is released at https://scam.ai/research.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了ChatGPT Images 2.5发布后51.1小时内的3,478张图像数据集，揭示生成器版本归因的模糊性，并发现检测器在真实网络图像上的标记率与误报率存在显著脱节。
AI.motivation: 图像工具可在保留公开名称的同时更换底层生成器，导致网络帖子的版本归因存在歧义，这一问题在产品换代（如ChatGPT Images 2.5发布）后尤为突出，现有检测评测又缺乏真实采集场景下的证据支撑。
AI.method: 冻结采集8个来源、2,440条帖子中的3,478张图像，时间限定在公告后51.1小时内；记录三级归因信息，经图像形式过滤与针对性复核保留独立图像；以标题声明与宿主记录作为准入证据；随后在参考照片上按5%标记率校准阈值，评测六个冻结检测器，并基于固定阈值、按帖聚类的bootstrap区间与4月数据集做X平台的探索性对比。
AI.result: 集合标记率为3.7%–56.4%，比GenImage召回低42–81个百分点；留出艺术图像误报率为1.5%–96.5%，高标记率并不代表更好检测；内容画像受来源构成影响，NightCafe占图像39.0%却占CLIP判定幻想场景的77.0%；X平台对比显示Effort在9月标记率更高，DoU存在提示性差异。
AI.conclusion: 归因、内容与处理差异使上述对比无法作因果解读；该数据集支持产品换代期间"已报告模型使用"的分析，并保留来源与归因证据，已在指定地址公开。

title: When the Wrong Key Wins: Understanding and Detecting Hallucinations in LLMs
summary: Large language models can hallucinate even when the knowledge required for a correct answer is already available. We study this failure through a latent-key view of inference, where answer selection depends on competition among associations acquired during pretraining. We show that model predictions can be highly sensitive to individual query keywords, that these influential keywords exhibit entity-specific binding, and that their effects are systematically shaped by pretraining frequency. Multiple bindings can also compete and exhibit higher-order interactions within the same query. Based on this mechanism, we introduce a two-stage keyword-perturbation method for hallucination detection. By removing influential keywords and measuring how the model reorganizes its prediction, the method distinguishes errors caused by misleading key associations from correct decisions supported by diagnostic evidence. Across multiple models and benchmarks, perturbation provides a strong and transferable detection signal, reaching $0.910$ AUROC on probe-known ScientistQA. Finally, we extend the same probabilistic framework to four hallucination regimes: knowledge deficit, wrong knowledge, context distraction, and unstable inference. Their operational distributions across benchmarks provide diagnostic context for why different detector families succeed in different settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文从"潜在键"视角解释大模型幻觉，认为答案选择取决于预训练中习得的关联之间的竞争，并据此提出两阶段关键词扰动检测方法。
AI.motivation: 大模型即使已具备正确答案所需知识仍会产生幻觉，需要从推理机制层面理解这一失败模式，并开发可迁移的检测手段。
AI.method: 提出潜在键推理视角：答案选择依赖预训练关联的竞争。分析发现预测对个别查询关键词高度敏感，这些关键词具有实体特异性绑定，且受预训练频率系统性影响；多个绑定可竞争并存在高阶交互。基于此设计两阶段关键词扰动方法，通过移除影响性关键词并测量模型预测重组情况，区分由误导性关键关联导致的错误与由诊断性证据支持的正确决策。
AI.result: 在多个模型与基准上，扰动信号表现强且可迁移，在probe-known ScientistQA上达到0.910 AUROC；并将同一概率框架扩展到知识缺失、知识错误、上下文干扰与推理不稳定四种幻觉情形，其操作性分布为不同检测器家族的适用场景提供诊断依据。
AI.conclusion: 关键词级别的关联竞争是幻觉产生的重要机制，扰动重组织可作为有效检测信号，统一概率框架有助于解释不同检测方法在不同设定下的表现差异。

title: Long-Tail Adaptive Flow Matching with Explicit Conditional Consistency Guidance for Precise Multimodal Face Synthesis
summary: Although diffusion-based methods have substantially improved the controllability of multimodal face synthesis, their semantic alignment remains suboptimal because most existing approaches rely on implicit latent-space objectives to model the relationship between denoising variables and multimodal conditions. Such implicit modeling is often insufficient to enforce precise correspondence between synthesized faces and conditional inputs, especially under long-tailed semantic mask distributions where rare attributes receive weak optimization signals. To address these limitations, we propose EC\textsuperscript{2}Face, a multimodal face synthesis framework that improves semantic alignment through explicit semantic supervision and distribution-aware optimization. First, we introduce Explicit Conditional Consistency Guidance (ECCG), which imposes direct consistency supervision in pixel space by decoding an approximate reverse estimate of the clean latent and explicitly aligning the synthesized image with textual descriptions and semantic masks. A temporal dynamic modulation function is further designed to adapt the supervision strength according to the timestep-dependent reliability of reverse estimation. Second, we propose Long-Tail Adaptive Flow Matching (LAFM), which reweights spatial optimization signals based on semantic attribute frequency, with normalized weights to maintain numerical stability during training. Importantly, all additional modules are used only during training and introduce no extra inference overhead. Extensive experiments show that EC\textsuperscript{2}Face consistently outperforms competitive baselines in both generation quality and semantic alignment, achieving a 29.38\% improvement in mask accuracy on rare attributes.

AI.tldr: 提出EC²Face多模态人脸合成框架，通过像素空间显式语义监督与长尾自适应优化提升语义对齐，稀有属性掩码准确率提升29.38%，且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的多模态人脸合成方法多依赖隐式潜空间目标建模去噪变量与多模态条件的关系，难以保证合成人脸与条件输入的精确对应，尤其在长尾语义掩码分布下稀有属性优化信号薄弱，导致语义对齐欠佳。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：1）显式条件一致性引导（ECCG），在像素空间对干净潜变量的近似反向估计进行解码，显式对齐合成图像与文本描述及语义掩码，并设计时间动态调制函数按时间步可靠性调整监督强度；2）长尾自适应流匹配（LAFM），基于语义属性频率重加权空间优化信号，并采用归一化权重保证训练数值稳定性。所有附加模块仅在训练阶段使用。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，EC²Face在生成质量与语义对齐上持续优于竞争基线，稀有属性的掩码准确率提升29.38%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式语义监督与分布感知优化，可有效改善多模态人脸合成的语义对齐，同时避免额外推理开销。

title: DNF-SR: Dual-Input and Negative-Aware Feature Fine-Tuning for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
summary: Benefiting from the powerful generative priors of diffusion models, diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) methods have demonstrated impressive performance.To achieve efficient Real-ISR, several recent works have designed one-step diffusion-based models.Howerver, unmediatedly feeding LR into a diffusion model creates a distributional gap with the model's original input.A straightforward approach to reduce the distribution gap is to introduce noise to the LR latents. However, directly adding noise inevitably corrupts the content of the LR images.In this study, we propose DNF-SR, a Dual-input and Negative-aware Feature fine-tuning method for Real-ISR.Specifically, we use a dual-input strategy that concatenates the original LR image with the noisy LR input and feeds them into a diffusion-based image editing model, ensuring both high-fidelity one-step super-resolution and improved perceptual and content consistency.Additionally, the noise present in the noisy LR input introduces randomness and diversity into the outputs. We exploit this property and propose a post-training optimization method, Negative-aware Feature Fine-Tuning (NF2T), which guides the model toward producing higher-quality results.NF^2T classifies multiple outputs into positive and negative subsets and then defines implicit policy improvement directions in both the image and feature spaces, thereby further enhancing the stability of the optimization.Extensive experiments show that DNF-SR outperforms other methods.Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出DNF-SR，一种面向真实世界图像超分的双输入、负样本感知特征微调方法，用于高效一步扩散超分。
AI.motivation: 现有一步扩散Real-ISR方法直接将低分辨率图像输入扩散模型，造成与模型原始输入之间的分布差异；简单地向LR潜变量加噪虽可缓解分布差异，却不可避免破坏LR图像内容。
AI.method: 采用双输入策略，将原始LR图像与加噪LR输入拼接后送入扩散图像编辑模型，兼顾一步超分的高保真度与感知、内容一致性；并利用加噪LR输入的随机性带来的输出多样性，提出后训练优化方法NF2T（Negative-aware Feature Fine-Tuning），将多个输出划分为正、负子集，在图像空间与特征空间定义隐式策略改进方向以提升优化稳定性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DNF-SR优于其他方法（代码将开源）。
AI.conclusion: DNF-SR通过双输入设计与负样本感知特征微调，在一步扩散Real-ISR中同时改善了分布差异、内容保真与感知质量。

title: MoME: Mixture-of-Memory Embeddings for Context-Aware Sparse Lookup
summary: Scaling large language models efficiently has motivated sparse capacity mechanisms such as Mixture-of-Experts and, more recently, conditional memory: token-indexed embedding tables that augment the backbone with cheap parametric lookups. Existing memory-embedding methods retrieve via a deterministic function of the surface form, which collapses different contextual senses of the same token (e.g., python the language vs. the animal) into a single fixed entry. We introduce Mixture of Memory Embeddings (MoME), a context-aware memory mechanism that replaces each token's single memory row with a mixture of M slots and uses a learned gate over the hidden state to choose which slots to read at each position. In controlled pretraining experiments across nanochat, Llama-3/MobileLLM, and Qwen3 backbones, MoME improves over Value Embedding, Bigram, and STEM baselines in iso-parameter and iso-training-FLOP settings, shows a more promising memory-size scaling trend at sub-billion scale, and remains efficient in training and inference. Qualitative routing analyses on polysemous tokens further suggest that the learned mixture exhibits a degree of semantic interpretability, dispatching the same surface token to distinct memory slots under different senses.

AI.tldr: 提出MoME（Mixture of Memory Embeddings），一种上下文感知的条件记忆机制，用M个记忆槽的混合替代单一记忆行，通过基于隐状态的学习门控选择读取哪些槽，缓解同形异义词被压缩到单一固定条目的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有条件记忆（token索引嵌入表）通过表层形式的确定性函数检索，将同一token的不同上下文语义（如python指语言或动物）坍缩为单一固定条目，无法区分多义，限制了稀疏容量机制的表达能力。
AI.method: 将每个token的单条记忆行替换为M个槽的混合（mixture of M slots），并训练一个基于隐状态的学习门控（learned gate）在每个位置决定读取哪些槽；在nanochat、Llama-3/MobileLLM与Qwen3骨干上开展受控预训练实验，与Value Embedding、Bigram、STEM基线在等参数与等训练FLOP设定下对比，并附多义词路由的定性分析。
AI.result: 在等参数与等训练FLOP设定下均优于Value Embedding、Bigram和STEM基线；在亚十亿（sub-billion）规模下呈现更有前景的记忆容量扩展趋势；训练与推理仍保持高效；多义词路由分析显示同一表层token在不同语义下被派发到不同记忆槽，具一定语义可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MoME以上下文感知的槽混合与隐状态门控改进了条件记忆机制，在多个骨干与受控设定中取得一致增益，并在小规模上展现良好容量扩展性与语义可解释路由，为高效稀疏容量扩展提供了新方向。

title: woma: a real-time foundation model and its fine-tuned models for endoscopy
comment: 28 pages, 10 figures (8 in the main text, 2 supplementary), 13 tables (8 in the main text, 5 supplementary). Preprint. Models and run records are available from the corresponding author
summary: woma is a real-time foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy: a network trained without labels on about a million endoscopy frames, from which task models are fine-tuned. We contribute a systematic design for production. Requirements and pass marks were fixed before any run, eight candidates screened under pre-registered rules, self-supervised training taken to a stopping rule, then fine-tuning and deployment optimisation, all on one self-contained library, numbat. We also contribute woma itself with two fine-tuned models, every outcome reported met or missed. Our colonoscopy model finds and outlines polyps, names which colon segment is in view, suggests polyp type and grades bowel preparation. Our gastroscopy model names a station out of 22 protocol sites, flags and outlines lesions, and names one of seven findings. Every number was read on data never seen in training, and shipped weights were chosen on that record. In colonoscopy, 96% of polyps in a six-hospital PolypGen set are found at precision >=0.85, and 19 of 19 polyps across fifteen full REAL-Colon videos at 1.6 false alarms per procedure. In gastroscopy, landmark region is named correctly on 92% of frames from unseen patients, and 37 of 39 held-out neoplasia frames are flagged at specificity 0.91. On one workstation GPU every task runs over 1080p video at about 100 frames per second, faster than PyTorch, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT in all four precision regimes tested. TensorRT comes closest: one pass of our foundation model takes it 3 to 27% longer than ours, and we deliver 6 to 31% more frames per second from frame to results. A second build links no vendor library at all -- our own kernels over Vulkan -- so a site deploys two files and needs no toolkit, no cuDNN and no framework; in f32 it beats the CUDA build on the same card.

AI.tldr: 本文提出woma——一个用于胃肠内镜的实时基础模型，基于约百万帧无标签数据自监督预训练，并配套系统化生产流程（numbat库），在结肠镜与胃镜多任务上达到预先设定的性能指标，且推理速度超越PyTorch、ONNX Runtime和TensorRT。
AI.motivation: 胃肠内镜实时辅助诊断需要兼顾准确性与部署效率，现有方案缺乏系统化的生产级设计流程与统一的自监督基础模型，导致任务模型性能与推理速度难以同时满足临床实时需求。
AI.method: 在约百万帧内镜图像上进行无标签自监督训练得到基础模型woma，并用其微调任务模型；采用预注册规则的生产化设计：先固定需求与合格线，八名候选按规则筛选，自监督训练设停止准则，再进行微调与部署优化，全部在一个自包含库numbat中完成。另构建完全不含厂商库、基于自有Vulkan内核的第二版本。
AI.result: 结肠镜：六医院PolypGen中96%息肉在精确度≥0.85下被检出；15段REAL-Colon视频中19/19息肉被检出，误报率1.6次/例。胃镜：未见患者92%帧正确命名地标区域；39帧保留肿瘤性病变中37帧被标记，特异度0.91。单GPU上1080p视频约100帧/秒，在四种精度模式下均快于PyTorch、ONNX Runtime和TensorRT（TensorRT最接近，基础模型单次推理慢3–27%，端到端帧率低6–31%）。Vulkan版本在f32下优于同卡CUDA构建，仅需两个文件、无需工具链、cuDNN和框架。
AI.conclusion: woma提供了可复现、指标预注册的实时内镜基础模型生产范式，在结肠镜与胃镜多任务上达成全部预设指标，并实现跨框架最高推理速度与极简部署。

title: AdaVSkip: Adaptive Visual Token Skipping Across Layers For Efficient MLLMs Inference
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require substantial computation to process numerous visual tokens across all transformer layers. Most methods for efficient MLLM inference exploit horizontal redundancy by compressing visual tokens. Beyond token reduction, recent studies exploit vertical redundancy through early exit or fixed-layer skipping. However, we find that the extent and distribution of this redundancy vary across inputs and differ between self-attention and MLP modules. Motivated by these observations, we propose AdaVSkip, which equips each layer with two lightweight routers that independently determine whether visual tokens pass through by or skip the self-attention and MLP modules. These decisions collectively define an input-specific visual-computation path, but their discrete and non-differentiable nature makes learning effective paths challenging. To address this challenge, we develop a progressive two-stage training framework that updates only the routers while keeping the backbone frozen. Stage I establishes an initial routing policy through supervised training with input-specific targets derived from module-wise necessity scores. To further align the routing policy with task performance, Stage II uses reinforcement learning to optimize routing decisions with direct feedback from generated answers. It combines an answer correctness reward with a skip-consistency reward that discourages excessive retention of visual-token computation. Across three MLLM backbones, AdaVSkip maintains strong task performance with substantially less computation. On LLaVA-NeXT-7B, AdaVSkip reduces FLOPs by 53.2\% while preserving the original model's average performance. Combining it with visual token compression increases this reduction to 91.2\%, while retaining 97.2\% of the original performance on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaVSkip，通过为每层配备轻量路由器独立决定视觉 token 是否经过自注意力与 MLP 模块，并采用两阶段训练（监督初始化 + 强化学习优化），在保持性能的同时大幅降低 MLLM 推理计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型推理效率方法多在水平维度上压缩视觉 token，或利用早期退出/固定层跳过等垂直冗余。但作者发现垂直冗余的程度与分布随输入变化，且在自注意力与 MLP 模块间存在差异，因此固定的跳过策略并非最优。
AI.method: 提出 AdaVSkip：每层配置两个轻量路由器，分别独立决定视觉 token 是否跳过自注意力与 MLP 模块，组合成输入相关的视觉计算路径。针对决策离散、不可微的难题，设计渐进式两阶段训练框架，冻结主干仅更新路由器：阶段一用基于模块必要性分数的输入相关目标进行监督训练，得到初始路由策略；阶段二用强化学习，结合答案正确性奖励与跳过一致性奖励，直接依据生成答案反馈优化路由决策。
AI.result: 在三种 MLLM 主干上均以显著更少计算维持了较强的任务性能。在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上，AdaVSkip 降低 53.2% FLOPs 且保持原模型平均性能；与视觉 token 压缩结合后，FLOPs 降低达 91.2%，平均仍保留原性能的 97.2%。
AI.conclusion: AdaVSkip 表明输入自适应的垂直计算跳过可有效利用 MLLM 中的垂直冗余，且与水平 token 压缩互补，能在大幅削减 FLOPs 的同时保持任务性能。

title: SparseTalk - Sparsifying 3D Gaussian Language Fields for Efficient 3D Visual Question Answering
summary: 3D Gaussian language fields provide an explicit, spatially grounded representation for 3D visual question answering (VQA), but their dense semantic features can require tens of thousands of embeddings per scene, resulting in substantial storage, memory, and inference costs. We investigate how much of this representation is actually necessary for downstream reasoning. Starting from a full embedding representation, we systematically sparsify its semantic embeddings, including the previously underexplored regime below a single image-equivalent block down to 8 visual tokens. We compare random, geometric, semantic, and joint spatial-semantic selection strategies and introduce an object-based sparsification method that distributes the token budget across detected object instances while retaining background context. Experiments on ScanQA and MV-ScanQA reveal substantial redundancy in dense Gaussian language fields. Strong VQA performance is retained with only a few hundred semantic embeddings, corresponding to less than 1% of the original representation. Object-based selection performs well relative to others, with only modest observed changes down to 256 tokens. At this budget, SparseTalk retains 0.80% of SplatTalk's 32,076-token inference input and 0.332% of the mean 77,207-Gaussian dense field, increasing inference throughput while reducing decoded-feature memory 125-fold.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究3D高斯语言场的语义嵌入冗余性，发现仅需数百个语义嵌入（<1%）即可维持强劲的3D VQA性能，并提出基于对象的稀疏化方法，在256 token预算下仅用原输入的0.80%即保留竞争力，吞吐提升且解码特征内存降低125倍。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯语言场为3D视觉问答提供了显式、空间接地的表示，但其密集语义特征每场景需数万嵌入，带来高昂的存储、内存与推理成本。论文旨在探究下游推理究竟需要多少该表示，揭示其冗余程度。
AI.method: 从完整嵌入表示出发，系统稀疏化语义嵌入，覆盖低于单图等效块直至8个视觉token的区间；比较随机、几何、语义及联合空间-语义选择策略；提出基于对象的稀疏化方法，在检测到的物体实例间分配token预算并保留背景上下文。
AI.result: 在ScanQA与MV-ScanQA上，密集高斯语言场存在显著冗余：仅数百个语义嵌入（不足原表示1%）即可保留强劲VQA性能。基于对象的选择相对其他策略表现良好，降至256 token时变化温和。该预算下SparseTalk保留SplatTalk 32,076 token推理输入的0.80%及平均77,207高斯密集场的0.332%，提升推理吞吐并将解码特征内存降低125倍。
AI.conclusion: 密集3D高斯语言场高度冗余，少量语义嵌入即可支撑3D VQA；基于对象的稀疏化是有效策略，可大幅压缩表示并降低内存、提升吞吐，为高效空间接地3D推理提供可行路径。

title: Automated Perceptually-Motivated Assessment of Photographic Consistency in Paired Clinical Photographs: Pipeline Development and Internal Evaluation
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to SPIE Journal of Medical Imaging
summary: Purpose: Paired pre- and post-operative photographs are the standard unit of evidence for plastic surgical outcomes, yet no objective metric verifies whether two images of the same patient were captured under conditions consistent for comparison. Approach: We developed a perceptually motivated pipeline that analyzes pre/post pairs across thirteen calibrated sub-metrics, partitioned by unsupervised correlation-structure analysis into five data-driven clusters (photometric, texture / sharpness, pose, illumination direction, and pitch), averaged within each cluster and combined across clusters by a weighted sum into a single consistency score. Each sub-metric is calibrated so that its median difference across published within-patient pairs scores 0.5, which is a reference point and carries no pass/fail meaning. The pipeline was calibrated on 134 matched within-patient published pre/post pairs and evaluated against identical-image pairs, synthetic-perturbation pairs, and 134 mismatched cross-publication pairs. Results: The master consistency score S separated matched from mismatched pairs (sensitivity index d' = 2.15, 95% confidence interval (CI) [1.83, 2.55]; area under the receiver operating characteristic curve AUC = 0.928, 95% CI [0.896, 0.959]), closely matching Gaussian-equal-variance predictions. The three head-pose angles did not fall in one cluster: yaw and roll grouped together while pitch separated. Identical pairs scored at ceiling (S = 0.99) and the master score fell monotonically with perturbation magnitude on all five perturbation axes. Conclusions: The score quantifies photographic comparability, not aesthetic or surgical quality, and provides a freely available web tool for auditing the photographic comparability of pre/post pairs, pending validation against expert judgment.

AI.tldr: 提出一套感知驱动的术前/术后照片一致性评分流程，将13个经校准的子指标经相关性结构聚类归为5类，加权合成单一评分S；在134对匹配与134对错配样本上，S的AUC达0.928，可有效区分可比与不可比照片对，并提供公开网页工具。
AI.motivation: 整形外科疗效评估以术前/术后配对照片为标准证据单元，但缺乏客观指标来判断同一患者的两张照片是否在可比条件下拍摄，即现有方法无法验证照片的可比性。
AI.method: 构建感知驱动的分析流程：计算13个经校准的子指标，用无监督相关性结构分析将其划分为5个数据驱动聚类（光度、纹理/锐度、姿态、光照方向、俯仰角），簇内取平均、簇间加权求和得到一致性评分S。校准方式为使已发表患者内配对的中位差异对应0.5（仅作参考点，无通过/不通过含义）。基于134对已发表的患者内术前/术后配对进行校准，并在同图对、合成扰动对和134对跨文献错配对上进行评估。
AI.result: 主评分S能区分匹配与错配对（敏感度指数d'=2.15，95%CI[1.83, 2.55]；AUC=0.928，95%CI[0.896, 0.959]），与高斯等方差预测吻合。三个头部姿态角未聚为一类：偏航与翻滚聚在一起，俯仰单独成簇。同图对达上限（S=0.99），S在五个扰动轴上随扰动幅度单调下降。
AI.conclusion: 该评分量化的是照片的可比性，而非美学或手术质量；研究提供了免费网页工具用于审计术前/术后配对照片的可比性，但仍需针对专家判断进行验证。

title: Improving Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities in Large Language Models via Reasoning Process Error Classification
summary: The reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) is a critical factor for practical LLM-based applications. To investigate the current reasoning capability of LLMs, we clarify the types of errors that arise in LLMs' reasoning processes on mathematical datasets. We focus on problems where LLMs produce an incorrect answer. We define errors in the reasoning process as reasoning errors and manually analyze the features of reasoning errors. We defined and classified 21 error classes and identified the frequently occurring classes among them. Beyond qualitative evaluation, we leverage the evaluation results to improve the reasoning capability. We designed a prompt that explicitly focuses on eight error classes. The experiments demonstrate that this prompt effectively improves reasoning performance. Furthermore, the results suggest that the frequent reasoning errors identified in this paper are common across LLMs of comparable scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）在数学数据集上的推理错误进行人工分析，定义并划分出21类推理错误，识别高频错误类别，并据此设计聚焦8类错误的提示词，实验证明该提示词有效提升了推理性能。
AI.motivation: 推理能力是LLM实际应用的关键因素，但当前LLM在推理过程中仍会产生错误。为探究LLM的推理能力现状，需要明确其在数学数据集推理过程中出现的错误类型，从而为改进推理性能提供依据。
AI.method: 聚焦于LLM给出错误答案的问题，将推理过程中的错误定义为"推理错误"，并对其进行人工分析；定义并划分出21个错误类别，识别其中的高频类别；将评估结果用于性能改进，设计了一个明确聚焦于8个错误类别的提示词。
AI.result: 实验表明，聚焦8类错误的提示词能够有效提升推理性能；此外，结果显示本文识别出的高频推理错误在规模相当的LLM之间具有共性。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统分类推理错误并利用高频错误指导提示词设计，可以有效改善LLM的推理能力；且高频推理错误在同规模LLM中具有普遍性。

title: Weakly Supervised Spatial Grounding for Discriminative Attention-Based Ultrasound-Histopathology Alignment in Prostate Cancer Grading
summary: Unpaired cross-modal distillation transfers grade structure from histopathology into a micro-ultrasound (micro-US) encoder by aligning a pooled needle-region embedding to a frozen histopathology teacher under grade-group correspondence alone. A single objective is thereby required to serve two distinct functions: rendering patch features discriminative of tissue state, and selecting which patches enter the pooled representation. We decouple them. Weak spatial supervision derived from percentage involvement, recorded routinely at biopsy, constrains the predicted proportion of malignant tissue within each core, acting on the encoder features independently of the alignment objective. The alignment loss then operates on features that differ across a core, and attention concentrates on a subset of patches rather than remaining near-uniform. On 7,166 biopsy cores from 811 patients across seven centers under patient-level 5-fold cross-validation, the method reaches 67.1 macro AUC and 68.5 csPCa AUC, against 61.2 and 52.8 for the existing unpaired alignment method and 63.1 and 62.6 for the strongest unimodal baselines. Ablation against existing attention regularizers designed to prevent attention-uniformity collapse shows that such regularizers do not substitute for label-derived supervision: they constrain the attention distribution, whereas the signal required acts on the features that attention reads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在无配对跨模态蒸馏中解耦"特征判别性"与"patch选择"两个功能：利用活检常规记录的肿瘤累及百分比（percentage involvement）生成弱空间监督，直接约束编码器特征上预测的癌组织比例，再让对齐损失作用于核心内存在差异的特征上，使注意力集中于部分patch。在7,166个活检核心、811名患者、七个中心的数据上，方法达到67.1 macro AUC与68.5 csPCa AUC，显著优于现有无配对对齐方法（61.2/52.8）与最强单模态基线（63.1/62.6）。
AI.motivation: 现有无配对跨模态蒸馏仅靠"分级组对应"把微超声（micro-US）编码器的池化针区嵌入对齐到冻结的组织病理教师，导致单一目标需同时承担两个功能：使patch特征对组织状态具判别性，以及决定哪些patch进入池化表示。二者耦合使注意力趋于近均匀分布，特征判别性不足，性能受限。
AI.method: 从活检常规记录的肿瘤累及百分比（percentage involvement）中提取弱空间监督，约束每个core内预测的恶性组织比例；该监督独立于对齐目标，直接作用于编码器特征。随后对齐损失在core内具有差异的特征上运行，注意力因而集中于部分patch而非近均匀分布。同时与现有防止注意力均匀化崩塌的正则化方法进行消融对比。
AI.result: 在七个中心、811名患者、7,166个活检核心上，采用患者级5折交叉验证：本方法达67.1 macro AUC与68.5 csPCa AUC；现有无配对对齐方法为61.2与52.8；最强单模态基线为63.1与62.6。消融显示，防注意力均匀化的正则化不能替代标签衍生监督。
AI.conclusion: 解耦特征判别性与patch选择是提升无配对跨模态蒸馏的关键。注意力均匀化正则化仅约束注意力分布，而所需信号作用于注意力所读取的特征，因此无法替代由标签导出的弱空间监督。

title: PACE: Progressive Angular-to-Norm Contrastive Embedding
summary: Multimodal embedding models encode heterogeneous inputs into a shared embedding space, enabling efficient similarity computation across modalities and tasks. Most existing methods optimize cosine-based contrastive objectives, which promote stable training but restrict semantic compatibility to angular geometry, precluding embedding norms from serving as an additional semantic signal. However, directly optimizing the more expressive dot-product similarity, which leverages both angular and norm information, underperforms cosine-based training and exhibits unstable training dynamics. We attribute this discrepancy to premature optimization-space expansion, manifested as angular--norm entanglement and directional anisotropy in the representation space and further compounded by full-parameter fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose PACE, a two-stage framework that progressively expands both the representation and trainable parameter spaces. Stage I combines cosine-based objective with low-rank adaptation to establish a reliable angular geometry within constrained optimization spaces. Stage II switches to dot-product similarity and full-parameter fine-tuning, enabling embedding directions and norms to jointly encode semantic information. We further introduce Focal Embedding Loss, a confidence-adaptive objective that downweights queries with high positive retrieval confidence while emphasizing ambiguous queries with competitive negatives. Experiments across multiple backbone scales and diverse multimodal embedding tasks consistently validate the effectiveness of PACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PACE 两阶段框架，通过渐进式扩展表示空间与可训练参数空间，解决点积相似度在多模态嵌入中训练不稳定的问题，并引入 Focal Embedding Loss 提升效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型多采用余弦对比目标，训练稳定但仅利用角度几何，无法将嵌入范数作为额外语义信号；而直接优化更具表达力的点积相似度性能更差且训练动态不稳定。作者将这一差异归因于优化空间过早扩张，表现为角度-范数纠缠、方向各向异性，并被全参数微调进一步放大。
AI.method: 提出 PACE 两阶段框架：阶段一结合余弦目标与低秩适配（LoRA），在受限优化空间内建立可靠的角度几何；阶段二切换为点积相似度并采用全参数微调，使嵌入方向与范数共同编码语义。此外提出 Focal Embedding Loss，一种置信度自适应目标，对高正样本检索置信度的查询降权，同时强调具有竞争性负样本的模糊查询。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络规模和多样化的多模态嵌入任务上进行了实验，结果一致验证了 PACE 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过渐进式扩展表示与参数空间，可稳定地利用点积相似度中的角度与范数信息，PACE 与 Focal Embedding Loss 在多模态嵌入任务上均表现出一致的有效性。

title: A literature-guided descriptor-based framework for filtering composition search spaces
summary: Scientific literature contains latent knowledge about materials behavior, but much of this knowledge is expressed through words, contexts, and recurring associations rather than explicit design principles. This raises a central question: how can large-scale scientific corpora be used for practical problems in materials discovery? Here, we present a literature-guided descriptor-based filtering framework for reducing composition search spaces. For a given performance metric, the framework selects two descriptors from a filtered vocabulary in a literature-trained word embedding model and uses the selected descriptors to construct a Pareto-based filter for candidate compositions. Across the evaluated performance metrics and composition search spaces, the framework filters out an average of 74.27\% of the candidate compositions, with an average best-value error of 1.93\% relative to experimental measurements. Compared with expert-chosen and random descriptors, our performance metric-dependent descriptors provide a more controlled balance between retained fraction and best-value error. These results show that literature-derived embeddings can support intuitive and reproducible filters for narrowing candidate composition spaces while preserving high-performing compositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种文献引导的、基于描述符的筛选框架，利用文献训练的word embedding模型自动选取描述符并构建Pareto过滤器，用于压缩材料成分搜索空间。
AI.motivation: 科学文献蕴含材料行为的潜在知识，但多以词汇、语境和重复关联形式存在，而非显式设计准则。核心问题是：如何将大规模科学语料用于材料发现的实际问题，以提高成分搜索效率。
AI.method: 针对给定性能指标，从过滤后的词表中、在文献训练的word embedding模型里选择两个描述符，并基于所选描述符构建Pareto过滤器，对候选成分进行筛选。
AI.result: 在所评估的性能指标和成分搜索空间中，该框架平均滤除74.27%的候选成分，相对实验测量的平均最优值误差为1.93%。与专家选取和随机描述符相比，依赖性能指标选取的描述符在保留比例与最优值误差之间实现了更可控的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 文献衍生的embedding可支持直观、可复现的筛选器，在保留高性能成分的同时有效缩小候选成分空间。

title: EMR: Self-Evolving Medical Multi-Agent System via Experience Mining and Reuse
summary: Large language model (LLM) driven multi-agent systems have shown promise in complex clinical reasoning, yet existing approaches rely on static strategies and lack persistent clinical memory, preventing self-evolving from prior diagnostic successes and failures. We present EMR, a self-evolving medical multi-agent system via Experience Mining and Reuse. EMR introduces a hierarchical clinical experience library that organizes accumulated knowledge into three levels: clinical principles, diagnostic patterns, and representative cases. During inference, EMR emulates multidisciplinary consultation: a planner agent coordinates domain-specific department agents for specialized reasoning, while a summary agent synthesizes their analyses into a final decision. Critically, EMR automatically extracts correct diagnostic insights and failure-related warnings from multi-agent reasoning trajectories, incrementally updating the experience library to guide future cases. Experiments on medical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EMR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art medical multi-agent baselines. Further analysis reveals that the hierarchical experience enables cross-specialty generalization and transfer across diverse LLM backbones, offering a scalable and in

AI.tldr: 提出EMR——一种基于"经验挖掘与复用"的自演化医疗多智能体系统，通过分层临床经验库实现多智能体的持续自我进化，在医疗推理基准上持续超越现有最优基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的医疗多智能体系统依赖静态策略，缺乏持久化临床记忆，无法从既往诊断成功与失败中自我演化，导致复杂临床推理能力受限。
AI.method: EMR引入分层临床经验库，将累积知识组织为临床原则、诊断模式、代表性病例三个层级。推理阶段模拟多学科会诊：由规划智能体协调各专科科室智能体进行专项推理，汇总智能体综合各方分析形成最终决策。关键在于系统自动从多智能体推理轨迹中提取正确诊断洞见与失败相关警示，增量更新经验库以指导后续病例。
AI.result: 在医疗推理基准测试上，EMR持续优于当前最先进的医疗多智能体基线；进一步分析表明，其分层经验支持跨专科泛化，并可跨不同LLM主干模型迁移，具备可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 分层经验驱动的自演化机制有效提升医疗多智能体的临床推理性能，并展现出跨专科泛化与跨模型迁移能力，为可扩展的医疗推理系统提供了可行路径。

title: CITECHOICE: A Causal Audit of How Document Presentation Redistributes Citation Credit in Agentic Search
summary: When several retrieved sources support the same claim, an answer engine cites some but not others. We call this decision citation allocation and introduce CITECHOICE, a causal audit of authentic multi-turn agentic search. From 129 everyday-query transcripts, CITECHOICE selects 113 same-call document pairs with independently verified support for the same pre-specified fact, without observing ranks or answer outcomes; blinded human review confirms 103. It runs a hash-verified 2-by-2 replay crossing pair order with jointly generated, fidelity-checked structured and prose renderings of one target while the rest of the transcript remains fixed. Three results emerge. First, and most importantly, structured rendering concentrates citation credit rather than clearly increasing source admission. It raises target citation count by +0.50 citations per answer (95 percent CI [+0.20, +0.84]; Holm-adjusted p=.033), without increasing total citations or reducing competitor credit. The pre-specified incidence effect (whether the target is cited at all) is +4.5 percentage points and inconclusive (95 percent CI [-1.4, +10.4]; p=.168). Second, observational position differences exceed controlled reordering effects: the citation-rate gap between rank 1 and rank 5 is 42.3 percentage points, compared with +7.9 percentage points in the main replay and 0.0 percentage points held out. Third, citation evaluation has a measurable noise floor. Although the aggregate count effect repeats under fresh decoding of 30 frozen families, 15 percent of binary decisions change and decoding accounts for an estimated 45 percent of single-generation family-effect variance. Together, these findings isolate what survives control: presentation can causally redistribute visible citation credit within frozen transcripts. They do not establish reliable source admission, a pure formatting mechanism, or a general rank advantage.

AI.tldr: 提出"引用分配"概念与CITECHOICE因果审计方法，在真实多轮智能体检索轨迹中通过哈希校验的2×2重放发现：结构化呈现并不明显提升来源被纳入，而是集中了引用功劳。
AI.motivation: 多个检索来源同时支持同一主张时，答案引擎只引用其中一部分。现有研究多依赖观测性排名相关，难以区分呈现方式、位置与生成噪声各自的因果贡献，因此需要一个可控审计来分离这些因素。
AI.method: 从129条日常查询轨迹中筛选出113对同一调用内、且经独立验证支持同一预设事实的文档对（盲审确认103对），在不观察排名与答案结果的前提下开展哈希校验的2×2重放实验：交叉文档对顺序，并对同一目标分别生成结构化与散文式渲染且通过保真性检查，其余轨迹保持不变；辅以冻结家族重解码检验。
AI.result: 结构化渲染使目标引用数每答案增加+0.50次（95% CI [+0.20, +0.84]；Holm校正后p=.033），但总引用数与竞争者引用未变；预设的"是否被引用"发生效应为+4.5个百分点且不显著（95% CI [-1.4, +10.4]；p=.168）。观测层面rank 1与rank 5引用率差距达42.3个百分点，而受控重排仅+7.9个百分点，留出样本为0.0个百分点。30个冻结家族重新解码下总计数效应可复现，但15%二值决策发生变化，解码解释了约45%的单次生成家族效应方差。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结轨迹内，呈现方式可因果地重新分配可见引用功劳，但不足以证明可靠来源纳入、纯格式机制或普遍排名优势；引用评测本身存在可测量的噪声下限。

title: GRAVA: Grounded Reasoning-to-Action Representation and Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly reason before acting, but their intermediate reasoning is often weakly grounded in physical scene evidence and loosely connected to executable behavior. We present GRAVA, a framework built around Grounded Reasoning-to-Action (GRA), which unifies grounding, reasoning, and action generation in a single autoregressive stream. GRA links action-relevant language references to 2D visual regions and ego-centric physical states, organizes object interactions and decisions in a trajectory-anchored typed graph, and serializes this structure into grounded reasoning. A single VLM generates this reasoning followed by a compact Executable Planner action that is deterministically decoded into a continuous trajectory. We further introduce an agentic GRA data construction pipeline that combines forward scene grounding with backward trajectory anchoring, and use it to build GR-NavSim with 2.2M grounded question-answer pairs and 70K GRA reasoning traces. A progressive training strategy develops grounded cognition through pre-training, establishes the reasoning-to-action interface through imitation, and improves driving behavior through reinforcement learning and exploration. Using about 60% of the available human driving demonstrations for action supervision, GRAVA-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance among purely autoregressive driving models on the full NAVSIM benchmark. On an internal long-tail benchmark, full GRA improves key-object compliance and Closed-loop Driving Score by 19.3% and 20.5% over action-only prediction, respectively. These results show the benefit of preserving action-relevant physical evidence from grounded reasoning through executable action generation.

AI.tldr: GRAVA 通过 Grounded Reasoning-to-Action（GRA）将场景接地、推理与动作生成统一到单一自回归流中，在 NAVSIM 上取得纯自回归驾驶模型的最优性能，并在长尾基准上显著提升关键目标遵从率与闭环驾驶得分。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶 VLA 模型虽逐步在行动前进行推理，但其中间推理往往缺乏物理场景证据的支撑，且与可执行行为联系松散，导致推理与实际驾驶动作脱节。
AI.method: 提出 GRAVA 框架：以 GRA（Grounded Reasoning-to-Action）统一接地、推理与动作生成。GRA 将动作相关语言指代链接到 2D 视觉区域与自车物理状态，用轨迹锚定的类型化图组织物体交互与决策，并序列化为有据推理；由单一 VLM 生成该推理及紧凑的 Executable Planner 动作，确定性解码为连续轨迹。同时构建智能体式 GRA 数据流水线，结合前向场景接地与反向轨迹锚定，生成 GR-NavSim（2.2M 接地问答对、70K GRA 推理轨迹）。采用渐进式训练：预训练建立接地认知，模仿学习建立推理到动作接口，强化学习与探索优化驾驶行为。
AI.result: 仅使用约 60% 可用人类驾驶示范进行动作监督，GRAVA-8B 在完整 NAVSIM 基准上取得纯自回归驾驶模型中的最优性能；在内部长尾基准上，完整 GRA 相比仅动作预测将关键目标遵从率与闭环驾驶得分分别提升 19.3% 和 20.5%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明确保从接地推理到可执行动作生成过程中保留与动作相关的物理证据具有显著收益。

title: EECTracker: Swarm Motion Prior-Guided Feature Compensation for Airborne Optical UAV Swarm Tracking
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication.Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Airborne optical tracking of uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) swarms is challenging due to extremely small target scales, rapid viewpoint changes, and cluttered backgrounds, which can weaken target feature responses and lead to intermittent or temporarily missing detector responses. Existing multi-object tracking methods generally depend on reliable target-specific detector responses to maintain target states and identities across frames. When such responses become unreliable, target states cannot be reliably updated and cross-frame association cues become ambiguous, resulting in fragmented trajectories and identity switches. To address this problem, we propose EECTracker, a swarm-motion-prior-guided joint detection-and-tracking framework for airborne optical UAV swarm tracking. EECTracker constructs a probabilistic swarm motion prior from reliable historical tracklets to capture the shared short-term image-plane motion tendency of the swarm and its uncertainty, providing spatial guidance for cross-frame feature compensation. Building on this prior, we introduce Energy--Entropy Consistency Activation (EEC Activation) to evaluate motion-prior-conditioned feature consistency using feature residual energy and local residual entropy. The resulting Local EEC score guides pixel-level feature compensation by enhancing motion-prior-consistent feature responses in potential target regions while suppressing inconsistent background responses. Experiments on AIRMOT and UAVSwarm show that EECTracker achieves superior overall tracking performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. Compared with the strongest competing method SCT-MOT, EECTracker improves MOTA/IDF1 by 3.89/1.79 percentage points on AIRMOT and by 2.81/1.74 percentage points on UAVSwarm, while maintaining online inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出EECTracker，一种基于群体运动先验引导的联合检测-跟踪框架，用于机载光学无人机集群跟踪，通过能量-熵一致性激活实现特征补偿。
AI.motivation: 机载光学跟踪无人机集群面临目标尺度极小、视角快速变化和背景杂乱等挑战，导致目标特征响应减弱、检测器响应间歇性缺失。现有多目标跟踪方法依赖可靠的目标级检测响应来维持状态和身份，一旦响应不可靠，目标状态无法可靠更新、跨帧关联线索模糊，造成轨迹碎片化和身份切换。
AI.method: EECTracker从可靠历史轨迹片段构建概率群体运动先验，捕捉群体共享的短期像平面运动趋势及其不确定性，为跨帧特征补偿提供空间引导。在此基础上提出Energy-Entropy Consistency Activation（EEC激活），利用特征残差能量和局部残差熵评估运动先验条件下的特征一致性；生成的Local EEC分数引导像素级特征补偿，增强潜在目标区域中与运动先验一致的特征响应，抑制不一致的背景响应。
AI.result: 在AIRMOT和UAVSwarm数据集上，EECTracker整体跟踪性能优于最先进方法。与最强竞争者SCT-MOT相比，EECTracker在AIRMOT上MOTA/IDF1提升3.89/1.79个百分点，在UAVSwarm上提升2.81/1.74个百分点，同时保持在线推理速度。
AI.conclusion: EECTracker通过群体运动先验引导的联合检测-跟踪与EEC激活机制，有效缓解检测响应不可靠问题，提升机载无人机集群跟踪的鲁棒性与精度，且推理保持在线效率。

title: Does Attention-Guided Masking Really Help Object Discovery in Object-Centric Learning?
summary: Object-Centric Learning (OCL) aims to decompose images into objects without human annotations. A major family of mainstream methods uses Slot Attention to aggregate image features into object-level representations and then from them reconstructs masked image content, i.e., Random Masking (RM), to provide self-supervision. The recent method DIAS simply masks image patches at uniform randomness yet achieves competitive object discovery accuracy. Since attention during aggregation already possesses object discovery ability, we explore using it to develop a better image patch masking strategy, i.e., Attention Guided Masking (AGM), thereby providing better self-supervision. Results on six recognized datasets show that AGM does not always outperform RM. Under unconditional slot initialization, AGM substantially improves background segmentation on datasets with realistic textures (COCO and VOC); Regardless of conditional or unconditional slot initialization and across datasets, foreground object discovery remains comparable or decreases. We suggest peer researchers in the OCL community that attempts to exploit internal attention semantics to improve OCL with masked decoding are risky. Our source code, model checkpoints and evaluation logs is available on https://github.com/und-entropy/Does-Attention-Guided-Masking-Really-Help-Object-Discovery-in-Object-Centric-Learning-.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究将注意力引导掩码（AGM）用于目标中心学习（OCL）的自监督，发现在六个数据集上AGM并非总优于随机掩码（RM）：无条件槽初始化时AGM显著提升背景分割，但前景目标发现相当或下降，提示利用内部注意力语义改进掩码解码存在风险。
AI.motivation: 主流OCL方法用Slot Attention聚合图像特征为对象表示，并通过重建随机掩码（RM）内容提供自监督；DIAS仅用均匀随机掩码却取得竞争性发现精度。由于聚合时的注意力本身具备目标发现能力，作者想探究用注意力引导掩码（AGM）能否提供更好的自监督。
AI.method: 提出Attention Guided Masking（AGM）：利用Slot Attention聚合过程中的注意力来指导图像patch的掩码选择，替代均匀随机的Random Masking，并在条件与无条件槽初始化两种设定下，于六个公认数据集上对比AGM与RM对目标发现和背景分割的影响。
AI.result: AGM并不总是优于RM。在无条件槽初始化下，AGM在具有真实纹理的数据集（COCO、VOC）上显著改善背景分割；但无论条件还是无条件槽初始化、跨数据集，前景目标发现保持相当或有所下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议OCL同行：试图利用内部注意力语义、通过掩码解码来改进OCL的做法存在风险。代码、模型检查点和评估日志已开源。

title: MUSE: A Theory-Harnessed Story Engine for Vibe Narrativizing
comment: 59 pages, including appendices; 3 figures. Code: https://github.com/RoadtoAGI/MUSE
summary: LLMs have been able to generate fluent prose, but high-quality stories also require coordinated decisions about plot, character, and language across planning, drafting, and revision. We formulate Vibe Narrativizing as turning natural-language writing requirements into a finished story. MUSE, a Theory-Harnessed Story Engine, addresses two bottlenecks: rule quality and sustained rule realization. Story theory supplies the rules, and a practical agent harness puts them to work. Knowledge engineering organizes Robert McKee's theory through rule atomization, semantic consolidation, mechanism abstraction, a single source of truth, and layered disclosure; typical examples clarify judgments that depend on context and aesthetic purpose. The harness preserves story decisions in intermediate deliverables across design, character performance, scene composition, and revision. Context engineering supplies each role with relevant guidance and decisions; a masterwork corpus provides inspiration and prose references. A worked example follows a requested object from its thematic role to climactic actions. Across four base models, MUSE improves WritingBench by 1.1 to 6.2 points over zero-shot generation; it is the only multi-stage system in our comparison to do so. It also raises LongStoryEval by more than ten points on three of the four models. ConStory-Bench consistency error density remains in the low single digits for all four models, below every reproduced story-system baseline on three of the four models. Ablations locate the largest quality contribution in structural design, voice-specific effects in the character path, and further gains in revision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MUSE（Theory-Harnessed Story Engine），将叙事学理论（Robert McKee 故事理论）规则化并嵌入智能体框架，通过设计、角色表演、场景编排与修订等阶段保存中间决策，实现从自然语言写作需求到完整故事的生成。在四个基础模型上，MUSE 使 WritingBench 提升 1.1–6.2 分，LongStoryEval 在四个模型中的三个上提升逾 10 分，ConStory-Bench 一致性错误密度保持低个位数。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型已能生成流畅文本，但高质量故事还需在情节、人物与语言之间跨规划、起草、修订环节进行协调决策。现有方法存在两个瓶颈：规则质量不高，以及规则难以在长流程中持续落实。作者因此希望将叙事理论转化为可执行的规则，并通过工程化的智能体框架保证规则在整个生成流程中被持续贯彻。
AI.method: 提出 MUSE 故事引擎，包含三大支柱：1）知识工程——通过规则原子化、语义整合、机制抽象、单一事实来源与分层披露来组织 Robert McKee 的故事理论，并以典型案例澄清依赖语境与审美目的的判断；2）智能体框架（harness）——在设计、角色表演、场景编排与修订阶段以中间交付物形式保存故事决策；3）上下文工程——为每个角色提供相关指导与决策，并用名著语料提供灵感与文风参照。文中以一个被请求的道具从主题角色到高潮动作的完整流程作为示例。
AI.result: 在四个基础模型上，MUSE 相较零样本生成使 WritingBench 提升 1.1 至 6.2 分，并且是所比较系统中唯一实现该提升的多阶段系统；在四个模型中的三个上使 LongStoryEval 提升超过 10 分；ConStory-Bench 一致性错误密度在所有四个模型上均保持低个位数，并在四个模型中的三个上低于所有复现的故事系统基线。消融实验表明，质量贡献最大来自结构设计，角色路径带来特定声音效果，修订阶段进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 将叙事理论通过知识工程规则化，并由智能体框架与上下文工程加以持续落实，是提升长文本故事生成质量的有效路径。结构设计是质量的主要来源，角色与修订环节各有独立增益，且该方法在一致性与长故事评测上普遍优于现有故事系统基线。

title: Reconstructing Is Not Acting: Action-Centric Latent Dynamics Modeling
summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action representations from unlabeled videos by inferring latent actions from visual transitions and reconstructing future states. However, we identify a fundamental $\textbf{reconstruction-action mismatch}$: lower reconstruction error does not necessarily yield better latent dynamics or downstream performance. We attribute this mismatch to two underconstrained aspects of reconstruction-based latent dynamics modeling: (i) the inverse dynamics model (IDM) is not explicitly encouraged to distinguish action-related transitions from nuisance appearance, and (ii) the forward dynamics model (FDM) can underutilize the inferred latent action by exploiting predictive shortcuts from the current state. To address both limitations, we propose $\textbf{ACT-LAM}$, a lightweight action-centric framework that strengthens both action extraction and action utilization. Specifically, its Action Query IDM (AQ-IDM) employs learnable action queries and gated aggregation to selectively extract rich action-related transition cues without strong information bottlenecks. And its Action Token FDM (AT-FDM) projects latent actions into action tokens that progressively interact with evolving state representations, enabling continuous state-aware action conditioning. ACT-LAM further streamlines feature processing to concentrate model capacity on latent dynamics modeling. Extensive experiments on several robotic datasets and the VP$^2$ benchmark demonstrate stronger latent action consistency, forward dynamics, and downstream visual planning performance with fewer trainable parameters and lower computational overhead. In particular, ACT-LAM surpasses the previous state of the art by $\textbf{7.6%}$ on the aggregated VP$^2$ success rate. Codes at $\href{https://github.com/DingjieFu/ACT-LAM}{url}$.

AI.tldr: 本文指出潜动作模型中存在"重建-动作失配"问题，并提出以动作为中心的轻量框架ACT-LAM，通过AQ-IDM和AT-FDM强化动作提取与利用，在机器人数据集和VP²基准上取得更优性能且参数与计算开销更低。
AI.motivation: 潜动作模型（LAMs）通过从无标签视频中推断潜动作并重建未来状态来学习动作表示，但作者发现"重建-动作失配"：更低的重建误差并不必然带来更好的潜动力学或下游性能。该失配源于重建式潜动力学建模的两个约束不足之处：(i) 逆动力学模型（IDM）未被显式鼓励区分与动作相关的转移和无关外观（nuisance appearance）；(ii) 前向动力学模型（FDM）可从当前状态利用预测捷径，从而未能充分利用推断出的潜动作。
AI.method: 提出ACT-LAM，一个以动作为中心的轻量框架，同时强化动作提取与动作利用。其中Action Query IDM（AQ-IDM）采用可学习动作查询与门控聚合，在不引入强信息瓶颈的情况下选择性提取丰富的动作相关转移线索；Action Token FDM（AT-FDM）将潜动作投影为动作token，使其与演化的状态表示逐步交互，实现连续的状态感知动作条件化。此外，还精简特征处理流程，将模型容量集中于潜动力学建模。
AI.result: 在多个机器人数据集与VP²基准上的大量实验表明，ACT-LAM在潜动作一致性、前向动力学以及下游视觉规划性能上均更强，同时可训练参数更少、计算开销更低。特别地，ACT-LAM在VP²聚合成功率上超越此前最先进方法7.6%。
AI.conclusion: 重建误差并非潜动作质量的可靠代理；通过面向动作提取（AQ-IDM）与动作利用（AT-FDM）的针对性设计，可在更低参数与计算成本下获得更强的潜动力学建模与下游视觉规划能力。

title: What Limits Us? Analyzing Self-Reported Limitations in NLP Research
summary: Since late 2022, a Limitations section has become mandatory at many top-tier NLP conferences. The growing number of accepted papers at these venues has resulted in a vast corpus of self-reported limitations that cannot all be manually reviewed, yet remains systematically unanalyzed. Therefore, in this paper, we conduct a large-scale analysis of the Limitations sections from ACL and EMNLP papers published between 2020 and 2025 to understand what researchers disclose about their own work. To do so, we implement a novel human-AI framework for iterative hybrid qualitative coding. This framework enables us to investigate trends in self-reported limitations over time, their correlations with specific paper attributes, and the writing patterns that recur around these disclosures. Our findings offer a critical reflection on the diverse reported challenges as well as the self-reporting practices of researchers in the NLP community.

AI.tldr: 该论文对2020–2025年ACL和EMNLP论文的Limitations章节进行大规模分析，采用一种新颖的人机协作迭代式混合定性编码框架，考察自报局限的时间趋势、与论文属性的关联及其写作模式，并对NLP社区的自报实践进行批判性反思。
AI.motivation: 自2022年底起，许多顶级NLP会议要求必须撰写Limitations章节，随之产生大量自报局限文本，但难以全部人工审阅且尚缺乏系统分析，因此需要对其内容与披露实践开展大规模研究。
AI.method: 收集2020至2025年ACL与EMNLP论文的Limitations章节，构建并实施一种新颖的人机协作框架，用于迭代式混合定性编码，进而分析自报局限的历时趋势、与论文属性的相关性以及围绕披露反复出现的写作模式。
AI.result: 识别出研究者所披露的多样化挑战，并揭示自报局限随时间的变化趋势、其与特定论文属性的关联，以及这些披露周围的典型写作模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究对NLP社区研究者所报告的多类挑战及其自报实践进行了批判性反思，为理解Limitations章节的实际运作与改进提供了实证依据。

title: Semiotic Relations and Proof Methods: A Cross-Genre Study of Argument Structure with Large Language Models
summary: When a direct proof of a statement $S$ seems hard or even impossible to obtain, there may exist another statement (or set of statements) $S^{*}$, somehow related to $S$, on the basis of which $S$ can be proved. In order to investigate what options can be used to move from $S$ to $S^{*}$, four kinds of semiotic relations inspired by the four master tropes of semiotic research are briefly reviewed. Specifically, our syntagmatic, paradigmatic, antithetic and meronymic relations correspond, respectively, to metonymy, metaphor, irony and synecdoche. It is suggested that these four semiotic relations determine the options to move from $S$ to $S^{*}$, leading to proof by inference, proof by analogy, proof by contradiction, and proof by case analysis. To examine how the four relations are actually used across different kinds of argument, we complement the framework with an empirical study. We turn the four relations into explicit operational definitions and apply them to a cross-genre corpus of mathematical, legal, and everyday argument using a panel of large language models. We find that the relations are used very unevenly across genres: mathematical proofs draw on all four, whereas legal and everyday reasoning rely almost entirely on inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出四种符号学关系（组合、聚合、对立、部分-整体，对应转喻、隐喻、反讽、提喻），用以刻画从待证命题S到辅助命题S*的转移路径，分别导向推理证明、类比证明、反证与分情形证明；并通过大语言模型在数学、法律与日常论证跨体裁语料上的实证研究，发现四类关系的使用高度不均。
AI.motivation: 当直接证明命题S困难甚至不可能时，研究者往往需要借助与之相关的另一命题S*来完成证明。然而，从S到S*存在哪些可选路径、这些路径在理论上如何分类，以及它们在实际论证中如何被使用，尚缺乏统一框架与经验证据。
AI.method: 受符号学四大修辞格启发，构造四类符号学关系：组合关系、聚合关系、对立关系与部分-整体关系，分别对应转喻、隐喻、反讽与提喻，并论证它们决定S到S*的四种转移方式。随后将四类关系转化为可操作的显式定义，借助一组大语言模型在数学、法律与日常论证构成的跨体裁语料上进行标注与分析。
AI.result: 四类符号学关系在跨体裁使用上呈现显著不均衡：数学证明会调用全部四种关系，而法律推理与日常推理几乎完全依赖推理（组合）关系。
AI.conclusion: 符号学四大修辞格可为间接证明策略提供统一的分类框架，说明不同论证类型的底层推理资源存在结构性差异，同时也为跨体裁论证研究提供了一种可操作的实证方法。

title: Long-to-Short Video Evidence Reasoning for Grounded Question Answering
summary: We present LOVER, a \underline{L}ong to sh\underline{O}rt \underline{V}ideo \underline{E}vidence \underline{R}einforced model for grounded question answering (GQA). LOVER highlights three innovations over existing reinforcement-learning (RL) based video reasoning models: (1) \textbf{Long-to-short Video Evidence Curriculum Learning}, which organizes RL training according to evidence duration and progressively adapts the model from long-range grounding to short-term reasoning; (2) \textbf{GQA Rewards}, which underscore the benefit of IoP reward over IoU for evidence spotting rather than strict temporal span overlap; (3) \textbf{Adaptive Timestamp Rendering}, which adaptively renders timestamps onto video frames using background-aware position and color selection to enhance temporal observability. The three designs are model-agnostic and reciprocal. They effectively improve QA, grounding, and grounded QA performance over different backbones. Notably, LOVER built on Time-R1 achieves new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results among open-source models on popular GQA benchmarks: NExT-GQA and ReXTime. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our three innovative components.

AI.tldr: 提出LOVER模型，通过长到短证据课程学习、GQA奖励和自适应时间戳渲染三项创新，提升基于强化学习的视频接地问答性能，并在NExT-GQA和ReXTime上取得开源模型SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的视频推理模型在接地问答中难以有效处理证据时长跨度大、时间定位奖励不匹配以及时间信息可观测性不足的问题，需要更系统的训练课程与奖励设计。
AI.method: 提出LOVER（Long to shOrt Video Evidence Reinforced）模型，包含三个模型无关且互补的设计：（1）长到短视频证据课程学习，按证据时长组织RL训练，从长程接地逐步过渡到短期推理；（2）GQA奖励，强调IoP奖励优于IoU，用于证据定位而非严格时间跨度重叠；（3）自适应时间戳渲染，利用背景感知的位置与颜色选择将时间戳渲染到视频帧上，增强时间可观测性。
AI.result: 三项设计在不同骨干网络上均有效提升QA、接地和接地QA性能；基于Time-R1的LOVER在NExT-GQA和ReXTime等主流GQA基准上取得开源模型新SOTA；消融实验验证了三个创新组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LOVER通过课程学习、专用奖励与自适应时间戳渲染的协同设计，显著提升视频接地问答的推理与定位能力，且方法具有模型无关性，易于推广。

title: Deep Learning-based Intelligent Diagnosis of Congenital Uterine Anomalies in 3D Ultrasound
summary: Objective: To develop an intelligent framework, termed CUA-Net, for the automated classification of congenital uterine anomalies (CUA) without requiring coronal plane reconstruction, and to evaluate its clinical applicability. Methods: CUA-Net was built on 3D ResNet-18, equipped with a dynamic data resampling strategy to mitigate the data imbalance issue and a hard sample mining technique to fully learn from the difficult cases by loss adjustment. We further proposed the self-supervised reconstruction to comprehensively explore the volumes and the online data augmentation to refine the wrong predictions and enhance the model's generalization. We compared the CUA-Net with different deep-learning methods and junior/senior sonographers in the testing set. The evaluation metrics included accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, micro-AUC, and macro-AUC. Results: The proposed CUA-Net exhibited satisfactory performance in both internal and external test sets. In the internal cohort, the model achieved accuracy of 93.88%, precision of 87.01%, recall of 95.92%, F1-score of 88.09%, and micro-AUC of 0.9982 and macro-AUC of 0.9997. In the external set, it maintained good performance with accuracy of 91.52%, precision of 83.27%, recall of 88.63%, F1-score of 81.49%, micro-AUC of 0.9945 and macro-AUC of 0.9990. Our CUA-Net outperformed the junior sonographers across all performance indicators and achieved performance comparable to that of the senior sonographers across most metrics. Conclusion: The CUA-Net demonstrates favorable accuracy and generalizability in classifying common CUA categories, while showing preliminary potential for recognizing less prevalent anomalies. These capabilities may help optimize clinical workflows and support more standardized diagnosis.

AI.tldr: CUA-Net：基于3D ResNet-18的先天性子宫畸形自动分类框架，无需冠状面重建，内外部测试集准确率分别达93.88%和91.52%，性能优于初级超声医师。
AI.motivation: 先天性子宫畸形（CUA）的临床诊断依赖冠状面重建，流程复杂且对操作者经验要求高，亟需无需重建即可实现自动化分类的智能框架以优化临床工作流。
AI.method: 以3D ResNet-18为骨干，采用动态数据重采样策略缓解数据不平衡，通过损失调整的难样本挖掘技术学习困难病例；引入自监督重建充分挖掘体数据信息，并使用在线数据增强修正错误预测、提升泛化能力。在测试集上与不同深度学习方法及初/高级超声医师进行对比，评价指标包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、micro-AUC和macro-AUC。
AI.result: 内部队列：准确率93.88%、精确率87.01%、召回率95.92%、F1分数88.09%、micro-AUC 0.9982、macro-AUC 0.9997；外部测试集：准确率91.52%、精确率83.27%、召回率88.63%、F1分数81.49%、micro-AUC 0.9945、macro-AUC 0.9990。CUA-Net在所有指标上均优于初级超声医师，在多数指标上达到与高级超声医师相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: CUA-Net在常见CUA类别分类中具有良好准确性与泛化性，对少见畸形亦展现初步识别潜力，有望优化临床工作流并支持更标准化的诊断。

title: Closed-form Bayesian homography estimation from noisy point correspondences
summary: While homographies are fundamental to many computer vision tasks, the majority of conventional estimation techniques provide only point estimates without directly quantifying uncertainty introduced by noisy observations. Uncertainty, though, propagates to subsequent processing steps such as camera calibration and 3D reconstruction and is particularly relevant in safety-critical and socially relevant fields including medical imaging, autonomous driving, and defense. We present a fast Bayesian formulation for homography estimation from point correspondences that explicitly incorporates measurement uncertainty and prior knowledge while providing a posterior distribution over the homography parameters. A closed-form solution of the posterior mean of the homography is derived in homogeneous coordinates and supplemented by an iterative Bayesian approach to handle non-linearities. Synthetic experiments demonstrate the applicability to projective transformations and show improved estimation accuracy over DLT under varying noise conditions. Image stitching experiments further demonstrate applicability to real image correspondences while additionally providing uncertainty information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种快速贝叶斯单应性估计方法，从含噪点对应中显式建模测量不确定性与先验，给出单应矩阵参数的后验分布，并在合成与图像拼接实验中验证其精度与不确定性量化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统单应估计方法（如DLT）多只给出点估计，未量化噪声观测引入的不确定性；该不确定性会传播至相机标定、三维重建等后续步骤，在医疗影像、自动驾驶、国防等安全攸关领域尤为重要。
AI.method: 提出快速的贝叶斯单应估计公式，从点对应中显式融合测量不确定性与先验知识，输出单应参数的后验分布；在齐次坐标下推导出后验均值的闭式解，并辅以迭代贝叶斯方法处理非线性问题。
AI.result: 合成实验表明该方法适用于投影变换，在不同噪声条件下估计精度优于DLT；图像拼接实验证明其可应用于真实图像对应，并额外提供不确定性信息。
AI.conclusion: 该贝叶斯框架在保持计算效率的同时实现了单应估计的精度提升与不确定性量化，具备推广至安全攸关应用场景的潜力。

title: Unsupervised Point Cloud Registration via Training-Time Semantic Guidance
summary: Unsupervised registration of large-scale LiDAR point clouds remains challenging due to the geometric ambiguity inherent in outdoor scenes, which degrades pseudo-label quality and leads to suboptimal convergence, particularly for sparse, low-resolution scans such as those from nuScenes. We reveal that registration models intrinsically encode semantic awareness that strongly correlates with registration accuracy, albeit without explicit semantic supervision. However, this native awareness is fragile: noisy supervision arising from geometric ambiguity in unsupervised settings rapidly erodes the learned semantic structure, causing performance collapse. To this end, we propose CAESAR, a teacher-student framework guided by an off-the-shelf 3D segmentation model exclusively during training. We observe that potential inlier matches are often buried just beneath a few spurious neighbors in the noisy feature space, motivating Dual-Cue Guided Re-Matching to recover them through reselection rather than simply rejecting. Building on this, a train-only Semantic-Geometric Label Mining performs lightweight, batch-specific teacher refinement and mines reliable pseudo-labels under semantic guidance. We further introduce Semantic Predictive Distillation to consolidate the student's semantic awareness in the feature space. Extensive experiments on KITTI and nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with pronounced gains on the challenging nuScenes benchmark. Crucially, CAESAR incurs zero inference overhead and requires no semantic annotations on the registration data. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出CAESAR框架：以教师-学生结构在训练时引入现成3D分割模型指导无监督LiDAR点云配准，零推理开销、无需语义标注。
AI.motivation: 大规模LiDAR点云无监督配准受室外场景几何歧义影响，伪标签质量差导致收敛不佳，稀疏低分辨率扫描（如nuScenes）尤为严重。作者发现配准模型隐含与精度强相关的语义感知，但该感知在几何歧义噪声监督下会被迅速侵蚀致性能崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 教师-学生框架，仅训练阶段使用现成3D分割模型指导；2) 观察到潜在内点匹配常被少量伪邻居掩埋于噪声特征空间，提出双线索引导重匹配（Dual-Cue Guided Re-Matching），通过重选而非简单剔除恢复内点；3) 训练专用的语义-几何标签挖掘（Semantic-Geometric Label Mining），进行轻量批次级教师细化并在语义引导下挖掘可靠伪标签；4) 语义预测蒸馏（Semantic Predictive Distillation）在特征空间巩固学生语义感知。
AI.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得SOTA性能，在更具挑战的nuScenes基准上增益尤为显著；零推理开销，配准数据无需语义标注。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义引导可有效保护并利用配准模型内在语义感知，缓解几何歧义下伪标签退化问题，在不增加推理成本与标注成本的前提下显著提升无监督LiDAR配准性能。

title: Pre-PEFT Probing: Weight Statistics and Perturbation Robustness for Layer Selection in VLM Vision Encoders
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026)
summary: We propose a pre-fine-tuning probing method for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) layer selection, aiming to obtain more stable and higher gains with fewer trainable parameters when adapting large vision--language models (VLMs). Unlike the common practice of applying LoRA and other adapters to all layers at once---where layer selection often relies on heuristic rules---we focus on the vision encoder and directly evaluate the "adaptability'' of each Transformer layer. Specifically, we characterize each layer from two perspectives: (i) the statistical properties of its Q/K/V projection weights (e.g., norms and condition numbers); (ii) robustness under controlled parameter perturbations. We then systematically compare these indicators with the downstream performance gains brought by applying PEFT to a single layer. Across experiments covering seven benchmarks and five PEFT variants, we observe a consistent correlation: layers (or matrices) with larger weight norms and higher condition numbers are usually more robust to perturbations and are more likely to yield larger fine-tuning gains. These results show that distribution-statistics analysis and perturbation tests before fine-tuning can provide practical signals for adaptation-layer selection, thereby maintaining or improving performance while reducing trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向PEFT层选择的预微调探测方法，从权重统计特性与扰动鲁棒性两个角度评估视觉编码器各Transformer层的"可适应性"，并在7个基准、5种PEFT变体上验证了权重范数与条件数同微调增益的一致性关联。
AI.motivation: 在适配大型视觉-语言模型时，常见的做法是一次性将LoRA等适配器施加于所有层，层选择多依赖启发式规则，导致可训练参数冗余且增益不稳定。作者希望以更少可训练参数获得更稳定、更高的性能提升。
AI.method: 提出预微调探测（pre-fine-tuning probing）方法，聚焦视觉编码器，直接评估每一Transformer层的"可适应性"：一是刻画其Q/K/V投影权重的统计特性（如范数与条件数）；二是考察其在受控参数扰动下的鲁棒性；随后将这些指标与对单层施加PEFT所带来的下游性能增益进行系统对比。
AI.result: 在涵盖7个基准与5种PEFT变体的实验中观察到一致的相关性：权重范数更大、条件数更高的层（或矩阵）通常对扰动更鲁棒，且更可能带来更大的微调增益。
AI.conclusion: 微调前的分布统计分析结合扰动测试可为适配层选择提供实用信号，从而在减少可训练参数的同时保持或提升性能。

title: Validating, Not Sampling: Region-Level Robustness of Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. There, a small perturbation to the recorded camera image may change a decision significantly. However, existing benchmarks for these models only sample perturbations, which does not guarantee the absence of a failure in the untested region. We present the first robustness validation of six VLMs (drawn from the Gemma, InternVL, LLaVA, and Qwen families) and five VLAs (drawn from the GR00T, OpenVLA, and $π$ families) over entire continuous regions of photometric and geometric image perturbation: brightness shifts, camera rotations, and their composition. To this end, we build on the validation framework H$^2$V and introduce H$^2$V-M, a margin-aware convergence rule that makes validation affordable at the 32B parameter scale. We demonstrate that H$^2$V-M outperforms H$^2$V by an order of magnitude in model queries and that it finds counterexamples faster than random sampling while providing soundness guarantees. Our VLM and VLA robustness validation shows that robustness is mostly dependent on the perturbation type, rather than the model, and that VLMs are more robust to large camera rotations than VLAs. For VLAs, even perturbations as small as $\pm1^\circ$ can change the commanded action in many cases. We also show that robustness depends more on model family than on model size.

AI.tldr: 提出H²V-M，一种margin-aware收敛规则，用于对6个VLM和5个VLA在连续图像扰动区域进行鲁棒性验证，结果发现鲁棒性主要取决于扰动类型而非模型。
AI.motivation: VLM和VLA在真实场景中部署增多，但相机图像的微小扰动可能显著改变决策。现有基准仅对扰动进行采样测试，无法保证未测试区域不存在失败，因此需要覆盖连续扰动区域的鲁棒性验证。
AI.method: 基于验证框架H²V，提出H²V-M（一种margin-aware收敛规则），使其在32B参数规模下验证仍可行；对6个VLM（Gemma、InternVL、LLaVA、Qwen系列）和5个VLA（GR00T、OpenVLA、π系列）在光度与几何图像扰动的整个连续区域（亮度偏移、相机旋转及其组合）上进行鲁棒性验证。
AI.result: H²V-M在模型查询量上比H²V优一个数量级，比随机采样更快找到反例且提供可靠性保证。鲁棒性主要取决于扰动类型而非模型；VLM对大幅相机旋转比VLA更鲁棒；对VLA而言，即使±1°的微小扰动在许多情况下也能改变指令动作；鲁棒性更依赖模型家族而非模型规模。
AI.conclusion: H²V-M实现了大规模连续扰动区域的高效鲁棒性验证，并揭示了VLM与VLA鲁棒性受扰动类型和模型家族主导、VLA对微小扰动高度敏感的规律。

title: A 25-$μ$s/inf Event-driven Graph Neural Network Processor with Spatiotemporal Caching and Spline Convolution for Ultra-low-latency AI at the Edge
comment: This paper was accepted for presentation at the IEEE ESSERC 2026 conference
summary: Dynamic-vision-sensor (DVS) cameras generate events on a per-pixel basis with a $μ$s-level temporal resolution, calling for new algorithm-hardware co-design approaches compared to standard frame-based vision. While event-driven graph neural networks (EV-GNNs) emerge as a promising algorithmic solution, they raise new HW challenges by mixing dense-regular compute operations and sparse-irregular memory accesses. We present ETHEREAL, the first EV-GNN accelerator that scales to 640$\times$480 resolutions, thanks to a neighbor-parallel spline convolution engine and a 2D/3D-split memory hierarchy with a novel region-of-interest spatiotemporal caching mechanism. Measurement results demonstrate end-to-end inference with 25.6$μ$s latency and 1.7$μ$J energy per event on state-of-the-art workloads

AI.tldr: 提出首个支持640×480分辨率的EV-GNN加速器ETHEREAL，通过邻域并行样条卷积引擎与2D/3D分割存储层次兼顾密集规则计算与稀疏不规则访存，实现25.6μs端到端延迟与1.7μJ/事件能效。
AI.motivation: DVS相机以像素级、微秒级时间分辨率生成事件，与传统帧式视觉差异显著，需要新的算法-硬件协同设计。EV-GNN是有前景的算法方案，但其混合了密集规则计算与稀疏不规则访存，给硬件实现带来新挑战，且现有工作难以扩展到高分辨率。
AI.method: ETHEREAL采用两项关键设计：一是邻域并行样条卷积引擎，用于高效处理事件图的卷积运算；二是2D/3D分割的存储层次结构，并引入新颖的兴趣区域（RoI）时空缓存机制，以缓解稀疏不规则访存开销。
AI.result: 在先进工作负载上实现端到端推理，单事件延迟为25.6μs，能耗为1.7μJ，并首次将EV-GNN加速器扩展到640×480分辨率。
AI.conclusion: ETHEREAL验证了面向高分辨率DVS的EV-GNN加速在算法-硬件协同设计上的可行性，在延迟与能效上取得领先指标，为事件驱动图神经网络的实际部署提供了硬件基础。

title: Artificial entrepreneurial cognition: Locating and causally steering an opportunity recognition dial inside large language models (LLMs)
comment: 105 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables (8 in the main text, 12 in the appendices)
summary: Entrepreneurial cognition is a foundation of entrepreneurship research. Yet the growing involvement of large language models (LLMs) in entrepreneurial work extends the cognition question beyond human actors to systems whose internal representations remain largely unexplored. We introduce artificial entrepreneurial cognition, the functional organisation of entrepreneurship-relevant representations and computations inside artificial intelligence (AI) systems. We bring mechanistic interpretability into entrepreneurship research through representation engineering. Focusing on opportunity recognition (OR), we construct 636 matched OR-present and OR-absent scenario pairs and recover an OR direction in Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct. Rather than infer the construct from outputs, we intervene directly on this direction, steering the model up and down along what we call the opportunity recognition dial, and its opportunity judgments shift with it. To our knowledge, this is the first causal intervention on an internal representation of an entrepreneurship construct inside an LLM. Held-out tests, lexical and topical controls, behavioural ablation, and geometric comparisons show that the direction is recoverable, consequential, and distinct from the opportunity evaluation and exploitation directions, although steering it also shifts judgments about these neighbouring stages. Recovery, signed steering, and geometric separation hold across four additional LLMs spanning different scales and families. These results give the contested distinction between opportunity recognition and evaluation a concrete representational form inside AI systems. More broadly, they establish internal representations as a new object of entrepreneurship inquiry and show how entrepreneurship theory can guide their identification, causal manipulation, and interpretation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"人工创业认知"概念，运用表征工程与机制可解释性方法，在Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct中识别出"机会识别"方向，并通过因果干预验证其可恢复性、有效性与阶段性区分度，且在另外四个大模型中复现。
AI.motivation: 创业认知是创业研究的基础，但LLM日益参与创业工作，使认知问题从人类行动者扩展到内部表征尚未被探索的人工系统。已有研究多从模型输出推断构念，缺乏对内部表征的因果检验，且机会识别与机会评价的边界在文献中仍存争议。
AI.method: 将机制可解释性引入创业研究，采用表征工程方法。构建636对匹配的"存在机会/不存在机会"情境对，在Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct中提取"机会识别方向"，并通过"机会识别旋钮"进行上下调制的定向干预，而非从输出反推构念。辅以留出测试、词汇与主题控制、行为消融及几何比较，并在四个跨规模、跨家族模型上进行复现。
AI.result: 该方向可被恢复、具有因果效力，且在几何上区别于机会评价与机会利用方向；调节该方向会同步改变对相邻阶段的判断。恢复、有符号调节与几何分离在四个额外LLM上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 为机会识别与机会评价之争提供了AI系统内部的具体表征形式；确立内部表征为创业研究的新对象，并展示创业理论如何指导其识别、因果操纵与解释。

title: AlignUS: MRI-Guided Ultrasound Representation Learning for ALS Classification from Tongue Images
summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease in which early assessment remains challenging, particularly in low-resource settings where MRI is often unavailable. High-resolution ultrasound (HRUS) of the tongue offers a portable and low-cost alternative for evaluating bulbar involvement, but learning reliable diagnostic models is limited by small datasets and the difficulty of extracting robust representations from ultrasound alone. We propose AlignUS, a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework that transfers anatomical knowledge from MRI to a HRUS-based classifier while requiring only HRUS at inference time. The model combines classification loss, supervised contrastive learning, and feature-level distillation to align HRUS representations with MRI embeddings. AlignUS achieves a patient-level balanced accuracy of 0.958, macro-F1 of 0.963, and ROC-AUC of 0.990, aggregated across four patient-level cross-validation folds, with consistent improvements over HRUS baselines and cross-modal alternatives. These results demonstrate that MRI-derived supervision can substantially improve ultrasound-based ALS assessment while preserving low-cost, inference-time independence from MRI.

AI.tldr: 提出AlignUS跨模态知识蒸馏框架，将MRI解剖知识迁移到舌部高分辨率超声分类器，仅推理时需超声即可实现ALS评估，患者级平衡准确率0.958。
AI.motivation: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）早期评估困难，在MRI常不可用的低资源环境中尤为突出。舌部高分辨率超声（HRUS）便携低成本，可用于评估球部受累，但小数据集以及仅从超声难以提取稳健表征，限制了可靠诊断模型的学习。
AI.method: 提出AlignUS跨模态知识蒸馏框架：将MRI中的解剖知识迁移至基于HRUS的分类器，推理阶段仅需HRUS。模型联合使用分类损失、监督对比学习以及特征级蒸馏，以对齐HRUS表征与MRI嵌入。
AI.result: 在四折患者级交叉验证中聚合，患者级平衡准确率达0.958，宏F1为0.963，ROC-AUC为0.990，并相较HRUS基线与跨模态替代方法取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: MRI衍生的监督可显著提升基于超声的ALS评估，同时保持低成本且推理阶段独立于MRI。

title: Reason What Matters: Retrieval-Grounded Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space for diverse retrieval tasks. Recent methods improve embeddings through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning optimized with GRPO using retrieval rewards. However, existing methods overlook the mismatch bettween candidate-aware retrieval supervision and input-only CoT generation: (1)trajectory-level rewards convey retrieval outcomes without explicitly identifying the input-supported evidence that distinguishes the positive from hard negatives; (2) input-only generation cannot directly assess whether further reasoning improves retrieval, potentially producing redundant CoTs with substantial latency. To bridge this gap, we propose Reason What Matters (ReWAM), a retrieval-grounded framework that aligns candidate-aware supervision with input-only generation. Specifically, we introduce Retrieval-Aware Self-Distillation (RASD), which extracts privileged guidance from input-supported facts and evidence distinguishing the positive from hard negatives. Conditioned on this guidance, an on-policy self-teacher provides token-level feedback to refine credit assignment, directing policy updates toward retrieval-relevant reasoning grounded in the input. We further propose Retrieval-Adaptive Inference (RAI), which learns a retrieval-aware stopping criterion from prefix-level retrieval feedback. It stops redundant reasoning without candidate access and uses speculative decoding to further reduce CoT latency. Extensive experiments on MMEB-V2 and MRMR demonstrate that ReWAM achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance while delivering up to 5x the inference throughput of competitive explicit-CoT UME methods. ReWAM thus enables high-quality retrieval through efficient input-only reasoning, making explicit CoT practical for corpus-scale multimodal retrieval. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReWAM 框架，通过检索感知自蒸馏与检索自适应推理，将候选感知监督与仅输入式 CoT 生成对齐，在 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 上实现 SOTA 检索性能并带来最高 5 倍推理吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入方法用 GRPO 结合检索奖励优化 CoT，但存在候选感知检索监督与仅输入式 CoT 生成的错配：轨迹级奖励只反映检索结果，未显式指出区分正样本与难负样本的输入支持证据；仅输入式生成无法评估进一步推理是否提升检索，易产生冗余 CoT 并带来高延迟。
AI.method: 提出 ReWAM，包含两部分：(1) 检索感知自蒸馏（RASD），从输入支持的事实和区分正样本与难负样本的证据中提取特权指导，据此由在线策略自教师提供 token 级反馈，细化信用分配，使策略更新聚焦于基于输入的检索相关推理；(2) 检索自适应推理（RAI），从前缀级检索反馈学习检索感知停止准则，在无候选访问下终止冗余推理，并用投机解码进一步降低 CoT 延迟。
AI.result: 在 MMEB-V2 与 MRMR 上的大量实验表明，ReWAM 取得 SOTA 检索性能，同时推理吞吐最高为竞争性显式 CoT UME 方法的 5 倍。
AI.conclusion: ReWAM 通过高效的仅输入式推理实现高质量检索，使显式 CoT 可实际应用于语料库规模的多模态检索。代码将公开。

title: Learning from Reliable Negatives: Confidence-Anchored Test-Time Adaptation for GUI Grounding
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding is essential for autonomous agents to map natural language instructions to precise screen coordinates. However, existing supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning methods are constrained by the high cost of annotation, creating a scalability bottleneck. In this paper, we introduce a label-free test-time training paradigm driven by two key insights: (1) confidence patterns in coordinate tokens are a better indicator than full-sequence confidence, and (2) in sparse GUI coordinate spaces, negative samples offer more reliable learning signals than potentially noisy positive ones. We first propose Confidence-Anchored Learning (CAL), which utilizes coordinate-token confidence to filter pseudo-labels and assign distance-based binary rewards. Building on this, we develop Confidence-Anchored Negative Learning (CANL), which exclusively optimizes the model using negative samples to bypass the risks of incorrect positive samples. Experimental results demonstrate that CANL-7B achieves 92.1% on ScreenSpot-V2. On more challenging ScreenSpot-Pro, CANL-7B reaches 33.8%, an 8.9% absolute improvement over the base model. Our findings establish coordinate-token confidence as a powerful alternative to manual annotations for scalable GUI agent development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需标注的测试时训练范式，利用坐标token置信度进行GUI定位，并进一步提出仅用负样本优化的CANL，在ScreenSpot-V2达92.1%，ScreenSpot-Pro达33.8%。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding是自主智能体将自然语言指令映射到精确屏幕坐标的关键能力，但现有监督微调与强化学习方法受限于高昂的标注成本，形成可扩展性瓶颈。因此需要一种无需人工标注的可扩展训练方案。
AI.method: 基于两点洞察：(1) 坐标token的置信度比全序列置信度更能反映定位质量；(2) 在稀疏的GUI坐标空间中，负样本比可能有噪声的正样本提供更可靠的学习信号。作者先提出Confidence-Anchored Learning (CAL)，利用坐标token置信度筛选伪标签并分配基于距离的二值奖励；在此基础上提出Confidence-Anchored Negative Learning (CANL)，仅使用负样本优化模型，以规避错误正样本的风险。
AI.result: CANL-7B在ScreenSpot-V2上达到92.1%；在更具挑战性的ScreenSpot-Pro上达到33.8%，相较基座模型绝对提升8.9%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明坐标token置信度可作为人工标注的有力替代，支持可扩展的GUI智能体开发。

title: When Agents Slow Down: Understanding LLM Agents' Test-Time Strategies via Elo-per-token Analysis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents allocate test-time compute adaptively as they revise solutions, use tools, explore alternatives, and decide when to stop. This test-time strategy makes it difficult to measure how agent performance scales. We study open-ended tasks that provide continuous scores for intermediate submissions, making progress observable throughout long trajectories. We propose Elo-per-token analysis, which tracks the best solution found at each token budget and uses a Bradley-Terry model to aggregate within-task orderings into Elo ratings across tasks with different score scales. We apply it to four general-purpose agents on four open-ended benchmarks, with sessions of up to 100M tokens, and to three feedback-driven LLM optimization harnesses in controlled single-task interventions. Independent sampling provides a theoretically characterized reference, for which Elo grows linearly with log compute. Against this reference, agents can initially convert tokens into Elo faster than independent sampling, but their marginal gains diminish and eventually fall below the reference. In contrast, the strongest historical human contestants improve superlinearly over contest time on shared AtCoder Heuristic Contest tasks, providing evidence of continual learning and substantial headroom after agents slow down. We define the scaling inflection point as the per-session budget where marginal Elo gains match the independent-sampling reference. Using this point as the per-session budget, we split 100M tokens across parallel sessions on FrontierCS Polyomino Packing, gaining +264 Elo over one long session and +355 over ten short sessions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“Elo-per-token”分析框架，用Bradley-Terry模型将开放式任务中的中间解排序聚合为Elo，从而在token预算维度上度量LLM智能体的测试时计算扩展规律，并揭示其边际收益递减及并行会话的显著增益。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在测试时会自适应分配计算（修改解答、调用工具、探索备选方案、决定停止），这种策略使传统性能-计算扩展曲线难以刻画，因此需要一个能跨不同评分尺度、在长轨迹中持续观测进展的度量方法。
AI.method: 提出Elo-per-token分析：跟踪每个token预算下找到的最优解，用Bradley-Terry模型将任务内排序聚合为跨任务的Elo评分；在4个通用智能体×4个开放式基准（单会话最高1亿token）以及3个反馈驱动优化框架的单任务干预中评估；以独立采样作为理论参照（其Elo随log计算量线性增长）；对AtCoder Heuristic Contest的人类选手数据作对比；并定义“扩展拐点”为边际Elo增益等于独立采样参照的会话预算。
AI.result: 智能体初期以高于独立采样的速率将token转化为Elo，但边际增益递减并最终低于参照；人类顶尖选手在AtCoder Heuristic Contest共享任务上随时间呈超线性提升，说明存在持续学习与显著提升空间；以扩展拐点作为单会话预算，在FrontierCS Polyomino Packing上将1亿token拆分到并行会话，相比单个长会话提升+264 Elo，相比十个短会话提升+355 Elo。
AI.conclusion: 测试时计算存在收益递减的扩展拐点，据此把预算分配到并行会话可显著优于单一长会话；人类表现超线性增长表明智能体放缓后仍有大量提升空间，并行化是释放该空间的有效策略。

title: Reducing the Output-Mode Gap in Speech Language Models via Joint-Output On-Policy Distillation
summary: Autoregressive generation of interleaved text and acoustic tokens is a common approach to spoken-response generation in speech large language models. Although this design enables streaming generation with explicit textual guidance, generated acoustic tokens become part of the context for subsequent text predictions. Given identical speech inputs, we observe markedly lower answer accuracy for the internal text generated in speech-to-text-and-speech (S2TS) mode than for speech-to-text (S2T) responses. We term this discrepancy the \emph{output-mode gap} (OMG). To reduce OMG, we propose \emph{Joint-Output On-Policy Distillation} (JO-OPD), which distills the model's stronger S2T policy into joint generation using student-generated S2TS trajectories. At each text position, the S2T teacher provides soft targets from a text-only projection of the student's preceding outputs, while the student predicts from the corresponding full interleaved history. A preservation objective further regularizes native non-text predictions. Experiments on Step-Audio-2-mini and Baichuan-Audio-Instruct reveal OMG across two interleaved generation architectures. On Step-Audio-2-mini, JO-OPD reduces OMG from 42.87 to 16.26 percentage points on Spoken-MQA and from 29.72 to 13.04 points on speech-rendered GSM8K, with little change in S2T accuracy and substantially larger reductions than matched SFT baselines. ASR-based evaluation further shows a 7.49-point improvement in spoken-answer accuracy on Spoken-MQA.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现语音大模型的"输出模式差距"（OMG）：同一语音输入下，交错的S2TS生成中内部文本准确率显著低于纯S2T，并提出JO-OPD通过在线策略蒸馏将更强的S2T策略迁移到联合生成中以缩小该差距。
AI.motivation: 交错文本-声学token自回归生成是语音大模型常见方案，支持流式生成并提供显式文本引导；但生成的声学token会进入后续文本预测的上下文，导致在相同语音输入下，S2TS模式内部文本的答案准确率明显低于S2T，作者将此差异定义为"输出模式差距"（OMG），并希望缩小该差距。
AI.method: 提出Joint-Output On-Policy Distillation（JO-OPD）：利用学生模型自身生成的S2TS轨迹，将更强的S2T策略蒸馏进联合生成。在每个文本位置，S2T教师基于学生前序输出的纯文本投影提供软目标，学生则从对应的完整交错历史进行预测；另设p保留目标对原始非文本预测进行正则化。在Step-Audio-2-mini与Baichuan-Audio-Instruct两种交错生成架构上验证。
AI.result: 在两种交错生成架构上均观察到OMG现象。Step-Audio-2-mini上，JO-OPD将Spoken-MQA的OMG从42.87个百分点降至16.26个百分点，将语音渲染GSM8K的OMG从29.72降至13.04个百分点，同时S2T准确率基本不变，且降幅显著大于匹配的SFT基线；基于ASR的评测显示Spoken-MQA口语答案准确率提升7.49个百分点。
AI.conclusion: JO-OPD能有效缩小交错语音生成中的输出模式差距，在不损害S2T能力的前提下提升S2TS内部文本与口语答案的准确性，且优于SFT基线。

title: Clean Scores, Buried Evidence, and Confident Wrong: A Receipt-Based Audit of Frontier Agentic QA
comment: 28 pages, 9 figures. Frozen evidence archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22310532
summary: Frontier models score well on shallow document/chart reading tasks. In a controlled data-room audit, moving evidence into buried conditions reduced accuracy, increased forced declarations, increased tool calls, and increased cost per correct answer. Confidence and benchmark calibration did not fully capture wrong answers; a documented production incident shows fabricated structural claims can be mixed with accurate numeric tables.
