Agentic evaluations need claim-level receipts (statement-level provenance, not answer-level scores), condition-aware scoring, and human-adversarial verification - an auditing discipline, not a leaderboard. The setting we measure is financial due diligence; the setting we are building toward next is defense staff work, where the same buried-evidence shape appears. In both, the model is not a party to the consequences; the person who signs is. In plain terms: in the documented cases we examine, agents can pair accurate numbers with confident fabricated explanations, and the burden of proof must therefore move from the model to the evidence trail.

AI.tldr: 前沿模型在浅层文档/图表阅读任务上表现良好，但当证据被埋入复杂条件后，准确率下降、被迫声明增多、工具调用与单次正确答案成本上升；置信度与基准校准无法完全识别错误，且存在将虚构结构性结论与准确数字表格混用的事故记录。因此提出智能体评估应转向"证据链审计"而非排行榜。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多在浅层、易获取的证据条件下评估模型，导致高分掩盖了真实场景中的脆弱性；在金融尽职调查等高风险场景中，证据常被埋藏在深层文档里，模型的错误会直接由人类签署者承担后果，需要更贴近实际的评估与审计方法。
AI.method: 采用受控的"数据室审计"（data-room audit）实验设计，通过将证据置于被埋藏（buried）条件下与浅层条件对比，观测准确率、被迫声明次数、工具调用次数、单次正确答案成本等指标，并结合置信度与基准校准分析，同时引用一起已记录的生产事故案例。
AI.result: 证据埋藏条件导致模型准确率下降、被迫声明增加、工具调用增加、单次正确答案成本上升；置信度与基准校准未能充分捕捉错误答案；生产事故表明模型可将虚构的结构性论断与准确的数字表格混合输出。
AI.conclusion: 智能体评估需要引入声明级凭据（陈述级溯源而非答案级评分）、条件感知评分以及人类对抗性验证，将其视为一种审计学科而非排行榜；应把举证责任从模型转移到证据链，因为最终承担后果的是人类签署者。

title: Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes for Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Volume-based multimodal retrieval jointly scores a text query with a candidate's video, audio, and subtitle embeddings. While this approach captures higher-order within-candidate alignment, the score remains candidate-local, and semantically related training samples primarily serve as contrastive negatives. This work introduces Hypergraph-Regularized Gramian Volumes (HyVol), a training-time module that incorporates these semantic relations prior to evaluating the original volume loss. Document hyperedges connect the observed modalities of each candidate, whereas semantic hyperedges link candidates whose detached captions are mutual top-k neighbors. A shallow gated hyper-graph network applies residual corrections to the modality embeddings. Presence masks exclude unavailable streams from message passing, and identity padding preserves the determinant of the observed Gram submatrix without feature imputation. As refinement operates on embeddings rather than scores, the same construction applies to both Gram and HyperGram. We remove the hypergraph after training, leaving the backbone-only architecture, original scoring function, and retrieval cost unchanged. We train both backbones on a 150K-clip subset of VAST-27M and evaluate zero-shot performance on six benchmarks. Under the paired protocol, HyVol improves R@1 across all five retrieval benchmarks, with video-to-text gains reaching +8.3 on MSR-VTT and +7.6 on VATEX. Under missing-modality masking, the V2T margin remains positive in all experimental settings, although the T2V margin becomes slightly negative in four.

AI.tldr: 提出 HyVol，一种训练期超图正则化 Gramian 体积模块，将样本间语义关系引入多模态检索打分，训练后移除超图，保持推理架构与检索开销不变。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态检索的 volume-based 打分虽能捕获候选内部各模态的高阶对齐，但打分仍是 candidate-local 的；语义相关的训练样本仅被当作对比负样本使用，样本间语义关系未被显式建模。
AI.method: 在评估原始 volume 损失之前，引入超图正则化。文档超边连接同一候选的各观测模态；语义超边连接 detached caption 互为 top-k 近邻的候选。用浅层门控超图网络对模态嵌入施加残差修正；presence mask 将缺失模态排除出消息传递，identity padding 在不做特征填补的前提下保持观测 Gram 子矩阵的行列式。因修正作用于嵌入而非分数，该构造对 Gram 与 HyperGram 均适用，训练后移除超图。
AI.result: 在 VAST-27M 的 150K 片段子集上训练两种骨干，并在六个基准上零样本评测。配对协议下，HyVol 在全部五个检索基准上提升 R@1，V2T 在 MSR-VTT 上 +8.3、VATEX 上 +7.6。缺失模态掩码下，全部实验设置的 V2T 边际为正，但 T2V 边际在四种设置中略为负值。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期超图正则化显式建模样本间语义关系，可在不改变推理结构与检索成本的前提下提升多模态检索性能；对视频到文本方向增益显著且对缺失模态较稳健，但文本到视频方向在部分缺失模态设置下仍有退化。

title: Concept-Grounded Reasoning with Prompt-Driven Localization for Interpretable Structured Report Generation
summary: Medical imaging modalities such as ultrasound and X-ray are widely used in clinical practice, where diagnosis follows a structured, evidence-driven workflow aligned with standardized criteria. While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promise for automated medical report generation, most existing systems rely on end-to-end multimodal fusion without modeling clinically defined intermediate attributes, leading to limited grounding and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose CORAL (COncept-grounded ReAsoning with Localization), a multimodal framework that integrates spatial grounding and concept-level supervision into a unified reasoning process. CORAL employs a prompt-driven medical segmentation model to localize lesions and predicts multi-class clinical attributes through a Concept Bottleneck module. The resulting textual concept tokens are combined with mask-modulated visual features within an MLLM to enable structured report generation and diagnostic prediction. Experiments on BUS-CoT and IU X-ray datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in diagnostic accuracy, concept consistency, and report quality over strong general-purpose and medical MLLMs, indicating that concept-grounded reasoning better aligns generation with clinical decision processes.

AI.tldr: 提出CORAL框架，将空间定位与概念级监督融入统一推理过程，通过概念瓶颈模块预测临床属性并结合掩码调制视觉特征，提升医学报告生成的诊断准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态大模型多采用端到端多模态融合，未建模临床定义的中间属性，导致视觉定位不足与可解释性有限。
AI.method: CORAL采用提示驱动的医学分割模型定位病灶，通过概念瓶颈模块预测多类临床属性；将文本概念token与掩码调制后的视觉特征在MLLM中结合，实现结构化报告生成与诊断预测。
AI.result: 在BUS-CoT和IU X-ray数据集上，诊断准确率、概念一致性与报告质量均稳定优于强通用及医学MLLM基线。
AI.conclusion: 概念驱动的推理能更好地使生成结果与临床决策过程对齐，验证了中间概念监督在医学报告生成中的有效性。

title: Query-Conditioned Spherical Centroid Aggregation for Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Multimodal retrieval integrates video, audio, subtitles, and text; however, recent geometric aggregators, such as Gramian volumes, hyperbolic volumes, and spectral objectives, treat all modalities symmetrically. Under a unified evaluation protocol, their joint scores frequently lag behind the strongest single-modality pathway by 1.9 to 27.6 R@1. Controlled analyses attribute this outcome to uniform modality influence. This work introduces Spherical Centroid Aggregation with Learned Adaptive Relevance (SCALAR), a query-conditioned aggregator that assigns relevance-based weights to each available modality before computing a spherical centroid. SCALAR accommodates arbitrary modality subsets and is trained on masked, reduced-arity views using rank-8 LoRA adapters. Across five benchmarks, SCALAR achieves positive aggregation gain on four, reaching +4.0 R@1, while none of the evaluated prior aggregators is positive on more than one. A uniform-weight ablation reproduces the degradation observed with symmetric aggregation. With only 4.8 million trainable parameters, SCALAR attains the highest text-to-video R@1 on three and performs within seed variation of the best result on a fourth. Under test-time modality dropout, SCALAR's representation-stage score surpasses the released GRAM checkpoint at every evaluated masking rate and benchmark by 3.2 to 10.9 R@1. Finally, as modalities are removed, rerankers trained exclusively on complete modality sets increasingly converge toward their video-only pathways, diminishing these representation-level gains and underscoring a limitation of standard two-stage retrieval pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出查询条件的球面质心聚合器SCALAR，通过学习自适应模态相关性权重解决多模态检索中对称聚合导致性能落后于单模态的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态几何聚合器（Gramian体积、双曲体积、谱目标）对所有模态对称处理，在统一评测协议下联合得分常落后于最强单模态路径1.9–27.6 R@1；受控分析表明原因是模态影响均匀。
AI.method: SCALAR对每个可用模态分配基于相关性的权重，再计算球面质心；支持任意模态子集；使用掩码、降元视图训练，采用rank-8 LoRA适配器，仅4.8M可训练参数。
AI.result: 五个基准中四个取得正向聚合增益，最高+4.0 R@1（此前聚合器最多仅一个正向）；均匀权重消融复现对称聚合的退化；三个基准文搜视频R@1最高，第四个在种子波动范围内；测试时模态丢弃下表示阶段得分比GRAM检查点高3.2–10.9 R@1。
AI.conclusion: SCALAR验证了自适应模态相关性对多模态聚合的关键作用，但其表示级增益在模态缺失时被仅用完整模态训练的两阶段重排器削弱，揭示标准两阶段检索流程的局限。

title: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Efficient Latent-Space Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) primarily perform inference at the token level, resulting in substantial memory overhead and compromised computational efficiency. In this paper, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Extraction and Inference (DSEI) framework, which achieves segment-level inference within the latent space through a two-stage training strategy. First, we construct a Dynamic Semantic Autoencoder (DSAE) via self-supervised learning. DSAE dynamically extracts segment-level semantics and compresses them into compact latent representations via adaptive semantic weighting and gated fusion. Subsequently, we integrate the DSAE into the LLM architecture and train the model to infer over dense latent space. DSEI substantially reduces both input and generation sequences and significantly enhances inference efficiency. Extensive experiments conducted on the Wanjuan dataset demonstrate that DSEI reduces perplexity by 48% compared to static sentence-level latent inference baseline. Furthermore, compared to standard LLMs using token-level inference, DSEI accelerates inference speed by 2.5$\times$ and reduces memory overhead by 90%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态语义抽取与推理框架DSEI，通过两阶段训练实现潜空间中的片段级推理，在降低困惑度的同时大幅提升推理效率并减少内存开销。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型主要在token级别进行推理，导致内存开销大、计算效率低，亟需更高效的推理范式。
AI.method: 采用两阶段训练策略：首先通过自监督学习构建动态语义自编码器（DSAE），借助自适应语义加权与门控融合动态抽取片段级语义并压缩为紧凑的潜在表示；随后将DSAE集成到LLM架构中，训练模型在稠密潜空间中进行推理。
AI.result: 在Wanjuan数据集上的大量实验表明，相比静态句子级潜推理基线，DSEI将困惑度降低48%；相比采用token级推理的标准LLM，推理速度提升2.5倍，内存开销降低90%。
AI.conclusion: DSEI通过片段级潜空间推理显著缩减了输入与生成序列长度，在提升推理效率、降低内存开销的同时也改善了模型性能，验证了潜空间片段级推理的可行性与有效性。

title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models for Time-Series Forecasting
summary: We study the adaptation of pretrained language models to univariate time-series forecasting through a parameter-efficient transfer learning framework, with the goal of understanding which design choices drive effective cross-modal transfer. While language models operate on discrete textual tokens, time series consist of continuous numerical observations with temporal dependencies. To bridge this modality gap, we project fixed-length time-series patches directly into the embedding space of a pretrained GPT-2 backbone, bypassing textual tokenization and treating the Transformer as a generic sequence encoder. Through controlled ablation studies on seven benchmark datasets spanning energy, weather, traffic, and finance, we analyze the effects of (i)~representation strategy (continuous embeddings versus textual serialisation), (ii)~adaptation regime (frozen backbone versus partial or full fine-tuning), (iii)~architectural components such as adapters, pooling strategies, and prediction heads, and (iv)~input context length. Continuous patch-based embeddings consistently outperform textual prompting and randomly initialised backbones. The adapted pipeline attains MASE within the range of specialised forecasting architectures while updating less than 1\% of total model parameters. Results further indicate that freezing the pretrained backbone and training lightweight projection and adapter modules provides a favourable accuracy--efficiency trade-off with stable behaviour across varying context lengths.

AI.tldr: 本文通过参数高效的迁移学习框架，研究预训练语言模型（GPT-2）适配单变量时间序列预测的设计选择，发现连续patch嵌入优于文本序列化，冻结主干并训练轻量投影/适配器可在1%参数更新下达到专业预测架构的MASE水平。
AI.motivation: 语言模型处理离散文本token，而时间序列是带时序依赖的连续数值观测，两者存在模态鸿沟。作者希望系统理解哪些设计选择能驱动有效的跨模态迁移，特别是在参数高效的前提下。
AI.method: 将定长的时间序列patch直接投影到预训练GPT-2主干的嵌入空间，绕过文本分词，把Transformer当作通用序列编码器；在能源、天气、交通、金融共七个基准数据集上进行受控消融，考察：(i)表示策略（连续嵌入 vs 文本序列化）；(ii)适配机制（冻结主干 vs 部分/全量微调）；(iii)适配器、池化策略、预测头等架构组件；(iv)输入上下文长度。
AI.result: 连续patch嵌入稳定优于文本提示和随机初始化主干；适配后的流程在更新不足1%总参数的条件下，MASE达到专业时间序列预测架构的水平区间；冻结预训练主干、仅训练轻量投影与适配器模块，在准确率—效率之间取得良好折中，且在变化上下文长度下表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: 连续patch表示+冻结主干的参数高效迁移是语言模型跨模态适配时间序列预测的有效范式，能以极小参数开销获得与专用模型相当的精度，并具备跨上下文长度的稳定性。

title: Robust Multi-Model Fitting through Learning Neighbor Regions
summary: Multi-model fitting involves fitting multiple models accurately in a noisy environment. It is the basis for computer vision tasks such as scene reconstruction and mixed reality. However, its performance is often limited by insufficient feature utilization, inefficient optimization, model overlap, and the non-differentiable pipelines. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a robust coarse-to-fine framework called Learning Neighbor Regions (LNR). Recognizing that substantial computational resources are wasted on numerous bad minimum sets, we propose the coarse-level module. This module utilizes a neural network to extract and analyze geometric feature of both local point-wise relationships and global contextual information in minimum sets, outputting confidence to pre-select a small number of good minimum sets, thereby enhancing overall efficiency before solving hypotheses. To address model overlap, LNR encodes neighbor region features for each hypothesis in its fine-level module. These region features consist of geometric features of neighboring data points, which can be used by multiple regions simultaneously. This design allows the neural network to individually refine and score each hypothesis. Importantly, LNR is trained to learn directly from data point features rather than from the hypothesis parameters, thus avoiding differentiating the sampling process and the model solvers. Extensive experiments on four classic multi-model fitting tasks demonstrate that LNR achieves state-of-the-art performance. The analysis suggests that LNR can be easily adapted to various robust multi-model fitting tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LNR（Learning Neighbor Regions）粗到细框架，用于鲁棒多模型拟合。粗层用神经网络评估最小集的局部与全局几何特征，输出置信度预筛选少量优质最小集以提升效率；细层为每个假设编码邻居区域特征，缓解模型重叠并实现独立精化与打分。该方法直接从数据点特征学习，避免对采样过程与求解器求导。四类经典任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模型拟合是场景重建、混合现实等计算机视觉任务的基础，但现有方法性能受限于四个问题：特征利用不充分、优化效率低、模型重叠、以及流水线不可微。
AI.method: 提出粗到细框架LNR。粗层：用神经网络提取最小集的局部逐点关系与全局上下文几何特征，输出置信度预筛选少量优质最小集，减少计算浪费。细层：为每个假设编码邻居区域特征（相邻数据点的几何特征，可被多个区域共享），使网络能独立精化并打分每个假设。训练上直接学习数据点特征而非假设参数，从而无需对采样过程和模型求解器求导。
AI.result: 在四个经典多模型拟合任务的广泛实验表明，LNR取得state-of-the-art性能。分析显示LNR易于适配各类鲁棒多模型拟合任务。
AI.conclusion: LNR通过粗层预筛选与细层区域特征编码，同时缓解效率与模型重叠问题，并以数据点特征学习规避不可微流水线，具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

title: End-to-End Cell Detection via Instance-aware Graph Modeling
summary: Accurate cell detection and classification are crucial for pathological analysis, directly affecting diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning. To capture complex cellular interactions beyond visual appearance within the tumor microenvironment, several approaches have employed graph neural networks to model spatial and relational patterns among cell nuclei, yielding promising results. However, these methods typically adopt a two-stage paradigm of visual extraction followed by relational modeling, which necessitates separate tuning for each stage, thereby increasing pipeline complexity and hindering end-to-end joint optimization. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end framework for cell detection and classification that jointly models patch-level visual representations and instance-level interactions, which incorporates a dynamic graph construction module and an instance-aware graph network. Specifically, the graph construction module dynamically builds the graph structure using learnable queries derived from patch-level features as cell instance representations, with adjacency defined by integrating feature similarity and spatial distances. The instance-aware graph network performs adaptive instance filtering and feature reorganization, aggregating them over the cell graph into a topological latent state for a selective state-space transition driven by visual cues, fusing appearance and relational evidence. When evaluated on multiple datasets with different staining protocols for cell and nucleus detection, our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in both detection and classification performance. The code will be released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/IGM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端框架，联合建模patch级视觉表征与实例级交互，用于细胞检测与分类，在多数据集上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 细胞检测与分类对病理诊断和治疗规划至关重要。现有基于图神经网络的方法虽能建模细胞核的空间与关系模式，但普遍采用"视觉提取+关系建模"的两阶段范式，各阶段需分别调参，增加了流程复杂度且阻碍端到端联合优化。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架，包含动态图构建模块与实例感知图网络。图构建模块利用由patch级特征导出的可学习查询作为细胞实例表征，动态构建图结构，其邻接关系由特征相似度与空间距离共同定义。实例感知图网络进行自适应实例过滤与特征重组，在细胞图上聚合为拓扑隐状态，并由视觉线索驱动选择性状态空间转换，融合外观与关系证据。
AI.result: 在采用不同染色协议、面向细胞与细胞核检测的多个数据集上评估，方法在检测与分类性能上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法通过端到端联合优化视觉表征与实例交互，克服了两阶段范式的局限，为病理细胞检测与分类提供了有效方案，代码将开源。

title: Diffusion Trajectory Modeling for Semantic Correspondence
summary: Diffusion models generate images through an iterative diffusion process, and recent studies have demonstrated that the intermediate feature maps produced during this process contain rich visual representations, leading to their adoption across a variety of downstream tasks. However, most existing approaches are limited to either using a single feature map at a specific timestep or aggregating feature maps across multiple timesteps. We observe that intermediate representations in the diffusion process form meaningful trajectories along the time axis. In particular, the representation of each spatial patch evolves progressively throughout the generative process, encoding semantics that are difficult to capture from static snapshots alone. This observation motivates the need to treat diffusion representations as temporally structured trajectories rather than static snapshots. To this end, we propose Diffusion Trajectory Modeling (DTM), a framework that interprets the temporal evolution of each spatial patch as a trajectory and leverages it for semantic correspondence. By effectively modeling patch-wise trajectories generated across multiple timesteps, DTM captures correspondence cues that prior methods are not designed to capture. We further demonstrate empirically that spatially corresponding patches form similar trajectory patterns throughout the diffusion process, suggesting that the temporal axis of diffusion carries semantic information. Experiments on SPair-71k, SPair-U and AP-10K show that DTM achieves strong performance, presenting a new perspective for exploiting diffusion representations from a trajectory-centric viewpoint.

AI.tldr: 将扩散模型中间特征视为每个空间patch沿时间轴形成的轨迹，提出Diffusion Trajectory Modeling (DTM)框架用于语义对应，在SPair-71k、SPair-U和AP-10K上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有利用扩散中间特征的方法多局限于单一时间步的某个特征图，或简单聚合多个时间步的特征，忽略了特征在时间轴上的演化结构。作者观察到扩散过程中间表示沿时间轴构成有意义的轨迹，每个空间patch的表征随生成过程逐步演化，编码了静态快照难以捕捉的语义，因此需要把扩散表示视为时间上结构化的轨迹而非静态快照。
AI.method: 提出Diffusion Trajectory Modeling (DTM)框架，把每个空间patch在多个时间步生成的特征序列视为一条轨迹，并对其进行建模以服务于语义对应任务。通过对patch级轨迹的有效建模，DTM能够捕获先前方法未设计的对应线索。
AI.result: 实证表明空间上相互对应的patch在整个扩散过程中形成相似的轨迹模式，说明扩散的时间轴携带语义信息。在SPair-71k、SPair-U和AP-10K三个基准上，DTM取得了很强的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: DTM从以轨迹为中心的新视角利用扩散表示，验证了时间维度语义信息的价值，为扩散特征在下游任务中的应用提供了新思路。

title: RSIAgent: Autonomous Exploration for Recursive Self-improvement in New Environments
summary: Digital agents must often adapt to new environments whose interfaces, tools, and failure modes are not fully captured by pretrained models. We introduce \textbf{RSIAgent}, a training-free multi-agent framework for recursive self-improvement through autonomous memory construction. RSIAgent coordinates curriculum, actor, and verifier agents to continually explore the environment, validate outcomes, and retain environment-specific knowledge, including reusable causal relationships between actions, conditions, and consequences. It further adopts a \textbf{broad-then-deep} exploration strategy, combining parallel broad recursive self-exploration for discovering diverse environment structures with focused deep self-exploration for uncovering hard cases, hidden constraints, boundary conditions, and previously unknown causal dependencies. The resulting memory is frozen and can be directly reused for downstream tasks without updating model parameters. Experiments on OSWorld-v2 and Agent's Last Exam show that RSIAgent substantially improves strong open-source models, enabling Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 to outperform frontier closed-source models including GPT-6.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练多智能体框架 RSIAgent，通过自主记忆构建实现递归自我改进，在 OSWorld-v2 与 Agent's Last Exam 上显著提升开源模型表现。
AI.motivation: 数字智能体常需适应新环境，而新环境的界面、工具与失败模式难以被预训练模型充分覆盖，因此需要一种无需更新参数即可持续积累环境特定知识的方法。
AI.method: RSIAgent 是一个免训练多智能体框架，协调课程智能体、执行智能体与验证智能体，持续探索环境、校验结果并保留环境特定知识（包括动作—条件—后果之间可复用的因果关系）；采用"先广后深"探索策略，先并行广域递归自探索以发现多样环境结构，再进行聚焦式深度自探索以挖掘难例、隐藏约束、边界条件及未知因果依赖；所得记忆被冻结，可直接复用于下游任务而无需更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-v2 和 Agent's Last Exam 上，RSIAgent 大幅提升强开源模型性能，使 Kimi-K3 与 GLM-5.3 超越包括 GPT-6 在内的前沿闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过自主记忆构建实现递归自我改进的免训练多智能体框架，可有效增强智能体对新环境的适应能力，并具备跨任务复用记忆的优势。

title: CapsuleMotion: A Lightweight Real-Time Visual Motion Predictor for Capsule Endoscopy
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, accepted at the 22nd Annual International Conference on Body Sensor Networks (BSN2026)
summary: Video Capsule Endoscopy (VCE) is a non-invasive medical examination that allows for the observation of the small intestine, which is otherwise difficult to access. A fundamental challenge persists in the form of their limited size in order to still be swallowable. The resulting restricted battery capacity, however, contradicts with the power-intensive nature of image capture and transmission. Therefore, we propose CapsuleMotion, a patient-specific dynamic capsule behavior that utilizes the available energy in a goal-oriented manner to increase the likelihood of a complete screening of the gastrointestinal tract. By investigating and combining metrics from the on-device image compression, CapsuleMotion predicts the motion between two successive frames. The camera's frame rate will be modified in accordance with the predicted magnitude of motion. Furthermore, prior to entering the small intestine, the capsule operates in a low power mode with a significantly reduced frame rate. In this mode, the LocalizationNet is employed to determine the current organ, provided that motion was predicted. The proposed framework is evaluated on the Rhode Island VCE dataset and deployed on an ultra-low power single-core RISC-V demonstrator with an integrated hardware accelerator. CapsuleMotion demonstrated the capability to reduce electric energy consumption by up to 20.66% in comparison with conventional capsules that lack a dynamic frame rate. Additionally, the accuracy of detecting the entry point of the small intestine has been improved.

AI.tldr: 提出CapsuleMotion，一种患者特定的动态胶囊行为框架，通过预测帧间运动自适应调整帧率并在进入小肠前采用低功耗模式，从而以目标导向方式利用有限能量，提升完整筛查可能性。
AI.motivation: 视频胶囊内窥镜（VCE）需保持可吞咽的小尺寸，导致电池容量受限，而图像采集与传输功耗高，二者矛盾限制了胃肠道完整筛查的实现。
AI.method: CapsuleMotion结合设备端图像压缩指标来预测相邻两帧之间的运动，并据此调整摄像头帧率；在进入小肠前以显著降低帧率的低功耗模式运行，当预测到运动时由LocalizationNet判定当前器官。
AI.result: 在Rhode Island VCE数据集上评估，并部署于集成硬件加速器的超低功耗单核RISC-V演示平台上。相比无动态帧率的传统胶囊，能耗最多降低20.66%，且小肠入口检测准确率得到提升。
AI.conclusion: CapsuleMotion通过运动预测驱动的动态帧率与低功耗定位策略，有效降低能耗并提高小肠入口检测准确性，为实现更完整的胃肠筛查提供了可行方案。

title: SlopShape: Identifying AI-Generated Commercial Web Content
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures. Verification artifacts and code: https://github.com/pulse-energy-eu/slopshape. v3: format-sensitive features excluded from the analysis; results updated
summary: Word-level detectors identify unedited AI-generated text almost perfectly, but the literature documents their brittleness under rewording, and a word-level score neither characterizes a text nor identifies which AI model wrote it. We ask whether AI-generated text can be identified one level deeper, from structural signatures: how information is presented, in what order, with what evidence, and in what voice. We replicate StoryScope (Russell et al., 2026), which showed such patterns for AI-generated fiction, on commercial content: 2,250 pre-ChatGPT human blog posts from 268 company domains against 11,250 AI mirrors from five frontier models. A 203-feature instrument, applied by an LLM and validated in a human gold-annotation session (human-human kappa 0.939, human-model 0.951), detects AI posts from its 176 structural features alone at 97.0 macro-F1 on held-out companies, nearly unchanged (96.1) when every AI post is reworded by its own model. The signal characterizes and attributes: AI posts share a tidy, self-announcing shape, 68.6% are attributed to the correct source against a 16.7% chance rate, and human posts occupy rare structural configurations. All effects replicate StoryScope's, consistent in direction and at least as large in magnitude. We release pipeline, instrument, prompts, code, and aggregate artifacts.

AI.tldr: 该研究将AI生成文本检测从词级提升到结构级，复制StoryScope的结构签名方法于商业博客内容，发现仅用176个结构特征即可在高泛化条件下以97.0 macro-F1识别AI文本，且在改写后仍保持96.1。
AI.motivation: 词级检测器虽近乎完美，但在改写条件下脆弱，且词级分数无法刻画文本特征或识别具体AI模型，因此作者试图从结构签名（信息呈现方式、顺序、证据与语态）这一更深层次识别AI生成文本。
AI.method: 复制StoryScope在商业内容上的实验：使用2,250篇来自268个公司域名的ChatGPT前人类博客文章，对比五个前沿模型生成的11,250篇AI镜像文本；采用203个特征的LLM标注工具，并通过人类金标注验证（人-人kappa 0.939，人-模型0.951）；在留出公司上评估176个结构特征的检测与归因表现，并对每篇AI文本进行改写测试。
AI.result: 仅用176个结构特征在留出公司上达到97.0 macro-F1；每篇AI文本经自身模型改写后仅降至96.1；AI文本呈整洁、自我宣告式结构，来源归因准确率68.6%（随机为16.7%）；人类文本占据罕见结构配置；所有效应方向一致且幅度不低于StoryScope。
AI.conclusion: 结构签名是词级检测之外更深层、更稳健的AI文本识别维度，兼具表征与归因能力，并可在商业内容上复制StoryScope结论；作者公开了流水线、工具、提示、代码及汇总产物。

title: ESG: Generating Physically Consistent Dynamic 3D Scenes from Text Descriptions
summary: Recent progress in image and 3D scene generation has enabled increasingly realistic static environments, yet most methods remain confined to such static configurations. Generating dynamic scenes from natural language is fundamentally challenging: it requires joint reasoning over scene structure, temporal evolution, and physical feasibility, while ensuring reliable execution in modern physics engines. We present a unified framework for generating physically consistent dynamic 3D scenes from text, with outputs directly executable in Unreal Engine. Central to our approach is the \emph{Evolutive Scene Graph} (ESG), which specifies entities with physical attributes, spatial relations, and event-driven timelines in a machine-checkable form. Given a prompt, a large language model constructs and validates a complete ESG; spatial layouts are grounded via energy-minimized gradient optimization; timeline-constrained physical parameters are then optimized through differentiable simulation to satisfy user-specified events; and the resulting scene is compiled into an engine-executable class. Experiments on 10 scenes across three complexity levels show that our method achieves $16.4/18$ mean event completion, outperforming Scene Language, the strongest engine-executable baseline (SimWorld), and our ablation without physical optimization by a clear margin in event completion and parameter accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架，从文本生成物理一致的动态3D场景，核心为可机器校验的\"演化场景图\"(ESG)，可直接在Unreal Engine中执行。
AI.motivation: 图像与3D场景生成虽已能产生逼真静态环境，但多数方法局限于静态配置；从自然语言生成动态场景需联合推理场景结构、时间演化与物理可行性，并保证在现代物理引擎中可靠执行，这一任务极具挑战性。
AI.method: 构建演化场景图(ESG)，以可机器校验形式规定具有物理属性、空间关系与事件驱动时间线的实体；由大语言模型根据提示构建并校验完整ESG；空间布局通过能量最小化的梯度优化落地；时间线约束的物理参数用可微仿真优化以满足用户指定事件；最终场景编译为引擎可执行类。
AI.result: 在3个复杂度等级的10个场景上，方法达到16.4/18的平均事件完成度，明显优于Scene Language、最强的引擎可执行基线SimWorld，以及去除物理优化的消融版本，在事件完成度与参数精度上均有清晰优势。
AI.conclusion: ESG为文本到动态3D场景提供了一个可校验、可执行、物理一致的统一建模范式，并在事件完成与参数精度上取得领先，验证了结构—时间—物理联合优化的有效性。

title: BSC-Net: A Small-Branch-Sensitive Structural Continuity Network for Coronary Vessel Segmentation and Quantitative Angiographic Analysis
summary: Vessel segmentation in X-ray coronary angiography (XCA) is a fundamental step for quantitative coronary analysis and subsequent assessment of coronary artery disease. However, accurate vessel segmentation remains challenging because of imaging noise, complex bifurcations, and the overlap of vessels and background structures, which can lead to disrupted vascular connectivity and missed small branches. In this work, we propose BSC-Net, a ResNet-U-Net-based framework tailored to improve small-vessel representation and repair vascular structural continuity. BSC-Net enhances small-vessel representation through targeted sampling and improves vascular structural continuity by integrating long-range contextual modeling and Edge-Informed Loss (EIL). BSC-Net was validated on two public XCA datasets, demonstrating state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in coronary vessel segmentation with Dice and IoU scores of 77.8%/90.6% and 64.5%/83.0%, respectively. Furthermore, based on the obtained vessel segmentation, we performed automated quantitative coronary analysis and derived clinically relevant morphological and hemodynamic parameters, including stenosis ratio, time-to-peak, and relative propagation velocity. These results demonstrate that BSC-Net produces accurate vessel segmentation results with preserved vascular continuity for quantitative coronary assessment, enabling reliable downstream analysis and clinical evaluation of coronary artery disease.

AI.tldr: 提出 BSC-Net，一种基于 ResNet-U-Net 的 X 射线冠状动脉造影血管分割框架，通过定向采样、长程上下文建模与边缘引导损失提升小血管表征与血管连续性，在两个公开数据集上取得 SOTA 分割性能，并据此完成自动化定量冠脉分析。
AI.motivation: XCA 血管分割是定量冠脉分析与冠心病评估的基础步骤。但受成像噪声、复杂分叉、血管与背景结构重叠等影响，分割易出现血管连通性中断与小分支漏检，现有方法难以兼顾小血管表征与结构连续性。
AI.method: 提出 BSC-Net，基于 ResNet-U-Net 架构。通过定向/靶向采样增强小血管表征；通过整合长程上下文建模与边缘引导损失（EIL）修复血管结构连续性。
AI.result: 在两个公开 XCA 数据集上验证，冠脉血管分割达到 SOTA：两数据集 Dice/IoU 分别为 77.8%/90.6% 与 64.5%/83.0%。基于分割结果开展自动化定量冠脉分析，提取狭窄率、峰值时间、相对传播速度等形态学与血流动力学参数。
AI.conclusion: BSC-Net 能输出保持血管连续性的精确分割结果，支撑可靠的定量冠脉评估与冠心病下游分析与临床评价。

title: MarKey: Marginal Utility Guided Greedy Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) because densely encoding long frame sequences is computationally expensive, while uniform sampling under a limited visual budget can miss sparse yet decisive evidence. Recent training-free keyframe selection methods have enabled more efficient inference and yielded promising performance gains. However, many existing methods score frames largely in isolation without explicitly considering how each candidate complements the currently selected subset, potentially resulting in redundant selections and incomplete evidence coverage. To address this limitation, we propose MarKey, a training-free framework that formulates keyframe selection as subset-aware greedy optimization. At each iteration, MarKey scores each candidate using a tractable surrogate that jointly accounts for query relevance, marginal coverage gain, and context-dependent redundancy, and selects the frame with the highest utility. To make this iterative subset-aware evaluation efficient, MarKey uses a compact set of representative anchors to approximate full-video coverage and a bounded window of previously selected frames to limit context-dependent comparisons. Experiments on six benchmarks spanning holistic video understanding, human-centric video understanding, and open-ended video understanding demonstrate that MarKey consistently outperforms existing methods. Further analyses show robust gains across different MLLM backbones, model scales, and frame budgets.

AI.tldr: MarKey：无需训练的关键帧选择框架，将选帧建模为子集感知的贪心优化，联合考虑查询相关性、边际覆盖增益和上下文相关冗余。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解中，密集编码帧序列计算代价高，而有限视觉预算下的均匀采样会遗漏稀疏但关键的证据。已有无需训练的关键帧选择方法虽有性能提升，但多数方法孤立地对帧打分，未考虑候选帧与已选子集的互补性，导致冗余选择与证据覆盖不完整。
AI.method: 提出 MarKey 框架，将关键帧选择形式化为子集感知的贪心优化。每次迭代用可处理的代理评分函数对候选帧打分，联合考虑查询相关性、边际覆盖增益和上下文相关冗余，选效用最高者。为提升效率，用紧凑的代表性锚点集近似全视频覆盖，并用有界窗口的已选帧限制上下文比较。
AI.result: 在涵盖整体视频理解、人物中心视频理解和开放式视频理解六项基准上，MarKey 持续优于现有方法；跨不同 MLLM 主干、模型规模和帧预算均表现稳健增益。
AI.conclusion: 子集感知的贪心优化可有效缓解关键帧选择中的冗余与覆盖不完整问题，无需训练即可在不同模型与预算下稳定提升长视频理解性能。

title: ViCo-SAM3: Vision-Conditioned Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Camouflaged Object Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary camouflaged object segmentation (OVCOS) aims to segment unseen camouflaged objects under text guidance. We observe that SAM3 still suffers from a pronounced semantic gap between global textual semantics and fine-grained pixel-level visual cues in OVCOS. Meanwhile, fully fine-tuning the text encoder introduces heavy parameter overhead and risks overfitting to training categories, which compromises open-vocabulary representation flexibility. To address these issues, we propose ViCo-SAM3, a Vision-Conditioned alignment framework designed for OVCOS. Specifically, we introduce vision-conditioned (ViCo) module, which dynamically modulates text embeddings with global visual context, enabling textual representations to adapt to the current image content and thereby effectively bridging the semantic gap between vision and text. Building on this, we further design a vision-conditioned cross-modal binding (ViCoBind) module to enhance cross-modal interaction and semantic alignment between visual and textual representations. Without bells and whistles, ViCo-SAM3 achieves state-of-the-art performance on the OVCamo benchmark and demonstrates strong generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出ViCo-SAM3框架，通过视觉条件化模块动态调制文本嵌入并对齐跨模态表征，解决开放词汇伪装目标分割中的语义鸿沟与文本编码器微调过拟合问题，在OVCamo基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇伪装目标分割（OVCOS）需在文本引导下分割未见过的伪装目标。作者观察到SAM3存在全局文本语义与细粒度像素级视觉线索之间明显的语义鸿沟；同时全量微调文本编码器会带来大量参数开销，并易过拟合于训练类别，损害开放词汇表征的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出ViCo-SAM3视觉条件化对齐框架：一是视觉条件化（ViCo）模块，用全局视觉上下文动态调制文本嵌入，使文本表征适配当前图像内容，从而弥合视觉-文本语义鸿沟；二是视觉条件化跨模态绑定（ViCoBind）模块，增强视觉与文本表征间的跨模态交互与语义对齐。
AI.result: 在OVCamo基准上取得最先进（SOTA）性能，并展现出较强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉条件化的文本调制与跨模态绑定对齐，可在不依赖繁复设计、避免文本编码器全量微调的前提下，有效提升OVCOS的开放词汇分割性能与泛化性。

title: On The Robustness-Resolution Tradeoff In Temporal Quantization Of Event Streams
summary: Event pipelines often discretize asynchronous timestamps before learning. This step looks harmless, but its stability depends directly on temporal resolution. We study this dependence at the representation level. We first show that hard temporal binning is discontinuous: an arbitrarily small timestamp shift near a boundary can move unit event mass between bins. We then define a class of nonnegative, mass-preserving, resolution-faithful continuous encoders and prove that every encoder in this class has global L1 sensitivity at least 2/Delta, where Delta denotes bin width. Linear two-bin interpolation attains this limit. Local support and first-moment preservation also make it unique. Experiments on SHD, N-MNIST, and DVS128 Gesture support the analysis. Across uniform timestamp budgets, linear interpolation lowers mean representation drift by 47-72% while keeping clean accuracy nearly unchanged. On DVS Gesture, it produces zero prediction flips across all tested budgets and three seeds. On SHD, measured drift follows 1/Delta with R^2 = 0.992.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了事件数据中时间戳离散化（硬分箱）的不连续性，并证明其稳定性直接取决于时间分辨率。作者定义了一类非负、保质量、分辨率忠实的连续编码器，证明该类编码器的全局L1敏感度下界为2/Delta，且线性双箱插值达到该下界并具有唯一性。实验表明线性插值显著降低表示漂移且几乎不影响精度。
AI.motivation: 事件流水线通常在学习前对异步时间戳进行离散化，这一步看似无害，但其稳定性直接依赖于时间分辨率。作者希望在表示层面研究这种依赖性，揭示硬时间分箱的不连续性问题。
AI.method: 首先证明硬时间分箱是不连续的：边界附近任意小的时间戳移动都可能将单位事件质量在箱间转移。随后定义了一类非负、保质量、分辨率忠实的连续编码器，并证明该类中每个编码器的全局L1敏感度至少为2/Delta（Delta为箱宽）。进一步证明线性双箱插值达到该极限，且局部支撑与一阶矩保持使其具有唯一性。在SHD、N-MNIST和DVS128 Gesture上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验支持理论分析。在统一时间戳预算下，线性插值将平均表示漂移降低47-72%，同时干净准确率几乎不变。在DVS Gesture上，所有测试预算和三个随机种子下均产生零预测翻转。在SHD上，实测漂移遵循1/Delta规律，R^2 = 0.992。
AI.conclusion: 硬时间分箱在表示层面存在不稳定性，其敏感度直接受时间分辨率控制。线性双箱插值作为一类连续编码器的最优解，在理论上达到L1敏感度下界且具有唯一性，在实践中能有效降低表示漂移并保持精度，是事件数据时间戳处理中更稳定的离散化替代方案。

title: A Conservative OCR-Enabled Workflow for R214 Sodium Screening of South African Packaged Foods
summary: Using food package images to monitor sodium and salt content against South Africa's R214 sodium limits is challenging when screening decisions require product identity, nutrition facts panel evidence, reporting basis, and category-specific thresholds. This study presents a conservative image-based workflow that combines region detection, optical character recognition (OCR), product identity and sodium evidence extraction, R214 category assignment, deterministic threshold comparison, and independent vision language model comparison. The evaluation used 442 packaged food products and 3 929 full package images from a real-world South African food packaging dataset. A YOLO26s small detector generated 4 195 region crops, and strict post-processing produced one sodium evidence row per product. The integrated workflow produced 290 OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE, 139 REVIEW, seven SCREEN-PASS, and six SCREEN-FAIL outcomes. The independent Qwen2.5-VL 7B vision language model workflow produced 387 OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE, 31 REVIEW, twenty SCREEN-PASS, and four SCREEN-FAIL outcomes. The workflows agreed on exact R214 category assignment for 415 of 442 products (93.9%) and on whether the assigned category was within R214 scope for 416 of 442 products (94.1%). Final screening outcome agreement was 307 out of 442 products, or 69.5%. Manual verification on 60 products showed lower strict outcome agreement than regulated status agreement, while all manual INSUFFICIENT DATA cases were kept out of SCREEN-PASS and SCREEN-FAIL by both automated workflows. The findings show that conservative image-based screening can organise package evidence, identify clear cases, and assign uncertain cases to REVIEW rather than forcing SCREEN-PASS or SCREEN-FAIL decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于包装图像的保守型筛查工作流，在442个南非包装食品上验证，与独立视觉语言模型工作流相比，R214类别分配一致率为93.9%，类别是否在监管范围内一致率为94.1%。
AI.motivation: 利用食品包装图像监测钠/盐含量是否超过南非R214限量存在困难：筛查判定需要产品身份、营养成分表证据、报告基准以及类别专属阈值。因此需要一个能组织证据、识别明确案例并将不确定案例归入REVIEW而非强行判定的保守型图像筛查流程。
AI.method: 研究构建了保守型图像工作流，包含区域检测、OCR、产品身份与钠证据提取、R214类别判定、确定性阈值比较，以及独立的视觉语言模型对比。使用南非真实食品包装数据集中的442个包装食品、3929张完整包装图像；由YOLO26s小型检测器生成4195个区域裁剪，经严格后处理为每个产品生成一条钠证据记录。对比流程采用Qwen2.5-VL 7B视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 集成工作流产生290例OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE、139例REVIEW、7例SCREEN-PASS、6例SCREEN-FAIL；Qwen2.5-VL 7B工作流产生387例OUTSIDE R214 SCOPE、31例REVIEW、20例SCREEN-PASS、4例SCREEN-FAIL。两者在415/442个产品（93.9%）上R214类别分配完全一致，在416/442个产品（94.1%）上对类别是否属于R214范围判断一致，最终筛查结果一致率为307/442（69.5%）。对60个产品的人工核验显示严格结果一致率低于监管状态一致率，且所有人工判定为INSUFFICIENT DATA的案例均未被两个自动化工作流归入SCREEN-PASS或SCREEN-FAIL。
AI.conclusion: 保守型图像筛查能够有效组织包装证据、识别明确案例，并将不确定案例归入REVIEW，而非强行给出SCREEN-PASS或SCREEN-FAIL判定。

title: AnchorGUI: Asymmetric Memory for Dual-Scale Learning in GUI Navigation
comment: Published in ECCV 2026. 41 pages including supplementary material
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable autonomous GUI navigation, but agents still struggle to process and learn from dense, continuous visual histories. This bottleneck hinders both immediate error correction within a single episode (intra-trial) and experience distillation across multiple attempts (cross-trial). We trace these challenges to an empirical informational asymmetry in GUI navigation: while expected transitions can often be compressed into lightweight textual summaries, unexpected outcomes benefit from preserved screenshots as causal evidence for accurate diagnosis. Building on this insight, we propose AnchorGUI, a unified framework driven by the Cognitive State Anchor (CSA). The CSA acts as a per-step primitive that actively compares expected and observed transitions, converting passive multimodal trajectories into explicit prediction-error signals. These signals orchestrate a dual-scale learning mechanism via an asymmetric memory. For intra-trial correction, a sliding window selectively retains visual evidence for detected mismatches, providing immediate, visually-grounded feedback. For cross-trial distillation, this asymmetric memory focuses the computationally expensive credit assignment search space on likely failure steps. Experiments across four benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach. On AndroidWorld, AnchorGUI achieves a 57.3% success rate with a $2.4\times$ token reduction per step. Furthermore, cross-trial distillation reaches 69.2% success (+11.9% gain), significantly outperforming standard reflection methods while maintaining sub-linear context scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnchorGUI 框架，以认知状态锚（CSA）为核心，通过非对称记忆机制实现 GUI 导航中的单回合纠错与跨回合经验蒸馏。
AI.motivation: VLM 驱动的 GUI 智能体难以处理并学习稠密、连续的视觉历史，导致单回合内错误纠正与跨回合经验蒸馏均受限制。作者将其归因于 GUI 导航中的信息非对称性：预期转移通常可压缩为轻量文本摘要，而意外结果则需保留截图作为因果证据以支持准确诊断。
AI.method: 提出 AnchorGUI 统一框架，核心为认知状态锚（CSA）。CSA 作为逐步原语，主动比较预期转移与观测转移，将被动多模态轨迹转化为显式预测误差信号，并以此为驱动，通过非对称记忆编排双尺度学习机制：单回合纠错采用滑动窗口，对检测到的失配选择性保留视觉证据，提供即时、视觉落地的反馈；跨回合蒸馏则利用该非对称记忆，将计算代价高昂的信用分配搜索空间聚焦于可能的失败步骤。
AI.result: 在四个基准上验证有效性。AndroidWorld 上成功率达 57.3%，每步 token 使用减少 2.4 倍；跨回合蒸馏成功率达 69.2%（提升 11.9%），显著优于标准反思方法，同时保持次线性上下文扩展。
AI.conclusion: AnchorGUI 通过显式预测误差信号与非对称记忆，有效缓解 GUI 导航中视觉历史处理瓶颈，兼顾效率与性能，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Turkish MMLU Pro: Traceable Option Augmentation and Its Validity Limits in Turkish Multiple-Choice Evaluation
comment: Preprint of a manuscript submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Adding answer options can lower multiple-choice scores without improving assessment validity. Turkish MMLU Pro examines this distinction using 12,000 Turkish-source questions across 58 sections. Each question retains its stem, five original options and source key, and receives five options copied from other questions in the same section. Sentence-embedding retrieval proposes candidates; a language model selects existing identifiers. Deterministic verification reconstructs all 60,000 additions. A 25-model calibration exposes scoring and generation-budget effects. Five evaluations produce source-key accuracies of 34.8%-81.4%. On 981 shared questions, one API-served model falls from 93.7% with five choices to 83.1% with ten; 102 of 115 lost correct responses select borrowed options. The decrease is 24.4 percentage points on heuristically flagged negative stems and 5.9 points elsewhere. A completed human-checked audit of 200 sampled questions, with undocumented reviewer tool use, yields 47 and 31 multiple-answer judgments across the two record sets, 25 of the latter unresolved. These records support concern about ambiguity, while their dependence and incomplete reviewer-method documentation limit validation. Because order and labels also change, the paired comparison measures augmentation as implemented. The contribution is a traceable construction and an analysis of its validity limits, not evidence that lower ten-choice scores measure knowledge better.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建土耳其语MMLU Pro基准（12,000题、58个分节），通过在同节内为每题添加五个"借来"选项，将每题扩展为十选项，并对60,000条添加做确定性验证；25个模型的校准显示评分与生成预算效应，五选项源键准确率为34.8%–81.4%，共享题上某API模型从93.7%降至83.1%，作者强调该结果衡量的是"按此实现方式"的增强效果，而非证明十选项能更好地测量知识。
AI.motivation: 增加选项数量可能在降低多项选择得分的同时并不提升评估效度，二者常被混为一谈；作者希望用可追溯的构题流程与成对比较，厘清"分数下降"与"评估更有效"之间的区别，并明确其效度边界。
AI.method: 基于12,000个土耳其语来源问题（跨58个分节），保留题干、五个原始选项与来源键，并从同节其他题目复制五个选项形成十选项版本；用句嵌入检索提出候选，由语言模型在已有标识符中选择，再用确定性验证重建全部60,000条添加；开展25个模型的校准以分离评分与生成预算效应；进行五次评测，并在981道共享题上做配对比较。
AI.result: 五次评测的源键准确率为34.8%–81.4%；981道共享题上，某API服务模型从五选项93.7%降至十选项83.1%，115个失去的正确答案中102个选择了借来的选项；启发式标记的否定题干上下降24.4个百分点，其他题目下降5.9个百分点；对200道抽样题的人工核查审计（审查者工具使用未记录）在两组记录中分别给出47与31个多答案判定，后者25个未解决。
AI.conclusion: 这些记录支持对歧义性的担忧，但其依赖性与审查方法记录不完整限制了验证力度；由于顺序和标签也发生变化，配对比较衡量的是"按当前实现方式"的增强。该工作的贡献是可追溯的构造及其效度局限分析，而非证明更低的十选项得分更好地测量了知识。

title: Temperature Fragility and the Conditional Benefits of Truncation Sampling
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/larosafrancesco289/decoding-robustness
summary: Large language models generate text by sampling each token from a predicted distribution, and a temperature parameter sets how far the draw strays from the most probable tokens. Truncation samplers such as top-p and min-p discard the least probable tokens before the draw, so that sampling at high temperature stays coherent. Their reported accuracy gains come from temperatures of 1.5 to 3, while the defaults of deployed systems cluster between 0.6 and 1.0. Whether they change accuracy at those defaults, and for which models, has not been measured. We test thirteen open-weight models on GSM8K and MMLU-Pro at temperatures 0.7, 1.0, and 1.3 in one controlled pipeline, ten of them under eight decoding configurations. Six of the thirteen models lose 17 to 38 accuracy points on MMLU-Pro between 0.7 and 1.3, and the other seven lose at most 10. The lost accuracy comes from generations that run to the token limit or never state an answer. These results suggest that truncation samplers improve accuracy primarily when higher temperatures substantially degrade model performance. Where accuracy remains stable across temperatures, none of the tested truncation samplers improves on plain temperature sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文在温度 0.7、1.0、1.3 下，用统一流程测试 13 个开源权重模型在 GSM8K 与 MMLU-Pro 上的表现（其中 10 个模型测试 8 种解码配置），考察截断采样器（top-p、min-p）在部署常用默认温度区间是否真正提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有工作报告的截断采样器（top-p、min-p）准确率收益来自温度 1.5–3 的高温区间，但实际部署系统的默认温度集中在 0.6–1.0。该默认区间内截断采样器是否改变准确率、对哪些模型有效，此前未被系统测量，存在明显的评估空白。
AI.method: 在单一受控流程下测试 13 个开源权重模型，任务为 GSM8K 与 MMLU-Pro；温度设为 0.7、1.0、1.3；其中 10 个模型在 8 种解码配置下运行，对比普通温度采样与截断采样器（top-p、min-p）的效果。
AI.result: 13 个模型中有 6 个在 MMLU-Pro 上从温度 0.7 到 1.3 损失 17–38 个准确率点，另外 7 个损失至多 10 个点。准确率损失主要来源于生成达到 token 上限或始终未给出最终答案。在准确率对温度稳定的情形下，所测截断采样器均未优于普通温度采样。
AI.conclusion: 截断采样器主要在高温显著损害模型性能时才带来准确率提升；当准确率跨温度保持稳定时，所测截断采样器相对普通温度采样没有优势。这提示常用默认温度区间内，截断采样的收益并不普遍成立。

title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
comment: The 3rd version. V1 was released on Sept. 14, 2026. Project Page: https://yoloytang.me/BVB/
summary: Multimodal agents can create complex videos in software such as Blender by writing code instead of using diffusion models. Yet video understanding benchmarks still evaluate models mainly through question answering. If an agent truly understands a video, it can reconstruct it programmatically. We introduce BVB, Blender-VideoBench, a benchmark that tests this ability by asking agents to reconstruct real-world videos as animated Blender scenes. To ensure fair comparison, each agent programs the reconstruction through a lightweight harness, Mini-BVB, in an identical sandbox under a shared cost limit. The benchmark renders each reconstruction from its animated camera and evaluates it on two axes: (1) Dual VQA measures how many spatiotemporal facts the reconstruction preserves. (2) Latent Similarity measures how closely the reconstruction matches the source video perceptually. Our overall score, a square-root mean, favors balanced performance. We evaluate 51 configurations from 10 model families and analyze semantic retention, perceptual similarity, reasoning effort, and cost. The best model reaches 88.6 Latent Similarity but retains only 53.7% of the spatiotemporal facts from the source video. Additional reasoning improves perceptual similarity but does not close this gap. In a blind study with 15 raters and five configurations, Latent Similarity correlates strongly with human preference. These results show that programmatic reconstruction is a viable test of agentic video understanding, and that semantic retention remains the main challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出 BVB（Blender-VideoBench）基准，通过让智能体将真实视频用代码重建为 Blender 动画场景来测试其视频理解能力；最佳模型潜相似度达 88.6，但仅保留 53.7% 时空事实，语义保留仍是核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体已能通过写代码在 Blender 等软件中生成复杂视频，但视频理解基准仍主要以问答形式评估模型。作者认为，若智能体真正理解视频，就应能通过程序化方式重建它，因此需要一个以"程序化重建"来检验智能体视频理解的新基准。
AI.method: 构建 BVB 基准，要求智能体将真实视频重建为 Blender 动画场景。为保证公平比较，各智能体通过轻量框架 Mini-BVB，在相同沙箱与统一成本限制下编程重建。评估从两个维度进行：Dual VQA 衡量重建保留了多少时空事实；Latent Similarity 衡量重建与源视频的感知匹配程度。总体得分为平方根均值，偏向均衡表现。共评估来自 10 个模型家族的 51 种配置，并分析语义保留、感知相似度、推理投入与成本；另开展15名评分者、5种配置的盲测。
AI.result: 最佳模型达到 88.6 的 Latent Similarity，但仅保留源视频 53.7% 的时空事实。增加推理投入可提升感知相似度，但未能弥合语义保留差距。盲测中 Latent Similarity 与人类偏好强相关。
AI.conclusion: 程序化重建是检验智能体视频理解的有效方式，而语义保留仍是当前主要挑战。

title: PalmLeaf-VQA: A Multi-Script Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Historical Palm-Leaf Manuscript Understanding Across Diverse Regions
summary: Historical manuscripts remain largely absent from modern vision-language benchmarks, leaving open how well multimodal large language models (MLLMs) handle culturally diverse, degraded, and non-Latin document images. We introduce \textbf{PalmLeaf-VQA}, a multi-script visual question answering benchmark for historical palm-leaf manuscript understanding across South and Southeast Asian traditions. PalmLeaf-VQA contains \textbf{923 curated manuscript images} and \textbf{7,384 question--answer pairs} from eight collection groups: Balinese, Grantha, Jathakam, Kambaramayanam, Kannada, Khmer, Sundanese, and Tamil. Unlike recognition-oriented resources, the benchmark targets manuscript-aware visual reasoning over preservation-relevant cues, including physical condition, line structure, material and coating, binding holes, margins, symbols, drawings, and localized visual artifacts. We evaluate recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under open-answer and constrained-answer prompting and provide fine-grained analysis across collections, question categories, and task types. The strongest evaluated model reaches only \textbf{58.00\% exact-match accuracy} on the held-out test split, revealing substantial limitations in current MLLMs for rare-script, degraded-layout, and preservation-oriented document understanding. PalmLeaf-VQA provides a standardized benchmark for advancing culturally grounded and layout-aware multimodal document analysis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PalmLeaf-VQA，一个面向南亚与东南亚历史贝叶经手稿的多文种视觉问答基准，包含 923 幅图像和 7,384 组问答对，覆盖八个收藏组，用于评测 MLLM 在手稿感知视觉推理上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言基准普遍缺乏历史手稿内容，导致多模态大模型在文化多样、图像退化、非拉丁文字的文档图像上的表现尚不明确，亟需标准化评测资源。
AI.method: 构建 PalmLeaf-VQA 基准，涵盖 Balinese、Grantha、Jathakam、Kambaramayanam、Kannada、Khmer、Sundanese、Tamil 八个收藏组；任务聚焦保存相关线索的手稿感知视觉推理，如物理状况、行结构、材质与涂层、装订孔、页边、符号、绘图及局部视觉伪影。在开放答案与受限答案两种提示设置下评测近期闭源与开源权重 MLLM，并按收藏组、问题类别与任务类型进行细粒度分析。
AI.result: 最强评测模型在留出测试集上仅达到 58.00% 的精确匹配准确率，表明当前 MLLM 在稀有文字、退化版式与保存导向的文档理解方面存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: PalmLeaf-VQA 为推进文化根基扎实且版式感知的多模态文档分析提供了标准化基准。

title: CatchMonitor: a machine learning system for automated fish discard quantification
summary: We report on the continued development of CatchMonitor, resulting in a prototype computer vision system designed to automatically quantify discarded fish from video footage collected from Remote Electronic Monitoring (REM) systems on fishing trawlers. The analysis of trawler surveillance footage is a challenging problem due to the real-world conditions on board fishing vessels. Building on our prior work we improve the accuracy of species identification through the application of semi-supervised learning. We utilise a simple and robust object tracking approach, upon which we build our prototype discard quantification system. Finally we analyse the variability of manual discard quantification performed by multiple expert human analysts, using it as a benchmark against which we compare the performance of our system.

AI.tldr: 本文报告CatchMonitor原型系统，利用计算机视觉自动从渔船REM视频中量化丢弃鱼，并通过半监督学习提升物种识别精度。
AI.motivation: 渔船上的真实监控条件使视频分析极具挑战，需自动量化被丢弃的鱼类以替代人工分析。
AI.method: 在前期工作基础上采用半监督学习提高物种识别准确率，并使用简单稳健的目标跟踪方法，构建丢弃量化的原型系统；同时分析多位专家人工量化的变异性作为基准。
AI.result: 原型系统可自动量化视频中的丢弃鱼，其性能与多位专家人工量化结果进行对比，人工量化本身存在变异性。
AI.conclusion: 半监督学习与稳健跟踪可用于真实渔船监控条件下的丢弃鱼自动量化，专家人工量化变异性可作为评价基准。

title: SyntheticDoc: A Large Synthetic Dataset for Document Unwarping and Illumination Correction
comment: D. Woortmann and T. Magne -- Equal contribution. Accepted at ECCV 2026 (Spotlight). 20 pages
summary: Deep learning models have become the standard tool for document rectification and illumination correction, yet their performance is fundamentally bound by their training data. For nearly a decade, the community has heavily relied on Doc3D, a pioneering but increasingly limited document unwarping dataset in terms of scale and quality. To address this bottleneck, we introduce SyntheticDoc, a massive, high-quality dataset designed to push the boundaries of document unwarping. SyntheticDoc is composed of 1,000,000 high-resolution procedurally generated training samples, alongside extensive validation and test sets. Each sample is paired with rich, pixel-perfect annotations, including UV maps, normal maps, albedo and shading. To ensure physical accuracy and photorealism, the paper geometries are generated via a physics-based simulator and rendered using a path tracer. To demonstrate the benefit of our dataset, we train a simple baseline model on SyntheticDoc and report on its performance in comparison to state-of-the-art methods on both document unwarping and illumination correction tasks. Our dataset is available at https://igl.ethz.ch/projects/SyntheticDoc/ and the code used to generate it at https://github.com/tanguymagne/SyntheticDoc .

AI.tldr: 提出大规模高质量合成文档去畸变数据集 SyntheticDoc，包含百万级训练样本及像素级标注，旨在突破现有数据集在规模与质量上的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 深度学习文档矫正与光照校正模型性能受训练数据根本性制约，社区近十年依赖 Doc3D，但其规模与质量日益受限，形成数据瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建 SyntheticDoc 数据集：1,000,000 个高分辨率程序化生成训练样本，另有大规模验证与测试集；每样本配像素级 UV 图、法线图、albedo 与 shading 标注；文档几何由基于物理的模拟器生成，并使用路径追踪渲染以保证物理准确性与照片级真实感。
AI.result: 在 SyntheticDoc 上训练简单基线模型，并在文档去畸变与光照校正任务上与当前最先进方法进行对比评估。
AI.conclusion: SyntheticDoc 为文档去畸变与光照校正提供了可扩展的高质量数据基础，数据集与生成代码均已公开。

title: Evaluating Losslessness in Speculative Decoding Under Finite-Precision Inference
summary: Lossless speculative decoding is typically defined at the algorithmic level: a speculative procedure proposes multiple tokens and a verification procedure is designed to preserve the output trajectory of an autoregressive reference model exactly. In practical neural inference, however, this guarantee is implemented using finite-precision floating-point computations, and discrete token selection can amplify small numerical differences into divergent generation trajectories. We investigate this distinction using Orthrus, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion architecture that performs self-drafting and self-verification within a frozen autoregressive backbone, as a representative case study. Across 1,190 prompts from 12 domains, exact trajectory matching under BF16 occurs for only 45\% of the authors' checkpoint generations and 43% of those from our independently trained model. The probability of matching is strongly associated with the response-conditional perplexity of the autoregressive reference, indicating that trajectory divergence is not uniform across inputs. Despite these divergences, Orthrus does not exhibit systematic degradation on the evaluated downstream tasks. In contrast, FP32 inference yields exact trajectory matching on all evaluated prompts. These results demonstrate a gap between algorithmic losslessness and its implementation under finite-precision arithmetic, and motivate evaluating lossless speculative decoding at the level of exact generation trajectories as well as downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文以Orthrus（一种混合自回归-扩散架构，在冻结自回归骨干内进行自起草与自验证）为案例，揭示了"算法层面无损"的投机解码在实际有限精度浮点推理下并不保证轨迹无损：BF16下精确轨迹匹配率仅约45%（官方权重）与43%（独立训练模型），且匹配概率与参考模型的条件困惑度强相关；FP32下所有测试提示均能精确匹配。
AI.motivation: 无损投机解码通常只在算法层面定义无损性，即验证过程应完全保留自回归参考模型的输出轨迹。但实际神经推理依赖有限精度浮点计算，离散token选择会将微小的数值差异放大为生成轨迹的分歧。作者希望厘清"算法无损"与"实现无损"之间的差距，并呼吁从精确生成轨迹层面评估无损投机解码，而不仅是下游任务性能。
AI.method: 以Orthrus为代表性案例进行研究：该架构在冻结的自回归骨干内执行自起草（self-drafting）与自验证（self-verification），兼具自回归与扩散特性。在12个领域共1190条提示上，对比官方checkpoint与作者独立训练的模型，分别在BF16和FP32精度下统计精确轨迹匹配率，并分析匹配概率与响应条件困惑度（response-conditional perplexity）之间的关联，同时评估下游任务表现。
AI.result: BF16下精确轨迹匹配率仅为45%（作者提供的checkpoint生成）和43%（独立训练模型生成）；匹配概率与自回归参考模型的响应条件困惑度强相关，说明轨迹分歧在不同输入上并非均匀分布。尽管存在轨迹分歧，Orthrus在评测的下游任务上并未出现系统性性能退化。相比之下，FP32推理在所有评测提示上均实现精确轨迹匹配。
AI.conclusion: 算法层面的无损性与其在有限精度算术下的实现之间存在实质性差距。因此，评估无损投机解码时不应仅关注下游任务性能，还应以精确生成轨迹为评价维度。该发现为投机解码的可靠性评估提供了新的视角与基准需求。

title: Authorship attribution and aesthetic evaluation of AI poetry: a case study with Haiku
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures. Accepted as a full paper at the 2026 Joint 14th International Conference on Soft Computing and Intelligent Systems and 27th International Symposium on Advanced Intelligent Systems (SCIS&ISIS 2026), November 2-5, 2026
summary: This paper investigates the generation and human evaluation of Japanese haiku by contemporary Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on authorship perception and aesthetic judgment within a constrained poetic form. Using a few-shot prompting strategy, Japanese haiku were generated across a heterogeneous set of large language models, including open- and closed-source systems, medium-scale and large-scale architectures, models with native or adapted Japanese support, and multilingual proprietary models. These AI-generated haiku were combined with human-written ones and presented in a questionnaire distributed to students at Japanese universities in Tokyo. The survey assessed whether respondents could distinguish between AI-generated and human-written haiku and which cues informed their judgments. Recognition accuracy varied across models. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5, and StableLM-7B performed at approximately chance level (approx 0.50), whereas LLM-JP, Gemma-2B, and LLaMA-2 showed moderate detectability (approx 0.59-0.67). However, recognition was strongly item-dependent. Ratings of fluency, coherence, poeticness, and related aesthetic dimensions predicted perceived humanness but not correct classification, indicating an attribution bias linked to aesthetic evaluation and revealing a dissociation between aesthetic evaluation and true authorship detection. The extended analysis additionally examines generation-constraint adherence, participant-level characteristics, and exploratory LLM-based evaluations of haiku authorship. Overall, the findings suggest that as LLMs improve, surface-level creative plausibility may reduce reliable human discrimination within constrained poetic settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察当代LLM生成日语俳句及人类评判，发现AI与人类俳句的辨识准确性因模型而异（约0.50–0.67），且高度依赖具体诗作；审美评分预测"似人感"而非正确分类，揭示审美判断与真实作者识别的分离。
AI.motivation: 探究在受严格形式约束的诗歌体裁（日语俳句）中，LLM生成文本能否被人类可靠辨别，以及人们依据何种线索作出作者归属判断，从而检验"表面创作可信度"对人类判别力的影响。
AI.method: 采用少样本提示（few-shot prompting）策略，在异构LLM集合（开源与闭源、中等与大规模、原生或适配日语支持、多语言专有模型）上生成日语俳句；将AI生成与人类创作俳句混合，制成问卷发放给东京的日本大学生，评估辨识准确性与判断线索；并分析生成约束遵循度、参与者特征及基于LLM的探索性作者评判。
AI.result: 模型间识别准确率差异明显：GPT-5、Gemini 2.5、StableLM-7B接近随机水平（约0.50）；LLM-JP、Gemma-2B、LLaMA-2具中等可检测性（约0.59–0.67）；识别强烈依赖具体诗作。流畅性、连贯性、诗意性等审美维度评分能预测"感知似人性"，但不能预测正确分类。
AI.conclusion: 审美评价与真实作者识别之间存在分离，表现出与审美判断相关的归因偏差；随着LLM能力提升，表面层面的创作可信度可能削弱人类在受约束诗歌场景中的可靠辨别能力。

title: Beyond Safe Answers: Segment-Aware Listwise Alignment for Reasoning Safety in Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) pose a dual-surface safety challenge: both intermediate reasoning traces and final answers can contain harmful content. Existing alignment methods often operate at the whole-response level, allowing unsafe reasoning to be masked by a safe-looking final answer. We propose Segment-aware Listwise Target DPO (SaLT-DPO), which addresses this gap through three mechanisms: (1) segment-aware listwise alignment that decomposes responses into reasoning and answer segments, independently scores each segment's safety, and aligns length-normalized segment rewards with soft target distributions over multiple candidates; (2) joint safety coherence regularization that applies a weakest-link principle to promote safety consistency across both segments; and (3) utility anchoring on benign prompts to mitigate over-refusal and reasoning degradation. Experiments on three LRMs show that SaLT-DPO consistently reduces unsafe rates for both reasoning and answer segments while mitigating degradation in benign compliance and preserving general reasoning performance. Ablation studies demonstrate the complementary contributions of its components.

AI.tldr: 提出SaLT-DPO框架，通过分段感知的listwise对齐、联合安全一致性正则和效用锚定三种机制，同时降低大型推理模型推理轨迹与最终答案中的不安全内容，并缓解良性拒绝过度与推理性能退化。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）存在双重表面安全风险：中间推理轨迹和最终答案均可能包含有害内容。现有对齐方法多在整条回复层面操作，导致不安全的推理过程被表面安全的最终答案所掩盖，缺乏对推理段的独立安全约束。
AI.method: 提出SaLT-DPO（Segment-aware Listwise Target DPO），包含三个机制：(1) 分段感知listwise对齐：将回复分解为推理段与答案段，独立评估各段安全性，并对长度归一化的分段奖励与多个候选上的软目标分布进行对齐；(2) 联合安全一致性正则：采用“最弱环节”原则促进两段间的安全一致性；(3) 效用锚定：在良性提示上进行锚定以缓解过度拒绝与推理退化。
AI.result: 在三个LRM上的实验表明，SaLT-DPO在推理段与答案段上均持续降低不安全率，同时缓解良性合规性退化并保持通用推理性能。消融实验验证了各组成部分的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: SaLT-DPO通过对推理与答案分段进行细粒度安全对齐，有效解决了整条回复级对齐中不安全推理被掩盖的问题，实现了安全性与效用性的平衡。

title: Psychosis involves a deficit of information compression in connected speech
summary: Large language models (LLMs) with human-like performance on linguistic tasks have transformed the study of language in neurodiverse conditions. LLMs provide representations of linguistic input in the form of high-dimensional vectors (embeddings), and next-token predictions computed from these embeddings. Previous crosslinguistic evidence suggests a complexity reduction in the form of both lower intrinsic dimensionality (ID) of LLM representations and higher mean surprisal (prediction error) in psychosis. We hypothesized that these metrics reflect a general deficit of information compression in psychosis, linked to grammatical organization as what enables predictions in language.We operationalized surprisal difference as the difference between surprisal as estimated from word frequency and surprisal as based on a contextual LM, which is sensitive to grammatical organization over and above lexical concepts. Using a dataset of 144 Turkish speakers, including 106 patients with schizophrenia-spectrum disorders (SSD) - 56 with chronic schizophrenia (SZH), 33 with first-episode psychosis (FEP), and 17 with schizoaffective disorder (SZA) - and 38 healthy controls. We report: (1) Surprisal difference is attenuated in all clinical groups relative to controls, independently of word count; (2) Compressibility (intrinsic dimension) is reduced in SZH and FEP; (3) Syntactic complexity and compressibility both predict surprisal difference. These results, further refining an alteration in the geometry of the semantic space in psychosis as previously attested, suggest a broader deficit in information compression in this disorder, with a mechanistic underpinning in the operations of grammar.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型（LLM）的表征指标，研究精神分裂症谱系障碍（SSD）语言中的信息压缩缺陷。通过土耳其语被试数据，发现临床组的"惊奇度差"减弱、内在维度降低，且句法复杂度与可压缩性均可预测惊奇度差，提示语法运作是 psychosis 信息压缩缺陷的机制基础。
AI.motivation: 既有跨语言证据显示，精神病（psychosis）中 LLM 表征的内在维度（ID）更低、平均惊奇度（预测误差）更高，表现为一种"复杂度降低"。作者希望检验这是否反映 psychosis 中普遍的信息压缩缺陷，并将其与语法组织（语言预测能力的基础）联系起来。
AI.method: 1) 以"惊奇度差"为操作化指标：基于词频估计的惊奇度与基于上下文语言模型估计的惊奇度之差，后者对超出词汇概念的语法组织敏感；2) 使用144名土耳其语者数据集（106名精神分裂症谱系患者：56名慢性精神分裂症SZH、33名首发精神病FEP、17名分裂情感障碍SZA；38名健康对照）；3) 计算LLM嵌入的中内在维度（可压缩性）与惊奇度指标，并进行预测分析。
AI.result: (1) 所有临床组的惊奇度差相对对照组均减弱，且独立于词数；(2) SZH与FEP组的内在维度（可压缩性）降低；(3) 句法复杂度与可压缩性均可预测惊奇度差。
AI.conclusion: 结果进一步细化了此前关于精神病语义空间几何改变的发现，提示该障碍存在更广泛的信息压缩缺陷，其机制基础在于语法的运作。

title: Assessing nnU-Net Generalization across Brain Tumor Populations in BraTS-GoAT 2026
summary: BraTS-GoAT evaluates tumor segmentation across heterogeneous populations. We trained a conventional 3D nnU-Net on 1,351 labeled cases using five-fold cross-validation and 1,000 epochs per fold. The final predictor averaged all folds and applied test-time mirroring. On pooled official validation, global DSC values were 0.7805, 0.8288, and 0.8854 for enhancing tumor (ET), tumor core (TC), and whole tumor (WT). Under matched fold-0 inference, mean regional Dice decreased from 0.9058 on source out-of-fold (OOF) cases to 0.8310 on pooled validation (difference--0.0747). Mirroring gave small single-fold gains but no clear ensemble benefit; a residual-encoder alternative reached 0.8282 mean Dice. In labeled OOF predictions, failure cases had substantially smaller reference ET volumes; after adjustment for ET and WT volume, lower Dice remained associated with more disconnected ET components and a smaller fraction of ET contained in the largest component.

AI.tldr: 在BraTS-GoAT异质人群数据上,常规3D nnU-Net的平均区域Dice由源域OOF的0.9058降至官方验证的0.8310(降幅0.0747),文档记录的特征显示失败案例与ET体积小、ET成分更碎片化相关。
AI.motivation: BraTS-GoAT旨在评估肿瘤分割模型在异质人群上的表现,即考察模型跨域泛化能力及其失效模式。
AI.method: 在1,351例标注数据上训练常规3D nnU-Net,采用五折交叉验证、每折1,000个epoch;最终预测器对五折结果取平均,并施加测试时镜像(mirroring)。对比条件下还评估了残差编码器(residual-encoder)替代方案。通过源域OOF(折内)与官方验证集的fold-0配准推理对比、镜像效果的消融,以及对失败案例按参考ET/WT体积和ET连通性成分的分析来定位误差来源。
AI.result: 汇总官方验证集上全局DSC为ET 0.7805、TC 0.8288、WT 0.8854。fold-0配准推理下,平均区域Dice从源域OOF的0.9058降至汇总验证的0.8310(差-0.0747)。镜像带来小幅单折增益,但无明显集成收益;残差编码器替代方案mean Dice为0.8282。在标注OOF预测中,失败案例的参考ET体积显著更小;在调整ET与WT体积后,较低Dice仍与ET连通成分更多、最大成分中ET占比更低相关。
AI.conclusion: 常规nnU-Net在BraTS-GoAT异质人群上存在明显跨域性能下降,主要体现在ET类;该下降不能完全由肿瘤体积解释,ET的空间碎片化(多连通成分、最大成分覆盖不足)是残余误差的重要来源。镜像与残差编码器均未带来实质性改善。

title: To Each Language Its Tokenizer: Modular Tokenizers for Efficient Multilingual LLMs
summary: Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) traditionally rely on a single vocabulary shared by all supported languages, which can lead to uneven compression across them. Moreover, their large embedding and output matrices increase memory usage and slow inference, notably for small-scale models. It is also wasteful as models are often used for only a subset of languages. To address these issues, we introduce a modular framework for multilingual model training. First, we propose methods to learn large modular BPE and Unigram tokenizers that enable extraction of subtokenizers tailored to any language subset. These subtokenizers achieve compression on par with monolingual tokenizers and improve cross-lingual fairness. Second, we design a pretraining strategy that samples subtokenizers to form batches, restricting predictions to the relevant vocabulary subset and allowing efficient training despite a large vocabulary. This supports efficient inference with any combination of language-specific vocabularies. Therefore, it reduces memory usage and speeds up inference in models without sacrificing performance.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化多语言训练框架：学习大型模块化BPE/Unigram词表，可按语言子集抽取子词表，并结合子词表采样预训练，实现压缩均衡、跨语言公平、内存降低与推理加速。
AI.motivation: 传统多语言大模型共享单一词表，导致各语言压缩不均；庞大的嵌入与输出矩阵增加内存占用、拖慢推理，尤其影响小规模模型；且模型常仅服务部分语言，共享全量词表造成浪费。
AI.method: 1）提出学习大型模块化BPE与Unigram分词器的方法，支持抽取面向任意语言子集的子词表；2）设计预训练策略，通过采样子词表构成批次，将预测限制在相关词表子集内，在大词表下实现高效训练，并支持任意语言特定词表组合的高效推理。
AI.result: 抽取出的子词表压缩率与单语分词器相当，并提升跨语言公平性；在不牺牲性能的前提下，降低内存占用并加速推理。
AI.conclusion: 模块化词表与子词表采样训练相结合，可缓解多语言词表压缩不均与资源浪费问题，兼顾性能、公平性与推理效率，为多语言模型提供可扩展方案。

title: Option-Aware Retrieval and Task-Specific VLM Adaptation for Medical VQA
summary: We describe our submission to the MedReason 2026 challenge, covering multiple-choice (MCQ) and open-ended (OE) medical visual question answering (VQA) under fully offline, containerized inference. Our first finding is that MCQ retrieval must compare answer \emph{semantics} rather than answer labels: labels are independently assigned per question, so copying a retrieved neighbor's label transfers no useful information, whereas scoring each current option's text against correct-answer text from similar training cases raises retrieval-only accuracy from 20.0\% to 57.5\% on a 200-case retrieval-excluded development holdout. Our second finding attributes the submitted system's accuracy: holding the task-specific MCQ Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter fixed and varying the number \(k\) of in-prompt retrieved examples changes accuracy by at most one case --- 187/200 (93.5\%) at both \(k=0\) and the adapter's training-time \(k=1\), 188/200 (94.0\%) at the packaged runtime's default \(k=3\) --- and the submitted confidence-gated override adds no net accuracy on top of \(k=3\), selecting the VLM in 198/200 cases. With the final MCQ adapter fixed, retrieval changes accuracy by at most one case, and gating provides no net gain. On 20 OE cases, token-F1 and RaTEScore~\cite{zhao2024ratescore} decrease as \(k\) grows, but paired sign tests on token-F1 differences are nonsignificant (\(p \ge 0.29\)); a single-annotator comparison found 6/20 wrong-anchor errors for the final configuration and 14/20 for an earlier configuration that jointly differed in routing, adapter, and prompting. The system reaches 94.0\% MCQ accuracy on the development holdout and 93.20\% on the organizer's official pre-evaluation, versus 29.43\% for the off-the-shelf reference baseline, while both of the organizer's open-ended scores are lower than that baseline's (ground-truth agreement 1.245 versus 1.588, visual accuracy 1.995 versus 2.696, each out of 4).

AI.tldr: 该文介绍 MedReason 2026 挑战赛的离线医疗视觉问答系统，发现选择题检索须匹配答案语义而非标签，且任务适配器固定后检索与门控几乎不改变准确率；最终 MCQ 准确率 94.0%，但开放式得分低于基线。
AI.motivation: 在完全离线、容器化的推理约束下，医疗视觉问答（VQA）系统的性能来源不清晰：选择题检索中检索示例的答案标签与当前问题标签体系不一致，可能无法迁移有用信息；同时任务专用的 LoRA 适配器、检索示例数量与置信度门控各自的贡献缺乏消融验证。作者希望厘清这些组件的实际作用，并解释系统在选择题与开放式任务上表现差异的原因。
AI.method: 构建覆盖多项选择题（MCQ）与开放式（OE）医疗 VQA 的离线容器化系统。针对 MCQ，提出按答案语义（将当前选项文本与相似训练样例的正确答案文本打分比对）进行检索，而非复制邻居的答案标签；固定任务专用 LoRA 适配器，变化提示内检索示例数 k（k=0、1、3），并评估置信度门控覆盖机制的作用。在 200 例排除检索的开发留出集上评估检索-alone 准确率；在 20 例 OE 上考察随 k 变化的 token-F1 与 RaTEScore，并做配对符号检验与单标注者错误对比。
AI.result: 语义检索将纯检索准确率从 20.0% 提升到 57.5%（200 例开发留出集）。固定 MCQ LoRA 适配器后，改变 k 最多只造成一例差异：k=0 与训练时 k=1 均为 187/200（93.5%），打包运行时默认 k=3 为 188/200（94.0%）；置信度门控在 k=3 之上无净增益，198/200 例仍选择 VLM。OE 上 token-F1 与 RaTEScore 随 k 增大而下降，但配对符号检验不显著（p ≥ 0.29）；单标注者比较显示最终配置 6/20 错锚错误，早前配置 14/20。系统在开发留出集达 94.0% MCQ 准确率，官方预评估 93.20%，远高于现成基线 29.43%；但开放式指标均低于基线（ground-truth agreement 1.245 vs 1.588，visual accuracy 1.995 vs 2.696，满分 4）。
AI.conclusion: 性能主要来自任务专用 LoRA 适配器而非检索或门控：适配器固定后，k 的变化与置信度门控对 MCQ 准确率几乎无影响，故系统本质上接近无检索的适配模型。选择题上的优势（94.0%）与开放式上的劣势（低于参考基线）并存，说明该系统对判别式选择题适应良好，而生成式开放式答题能力受限，检索对 OE 也无显著收益。

title: Multi-Stage NeRF for Efficient 3D Coronary Artery Reconstruction from Two Narrow-Angle Angiographic Projections
summary: X-ray coronary angiography is the clinical gold standard for coronary artery disease during real-time cardiac interventions, but provides only 2D projections of inherently 3D vessels. Existing learning-based 2D-to-3D reconstruction methods typically require wide angular coverage or multiple views, assumptions that are rarely satisfied in routine practice where only two projections with narrow angular separation are available. To address these challenges, we propose NeCA++, a multi-stage self-supervised neural radiance field (NeRF) framework tailored to clinically realistic acquisition constraints. The framework decomposes reconstruction into two stages that progressively refine spatial support and representation capacity. In the first stage, a coarse 3D representation of the vasculature is reconstructed, restricting the subsequent optimisation to regions with a higher likelihood of vessel presence, termed an active region. Afterward reconstruction is restricted to this region while higher-resolution representations are progressively activated to recover fine vascular details. This multi-stage strategy focuses learning on anatomically plausible regions, mitigates gradient dilution under extreme sparsity, and stabilises global topology before recovering fine vascular branches. Furthermore, two vessel-specific regularisations are introduced: a ray-aligned constraint to reduce projection-induced ambiguity, and a bimodal density penalty to enable early vessel-background separation. Extensive experiments across three datasets (ImageCAS, ASOCA, and Synthetic RCA) and four angular configurations demonstrate consistent superiority over state-of-the-art baselines, particularly under clinically realistic narrow-angle settings, while achieving reconstruction within 58 seconds per case.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeCA++，一种面向临床窄角双投影约束的多阶段自监督NeRF冠脉2D-to-3D重建框架，通过由粗到精的渐进式优化与血管专用正则化实现高精度重建。
AI.motivation: X射线冠脉造影仅提供三维血管的二维投影，现有基于学习的2D-to-3D重建方法通常依赖大角度覆盖或多视角输入，而临床常规仅有两个窄角间隔投影，这些假设难以满足，导致重建效果受限。
AI.method: 提出NeCA++多阶段自监督神经辐射场框架：第一阶段重建粗略血管三维表示，界定高血管存在概率的"活跃区域"；第二阶段将优化限制在该区域内并渐进激活更高分辨率表示以恢复细节。同时引入两种血管专用正则化：射线对齐约束以缓解投影歧义，双峰密度惩罚以实现血管-背景早期分离。
AI.result: 在ImageCAS、ASOCA与Synthetic RCA三个数据集及四种角度配置上，NeCA++一致优于当前最优基线，尤其在临床真实的窄角设置下优势明显，单例重建耗时58秒以内。
AI.conclusion: 该多阶段策略将学习聚焦于解剖合理区域，缓解极端稀疏下的梯度稀释，并在恢复细小血管分支前稳定全局拓扑，为临床可行条件下的冠脉三维重建提供了有效方案。

title: Don't Count the Edits, Judge by the Outcome Alone: Reward-Based Evaluation for Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Grammatical error correction (GEC) evaluation has traditionally relied on reference or edit overlap, which can penalize valid rewrites that differ from gold corrections. Reference-free metrics reduce this dependence, but evaluating whether a fluent output is a valid correction of the source remains challenging. We propose SURE, a source-conditioned reward evaluator trained on within-source preferences spanning minimal-edit and rewrite-oriented corrections. SURE jointly learns an overall reward with criteria-level supervision for grammaticality, faithfulness, and fluency, together with span-level grounding for source-side error resolution. Experiments on SEEDA show that SURE performs competitively against strong baselines, with particular gains on rewrite-style corrections and more disentangled criteria-level diagnostics. Our code is available at https://github.com/hayeonggg/SURE.

AI.tldr: 提出 SURE——一种源条件（source-conditioned）奖励评估器，用于无参考的语法纠错（GEC）评估。
AI.motivation: 传统 GEC 评估依赖参考译文或编辑重叠，会惩罚与标准答案不同的有效改写；而无参考指标虽降低依赖，却难以判断流畅输出是否为源句的有效纠正。
AI.method: SURE 基于同一源句内的偏好（涵盖最小编辑与改写导向的纠正）训练；联合学习整体奖励与准则级监督（语法性、忠实性、流畅性），并引入源侧错误消解的 span 级 grounding。
AI.result: 在 SEEDA 上，SURE 与强基线相比具有竞争力，在改写风格纠正上提升尤为明显，且准则级诊断更解耦。
AI.conclusion: SURE 为 GEC 提供了更符合改写有效性、诊断更清晰的评估方式，代码已开源。

title: Can We Trust the Judges? Validation of Factuality Evaluation Methods via Answer Perturbation
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures. Extended version of a paper accepted at EvalLLM 2025 (CORIA-TALN 2025)
summary: Evaluating the factual correctness of large language models (LLMs) is vital for many applications. But are our evaluation tools themselves trustworthy? Despite the rise of factuality-based metrics, their sensitivity and reliability remain underexplored. This paper introduces a meta-evaluation framework that systematically tests these metrics using controlled corruptions of gold standard answers. Our method generates ranked outputs with known degrees of degradation to probe how metrics capture nuanced changes in truthfulness. Our experiments reveal that pipeline-based methods, such as the RAGAS's factual correctness metric, better track degradation than LLM-as-judge approaches. We also propose a new variant of the factual correctness metric that provides a competitive and cost-efficient.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个元评估框架，通过受控腐化金标准答案来系统检验LLM事实性评估指标的敏感性与可靠性，发现基于流水线的方法（如RAGAS）优于LLM-as-judge，并提出一种更具成本效益的新指标变体。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型事实正确性评估对众多应用至关重要，但评估工具本身是否可信尚存疑问；尽管事实性指标不断涌现，其敏感性和可靠性仍缺乏深入探究。
AI.method: 构建元评估框架，对金标准答案施加受控腐化以生成具有已知退化程度的排序输出，借此探测指标对真实性细微变化的捕捉能力，并据此提出事实正确性指标的新变体。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于流水线的方法（如RAGAS的事实正确性指标）比LLM-as-judge方法更能有效跟踪退化程度；所提出的新指标变体兼具竞争力与成本效率。
AI.conclusion: 该元评估框架揭示了现有事实性指标的敏感性与可靠性差异，为选择和改进LLM事实正确性评估工具提供了依据。

title: PIVOT: Physics-Grounded Verification for AI-Generated Audio-Video Detection
summary: As generative models continue to advance, AI-generated content (AIGC) is becoming increasingly realistic, weakening the artifact cues commonly exploited by existing detectors. Nevertheless, faithfully reproducing the physical behavior of real-world events remains challenging for current generators. We therefore explore detecting AIGC by assessing whether the depicted event satisfies measurable constraints derived from physical laws. We introduce PIVOT, a physics-grounded AIGC detector, instantiated here for audio-video clips, that estimates physical quantities from video and audio, selects physical laws relevant to each clip, and verifies their measurable constraints. Beyond a real/fake decision, PIVOT returns supporting evidence that records the verification outcome, relevant time window, and supporting quantities for each applicable law. Although instantiated and evaluated here on audio-video data, the framework can, in principle, extend to other AIGC modalities whenever the physical quantities required for verification can be estimated reliably. We also introduce PhysForensics-Bench, comprising paired real and generated audio-video clips from nine event-centric scene families and two recent audio-video generators. On PhysForensics-Bench, PIVOT achieves 70.30% accuracy and 64.29% F1 score on Real+Seedance, and 72.16% accuracy and 65.82% F1 on Real+VEO. In comparison, direct inspection with Gemini 3.1 Pro obtains 53.96% accuracy and 60.09% F1 on Real+Seedance, and 57.22% accuracy and 63.44% F1 on Real+Veo. These results demonstrate the practical promise of physical-consistency verification as a structured and inspectable source of evidence that complements artifact-based AIGC detection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PIVOT——一个基于物理规律约束验证的音视频AIGC检测器，并构建PhysForensics-Bench基准；在Real+Seedance与Real+VEO上准确率分别达70.30%和72.16%，优于Gemini 3.1 Pro直接判断。
AI.motivation: 生成模型不断进步，AIGC内容愈发逼真，使现有检测器依赖的伪影线索逐渐失效，检测难度上升。但当前生成器仍难以忠实复现真实世界事件的物理行为，因此可从物理一致性角度寻找新的检测依据。
AI.method: 提出PIVOT，一个物理驱动的AIGC检测器，当前实例化于音视频片段：从视频与音频中估计物理量，为每个片段筛选相关物理定律，并核验其可测量约束。除真/假判定外，还输出支撑证据，包括核验结果、相关时间窗与每条适用定律的支持量。框架原则上可扩展至其他AIGC模态。同时构建PhysForensics-Bench，包含来自九个以事件为中心的scene family、由两种近期音视频生成器生成的成对真实与生成音视频片段。
AI.result: 在PhysForensics-Bench上，PIVOT在Real+Seedance上取得70.30%准确率与64.29% F1，在Real+VEO上取得72.16%准确率与65.82% F1；相较之下，Gemini 3.1 Pro直接检测在Real+Seedance上为53.96%准确率与60.09% F1，在Real+Veo上为57.22%准确率与63.44% F1。
AI.conclusion: 物理一致性验证可作为结构化、可审查的证据来源，与基于伪影的AIGC检测形成互补，展现出实际应用前景。

title: What a gated sensing pipeline never looks at: bandwidth reduction and the misses behind it
comment: 13 pages, 6 tables, no figures. Reports a superseded detection result alongside the corrected run that replaces it; Table 6 carries every scored run of every staged flight
summary: An airborne sensor on a contested link cannot send video, so the appealing move is to send findings instead and report the ratio between the two. We evaluate a gated sensing pipeline that does this, combining learned object detection and image-text comparison with deterministic scheduling, gating, evidence accumulation and transmission rules. On staged footage with the semantic stage live it sends 38,736 bits over 211 s, a reduction of 41,977x, and names 1 of 4 staged events with no false report. That detection has since been superseded: a correction to how the tracker measures speed removed the measurement artefact the normality model had been learning from, and the flight no longer warms. Under the corrected code the pipeline names 1 of 7 staged events across four flights, and we report both. On a control flight where nothing was staged it reports nothing, a reduction of 155,830x: the largest number in the study and the least informative, because a reduction ratio measures the scene. The mechanisms that produce the reduction also decide which observations ever reach a decision, so the two cannot be reported apart. We give a tick-level trace of one flight (3,187 rows) that places each of three missed events at the stage where it stopped progressing: one produced no track, one failed the structural place test at 0.129, and one passed 539 structural ticks but reached only 3.192 against a boundary of 3.807. We also report one instance of a known failure mode, an online normality model absorbing the object it will later judge, measured against the threshold that object then failed. The evidence is one detection and six misses across four staged flights, beside one clean control, and we treat it as a case study. We give the reproduction protocol and generated results, identify which supporting artifacts are not distributed, and state which experiments did not run.

AI.tldr: 论文评估一种门控感知流水线：在受限链路上只发送检测结论而非视频，并报告压缩比。原始版本压缩41,977倍并命名4个事件中的1个；修正跟踪器测速伪影后，跨四架次命名7个事件中的1个。对照飞行零报告、压缩155,830倍。研究给出单架次3,187行逐tick轨迹，定位三个漏检事件的停止阶段，并报告在线正态模型吸收待判目标的已知失效模式，整体定位为案例研究。
AI.motivation: 受限链路无法传输视频，因此"发送发现而非原始数据"并报告二者比例成为有吸引力的方案。作者希望评估一个把学习式目标检测、图文比较与确定性调度、门控、证据累积和传输规则结合的门控感知流水线在真实飞行中的表现，同时揭示压缩比指标的误导性，以及压缩机制与决策机制不可分离的问题。
AI.method: 构建门控感知流水线：学习式目标检测 + 图像—文本比较 + 确定性调度/门控/证据累积/传输规则。在分阶段布置的飞行footage上运行，语义阶段实时；随后修正跟踪器测速方式（移除正态模型此前正在学习的测量伪影，飞行不再"预热"），在修正代码下跨四架次重测；另设一无布置的对照飞行。对其中一架次给出3,187行逐tick轨迹，将每个漏检事件定位到其停止推进的阶段（无航迹/结构位置检验0.129失败/539个结构tick后仅达3.192而边界为3.807），并测量在线正态模型吸收其日后将判定的目标这一失效模式。
AI.result: 原始版本：分阶段footage上发送38,736比特/211秒，压缩41,977倍，命名4个事件中的1个且无虚报。修正后：跨四架次命名7个事件中的1个。对照飞行无任何报告，压缩155,830倍（研究中最大且信息量最低）。三个漏检事件分别止步于：无航迹产生、结构位置检验0.129失败、通过539个结构tick但仅达3.192（边界3.807）。另报告一例在线正态模型吸收待判目标的已知失效模式，并以该目标随后未通过的阈值度量。总体证据为四架次分阶段飞行中1次检测、6次漏检，外加一次干净对照。
AI.conclusion: 压缩比衡量的是场景本身而非系统性能，且产生压缩的机制同时决定哪些观测能进入决策，因此二者不能分开报告。修正测速伪影后检测结果被推翻，说明原检测结果依赖于测量伪影而非真实信号。作者将该工作定位为案例研究，给出复现协议与生成结果，指明哪些支撑工件未分发，并声明哪些实验未运行。

title: A Unified Vision-Language Model for PSMA PET/CT Report Generation, Visual Question Answering, and Lesion Segmentation
summary: Accurate PSMA PET/CT interpretation is central to prostate cancer management, yet existing PET/CT AI models typically address isolated tasks. We propose a unified PSMA PET/CT vision-language model for report generation, visual question answering, and lesion segmentation.
