The framework adopts an LLaVA-style architecture, comprising a PET/CT vision encoder, an MLP-Mixer projection module, a LoRA-tuned large language model, and a 3D segmentation branch. Training followed a four-stage strategy: vision encoder pretraining, projection-layer alignment, VLM fine-tuning, and final multitask tuning. Language tasks used 5,747 PSMA PET/CT datasets with paired reports, while segmentation used the PSMA subset of AutoPET. The model outperformed PET2REP and a CT-based baseline across standard report-generation metrics, improved performance across VQA question types, and achieved higher Dice and lesion-level overlap F1 than SegAnyPET and nnUNet. These results support the feasibility of a unified framework for structured, interactive, interpretable PSMA PET/CT analysis with voxel-level grounding within a single multitask model architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的PSMA PET/CT视觉-语言模型，可同时完成报告生成、视觉问答与病灶分割，在多任务上均超越现有专用模型。
AI.motivation: 准确的PSMA PET/CT解读对前列腺癌管理至关重要，但现有PET/CT AI模型通常只处理孤立任务，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 采用LLaVA式架构，包含PET/CT视觉编码器、MLP-Mixer投影模块、LoRA微调的大语言模型和3D分割分支；训练分四阶段：视觉编码器预训练、投影层对齐、VLM微调、最终多任务微调。语言任务使用5,747例带配对报告的PSMA PET/CT数据，分割任务使用AutoPET的PSMA子集。
AI.result: 在标准报告生成指标上优于PET2REP和基于CT的基线；在各类型VQA问题上均有提升；Dice和病灶级重叠F1高于SegAnyPET和nnUNet。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在单一多任务模型架构内实现结构化、交互式、可解释且具像素级定位能力的PSMA PET/CT分析的可行性。

title: VideoScout: Learning Agentic Active Exploration with Adaptive Reasoning Pacing for Long Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress on short video understanding yet remain limited on long videos due to the limited visual context window. Prevailing approaches rely on uniform frame sampling or recent coarse-to-fine agentic zooming, both of which struggle to localize sparse, decisive evidence in sufficiently long videos. We formulate long video understanding as a \textbf{Sequential Evidence Acquisition (SEA)} problem, in which an agent reads the video turn by turn along the temporal axis, deciding at each turn how fast to watch, what evidence to retain, when to revisit uncertain segments, and when to stop and answer. Inspired by this view, we propose \textbf{VideoScout}, a multi-turn reasoning agent that instantiates the SEA paradigm through adaptive reasoning pacing. Specifically, by dynamically controlling the viewing pace, VideoScout enables efficient traversal of long videos within a bounded visual context window, allowing the agent to access more video content while balancing content analysis depth with reading efficiency. To train VideoScout, we construct VideoScout-66K, a set of over 66K high-quality exploration turns from 10K answer-verified trajectories, and adopt a two-stage pipeline: cold-start supervised fine-tuning teaches the agent per-turn output format, while the Decoupled Clip and Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO) algorithm performs trajectory-level reinforcement learning with a composite reward that jointly considers answer accuracy, output format compliance, and the temporal alignment between the agent's viewing progress and the teacher's answer timing measured by intersection-over-union (IoU). Extensive experiments on long video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our 7B model achieves strong performance compared with existing trained 7B agentic models.

AI.tldr: 本文将长视频理解形式化为顺序证据获取（SEA）问题，提出多轮推理智能体 VideoScout，通过自适应观看节奏在有限视觉上下文窗口内高效遍历长视频，并构建 VideoScout-66K 数据集与两阶段训练流程，7B 模型在长视频理解与推理基准上取得优于现有同规模智能体模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在短视频理解上进展显著，但受限于视觉上下文窗口，在长视频上表现不佳。现有方法依赖均匀帧采样或粗到细的智能体缩放，难以在足够长的视频中定位稀疏且关键的证据。
AI.method: 将长视频理解建模为顺序证据获取（SEA）问题：智能体沿时间轴逐轮读取视频，每轮决定观看速度、保留哪些证据、何时回访不确定片段以及何时停止作答。据此提出 VideoScout——一种通过自适应推理节奏实现 SEA 范式的多轮推理智能体，动态控制观看节奏以在有限视觉上下文窗口内高效遍历长视频。训练方面构建了 VideoScout-66K（来自 10K 条答案可验证轨迹的 66K+ 高质量探索轮次），采用两阶段流程：冷启动监督微调学习每轮输出格式；DAPO 算法进行轨迹级强化学习，复合奖励联合考虑答案准确性、输出格式合规性，以及智能体观看进度与教师答案时机的 IoU 时间对齐。
AI.result: 在长视频理解与推理基准上的大量实验表明，该 7B 模型相比现有已训练的 7B 智能体模型取得了强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将长视频理解重构为顺序证据获取问题并引入自适应推理节奏机制，VideoScout 在受限上下文窗口下实现了更高效的长视频遍历与证据定位，验证了该范式的有效性。

title: Through the Eyes of the Beholder: Biometric and Demographic Conditioning for Multimodal Sexism Detection
summary: Detecting sexism on the internet is a fundamentally subjective task; our team, VANGUARD, addresses this challenge in the EXIST 2026 Task 2 by proposing a human-centered multimodal framework that analyses and incorporates the psychological and demographic characteristics of human annotators into the detection pipeline. We fuse five input modalities through a cross-attention architecture with Feature-wise Linear Modulation conditioning. Meme text is extracted and visually described with Gemma 4, then augmented by automatic translation between English and Spanish with NLLB-200. Text and image representations are produced by LoRAadapted XLM-RoBERTa and CLIP encoders and fused with sensor features encoded by a pretrained autoencoder. To model annotator subjectivity, we frame Subtask 2.1 as a label distribution learning problem, optimizing a Kullback-Leibler divergence loss over the full annotator label distribution. At inference time, predictions are produced by soft-voting between the deep multimodal network and a complementary SVM trained on stylometric and physiological features. Our best submission ranks 29th out of 114 on Subtask 2.2 (source intention) under soft evaluation, and the normalized ICM scores remain above the baseline on Subtasks 2.1 and 2.2, indicating that annotator-centered conditioning contributes a usable signal. We release our full pipeline and analysis to support reproducible human-centered modeling.

AI.tldr: Summary generation failed
AI.motivation: 网络性别歧视检测本质上是主观任务，标注者之间的判断差异是任务固有属性而非噪声；因此需要把标注者的心理与人口统计特征显式纳入建模，而非仅追求单一"金标准"标签。
AI.method: 融合五种输入模态，采用交叉注意力架构并引入 Feature-wise Linear Modulation 条件化。用 Gemma 4 提取并视觉描述 meme 文本，再用 NLLB-200 做英西互译增强；文本与图像表示分别由 LoRA 适配的 XLM-RoBERTa 和 CLIP 编码器生成，并与预训练自编码器编码的传感器特征融合。将 Subtask 2.1 建模为标签分布学习，在全标注者标签分布上优化 KL 散度损失；推理时由深度多模态网络与基于风格计量和生理特征训练的 SVM 进行软投票。
AI.result: 最佳提交在 Subtask 2.2（source intention）软评估下于 114 支队伍中排名第 29；在 Subtask 2.1 与 2.2 上归一化 ICM 分数均高于基线，表明以标注者为中心的条件化提供了可用信号。
AI.conclusion: 标注者中心的条件化对主观性别歧视检测具有实用价值；团队公开完整流程与分析，以支持可复现的以人为中心建模研究。
AI.tlr: VANGUARD 团队针对 EXIST 2026 Task 2 的性别歧视检测，提出以人为中心的多模态框架，将标注者的心理与人口统计特征融入检测流程，通过交叉注意力加 FiLM 条件化融合五种模态，并以标签分布学习建模主观性。

title: IROH: Insightful Ranking Of Humor using Multi-Stage Hybrid Retrieval with Rationale-Distilled LLM Judges for JOKER 2026 Track Task 1 English
summary: Our team, VANGUARD, presents IROH (Insightful Ranking of Humor), a three-stage retrieval system for JOKER Task 1 English at CLEF 2026, achieving first place on the leaderboard with 0.6347 MAP. Our pipeline combines hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and a LoRA-adapted Large Language Model judge ensemble. We employ Gemma 4 to generate query-aware rationales under two prompt strategies, generic and typed, and produce up to four types of structured hard negatives for training data construction. Through an ablation across three cross-encoder architectures, four dense embedders, and eight judge configurations, our key findings are threefold: (1) the rationale-distilled judge is the primary driver of ranking quality, whereas appending rationales to the first-stage index contributes negligibly; (2) structured hard negatives degrade generalisation in nearly all configurations despite inflating local validation scores; and (3) across the components we ablate, the lighter, better-calibrated model is competitive with or stronger than its larger counterpart, with the generic-rationale Qwen2.5-7B judge (0.6055 MAP) outperforming every Gemma-4-31B configuration, and the advantage of generic over typed rationales is concentrated almost entirely in the smaller model.

AI.tldr: VANGUARD 团队提出三阶段检索系统 IROH，在 CLEF 2026 JOKER Task 1 英语赛道以 0.6347 MAP 排名第一，融合稀疏-稠密混合检索、交叉编码器重排与 LoRA 适配的大模型评审集成。
AI.motivation: 面向 JOKER Task 1 英语幽默检索任务，探索如何通过理由蒸馏、结构化难负样本与模型规模/校准的权衡来优化检索排序质量。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：稀疏-稠密混合检索 + 交叉编码器重排 + LoRA 适配大模型评审集成；用 Gemma 4 在通用与类型化两种提示下生成查询感知理由；构造最多四类结构化难负样本；对 3 种交叉编码器、4 种稠密编码器、8 种评审配置开展消融。
AI.result: 取得 0.6347 MAP 位列榜首。关键发现：(1) 理由蒸馏评审是排序质量的主要驱动，将理由附加至一阶段索引贡献可忽略；(2) 结构化难负样本在几乎所有配置下损害泛化，尽管会抬高本地验证分数；(3) 更轻、校准更好的模型可与更大模型竞争甚至更优，通用理由的 Qwen2.5-7B 评审（0.6055 MAP）优于所有 Gemma-4-31B 配置，通用优于类型化理由的优势几乎仅集中于较小模型。
AI.conclusion: 理由蒸馏评审与良好校准的中小规模模型是提升幽默检索排序的关键，结构化难负样本易致过拟合，应谨慎使用。

title: ModaLens: Measuring Image Sensitivity in Report-Conditioned Medical VLMs
summary: A radiology report can already answer a clinical question, so it is hard to tell whether a vision-language model also uses the image. ModaLens, a paired image-swap audit, measures how report availability changes image sensitivity: MedGemma-27B on 3,199 paired MIMIC-CXR cases from 293 patients, all 14 questions per case (13 finding-specific and one composite), each image replaced by one from another study, usually of the same patient, with question and report fixed. Under an explicit answer instruction, the model's generated answer changes on 4.26 percent of trials with the report and 20.94 percent without it, a paired increase of 16.7 points (patient-clustered 95 percent CI 15.6 to 17.7), so report availability reduces image-swap sensitivity under this protocol; the original prompt with a lowercase first-token readout gives 4.70 percent against 17.07 percent, and substitutions also move continuous answer scores where the binary prediction does not change. The labels are derived from reports, which limits conclusions about visual correctness; the direction replicates in two further model lineages. Code, the exact prompts and a run record for every number are at https://github.com/criticaldata/MODALENS.

AI.tldr: 提出 ModaLens 配对图像替换审计方法，量化“报告存在与否”如何影响视觉语言模型的图像敏感性。MedGemma-27B 在 MIMIC-CXR 的 3199 配对病例上，有报告时答案改变率 4.26%，无报告时 20.94%，配对提升 16.7 个百分点，说明报告可用性降低了图像替换敏感性。
AI.motivation: 放射报告本身即可回答临床问题，因此难以判断视觉语言模型是否真正使用了图像信息。作者希望设计一种可控审计手段，直接测量模型对图像的依赖程度，并考察报告可用性是否会掩盖或削弱这种图像敏感性。
AI.method: 提出 ModaLens：一种配对图像替换审计。以 MIMIC-CXR 中 3199 个配对病例（来自 293 名患者）为样本，每例 14 个问题（13 个具体征象加 1 个复合问题），将原图替换为另一项检查的图像（通常为同一患者），同时固定问题与报告。比较有报告与无报告两种条件下模型生成答案的变化率，并在显式作答指令与原始提示（小写首 token 读出）两种设置下验证，另记录连续答案分数的变化。
AI.result: 显式作答指令下，有报告时答案改变率 4.26%，无报告时 20.94%，配对增加 16.7 个百分点（患者聚类 95% CI 15.6–17.7）。原始提示下为 4.70% 对 17.07%。图像替换在二元预测未变时也会改变连续答案分数。该方向在两个其他模型谱系中可复现。局限在于标签源自报告，无法对视觉正确性下结论。
AI.conclusion: 在该协议下，报告可用性会降低模型对图像替换的敏感性，提示模型可能更多依赖文本报告而非图像。ModaLens 提供了一种可复现的审计范式；代码、精确提示与每次运行记录均已公开。

title: SAM3D-Part: Interactive Part Selection and Generation from 3D Objects
summary: Part-level control is essential for modern 3D asset creation, where objects are frequently edited, reused, animated, or fabricated through their individual components. In many such workflows, users need only several specific components rather than a complete object decomposition. However, existing 3D generation methods produce all parts regardless of user intent, while promptable 3D segmentation methods typically output partial surfaces instead of reusable complete meshes. In addition, image-conditioned part generators further struggle to preserve hidden geometry and accurate placement without directly conditioning on the source mesh. To address these problems, we present SAM3D-Part, a prompt-driven framework for selective part generation from input 3D object meshes. Given a source mesh and a part prompt, SAM3D-Part first encodes the source geometry into compact mesh features and aligns them with the rendered image, selective mask, and point-map observations via pixel-wise channel fusion. The fused representation conditions a feed-forward generative model to produce only the queried component as a completed mesh. To place the generated part back into the source coordinate frame, SAM3D-Part predicts dense per-voxel correspondences and estimates the part transformation from distributed spatial evidence rather than a single global pose code. For sequential multi-part queries, previously generated parts are stored in a part cache and reused as contextual constraints, reducing conflicts among independently requested components. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate that SAM3D-Part can significantly improve source alignment, reduce conditioning cost, and enable consistent selective part generation, achieving state-of-the-art. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/Jiahao620/sam3d-part.

AI.tldr: SAM3D-Part 是一个提示驱动的选择性部件生成框架，可从输入三维网格中按提示生成完整部件网格，并通过体素对应预测与部件缓存实现精确回置和多部件一致性生成，达到 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现代三维资产创作常围绕部件进行编辑、复用、动画与制造，但用户往往只需要若干特定部件而非完整分解。现有三维生成方法会生成全部部件、忽视用户意图；可提示三维分割方法通常只输出局部表面而非可复用的完整网格；图像条件式部件生成器在不直接以源网格为条件时，难以保持隐藏几何与准确放置位置。
AI.method: 提出 SAM3D-Part：输入源网格与部件提示，先将源几何编码为紧凑网格特征，并通过逐像素通道融合与渲染图像、选择性掩码、点图观测对齐；融合表征驱动前馈生成模型，仅生成被查询部件为完整网格；通过预测密集逐体素对应关系，从分布式空间证据而非单一全局位姿码估计部件变换以回置到源坐标系；对序列式多部件查询，将已生成部件存入部件缓存并作为上下文约束复用，减少独立请求部件间的冲突。
AI.result: 大量实验与消融表明，SAM3D-Part 能显著提升源对齐精度、降低条件成本，并实现一致的选择性部件生成，达到当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: SAM3D-Part 通过提示驱动的选择性部件生成、分布式位姿估计与部件缓存机制，解决了现有方法忽视用户意图、输出非完整网格、隐藏几何与放置不准的问题，代码与权重将开源。

title: Human-Grounded Calibration for Long-Text Image-Text Congruence in Vision-Language Models
summary: Long-text image--text congruence scoring is increasingly important for vision-language systems that must evaluate whether detailed textual descriptions match visual content. However, raw similarity scores from dual-encoder models are difficult to interpret as calibrated congruence measures, especially under the modality gap between image and text embeddings. This paper proposes Congruency Score (CS), a lightweight calibration layer that maps image--text similarity evidence into a bounded score. Using DOCCI and Urban1k, we evaluate four frozen vision-language backbones and show that observed reductions in post-projection centroid distance do not uniformly improve image--text retrieval performance. Human-grounded evaluations on DOCCI further reveal a trade-off: direct post-hoc calibration preserves high association with human judgments, whereas selected projection-based configurations can reduce threshold-relevant slope and intercept distortions at the cost of retrieval performance and association strength. These results establish long-text image--text congruence scoring as a calibrated score-estimation problem, where retrieval performance, human association, and threshold calibration must be evaluated as distinct objectives. CS provides a lightweight way to expose and operationalize this separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Congruency Score (CS)——一种轻量级校准层，将图像-文本相似度证据映射为有界一致性分数，并在长文本场景下论证检索性能、人类判断关联性与阈值校准是三个需分别评估的目标。
AI.motivation: 长文本图像-文本一致性评分对视觉语言系统日益重要，但双编码器模型的原始相似度分数受模态鸿沟影响，难以直接解释为经过校准的一致性度量。
AI.method: 提出 Congruency Score (CS)，一个将图像-文本相似度证据映射为有界分数的轻量级校准层；在 DOCCI 与 Urban1k 数据集上评估四个冻结的视觉语言骨干模型，并进行基于人类判断的评估。
AI.result: 投影后质心距离的下降并未一致地提升图像-文本检索性能；人类评估显示权衡关系：直接的事后校准与人类判断保持高关联，而部分基于投影的配置虽能减少阈值相关的斜率与截距失真，却以检索性能和关联强度为代价。
AI.conclusion: 长文本图像-文本一致性评分应被视为一个校准式的分数估计问题，检索性能、人类关联性与阈值校准必须作为彼此独立的目标加以评估；CS 提供了暴露并操作化这一分离的轻量级手段。

title: MedDiME: Efficient Latent Diffusion with Adaptive Masking for Medical Counterfactual Generation
summary: Medical counterfactual generation modifies images to change model predictions for interpretability. However, existing diffusion-based approaches are often prohibitively slow and memory-intensive, making them difficult to apply in high-resolution settings. Moreover, existing masking strategies are tightly coupled with pixel-space representations, making them incompatible with latent-space diffusion editing. To address these challenges, we propose MedDiME, a latent-space classifier-guided diffusion framework that reduces computational and memory overhead while introducing a latent-compatible, gradient-driven adaptive masking mechanism for spatially precise medical counterfactual generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MedDiME achieves high-quality counterfactual generation with significant efficiency gains compared to prior classifier-guided diffusion baselines, achieving up to 40 times faster inference and 13 times lower peak GPU memory usage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedDiME，一种潜在空间分类器引导的扩散框架，用于医学反事实生成。它通过自适应掩码机制实现精确的空间编辑，并在推理速度（最高快40倍）和显存占用（降低13倍）上显著优于已有基线。
AI.motivation: 医学反事实生成通过修改图像来改变模型预测以提升可解释性。但现有基于扩散的方法速度慢、显存消耗大，难以应用于高分辨率场景；同时现有掩码策略与像素空间表示紧密耦合，无法兼容潜在空间扩散编辑。
AI.method: 提出MedDiME：一种潜在空间、分类器引导的扩散框架。它降低计算与内存开销，并引入潜空间兼容、梯度驱动的自适应掩码机制，实现空间上精确的医学反事实生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MedDiME 相比先前的分类器引导扩散基线，实现了高质量反事实生成，同时效率显著提升：推理速度最高快40倍，峰值GPU显存占用降低13倍。
AI.conclusion: MedDiME 通过在潜在空间进行梯度驱动的自适应掩码与分类器引导扩散，兼顾了生成质量、空间精度与计算效率，为高分辨率医学反事实生成提供了可行方案。

title: From Model Patterns to Abstract Semantics in Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional Zero Shot Learning aims to recognize unseen compositions by recombining learned primitives. Recent methods rely on vision language models and attempt to explicitly model contextual variations of primitives through multiple representations. However, such approaches are limited by fixed variant capacity and competition between abstract and concrete semantics. In this work, we present a new perspective that views primitive variations as the context-driven activation of concrete visual cues rather than independent entities. Based on it, we propose CLEAR, a CLoze-style rEAsoning-based Re-ranking framework inspired by human perceptual processes. CLEAR extracts conditional variants from the primitive candidate set in a coarse-to-fine manner, performs cloze-style reasoning to infer high-level semantics, and re-ranks predictions to correct biases toward salient concrete primitives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLEAR consistently improves the Base Model and outperforms state-of-the-art methods on the challenging C-GQA and MIT-States datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/buptLwz/CLEAR.

AI.tldr: 提出CLEAR框架，将组合零样本学习中的原语变化视为上下文驱动的具体视觉线索激活，通过完形填空式推理和重排序提升未见组合识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的方法通过多重表示显式建模原语的上下文变化，但受限于固定的变体容量以及抽象语义与具体语义之间的竞争。
AI.method: 提出CLEAR（CLoze-style rEAsoning-based Re-ranking）框架，受人类感知过程启发，从原语候选集中以由粗到细的方式提取条件变体，执行完形填空式推理以推断高层语义，并通过重排序修正对显著具体原语的偏差。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CLEAR在具有挑战性的C-GQA和MIT-States数据集上持续优于基础模型，并超越当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将原语变化重新解释为上下文驱动的具体视觉线索激活，并结合完形填空推理与重排序，是提升组合零样本学习的有效新视角。

title: DualCount: Structurally Consistent Density and Point Modeling for Zero-Shot Object Counting
summary: Zero-shot object counting aims to estimate the number of objects specified by a text query without category-specific training. Recent approaches primarily rely on density regression or detection-style instance prediction. While effective, density-based models often suffer from spatial ambiguity and background leakage due to weakly regulated mass allocation, leading to fragmented or part-biased representations that increase counting error in complex scenes. In this work, we propose an instance-aware dual-decoder framework that structurally couples density and point representations for zero-shot object counting. Instead of treating density estimation as independent pixel-wise regression, we interpret it as a structured mass allocation problem over a latent set of object instances. Predicted instance centers induce a soft instance-wise decomposition of the density map, upon which we enforce two geometric constraints: (1) per-instance mass conservation, ensuring each object contributes approximately one unit of density mass, and (2) center-of-mass alignment, encouraging each density component to concentrate around its corresponding predicted center. These constraints introduce instance-level geometric consistency and lead to more accurate mass allocation, thereby reducing counting error. Extensive experiments on FSC-147, PUCPR+, and CARPK show that our approach consistently reduces counting error and establishes new state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot object counting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出实例感知双解码器框架，将零样本目标计数的密度估计建模为潜在实例上的结构化质量分配问题，并通过两条几何约束提升计数精度。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本目标计数方法主要依赖密度回归或检测式实例预测。密度模型因质量分配缺乏约束，易出现空间模糊与背景泄漏，导致表示碎片化或偏向局部，在复杂场景中计数误差偏大。
AI.method: 提出实例感知双解码器框架，将密度与点表示结构化耦合；把密度估计视为潜在实例集合上的结构化质量分配。由预测的实例中心对密度图进行软实例分解，并施加两项几何约束：(1) 逐实例质量守恒，使每个目标贡献约一个单位密度质量；(2) 质心对齐，促使各密度分量围绕其对应预测中心集中。
AI.result: 在 FSC-147、PUCPR+ 和 CARPK 数据集上实验表明，该方法持续降低计数误差，并在零样本目标计数任务上取得新的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入实例级几何一致性约束可改善密度质量分配，缓解空间模糊与背景泄漏，从而显著降低零样本计数的误差。

title: Empathy Is Steerable but Multi-Axial: Mechanism Geometry and Persona Effects in LLMs
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026
summary: Activation steering has been used to control traits such as honesty, refusal, and sycophancy, yet supportive empathy is evaluated along multiple dimensions that need not correspond to independently controllable activation directions. Using the EPITOME framework, which decomposes supportive empathy into Emotional Reactions, Interpretations, and Explorations, we study three instruction-tuned LLMs and ask whether candidate directions derived from these labels produce distinguishable intervention effects or instead share structure, and how persona prompts interact with those directions. We find that contrastive activation addition yields a stable middle-layer intervention that consistently shifts the EPITOME proxy scores across models, moving empathy analysis beyond response-level scoring. However, the recovered directions are only partially separable: steering one direction induces off-target shifts, and hand-crafted prompting shifts the empathy profile rather than isolating a single dimension. Persona prompts substantially change EPITOME scores, but a paired activation-shift decomposition shows that the recovered subspace captures only approximately 3 percent of persona-induced squared activation-shift magnitude at layer 15. Under this EPITOME-based definition, expressed empathy is steerable but multi-axial, and controlling persona-conditioned empathy requires targeting structure beyond individual mechanism directions.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于EPITOME框架，考察指令微调LLM中支持性共情的激活引导：中层对比激活引导可稳定改变共情代理分数，但方向仅部分可分离，且恢复的子空间仅解释约3%的人格提示诱导激活偏移。
AI.motivation: 激活引导已被用于控制诚实、拒绝、谄媚等特质，但支持性共情是多维构念，其各维度未必对应可独立控制的激活方向。作者希望厘清：由EPITOME标签推导的候选方向是否产生可区分的干预效应，还是共享结构，以及人格提示如何与这些方向交互。
AI.method: 采用EPITOME框架，将支持性共情分解为情绪反应（Emotional Reactions）、解释（Interpretations）与探索（Explorations）；研究三个指令微调LLM，使用对比激活添加（contrastive activation addition）提取候选方向并施加干预，进行跨模型评估，辅以手工设计提示与人格提示实验，并用配对的激活偏移分解量化人格诱导的激活偏移。
AI.result: 对比激活添加产生稳定的中层干预，能跨模型一致地改变EPITOME代理分数，使共情分析超越响应级评分；但恢复的方向仅部分可分离：引导某一方向会引发非目标维度的偏移，手工提示改变的是整体共情画像而非隔离单一维度。人格提示显著改变EPITOME分数，但配对分解显示，在15层恢复的子空间仅约解释人格诱导平方激活偏移幅度的3%。
AI.conclusion: 在EPITOME定义下，表达性共情是可引导的但呈多轴结构；控制人格条件下的共情需要针对比单一机制方向更复杂的结构。

title: KaiNinja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
summary: Native 3D generators turn one image into a single mesh. TRELLIS.2 and its peers deliver high-fidelity non-watertight geometry with materials, but the output is one fused object, while downstream work such as editing, rigging and simulation operates on part-level assets. A naive idea is to run a 3D segmentation network on the fused mesh that TRELLIS.2 generates, but such pipelines are slow and bounded by the accuracy of the segmentation. We want a simple way to extend an existing native 3D generator to the part level. But we face a critical problem: the O-Voxel grid stores one sheet of surface per voxel, so a single volume cannot represent the interface where two parts touch, at any resolution. We introduce a dual-volume representation to solve this problem and put forward KaiNinja, a part-level extension of TRELLIS.2 built on a dual-volume form of its O-Voxel representation. KaiNinja keeps the generation speed and quality of TRELLIS.2 while extending it to the part level, with no mask or segmenter in the pipeline. Its training data come from sources of many kinds, including CAD models and assets authored by an LLM-driven agent; to our knowledge it is the first 3D generative model trained on agent-authored part data. Surprisingly, we also find that whole-object fidelity improves over the same backbone fine-tuned on the same dataset. Against part generation pipelines of different paradigms, it lowers whole-object Chamfer distance by 40% and raises strict part F-score by 16%.

AI.tldr: 提出双体积（dual-volume）表示与 KaiNinja，将原生 3D 生成器 TRELLIS.2 从整体单网格生成扩展到部件级生成，无需掩码或分割器，保持原有速度与质量，并在整体保真度与部件精度上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 原生 3D 生成器（如 TRELLIS.2）输出的是单一融合网格，虽具备高保真非水密几何与材质，但下游的编辑、绑定（rigging）与仿真任务需要部件级资产。常见做法是在融合网格上跑 3D 分割网络，但这类流程速度慢，且性能受分割精度上限约束。因此需要一个简单方式，将已有原生 3D 生成器直接扩展到部件级。核心障碍在于：O-Voxel 网格每个体素只存储一片表面（one sheet of surface per voxel），因此无论分辨率多高，单个体积都无法表示两个部件相互接触的界面。
AI.method: 提出双体积（dual-volume）表示以解决单体积无法表示部件接触界面的问题，并在此基础上构建 KaiNinja——对 TRELLIS.2 的 O-Voxel 表示做双体积形式的部件级扩展。管线中不使用掩码或分割器。训练数据来源多样，包括 CAD 模型以及由 LLM 驱动的智能体（agent）创作的资产。
AI.result: KaiNinja 在保持 TRELLIS.2 生成速度与质量的同时扩展到部件级。相比在同一数据集上微调的相同骨干网络，整体物体保真度意外地有所提升。与其他不同范式的部件生成流程相比，整体物体 Chamfer 距离降低 40%，严格部件 F-score 提升 16%。
AI.conclusion: 双体积表示使原生 3D 生成器无需分割即可原生支持部件级生成。据作者所知，KaiNinja 是首个在智能体创作部件数据上训练的 3D 生成模型；该工作表明部件级建模不仅可行，还能反过来提升整体物体保真度。

title: CiteShade: Citation Laundering in Multi-Source Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Its Counterfactual Defense
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's answers on retrieved external knowledge and returns each answer with citations that identify its sources. Those citations are the user's audit trail: they let a reader verify a claim without trusting the model. Prior security work on RAG asks whether an attacker can corrupt the answer, leaving the citation channel unexplored. We show that this channel is a new and practical attack surface. We propose CiteShade, the first citation laundering attack to RAG, in which an attacker controlling a single source induces a model to produce an attacker-chosen wrong answer and to attribute it to a trusted source that does not support it, while the evidence for the correct answer remains in context. We formulate the attack as an optimization problem, derive three necessary conditions (retrieval, generation, and citation) and construct sources satisfying them without any instruction. On multi-source multi-hop question answering the attack raises the wrong-answer rate from 0.01 to 0.68, and source deletion confirms the malicious source is the causal driver in every measured case. Vulnerability tracks a model's propensity to cite rather than its scale, reaching CLR 0.84 under explicit instruction and 0.64 with no instruction at all on the most citation-prone model tested. We then show that perplexity filtering and citation-support checking are each insufficient, and propose a counterfactual defense that verifies which source actually drove the answer.

AI.tldr: 本文首次揭示RAG中引用通道是可被利用的攻击面，提出CiteShade引用洗白攻击，并给出基于反事实检验的防御方案。
AI.motivation: RAG系统会在回答中附带引用标注，作为用户核验答案的审计线索。此前RAG安全研究只关注攻击者能否污染答案内容，而忽略了引用通道本身是否可被操纵。作者认为引用通道是一个全新且实用的攻击面，值得系统研究。
AI.method: 提出CiteShade——首个针对RAG的"引用洗白"攻击：攻击者仅控制一个来源，即可诱使模型输出攻击者指定的错误答案，并将其归因于一个并不支持该答案的可信来源，同时正确证据仍保留在上下文中。作者将该攻击形式化为优化问题，推导出检索、生成、引用三个必要条件，并在不依赖任何指令的情况下构造满足这些条件的恶意来源。
AI.result: 在多源多跳问答任务上，攻击将错误答案率从0.01提升至0.68；来源删除实验证实恶意来源在每一个测量案例中都是因果驱动因素。脆弱性与模型的引用倾向而非模型规模相关，在最具引用倾向的模型上，显式指令下CLR达0.84，完全无指令时仍达0.64。困惑度过滤与引用支持性检查均不足以防御。
AI.conclusion: 引用通道构成RAG中一类实际可行的攻击面，且该漏洞难以通过常规过滤手段缓解。作者提出一种反事实防御方法，通过验证究竟是哪个来源真正驱动了答案来抵御此类攻击。

title: RAG-CT: Mitigating Privacy Risks on Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems via Scanning Prompt Distribution
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the quality of generated contents of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding responses in external knowledge, thus reducing hallucinations and factual errors. However, recent studies have highlighted a critical vulnerability: adversaries can exploit the retrieval process to extract personally identifiable information (PII) from the underlying corpus. To mitigate this risk, we propose a novel defense, RAG-CT, that identifies malicious queries by analyzing their entropy and margin distributions and using a score-based detection method. Extensive experiments with four state-of-the-art attack strategies and four defense baselines on two datasets show that our approach significantly reduces PII leakage while outperforming existing defenses. This work provides a lightweight yet effective mechanism to protect RAG systems against PII leakage without requiring modifications to the underlying LLM or retriever.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAG-CT，一种通过分析查询的熵与边界分布进行恶意查询检测的轻量级防御方法，可显著降低RAG系统中的个人身份信息泄露，且在四个攻击策略与四个基线防御上表现更优。
AI.motivation: RAG通过外部知识增强LLM生成质量、减少幻觉，但检索过程可被对手利用以从底层语料库中提取个人身份信息（PII），构成严重隐私威胁，亟需有效防御。
AI.method: 提出RAG-CT防御：分析恶意查询的熵分布与边界（margin）分布特征，并采用基于分数的检测方法识别恶意查询；无需修改底层LLM或检索器。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上，针对四种先进攻击策略和四种基线防御进行广泛实验，结果表明该方法显著减少PII泄露，并优于现有防御方法。
AI.conclusion: RAG-CT提供了一种轻量且有效的机制，在不改动底层LLM与检索器的前提下保护RAG系统免受PII泄露。

title: Circuit-MLLM: Topological Logic-Guided Latent-Space Visual Reasoning for Circuit Schematic Understanding
comment: Accepted at European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Through pre-training on extensive text and image datasets, current multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on general tasks. However, circuit schematics present a unique challenge for MLLMs due to their dense component layouts and distinct topological logic, demanding fine-grained structural parsing to extract the electrical semantics. To address this, we propose Circuit-MLLM, a multimodal reasoning framework that reformulates circuit topology analysis as a process of device localization, path tracing, and sequential reasoning within the latent space. We introduce a circuit knowledge mining mechanism that deeply aligns the model's latent representations with structurally rich features derived from multi-granularity circuit vision experts, enabling the model to effectively internalize topological semantics. Building upon these internalized semantics, we devise a topology-guided sequencing strategy that decouples reasoning from the rigid raster-scan order, enforcing stepwise inference along the circuit's topological logic in latent space. Across diverse circuit analysis tasks, Circuit-MLLM consistently outperforms strong baselines, notably achieving a 25% higher average score than GPT-5.1, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our framework in circuit schematic topology analysis. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/IC-Yuan/Circuit-MLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出Circuit-MLLM多模态推理框架，将电路原理图拓扑分析重构为潜在空间中的器件定位、路径追踪与序列推理过程，实现细粒度结构解析。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型虽在通用任务上表现优异，但电路原理图因元件布局密集、拓扑逻辑独特，需要细粒度结构解析才能提取电气语义，通用MLLM难以胜任。
AI.method: 采用两项核心机制：1）电路知识挖掘机制，将模型潜在表示与来自多粒度电路视觉专家的结构丰富特征深度对齐，使模型内化拓扑语义；2）拓扑引导排序策略，将推理与僵硬的栅格扫描顺序解耦，在潜在空间中沿电路拓扑逻辑逐步推理。
AI.result: 在多样化电路分析任务上持续优于强基线，平均得分较GPT-5.1高出25%，验证了框架在电路原理图拓扑分析上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Circuit-MLLM通过潜在空间的拓扑语义内化与拓扑引导推理，有效解决了电路原理图的细粒度结构解析难题，代码已开源。

title: Benchmarking Intra-Patient 3D Deformable Multimodal Image Registration
summary: Multimodal image registration is a key component of many clinical workflows, yet it remains challenging because corresponding anatomical structures often exhibit substantially different image intensities across modalities. In this work, we present a comprehensive benchmark of intra-patient 3D multimodal deformable registration methods across three datasets covering different anatomical regions and difficulty levels, including both synthetic deformation recovery and real clinical scenarios. We evaluate classical optimization-based approaches and modern learning-based methods, including recent deep learning and foundation models, using complementary metrics: Average Dice similarity coefficient (DSC), average 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), and a modality-independent structural similarity measure based on the MIND self-similarity context (MIND-SSC). Results show high variability across datasets, with learning-based methods demonstrating superior performance on large synthetic benchmarks, while only limited improvements are observed in real pelvic registration. A key finding of this study is the consistent disagreement between geometric metrics (DSC, HD95) and image-based similarity metrics (MIND-SSC), highlighting that improved overlap does not necessarily imply better global multimodal correspondence. Furthermore, anatomy-guided approaches achieve the highest overlap scores but exhibit degraded performance outside of segmented regions, revealing a trade-off between label-driven alignment and global structural coherence. Overall, our results indicate that no current method achieves robust performance across anatomies and modalities. We demonstrate that intra-patient 3D multimodal registration requires multi-criteria evaluation, including deformation-based metrics, and remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文对3D患者内多模态可变形配准方法进行了系统基准测试，覆盖三个解剖区域数据集，比较了经典优化方法、深度学习及基础模型。结果显示：学习方法在合成数据上占优，真实骨盆配准提升有限；几何指标（DSC、HD95）与图像相似度指标（MIND-SSC）存在系统性不一致；解剖引导方法在分割区域内重叠度高但全局结构一致性下降。结论是当前尚无方法在跨解剖、跨模态下均稳健，患者内3D多模态配准仍是开放问题，需多准则评价。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像配准是临床工作流的关键环节，但对应解剖结构在不同模态下强度差异显著，导致配准困难。现有研究缺乏跨解剖区域、跨难度、涵盖经典与学习方法的统一评测，且常用几何指标可能无法反映多模态对应的真实质量，因此需要系统性基准与多准则评估来厘清方法现状。
AI.method: 构建患者内3D多模态可变形配准的综合基准，覆盖三个数据集（不同解剖区域与难度，含合成形变恢复与真实临床场景）。评测经典优化方法与现代学习方法（含深度学习与基础模型），采用互补指标：平均Dice相似系数（DSC）、平均95% Hausdorff距离（HD95），以及基于MIND自相似上下文的模态无关结构相似度（MIND-SSC）。并分析解剖引导方法在分割区域内外表现的差异。
AI.result: 跨数据集性能差异显著：学习方法在大规模合成基准上表现更优，而在真实骨盆配准中改进有限。关键发现是几何指标（DSC、HD95）与图像相似度指标（MIND-SSC）持续不一致，说明重叠度提升不必然带来更好的全局多模态对应。解剖引导方法取得最高重叠分数，但在分割区域外性能退化，体现标签驱动对齐与全局结构连贯性之间的权衡。无任何方法能在所有解剖与模态下稳健。
AI.conclusion: 患者内3D多模态配准需要多准则评价，尤其应纳入基于形变的指标；该任务仍是未解决的开放问题。当前方法的表现高度依赖数据集与解剖区域，几何重叠与图像相似度的分歧提示单一指标评测不足，未来需发展兼顾全局结构一致性与跨模态稳健性的方法。

title: Don't Send What You Don't Need: Question-Guided Token Pruning as a Privacy Defense for Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is increasingly used in privacy-sensitive and bandwidth-constrained settings. Federated Learning (FL), Split Learning (SL), and U-Shaped Split Learning (USL) keep raw data local, but transmitting all visual tokens across a model partition remains costly and can expose private information. We propose QPriv-VL, a question-guided, privacy-aware token-pruning framework for FL, SL, and USL that prunes visual tokens before transmission based on task utility and privacy sensitivity. Its core component is a lightweight Dynamic Threshold Predictor (DTP) that jointly estimates a sample-specific pruning ratio and a token-level retention mask in one forward pass. DTP combines question relevance, computed from cross-modal similarity between visual patches and the pooled question embedding, with a sensitivity signal derived from frozen DINOv2 features. This allows the model to suppress potentially sensitive regions while preserving patches useful for answering the question, without requiring sensitivity labels. We evaluate QPriv-VL on GQA, OK-VQA, VQAv2, SLAKE, VQA-RAD, and PathVQA against four privacy attack families: FSHA, FORA, iDLG, and attribute-inference membership inference attacks. DTP matches or outperforms fixed-ratio pruning while using substantially fewer transmitted tokens. On VQA-RAD, it reduces membership-inference attack success from 0.99 to 0.76-0.79, lowers FSHA and FORA reconstruction PSNR relative to fixed-ratio pruning, and preserves competitive VQA accuracy using about 40% of the original visual-token budget. A sensitivity exclusion ratio of 1.20 +/- 0.18 indicates preferential removal of privacy-sensitive patches, while explainability analysis shows that retention adapts to question semantics rather than generic visual saliency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QPriv-VL，一种问题引导的隐私感知视觉token剪枝框架，适用于FL/SL/USL，可在传输前按任务效用与隐私敏感度剪枝视觉token，仅用约40%的token预算即保持竞争性VQA精度并显著削弱多种隐私攻击。
AI.motivation: VQA中基于VLM的应用日益出现在隐私敏感与带宽受限场景。FL、SL与USL虽可保持原始数据本地化，但跨模型分区传输全部视觉token成本高昂，且可能泄露隐私信息，因此需要一种兼顾任务效用与隐私保护的token传输机制。
AI.method: 提出QPriv-VL，其核心为轻量级动态阈值预测器（DTP），在一次前向传播中同时估计样本级剪枝比例与token级保留掩码。DTP融合两类信号：由视觉patch与池化问题嵌入的跨模态相似度得到的问题相关性，以及由冻结DINOv2特征导出的敏感度信号。由此在无需敏感度标签的情况下抑制潜在敏感区域，同时保留对回答问题有用的patch。
AI.result: 在GQA、OK-VQA、VQAv2、SLAKE、VQA-RAD与PathVQA上，针对FSHA、FORA、iDLG及属性推断成员推理攻击进行评估。DTP以显著更少的传输token匹配或超越固定比例剪枝。在VQA-RAD上，成员推理攻击成功率由0.99降至0.76-0.79，FSHA与FORA重建PSNR低于固定比例剪枝，并在约40%原始视觉token预算下保持竞争性VQA精度。敏感度排除比为1.20±0.18，表明优先移除隐私敏感patch；可解释性分析显示保留策略随问题语义而变，而非通用视觉显著性。
AI.conclusion: QPriv-VL通过问题引导的动态token剪枝，在FL/SL/USL中同时实现带宽压缩与隐私增强，且不牺牲VQA性能；其保留决策由问题语义驱动，体现任务效用与隐私敏感度的联合优化。

title: MambaMPD: A Mamba-Driven Segmentation Framework for Marine Pollution Detection from Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Accurate marine pollution detection (MPD) is essential for protecting coastal ecosystems and marine biodiversity. Vision Mamba models have shown promise in remote-sensing semantic segmentation by efficiently capturing long-range dependencies and global context, yet their potential for MPD remains underexplored. MPD is particularly challenging because of low signal-to-noise ratios, fragmented pollution patterns, and indistinct boundaries caused by the visual similarity between pollutants and the surrounding sea. To address these issues, we propose MambaMPD, an enhanced Mamba-based framework incorporating two complementary structural priors: Frequency-Aware Augmentation (FAA) and multi-scale Edge-Guided Attention (EGA). FAA integrates wavelet transforms into the encoder to decompose features into multi-scale frequency subbands, enabling the model to capture low-frequency contextual semantics and high-frequency structural details needed to identify small, low-contrast, and irregular pollution patterns. EGA adaptively fuses hierarchical, Laplacian-derived boundary cues with deep semantic representations, refining encoder features before decoding to sharpen boundaries and reduce ambiguity in visually confusing, spatially fragmented scenes. Together, these modules improve sensitivity to subtle pollution signals while preserving fine boundary structures. A U-Net-style decoder with squeeze-and-excitation attention and deep supervision progressively restores and refines semantic and spatial information across scales. Extensive experiments on two benchmark MPD datasets show that MambaMPD achieves higher mIoU than competing methods while requiring substantially less computation than foundation-model-based approaches. On MADOS, it improves F1 by 3.6% over OSDMamba; on M4D, it raises Oil Spill IoU by 6.82% over TransOilSeg.

AI.tldr: 提出MambaMPD框架，融合频率感知增强（FAA）与多尺度边缘引导注意力（EGA），在海洋污染检测任务上以更低计算量超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 海洋污染检测对保护海岸生态与海洋生物多样性至关重要，但面临低信噪比、污染模式破碎、污染物与海水视觉相似导致边界模糊等挑战；Vision Mamba在遥感语义分割中虽有效，但在该任务上的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: MambaMPD引入两种互补结构先验：FAA将小波变换集成到编码器，把特征分解为多尺度频率子带以捕捉低频上下文语义与高频结构细节；EGA自适应融合由拉普拉斯算子导出的分层边界线索与深层语义表示，在解码前细化编码器特征以锐化边界。解码端采用带压缩激励注意力和深监督的U-Net风格结构逐尺度恢复并精炼语义与空间信息。
AI.result: 在两个基准MPD数据集上，MambaMPD的mIoU高于对比方法，且计算开销显著低于基于基础模型的方案。在MADOS上F1较OSDMamba提升3.6%；在M4D上Oil Spill IoU较TransOilSeg提升6.82%。
AI.conclusion: 结合频率与边缘先验的Mamba框架能有效提升对微弱污染信号的敏感度并保持细粒度边界结构，实现精度与效率的良好平衡。

title: V-ICAL Bench: Evaluating Video In-Context Learning for Multimodal Agents in Interactive Environments
summary: While In-Context Learning (ICL) enables models to adapt from exemplars without parameter updates, multimodal ICL remains largely underexplored, particularly regarding video demonstrations in interactive environments. For multimodal agents, learning from videos presents unique challenges: they must translate in-context demonstrations into executable policies, ground these policies in novel visual states, and iteratively refine actions based on environmental feedback. We introduce V-ICAL, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate video-based ICL for multimodal agents. Comprising 342 interactive tasks across 37 environments, V-ICAL utilizes human-curated demonstration videos as task-specific behavioral exemplars, evaluating agents through sustained interaction from a target initialization. The benchmark seamlessly connects in-context knowledge induction with core agentic capabilities, including state grounding, temporal memory, planning, and adaptation in dynamic environments. Extensive evaluations across 19 state-of-the-art multimodal agents reveal significant limitations: the best-performing model, Seed-2.1-Pro, achieves a score of only 54.4/100, while other leading models (e.g., Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5.6) fail to surpass 50, far below the human baseline of 83.6. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that current agents struggle to reliably translate video exemplars into effective policies, failing to yield consistent performance gains. Ultimately, V-ICAL exposes a critical gap in the ICL capabilities of multimodal agents, underscoring an urgent need for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 V-ICAL，一个用于评估多模态智能体基于视频的上下文学习（ICL）的基准，覆盖 37 个环境、342 个交互任务，实验显示现有 19 个先进多模态智能体表现远低于人类基线，暴露出视频示范到可执行策略转化能力的显著缺口。
AI.motivation: 多模态 ICL 研究不足，尤其缺乏对交互环境中视频示范的探索。多模态智能体从视频中学习面临三重挑战：需将上下文示范转化为可执行策略、在新颖视觉状态下落地该策略、并依据环境反馈迭代修正动作。现有工作缺少能够将上下文知识归纳与智能体核心能力（状态落地、时序记忆、规划、动态适应）相衔接的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建 V-ICAL 基准：包含 342 个交互任务，涵盖 37 个环境；以人工筛选的示范视频作为任务特定的行为范例；评估方式为智能体从目标初始化状态出发进行持续交互，从而将上下文知识归纳与状态落地、时序记忆、规划及动态环境适应等核心智能体能力串联起来。并在 19 个当前最先进的多模态智能体上进行广泛评测与受控对比。
AI.result: 整体表现显著不足：最佳模型 Seed-2.1-Pro 仅得 54.4/100，其他领先模型（如 Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.6）均未超过 50 分，远低于人类基线 83.6。受控对比进一步表明，现有智能体难以可靠地将视频范例转化为有效策略，未能带来一致性的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: V-ICAL 揭示了多模态智能体在 ICL 能力上的关键缺口，尤其体现在视频示范到可执行策略的转化环节，凸显未来研究的紧迫需求。

title: RESKILL: Explicit Failure Attribution and Structured Repair for Interactive Language Agents
summary: Language agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, but post-failure repair is often handled by opaque one-shot reflection: a model generates a skill patch without explicitly maintaining how failure explanations relate to candidate repairs or how unsuccessful retests should influence later edits. We introduce RESKILL, a structured repair framework that maintains an explicit repair state across repair rounds. Given a failed rollout, the framework links failure hypotheses to candidate skill patches, selects local repairs through coverage-based attribution, retests the edited skill set in the environment, and uses retest outcomes to guide subsequent repair updates. The language model supplies structured repair factors, while the repair procedure records them, compares local skill patches by how well they address active failure explanations, and carries unsuccessful retest outcomes into later repair rounds. We evaluate RESKILL on ALFWorld and TextCraft across three model sizes under fixed repair budgets. RESKILL obtains the strongest final success in all six benchmark-model settings, improving average final success by 3.7 percentage points over direct repair and 3.3 points over hypothesis-conditioned repair. These results suggest that explicit attribution alone is insufficient; durable improvement emerges when attribution is integrated with repair selection and persistent retest-conditioned update.

AI.tldr: RESKILL 是一个结构化技能修复框架，通过维护显式修复状态，将失败假设、候选补丁、覆盖度归因与重测反馈整合到多轮修复流程中。
AI.motivation: 现有语言智能体的失败后修复多依赖不透明的一次性反思，模型直接生成技能补丁，却不显式维护失败解释与候选修复之间的对应关系，也不利用失败重测结果指导后续编辑。
AI.method: 给定失败轨迹后，RESKILL 将失败假设与候选技能补丁关联，通过基于覆盖度的归因选择局部修复，在环境中重测编辑后的技能集，并将重测结果用于后续修复更新；语言模型提供结构化修复因子，修复流程负责记录、比较与传播未成功的重测结果。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 TextCraft 上，对三种模型规模、固定修复预算进行评估，RESKILL 在全部六种基准-模型设定中取得最高最终成功率，平均最终成功率较直接修复提升 3.7 个百分点，较假设条件化修复提升 3.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠显式归因并不充分；只有当归因与修复选择及持续的、由重测条件驱动的更新相结合时，才能实现稳定持久的性能提升。

title: Can a Neural Encoding Model Replicate an fMRI Visualization Study?
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, accepted to the VISxVISION Workshop at IEEE VIS '26
summary: Most knowledge of graphical perception comes from behavioral studies. Understanding from a neural perspective is much more limited due in part to neuroimaging studies' expensiveness and difficulty to conduct. In this paper, we evaluate whether Meta's Tribe V2 neural encoding model can recover neural contrasts from a visualization fMRI study. Specifically, we evaluate Tribe V2 through a conceptual replication of the visualization-viewing component of a prior comparison of Bubble charts and three-dimensional Surface charts in color and grayscale. We generate TRIBE-predicted cortical responses for the original stimuli and compare the resulting contrasts with those reported in the human study. The model reproduced the direction of 11 of 14 reported cortical effects, with agreement concentrated in visual-processing regions. This agreement characterizes the model's alignment with the prior human-generated fMRI results rather than independently confirming them. We discuss the limitations encountered when working with this model for in-silico replication and hope to encourage future work exploring this new avenue for neuroimaging studies in visualization. Supplemental materials are available at https://osf.io/8a96x/.

AI.tldr: 本文评估Meta的Tribe V2神经编码模型能否复现一项可视化fMRI研究中Bubble图与三维Surface图的皮层对比效应，通过生成预测皮层响应并与原人类研究结果进行比较，发现模型在14个报告效应中复现了11个的方向，且一致性集中于视觉加工区域。
AI.motivation: 图形感知知识多来自行为研究，神经层面理解受限于神经影像研究成本高、实施难。本文探索能否用神经编码模型进行"in-silico"（计算机模拟）复现，以拓展可视化神经影像研究的途径。
AI.method: 对先前Bubble图与三维Surface图（彩色与灰度）比较研究的可视化观看部分进行概念性复现；用Tribe V2为原始刺激生成预测皮层响应，并将所得对比结果与人类研究报告的皮层效应进行比对。
AI.result: 模型复现了14个已报告皮层效应中11个的方向，一致性主要集中于视觉加工区域。
AI.conclusion: 这种一致性表明模型与先前人类fMRI结果的对齐，而非独立验证；作者讨论了使用该模型进行in-silico复现时的局限，并希望鼓励未来探索这一可视化神经影像研究新方向。

title: Predicting build orientation for SLM dental parts: a comparison of rotation representations and direct vector regression
summary: Build orientation for selective laser melting (SLM) manufacturing of dental parts is usually chosen manually by technicians. We treat orientation prediction as supervised machine learning of the part's up-axis from technician-labeled production data, and test which rotation representations produce the best results. Using $n\approx2400$ patient-specific dental parts, we trained a ResNet-50 multi-view image backbone and a PointNeXt-S point-cloud backbone, both pretrained and fine-tuned end-to-end, on 13 up-axis representations spanning six classical $SO(3)$ parameterizations and seven representations defined directly on the unit sphere $S^2$. We report the geodesic angular error between predicted and ground-truth up-axis on a test set, with and without test-time augmentation (TTA) over $K=21$ known rotations. With TTA, the octahedral map achieves the lowest mean angular error ($10.6^\circ$, ResNet-50). The three lowest-error results overall are direct $S^2$ representations, though this may reflect label noise in the unsupervised in-plane component of the $SO(3)$ targets rather than a topological advantage. von Mises-Fisher collapses to a near-constant prediction when trained with PointNeXt-S but not with ResNet-50. TTA reduces mean angular error by 31-73 % across almost every representation and backbone. Overall, test-time augmentation over a small set of known rotations is the most consistent driver of accuracy, whereas the best-performing representation is strongly backbone-dependent.

AI.tldr: 将牙科SLM零件建造朝向预测建模为有监督学习，系统比较13种上轴旋转表示，发现测试时增强（TTA）是最稳定的精度提升手段，而最优表示强依赖于骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 牙科SLM制造中零件建造朝向通常由技师凭经验手动选择，缺乏自动化与数据驱动的决策方法；同时旋转表示方式对学习效果的影响尚不清楚，需要系统评估哪种参数化最适合上轴预测任务。
AI.method: 使用约2400个患者定制牙科零件，将朝向预测定义为从技师标注数据中学习零件上轴的有监督任务。训练ResNet-50多视图图像骨干与PointNeXt-S点云骨干，均采用预训练并端到端微调。对比13种上轴表示：6种经典SO(3)参数化与7种直接定义在单位球面S^2上的表示。以测地角误差衡量预测与真值上轴的偏差，并评估K=21个已知旋转下的测试时增强（TTA）。
AI.result: 在TTA下，八面体映射取得最低平均角误差（10.6°，ResNet-50）。总体误差最低的三种结果为直接S^2表示，但作者指出这可能源于SO(3)目标中无监督面内分量带来的标签噪声，而非拓扑优势。von Mises-Fisher在PointNeXt-S训练下退化为近似常数预测，而ResNet-50无此现象。TTA在几乎所有表示与骨干组合下将平均角误差降低31%–73%。
AI.conclusion: 在少量已知旋转上进行测试时增强是最一致的精度驱动因素；最佳表示强依赖于骨干网络。未来工作应进一步厘清S^2表示优势是否真实，并处理SO(3)标签中面内分量的噪声问题。

title: Universal Defenses for Tool-Integrated LLM Agents Against Adversarial Attacks
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a variety of domains, particularly when integrated with external tools for multi-step task completion. However, they are increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks, including direct prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, and backdoor attacks, which exploit the model's openness to prompt injection and tool manipulation. In this work, we explore practical and generalizable defense strategies within a unified framework across these four attack types. We introduce two universal tool-based defenses: Attacker Tool Filtering, which uses anomaly detection (e.g., Isolation Forest) to identify and remove suspicious tools, and Normal Tool Recalling, a white-box method that restores the agent's original toolset prior to planning. Additionally, we incorporate prompt-based defenses: Chain-of-Thought prompting and self-reflection techniques to enhance reasoning and task paraphrasing to mitigate attacks. Experimental results across both four open-source LLMs (Gemma2-9B, Qwen2-7B, LLaMA3-8B, and LLaMA3.1-8B) and three proprietary LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and GPT-5) show that our methods significantly reduce the Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving 0% ASR in many settings, while preserving or even improving the original task success rate. These findings highlight the promise of simple, modular, multi-layered defenses for strengthening the security and robustness of tool-integrated LLM agents. The code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyan-Lisa/Defenses-for-Tool-Integrated-LLM-Agents-Against-Adversarial-Attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工具集成LLM智能体面临的四类对抗攻击，提出统一框架下的通用防御策略，显著降低攻击成功率并保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 工具集成LLM智能体虽在多步任务中表现优异，但因对提示注入和工具操纵的开放性，易受直接/间接提示注入、记忆投毒和后门攻击，亟需可泛化的防御方案。
AI.method: 提出统一防御框架，包含两类通用工具级防御：Attacker Tool Filtering（基于异常检测如Isolation Forest识别并移除可疑工具）与Normal Tool Recalling（白盒方法，在规划前恢复原始工具集）；并引入提示级防御：Chain-of-Thought提示、自我反思以增强推理，以及任务改写以缓解攻击。
AI.result: 在4个开源LLM（Gemma2-9B、Qwen2-7B、LLaMA3-8B、LLaMA3.1-8B）与3个闭源LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4、GPT-5）上，方法显著降低ASR，许多设置达0% ASR，同时保持甚至提升原始任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 简单、模块化、多层防御可有效增强工具集成LLM智能体的安全性与鲁棒性。

title: Data storytelling meets interpretable machine learning: Decoding AI decisions for non-experts without revealing sensitive data and model details
summary: AI-driven automated decision-making requires both predictive performance and interpretability. Recent advances in interpretable machine learning (IML) provide tools for explaining model predictions, but the technical complexity of these explanations may hinder accessibility to non-experts. To address this challenge, this study integrates data storytelling with IML to enhance the explainability of AI-generated decisions for a broader audience. Following the design science research (DSR) paradigm, this study proposes a formal definition of data storytelling in IML, introduces the DIST Pyramid to align data storytelling with IML, and presents the I-P-O Model to describe their interactions. It further develops an architecture to explain AI decisions through distinct "What-if" and "Why-not" event-generation processes. The architecture also employs data desensitization to protect sensitive input data. To validate the approach, a case study is conducted with the Boston Housing dataset, using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and large language models (LLMs) to generate data stories with And-But-Therefore (ABT) structures. An empirical evaluation shows that 76.4% and 74.3% of respondents rated the "What-if" and "Why-not" data stories as more comprehensible, with significantly higher accessibility scores than traditional SHAP visualizations. The paper concludes with the presentation of a narrative interpretation framework that integrates IML and data storytelling, thereby expanding the research scope as well as the practical applicability of AI decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文将数据叙事（Data Storytelling）与可解释机器学习（IML）相结合，提出DIST Pyramid、I-P-O模型及解释架构，通过"What-if"与"Why-not"事件生成和ABT叙事结构提升AI决策对非专家的可理解性，并以Boston Housing数据集实证验证。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的自动化决策需要兼顾预测性能与可解释性。现有IML工具虽能解释模型预测，但其技术复杂性阻碍了非专家用户的理解与使用，因此需要降低解释门槛、提升面向更广泛受众的可解释性。
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究（DSR）范式，给出IML中数据叙事的正式定义，提出DIST Pyramid以对齐数据叙事与IML，构建I-P-O模型描述二者交互，并设计支持"What-if"与"Why-not"事件生成、含数据脱敏保护的架构；以Boston Housing数据集为案例，采用SHAP值与LLM生成ABT结构的数据故事进行实证评价。
AI.result: 实证评估显示，76.4%的受访者认为"What-if"数据故事更易理解，74.3%认为"Why-not"数据故事更易理解；两类数据故事的可及性得分显著高于传统SHAP可视化。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出融合IML与数据叙事的叙事化解释框架，拓展了AI决策的研究范围与实用适用性，为非专家理解AI决策提供了可行路径。

title: Bench2Dex: Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across Dexterous Hands
summary: Tactile sensing provides contact information that can be difficult to infer from vision alone, but tactile hardware for dexterous hands has not converged to a common design. Dexterous hands differ in finger structure, contact surfaces, and sensor layouts, while simulated tactile signals still differ from measurements produced by physical sensors. These factors make it difficult to study visuo-tactile manipulation across diverse dexterous hands within a consistent experimental setting. We present Bench2Dex, a simulation benchmark for visuo-tactile bimanual manipulation across 12 dexterous hands. We adapt existing robot models with a shared simulated tactile interface that converts local contact geometry into image-like tactile observations. The interface provides a consistent observation format across different hand morphologies without attempting to reproduce the output of a specific physical tactile sensor. Bench2Dex includes 26 bimanual manipulation tasks that involve tool use, articulated-object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, together with about 1.3K human-teleoperated demonstrations. The benchmark provides synchronized visual, tactile, proprioceptive, action, and object-state observations, together with executable task metrics. For robustness, we group seven perturbation types into invariance axis, where the correct action does not change, and equivariance axis, where the correct action changes together with the perturbation. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, pi0.5, and GR00T N1.5 on Bench2Dex and report their performance and failure modes. Bench2Dex is meant as a platform for studying visuo-tactile learning across dexterous hands. It does not assume that simulated tactile observations can replace real tactile sensing; it offers a shared setting for algorithm development while tactile hardware and simulation models are still evolving.

AI.tldr: Bench2Dex是一个面向12种灵巧手的仿真基准，通过统一仿真触觉接口支持视触觉双臂操作研究，含26个任务与约1.3K人类遥操作演示。
AI.motivation: 灵巧手的触觉硬件设计尚未收敛，各手的指结构、接触面与传感器布局差异大；仿真触觉信号与物理传感器测量存在差异，导致难以在一致实验条件下跨多种灵巧手研究视触觉操作。
AI.method: 构建仿真基准Bench2Dex：改造现有机器人模型，加入共享仿真触觉接口，将局部接触几何转换为类图像触觉观测，从而在不同手部形态下提供一致的观测格式（不追求复现特定物理触觉传感器）。
AI.result: 包含26个双臂操作任务（工具使用、铰接物体交互、多阶段操作）与约1.3K人类遥操作演示；提供同步的视觉、触觉、本体感知、动作与物体状态观测及可执行任务指标。将七类扰动划分为不变性轴（正确动作不变）与等变性轴（正确动作随扰动改变）。在Bench2Dex上评估ACT、Diffusion Policy、pi0.5与GR00T N1.5，报告其性能与失败模式。
AI.conclusion: Bench2Dex为跨灵巧手的视触觉学习提供统一研究平台；它不假定仿真触觉观测可替代真实触觉感知，而是在触觉硬件与仿真模型仍演进时，为算法开发提供共享实验环境。

title: Transforming harmonic coefficients for 3D splat compression
summary: We address the problem of color attribute compression for 3D splats. We show that all images generated by 3D splats are linear in the coefficients for each color channel, each spherical harmonic, and each splat, and we identify a basis for the space of all such images. We identify an inner product for the coefficient space that induces the squared error loss on images. We show that orthonormalizing the coefficients with respect to this innner product before coding can yield over 2 dB gain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究3D splats的颜色属性压缩，证明3D splats生成的所有图像对每个颜色通道、每个球谐函数、每个splat的系数是线性的，为这类图像空间找出了一组基，并定义了能在图像上诱导平方误差损失的系数空间内积，证明编码前按该内积正交归一化系数可获得超过2 dB的增益。
AI.motivation: 3D splats渲染需要对大量splat的颜色属性（颜色通道与球谐系数）进行压缩，但现有压缩方法未充分利用这类图像在系数上的线性结构。作者希望从理论上揭示该线性结构并据此设计更高效的编码方案。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明3D splats生成的所有图像对每个颜色通道、每个球谐函数、每个splat的系数具有线性关系，并给出该图像空间的一组基；定义系数空间上的内积使其诱导图像域的平方误差损失；在该内积下对系数进行正交归一化，再进行编码。
AI.result: 在编码前按所定义内积对系数做正交归一化，可获得超过2 dB的增益。
AI.conclusion: 3D splats图像在系数上具有可显式刻画的线性结构，通过匹配图像平方误差的内积对系数正交归一化，可显著提升颜色属性压缩效率（>2 dB）。

title: Distributional sentiment modeling and anomaly detection for consumer complaint assessment
summary: Sentiment analysis is a common tool for converting unstructured text into quantitative signals in finance and risk management. Yet most applications reduce the output to a discrete polarity label or a single predictive feature, overlooking the distributional structure of sentiment intensity in consumer complaint narratives. In this paper we treat negative sentiment in consumer complaints as a bounded continuous variable and study its full distribution rather than a single label. We score each narrative with a transformer classifier, model the scores with Beta distributions, and compare the fitted distributions of meritorious and non-meritorious complaints through the Kullback Leibler divergence and the squared Hellinger distance. The fitted distributions are then linked with dollar amounts and company response outcomes to construct anomaly diagnostics that flag complaints whose textual severity is inconsistent with the recorded relief. We find that the two groups have strongly overlapping distributions, so negative sentiment intensity is not a sharp classifier of outcomes on its own; combined with monetary and categorical attributes, it isolates unusually severe complaints for operational risk monitoring. Treating sentiment analysis as continuous distributional measurement, this study links sentiment extraction, bounded response modeling, and anomaly detection in a unified framework for consumer complaint assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文把消费者投诉文本中的负面情绪视为有界连续变量，用Transformer分类器打分、Beta分布建模，并通过KL散度与Hellinger距离比较"有理投诉"与"无理投诉"的分布，进而结合金额与公司响应结果构建异常诊断，识别文本严重程度与实际救济不匹配的投诉。
AI.motivation: 金融与风险管理中的情感分析多将输出简化为离散极性标签或单一预测特征，忽略了消费者投诉叙事中情感强度的分布结构。作者希望突破单一标签的局限，将情感分析重新定位为连续分布测量，以捕捉情绪强度的完整分布形态。
AI.method: 将投诉中的负面情绪视为有界连续变量；用Transformer分类器为每条叙事打分；以Beta分布拟合分数；使用KL散度与平方Hellinger距离比较"有理投诉"与"无理投诉"的拟合分布；再将拟合分布与金额、公司响应结果关联，构建异常诊断指标，标记文本严重度与已记录救济不一致的投诉。
AI.result: 两类投诉的分布高度重叠，说明负面情绪强度本身并不能作为结果的清晰判别器；但当其与货币金额和类别属性结合后，可有效识别出异常严重的投诉，用于运营风险监测。
AI.conclusion: 将情感分析视为连续分布测量，本文把情感抽取、有界响应建模与异常检测统一在一个消费者投诉评估框架中，为运营风险监测提供了新的诊断思路。

title: Merging the Knowledge of LLMs for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, trained on paired speech-text data, have been improved by leveraging language models (LMs) trained on text-only data. LM fusion methods such as shallow fusion and density ratio are well-established methods that incorporate external LMs during ASR decoding. However, they incur additional computational costs due to LM inference, which is particularly problematic for recent larger LMs. In this study, we propose incorporating external LMs via model merging. This method integrates the LMs directly into the parameters of an LLM-based ASR model, requiring no additional computational cost at inference. We formulate domain extension and transfer via arithmetic operations on LoRA parameters. Experimental evaluations were conducted for the domain adaptation of LLM-based ASR trained on CSJ and LibriSpeech. We show that our LM merging consistently improved the ASR performance in the target domains, without degrading inference speed or memory footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过模型合并（model merging）将外部语言模型集成到基于LLM的ASR模型参数中，避免推理时的额外计算开销，并在领域适应任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LM融合方法（如shallow fusion、density ratio）在ASR解码时需引入外部LM推理，带来额外计算成本，对近期更大的LM尤为不利。因此需要一种无需增加推理开销即可利用外部LM知识的方法。
AI.method: 提出通过模型合并将外部LM直接集成进基于LLM的ASR模型参数中，无需额外推理成本；并将领域扩展与迁移形式化为对LoRA参数的算术运算。
AI.result: 在CSJ和LibriSpeech上训练的LLM-based ASR模型进行领域适应实验，LM合并方法在目标领域一致地提升了ASR性能，且未降低推理速度或增加内存占用。
AI.conclusion: 通过模型合并集成外部LM是一种有效且高效的替代方案，可在不增加推理开销的前提下提升ASR在目标领域的性能。

title: Look Before You Leap: Factual Decoding with Internal Attribution Signals
summary: Hallucination remains a critical challenge in large language models (LLMs), where early factual errors compound through autoregressive generation in a snowballing effect that neither post-hoc correction nor weight-level intervention can effectively preempt. We propose DescaPE (DEcoding Signal Control Against Path Error-snowballing), a decoding framework that leverages internal model signals to suppress hallucination-prone trajectories at inference time. Through sliding-window MLP ablation, we identify a factual-salient layer span within LLMs whose derived signal is selectively elevated for factual tokens and exhibits anomalous spikes at hallucination-prone steps. We train a lightweight probe to approximate this signal from a single forward pass and integrate it into candidate scoring to penalize high-risk continuations while rewarding factually grounded ones. Experiments across five factuality benchmarks on three LLMs demonstrate that DescaPE achieves factuality improvements over decoding-time baselines in multiple settings, while incurring only 1.10x latency overhead in our efficiency evaluation. Our code is available at https://github.com/hayeonggg/DESCAPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DescaPE解码框架，利用LLM内部信号在推理阶段抑制幻觉，实验证明在多个事实性基准上优于解码时基线且延迟开销仅1.10倍。
AI.motivation: LLM幻觉问题严重，早期事实错误会通过自回归生成产生"滚雪球效应"不断累积，而事后纠正和权重层面干预都无法有效预防这种错误传播。
AI.method: 通过滑动窗口MLP消融实验，识别出LLM中一个事实显著的层区间，其信号对事实性token选择性升高、在易幻觉步骤出现异常尖峰；训练轻量探针从单次前向传播中近似该信号，并将其整合到候选评分中，惩罚高风险续写、奖励有事实依据的续写。
AI.result: 在三个LLM、五个事实性基准上的实验表明，DescaPE在多种设置下相较解码时基线提升了事实性，效率评估中仅带来1.10倍延迟开销。
AI.conclusion: DescaPE是一种有效的解码时幻觉抑制框架，通过内部信号控制实现事实性提升，兼顾效率，代码已开源。

title: TopoRig: Topology-Agnostic Facial Rigging via Multi-Source Supervision
summary: Automatic facial rigging across heterogeneous mesh topologies remains challenging because high-quality expression supervision is often tied to canonical templates, while deformation transfer to arbitrary meshes can introduce geometric artifacts and correspondence errors. We present TopoRig, a topology-agnostic facial rigging framework that predicts FACS-conditioned deformations directly on input mesh vertices while preserving the original topology. Starting from the ICT FaceKit expression model, we construct complementary supervision from accurate but template-biased common-topology rigs, topology-diverse but noisier transferred rigs, and targeted image-based cues for controls poorly captured by geometric transfer. TopoRig combines local surface geometry, landmark-relative semantic features, global shape context, and FACS controls to predict per-vertex displacements. We train on 3,496 generated identities using 45 non-gaze expression controls from the 53-control ICT FaceKit vocabulary. On held-out identities and unseen mesh topologies, TopoRig more faithfully reproduces the reference expression space than prior neural facial-rigging methods, while qualitative results show consistent localized deformations across diverse character geometries. Ablations demonstrate that semantic landmark features and complementary supervision improve cross-identity and cross-topology generalization. Overall, TopoRig amortizes heterogeneous and imperfect expression supervision into a single topology-preserving deformation model.

AI.tldr: TopoRig：一种拓扑无关的面部绑定框架，直接在输入网格顶点上预测FACS条件形变并保持原拓扑，通过互补监督实现跨身份、跨拓扑的高保真表情重建。
AI.motivation: 自动面部绑定在异构网格拓扑上面临困难：高质量表情监督通常依赖规范模板，而形变迁移到任意网格会引入几何伪影与对应关系误差。因此需要一种不依赖特定拓扑、又能保留原网格结构的绑定方案。
AI.method: 以ICT FaceKit表情模型为起点构建三类互补监督：高精度但偏模板的公共拓扑绑定、拓扑多样但噪声较大的迁移绑定、以及针对几何迁移效果差的控件的图像线索。TopoRig融合局部表面几何、相对关键点的语义特征、全局形状上下文与FACS控制，逐顶点预测位移；使用3,496个生成身份与53个ICT FaceKit控件中的45个非注视表情控件训练。
AI.result: 在留出身份与未见网格拓扑上，TopoRig比既有神经面部绑定方法更忠实地复现参考表情空间；定性结果显示在多样角色几何上有一致且局部的形变。消融实验表明语义关键点特征与互补监督提升了跨身份与跨拓扑泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TopoRig将异构且不完美的表情监督摊销为单一保持拓扑的形变模型，验证了拓扑无关面部绑定的可行性。

title: Sequential Adapter Stacking for Cross-Lingual Low-Resource ASR
summary: Extending large-scale multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) models to low-resource languages remains challenging. Model performance is skewed toward high-resource languages and degrades sharply for languages with limited labeled data and pre-training exposure. To address this, we investigate parameter-efficient approaches for transferring knowledge from resource-rich source languages to low-resource target languages on Whisper. Alongside warm initialization and attention-based fusion, we propose Sequential Adapter Stacking, which places a trainable target-language adapter on top of a frozen source-language adapter. Under controlled experiments, these approaches are evaluated on three target languages unsupported by Whisper -- Asturian, Assamese, and Xhosa -- using source languages with varying degrees of relatedness. Sequential Adapter Stacking with the closest related source consistently and significantly outperforms full fine-tuning across the three targets, with 5--8\% relative WER reductions. These gains largely persist with only one hour of target training data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何通过参数高效方法，将Whisper多语言ASR的知识从资源丰富源语言迁移到低资源目标语言，并提出Sequential Adapter Stacking方法，在三个Whisper不支持的语言上取得一致且显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 大规模多语言ASR模型在低资源语言上表现不佳：性能偏向高资源语言，且对标注数据有限、预训练覆盖不足的语言性能急剧下降。因此需要研究参数高效的知识迁移方法，将资源丰富源语言的知识转移到低资源目标语言。
AI.method: 在Whisper模型上研究参数高效的跨语言知识迁移方法，包括warm initialization、attention-based fusion，以及提出的Sequential Adapter Stacking：在冻结的源语言adapter之上叠加可训练的目标语言adapter。在受控实验中，使用不同相关程度的源语言，在三个Whisper不支持的目标语言（Asturian、Assamese、Xhosa）上进行评估。
AI.result: Sequential Adapter Stacking搭配最相关源语言时，在三个目标语言上均一致且显著优于全量微调，相对WER降低5–8%。在仅有1小时目标语言训练数据的情况下，这些增益基本保持。
AI.conclusion: Sequential Adapter Stacking是一种有效的参数高效跨语言迁移方法，能够在低资源场景下稳定优于全量微调，并在极少目标数据条件下保持增益，为扩展多语言ASR到低资源语言提供了可行路径。

title: Enabling Streaming User Transcription in Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Models
summary: Full-duplex speech-to-speech (S2S) models enable natural conversational AI by allowing simultaneous listening and speaking. However, these models typically lack inherent user speech transcription, which is essential for applications such as conversation logging, accessibility features, and quality monitoring. In this work, we propose an efficient method to add streaming ASR capabilities to an existing duplex S2S model by introducing a lightweight ASR head in parallel to the agent text head. Our approach requires minimal additional parameters and no significant architectural changes to the base S2S model, enabling real-time user transcription while preserving full-duplex conversational capabilities including turn-taking and barge-in handling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves streaming average WER of 10.21% on the HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard within the duplex S2S framework. Additionally, we show that the same architecture trained as a standalone streaming ASR model achieves competitive results (7.73% WER) compared to current SOTA models. We will open-source our training and inference code to facilitate further research in joint streaming ASR and S2S modeling.

AI.tldr: 在现有全双工S2S模型上并行增加轻量级ASR头，以极小参数代价实现流式用户语音转写，同时保持全双工对话能力。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音到语音（S2S）模型支持边听边说，但缺乏对用户语音的转写能力，而转写在对话记录、无障碍功能和质量监控等场景中十分必要。
AI.method: 在原有agent text head之外并行引入一个轻量级ASR head，对基础S2S模型几乎不做架构改动、仅增加极少参数，从而为其赋予流式ASR能力。
AI.result: 在全双工S2S框架下取得HuggingFace Open ASR Leaderboard流式平均WER 10.21%；同一架构作为独立流式ASR模型训练时达到7.73% WER，与当前SOTA模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能以低开销为现有全双工S2S模型添加流式转写，并保留轮流发言与打断处理等全双工对话能力；训练与推理代码将开源以促进联合流式ASR与S2S建模研究。

title: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
summary: Data agents aim to fulfill natural-language instructions over heterogeneous data, including tables, files, and databases. However, data agents face a challenging agent-data gap: heterogeneous data resides outside the agent, while the agent can access it (e.g., column names and file paths) only through generic tools. Existing approaches either let agents directly explore raw data sources or inject manually constructed semantic layers into prompts. However, neither scales well to large heterogeneous data sources nor adapts to different agent behaviors. In this paper, we introduce EvoOntology, a self-evolving ontology layer for data agents. EvoOntology encapsulates the ontology as an MCP server comprising a schema layer, a content layer, and a tool layer, enabling agents to actively query and interact with the ontology at runtime. To this end, we introduce a builder agent for autonomous ontology construction and a self-evolution loop that continuously refines the ontology through attribution-guided typed edits that are accepted only after a backbone-conditional paired evaluation. Experiments on three well-adopted data-agent benchmarks with four LLM backbones demonstrate that EvoOntology consistently outperforms strong baselines and existing semantic-layer approaches, effectively bridging the agent-data gap and enabling more effective interaction with heterogeneous data. Code: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/EvoOntology

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoOntology——一个自演化的本体层，以 MCP server 形式封装模式层、内容层与工具层，让数据智能体在运行时主动查询本体，并通过构建智能体与自演化循环持续精炼本体，从而弥合智能体-数据鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 数据智能体的任务是在异构数据（表格、文件、数据库）上执行自然语言指令，但存在"智能体-数据鸿沟"：异构数据位于智能体外部，智能体仅能通过通用工具访问列名、文件路径等有限信息。现有做法要么让智能体直接探索原始数据源，要么在提示中注入人工构建的语义层，二者均难以扩展到大规模异构数据源，也无法适配不同的智能体行为。
AI.method: EvoOntology 将本体封装为 MCP server，包含三层结构：模式层（schema layer）、内容层（content layer）和工具层（tool layer），使智能体可在运行时主动查询和交互本体。同时引入一个构建智能体（builder agent）实现本体的自主构建，并设计自演化循环（self-evolution loop），通过归因引导的类型化编辑（attribution-guided typed edits）持续精炼本体，编辑仅在通过骨干条件配对评估（backbone-conditional paired evaluation）后才被接受。
AI.result: 在三个广泛采用的数据智能体基准上、使用四种 LLM 骨干进行实验，EvoOntology 一致优于强基线以及现有语义层方法，有效弥合了智能体-数据鸿沟，实现了对异构数据更有效的交互。
AI.conclusion: EvoOntology 通过自演化本体层为数据智能体提供了可扩展、可自适配的语义抽象，证明了以 MCP 服务形式暴露本体并配合归因引导的自演化机制，能显著提升智能体在异构数据源上的指令执行效果。代码已开源。

title: SURE-Map: Self-Correcting Streaming Geometric Foundation Models
comment: Corrected a typo in the title; manuscript content unchanged
summary: Streaming geometric foundation models are emerging as a compelling alternative to SLAM systems. Yet this streaming nature introduces a fundamental issue: each prediction is made from limited context, which is vulnerable to dynamic objects and weak textures. Small local errors accumulate into severe geometric distortion and long-horizon scale drift. We argue that reliable streaming reconstruction requires geometric foundation models to be not only predictive, but also self-correcting. We introduce SURE-Map, a self-correcting framework built upon two complementary principles. First, we explicitly model cross-view geometric uncertainty. Unlike conventional depth or point confidence, which primarily reflects the reliability of individual-view prediction, our uncertainty directly measures whether the jointly predicted pose and depth induce geometrically consistent cross-view pixel correspondences. Second, because local correction alone cannot eliminate slowly accumulating scale errors, we introduce multi-timescale self-correction: fast consecutive-frame inference preserves streaming efficiency, while sparse keyframe-window inference provides longer-range geometric evidence to periodically recalibrate the scale of recent trajectories. SURE-Map establishes new state-of-the-art performance for online feed-forward reconstruction across long-horizon benchmarks, reducing ATE-RMSE from 24.00 to 17.24 m on KITTI, 5.11 to 4.74 m on Oxford Spires, and 31.37 to 28.58 m on VBR, with further improvements to 15.17, 4.63, and 22.12 m when incorporating loop-closure refinement. Project page: https://mingkai-liu.github.io/projects/sure-map/.

AI.tldr: 提出自校正框架 SURE-Map，通过跨视图几何不确定性与多时间尺度自校正，缓解流式几何基础模型的长程几何畸变与尺度漂移。
AI.motivation: 流式几何基础模型作为 SLAM 的替代方案正受到关注，但其逐帧预测仅依赖有限上下文，易受动态物体和弱纹理影响；局部小误差会累积为严重几何畸变与长程尺度漂移。因此作者主张可靠的流式重建不仅需要"可预测"，还需具备"自校正"能力。
AI.method: SURE-Map 基于两条互补原则：(1) 显式建模跨视图几何不确定性——不同于只反映单视图预测可靠性的深度/点置信度，该不确定性直接度量联合预测的位姿与深度是否产生几何一致的跨视图像素对应；(2) 多时间尺度自校正——快速的连续帧推理保持流式效率，稀疏的关键帧窗口推理提供更长程的几何证据，以周期性重新校准近期轨迹的尺度，弥补局部校正无法消除的缓慢累积尺度误差。
AI.result: 在长程基准上刷新了在线前馈重建的 SOTA：KITTI 上 ATE-RMSE 从 24.00 m 降至 17.24 m，Oxford Spires 从 5.11 m 降至 4.74 m，VBR 从 31.37 m 降至 28.58 m；引入回环闭合优化后进一步降至 15.17 m、4.63 m 和 22.12 m。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将跨视图几何一致性的不确定性建模与多时间尺度自校正相结合，可有效抑制流式几何基础模型的误差累积与尺度漂移，显著提升长程在线前馈重建精度，并可与回环闭合优化协同增益。

title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
summary: Diffusion Transformers deliver state-of-the-art video generation, but their long spatiotemporal sequences make attention the dominant deployment cost, and a deployable low-bit kernel must be accurate and fast. Accuracy is limited by outliers: a block's quantization scale is set by its largest entries, leaving typical entries confined to a narrow range of representable values. Prior work smooths queries and keys, but value outliers follow no fixed channel or spatiotemporal structure and remain the dominant source of output error. Speed is limited by softmax: low-bit Tensor Cores accelerate only the two matrix multiplications, so the high-precision exponential between them becomes the longest pipeline stage on datacenter GPUs. We propose VC-Attention, a training-free low-bit attention framework that addresses both by pairing Value smoothing with a fused probability Cast. V-Smooth reorders value tokens by lightweight online clustering, so the tokens in a hardware block quantize well together. It quantizes only the residual after subtracting the block mean, and restores that mean from the row sum the online softmax already maintains. ExpCast-FP8 maps log-domain scores directly to E4M3 probability codes with one fused multiply-add, eliminating the FP32 exponential and the format conversion. We implement VC-Attention for B200, B300, H200, RTX PRO 6000, and RTX 5090. Across Wan2.2, LongCat-Video, HunyuanVideo-1.5, and MiniMax-H3, VC-Attention improves fidelity over low-bit baselines, speeds up the attention kernel over BF16 FlashAttention-4 by 1.46-1.59x on datacenter Blackwell and Hopper and by 2.3-3.6x on workstation cards, and generates a clip 1.13-1.19x and 1.36-1.70x faster end to end.

AI.tldr: VC-Attention 是一个免训练的低比特注意力框架，通过 V-Smooth（基于在线聚类的 value 平滑）和 ExpCast-FP8（融合的概率转换）同时解决 value 离群点带来的精度损失与 softmax 指数运算导致的速度瓶颈，在数据中心与工作站 GPU 上实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 的视频生成性能领先，但长时空序列使注意力成为部署的主要开销，需要一个既准确又快速的可部署低比特内核。精度方面，离群点限制了量化效果：块的量化尺度由最大元素决定，导致典型元素被压缩在狭窄的可表示范围内；已有工作平滑了 query 和 key，但 value 离群点不遵循固定的通道或时空结构，仍是输出误差的主要来源。速度方面，softmax 成为瓶颈：低比特 Tensor Core 只加速两个矩阵乘法，二者之间的高精度指数运算成为数据中心 GPU 上最长的流水线阶段。
AI.method: 提出 VC-Attention，配对 Value 平滑与融合的概率转换（Cast）。V-Smooth 通过轻量在线聚类对 value token 重排序，使同一硬件块内的 token 能良好地共同量化；仅量化减去块均值后的残差，并利用在线 softmax 已维护的行和恢复该均值。ExpCast-FP8 用一次融合乘加将对数域分数直接映射为 E4M3 概率编码，从而消除 FP32 指数运算与格式转换。该框架在 B200、B300、H200、RTX PRO 6000 与 RTX 5090 上实现。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.2、LongCat-Video、HunyuanVideo-1.5 与 MiniMax-H3 上，VC-Attention 相比低比特基线提升了保真度；注意力内核相比 BF16 FlashAttention-4 在数据中心级 Blackwell 与 Hopper 上加速 1.46–1.59 倍，在工作站显卡上加速 2.3–3.6 倍；端到端生成一段视频分别快 1.13–1.19 倍与 1.36–1.70 倍。
AI.conclusion: VC-Attention 以免训练方式同时缓解了 value 离群点导致的精度问题与 softmax 指数运算导致的速度瓶颈，在多种主流视频生成模型与多款 GPU 上实现了保真度提升与一致的注意力内核及端到端加速。

title: CiteGuard-RAG: A Validation-Centered AI System for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering
comment: Submitted to Engineering Reports. 22 pages, 2 figures, 12 tables
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can improve access to complex information; however, retrieving evidence alone does not ensure that answers are grounded, citation-valid, or appropriately refused. This paper introduces CiteGuard-RAG, a validation-centered AI system for evidence-grounded question answering. The system integrates hybrid semantic-lexical retrieval, citation-constrained generation, sentence-level grounding validation, and single-pass regeneration. Validation is used at runtime to determine whether a candidate answer should be accepted, refused, or regenerated before final delivery. CiteGuard-RAG is evaluated on 400 questions across a controlled housing-law dataset, PrivacyQA, and CUAD. In the controlled evaluation, it achieves 99.1% retrieval accuracy, 98.3% grounded-answer accuracy, and 98.3% citation validity, with no validation-detected hallucinations. Ablation results show that grounded-answer accuracy drops sharply when validation is removed, even when retrieval accuracy remains unchanged. External evaluation shows that while citation validity remains strong, evidence utilization, span alignment, and refusal calibration become harder under domain shift. These findings indicate that trustworthy RAG systems require explicit validation between retrieval and final answer delivery. CiteGuard-RAG provides a practical architecture for linking retrieval, generation, citation checking, abstention, and regeneration in high-stakes information access.

AI.tldr: 提出以验证为中心的RAG系统CiteGuard-RAG，在受控与外部数据集上验证"检索-验证-生成"闭环对答案落地性与引用有效性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 仅靠检索证据无法保证答案有根据、引用有效或能恰当拒答，因此需要在检索与最终交付之间引入显式验证机制。
AI.method: 系统集成混合语义-词汇检索、引用约束生成、句子级落地验证与单轮再生成；运行时验证决定答案被接受、拒答还是重新生成。
AI.result: 在400题评估中，受控住房法数据集达99.1%检索准确率、98.3%落地答案准确率与98.3%引用有效性，无验证检测出的幻觉；消融显示移除验证后落地准确率骤降而检索准确率不变；外部评估中引用有效性仍强，但证据利用、跨度对齐与拒答校准在领域迁移下变难。
AI.conclusion: 可信RAG系统必须在检索与最终答案交付之间设置显式验证，CiteGuard-RAG为高风险信息获取中的检索、生成、引用核查、弃答与再生成提供了可落地架构。

title: Integrating Multi-view Multi-light Surface Reconstruction into Cultural Heritage Workflows
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at VISART VIII, ECCV 2026 workshops
summary: Cultural heritage documentation increasingly relies on image-based 3D surface reconstruction, with photogrammetry software making such workflows accessible to archaeologists, conservators, and heritage technicians. These tools have been successful for conventional multi-view acquisition, but they do not routinely exploit richer multi-view, multi-light data, despite its potential for improving fine-scale surface reconstruction. This limitation is particularly relevant in heritage contexts, where controlled-light acquisition devices such as RTI domes are already used to capture illumination-varying image sets. The challenge is therefore to connect these existing acquisition practices with recent computer vision methods in a form that can be used within operational heritage workflows. In this work, we address this need by integrating state-of-the-art components from computer vision for multi-view, multi-light surface reconstruction into Meshroom, an open-source photogrammetry framework. Rather than proposing a new reconstruction algorithm, our contribution is to assemble and expose existing advanced methods, namely a complete photometric stereo ecosystem (calibrated, self-calibrated and universal), automatic object masking, and multi-view normal-and-reflectance integration, within a usable heritage-oriented workflow. The proposed system thus provides an intermediate software layer between computer vision research code and practical cultural heritage applications, making recent techniques easier to use and evaluate.

AI.tldr: 该工作将多视角多光照表面重建的先进计算机视觉方法（完整光度立体生态、自动物体掩膜、多视角法线与反射率融合）集成进开源摄影测量框架Meshroom，形成面向文化遗产的可用工作流，充当研究代码与实际遗产应用之间的中间软件层。
AI.motivation: 文化遗产数字化日益依赖基于图像的三维重建，摄影测量软件已让相关流程普及；但这些工具对常规多视角采集有效，却未常规利用更丰富的多视角、多光照数据，限制了精细尺度表面重建。而遗产场景中本已使用RTI穹顶等可控光照设备采集光照变化图像集，因此需要把既有采集实践与近期计算机视觉方法衔接起来并可用。
AI.method: 不提出新的重建算法，而是组装并暴露现有先进方法：完整的光度立体生态（标定、自标定、通用型）、自动物体掩膜、以及多视角法线与反射率融合，并将它们集成进开源摄影测量框架Meshroom中。
AI.result: 构建出一个面向遗产的可操作工作流系统，把计算机视觉研究代码与文化遗产实际应用连接起来，使近期技术更易使用与评估。
AI.conclusion: 该集成系统提供了介于研究代码与实际遗产应用之间的中间软件层，使多视角多光照方法更易于在文化遗产操作流程中被使用和评估。

title: TRACE: Two-Stage Detector-Response Estimation With Angular Cosine Expansion for Ring Artifact Correction in Photon-Counting CT
summary: Detector response nonuniformity introduces systematic projection errors and ring artifacts in photon-counting detector computed tomography (PCD-CT). In measured PCD-CT data, residual stripe amplitudes vary slowly with projection angle, which fixed-bias models cannot adequately capture. We propose TRACE, a two-stage unsupervised sinogram decomposition method for estimating and correcting these response-related errors. TRACE represents stripes as a fixed bias plus low-order discrete cosine transform (DCT) components, using a small number of coefficients to describe angular variations at each detector element. A learnable analysis--synthesis architecture represents the ideal projections, while two-stage optimization separates them from fixed and then dynamic stripes. An angular-gradient soft orthogonality constraint suppresses correlated variations within the shared DCT gradient subspace, reducing the leakage of object structures into the artifact estimate.
