All parameters are optimized directly on the measured sinogram without paired training data. Experiments on measured QRM mouse phantom and porcine trotter data show that TRACE suppresses ring artifacts and improves image uniformity while preserving edge sharpness, soft-tissue texture, and trabecular detail.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE，一种两阶段无监督正弦图分解方法，用于估计并校正光子计数探测器CT中由响应非均匀性引起的条纹误差与环状伪影。
AI.motivation: PCD-CT中探测器响应非均匀性会导致系统性投影误差和环状伪影；实测数据中残余条纹幅度随投影角度缓慢变化，固定偏置模型无法充分刻画这一动态特性。
AI.method: TRACE将条纹建模为固定偏置加低阶离散余弦变换（DCT）分量，用少量系数描述每个探测器单元的角向变化；以可学习的分析-合成架构表示理想投影，通过两阶段优化依次分离固定条纹与动态条纹；引入角向梯度软正交约束，抑制共享DCT梯度子空间内的相关变化，减少物体结构泄漏到伪影估计中。所有参数直接在实测正弦图上优化，无需配对训练数据。
AI.result: 在实测QRM小鼠体模和猪蹄数据上，TRACE抑制了环状伪影并提升图像均匀性，同时保留边缘锐度、软组织纹理和骨小梁细节。
AI.conclusion: TRACE通过无监督的两阶段正弦图分解与角向梯度软正交约束，有效校正PCD-CT中随角度缓变的响应相关条纹误差，在实测数据上兼顾伪影抑制与结构细节保留。

title: Proportional-Fair Resource Allocation and Dual-Threshold Early-Exit Inference for Secure Cooperative Multi-Layer Edge Intelligence
summary: This paper proposes FREDI (Fair Resource Allocation for Edge Dual-Threshold Inference), a secure wireless edge-intelligence framework for event-triggered inference in a cooperative user equipment (UE)--edge server (ES)--cloud system. Each UE performs early-exit convolutional neural network (CNN) screening using dual confidence thresholds, while critical events are securely offloaded to an edge server for detailed classification. We formulate a proportionally-fair utility maximization problem that jointly optimizes UE--ES association, wireless and processing resources, and confidence thresholds. FREDI decomposes the problem into proportional-fair resource allocation and dual-threshold inference optimization. We prove that the detected-critical event set is set-monotone non-increasing in both thresholds, and exploit the finite empirical confidence domain for exact threshold optimization. An empirical resource--utility response envelope yields a computable global suboptimality bound and a sufficient condition for global optimality. By pre-eliminating infeasible UE--ES pairs and exactly projecting out bandwidth and transmit-power variables, the resource-allocation subproblem is reduced to a mixed-integer exponential-cone program solvable to the certified global optimality within a prescribed gap. Numerical results with early-exit MobileNetV2 and ShuffleNetV2 demonstrate near-perfect UE fairness with aggregate utility close to a Sum-Utility benchmark, reveal security-induced resource fragmentation, and demonstrate the Stage-A scalability from 6 to 144 UEs with median solving time below 0.1~s in the tested configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FREDI，一个面向协作 UE–ES–云系统中事件触发推理的安全无线边缘智能框架，通过联合优化 UE–ES 关联、无线与计算资源及双置信阈值实现比例公平效用最大化。
AI.motivation: 协作 UE–边缘–云系统中，UE 侧的早期退出 CNN 筛查与关键事件安全卸载需兼顾公平性、安全性与资源效率，现有方法缺乏对关联、资源分配与置信阈值的联合优化及全局最优性保证。
AI.method: UE 使用双置信阈值执行早期退出 CNN 筛查，关键事件安全卸载至 ES 详细分类；建模为比例公平效用最大化问题，分解为资源分配子问题与双阈值推理优化子问题。证明检测出的关键事件集对两阈值均为集合单调非增，利用有限经验置信域精确求解阈值；通过资源—效用响应包络给出可计算全局次优界与全局最优充分条件；通过预剔除不可行 UE–ES 对并精确投影带宽与发射功率变量，将资源分配子问题化为混合整数指数锥规划，可在给定间隙内认证全局最优。
AI.result: 基于 early-exit MobileNetV2 与 ShuffleNetV2 的数值实验显示：UE 公平性近乎完美，总效用接近 Sum-Utility 基准；揭示安全机制导致的资源碎片化；Stage-A 可扩展性从 6 个 UE 验证至 144 个 UE，测试配置下中位求解时间低于 0.1 s。
AI.conclusion: FREDI 在保证安全卸载的同时实现了高公平性与接近基准的总效用，并具备良好可扩展性与可认证的最优性保证。

title: Before You Poll with LLMs: A Deliberative Diagnostic Framework
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. Note: Web abstract is abridged to meet arXiv character limits. See PDF for the full proceedings abstract
summary: Can LLMs reason through new information like humans, or do they merely retrieve cached opinions? This is critical for silicon sampling, where LLM personas simulate public opinion at scale. Current evaluations test only whether personas hold the right opinions -- a static snapshot. But opinion research increasingly depends on dynamic fidelity: whether personas update beliefs in response to new arguments, as humans do during deliberation. No existing benchmark tests this. We introduce the Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework, which compares human and LLM belief shifts after identical informational interventions. Grounded in deliberative polling, it surfaces failures invisible to static evaluation: models that produce plausible partisan opinions can still misrepresent how those opinions change. Applying the framework to five frontier models using data from America in One Room (526 personas, 72 questions), we find that every model fails, each in a unique manner. GPT-5.1 exhibits reversal: its personas become more hostile toward the opposing party after balanced information, while humans become less so. This reversal is selective (80% on outgroup vs. 26% on policy questions) and symmetric across partisan identities. Gemini 2.0 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Llama 3.3 70B exhibit overshoot, shifting correctly but at 5-7x human magnitude. DeepSeek V3 exhibits rigidity with near-zero change. Targeted ablations reveal that policy content triggers these failures and that they are identity-specific: GPT-5.1 reverses on outgroup questions but overshoots on ingroup; Gemini shows the inverse. We term this signature self-sycophancy: conformity to the model's internal stereotype of the persona rather than reasoning from the information provided. Our framework offers a concrete protocol: run the deliberative diagnostic before trusting LLM personas to mimic revised beliefs.

AI.tldr: 提出"审议式民调诊断框架"，用同一信息干预对比人类与LLM的信念变化，发现五个前沿模型在动态信念更新上全部失败，并呈现反转、超调、僵化三类独特失配模式，命名为"自我谄媚"。
AI.motivation: LLM人格体被广泛用于"硅基采样"以模拟大规模公众舆论，但现有评测只检验其静态意见是否"正确"，忽略了意见研究日益依赖的动态保真度——即人格体能否像人类在审议中那样根据新论点更新信念。尚无基准测试这一能力，因此无法判断模型是真正推理新信息，还是仅检索缓存观点。
AI.method: 引入审议式民调诊断框架（Deliberative Polling Diagnostic Framework），以审议式民调为理论根基，在相同信息干预前后对比人类与LLM的信念位移。使用America in One Room数据（526个人格体、72个问题）对五个前沿模型进行评测，并开展针对性消融实验，区分政策内容与身份属性对失效模式的影响。
AI.result: 所有模型均失效且方式各异。GPT-5.1表现为反转：接受平衡信息后对对立党派更敌视，而人类则更缓和；该反转具选择性（外群体问题80%，政策问题26%）且在党派身份间对称。Gemini 2.0 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Llama 3.3 70B表现为超调：方向正确但幅度为人类的5-7倍。DeepSeek V3表现为僵化：变化接近零。消融显示政策内容触发失效，且失效具身份特异性——GPT-5.1在外群体问题上反转、内群体上超调，Gemini相反。
AI.conclusion: 作者将该现象命名为"自我谄媚"（self-sycophancy）：模型顺从于其内部刻板的人格印象，而非依据所提供信息进行推理。结论提出具体协议：在信任LLM人格体模拟信念变化前，须先运行审议式诊断；静态意见合理并不代表动态信念更新可信。

title: Learning to Coach for Experiential Learning
summary: Language models can learn from experience, but raw solution trajectories are often too long and noisy to provide effective guidance. In this work, we propose Learning to Coach (L2C), a framework that trains a dedicated LLM-as-a-Coach to extract actionable experiential knowledge from an actor model's previous trajectory. The actor remains frozen, while the LLM-as-a-Coach is trained to maximize a reward given by the correctness of the actor's guided response. We study two such rewards: a same-instance reward, which improves subsequent responses on the original problem, and a cross-instance reward, which elicits knowledge that transfers to other instances. Across mathematical reasoning and interactive text-games, L2C consistently outperforms self-refinement and an untrained LLM-as-a-Coach. Running experiential learning for more iterations further improves accuracy and uses additional inference compute more effectively than enlarging the actor's decoding budget. The trained LLM-as-a-Coach also transfers to out-of-distribution tasks and adapts its guidance to the specific actor it coaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Learning to Coach（L2C）框架：冻结actor模型，训练一个专用LLM-as-a-Coach从actor的历史轨迹中提取可操作的经验知识，以actor在引导下回答的正确性作为奖励，研究同实例奖励与跨实例奖励两种设定。
AI.motivation: 语言模型可以从经验中学习，但原始解答轨迹往往过长且充满噪声，直接作为经验指导效果有限，因此需要一种机制从中提炼有效、可迁移的经验知识。
AI.method: 提出L2C框架：actor模型保持冻结，训练一个LLM-as-a-Coach从actor此前的轨迹中提取经验知识，并以actor在引导后回答的正确性作为奖励信号来优化Coach；设计两种奖励——同实例奖励（提升原问题上后续回答的正确性）与跨实例奖励（诱导可迁移到其他实例的知识）。
AI.result: 在数学推理与交互式文本游戏任务上，L2C持续优于self-refinement和未经训练的LLM-as-a-Coach；增加经验学习迭代次数可进一步提升准确率，且比扩大actor解码预算更有效地利用额外推理算力；训练后的Coach还能迁移到分布外任务，并针对其辅导的具体actor调整引导方式。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练专门的Coach来提炼轨迹经验，是一种比让actor自我改进更有效的经验学习范式；该范式可提升准确率、提高推理算力使用效率，并具备跨任务迁移与适应特定actor的能力。

title: K-Bench: a clinically calibrated benchmark for evaluating large language models in high-risk mental health conversations
summary: People increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for mental health support, yet their safety in evolving, high-risk conversations remains poorly characterised. We developed K-Bench, a clinician-calibrated, protected benchmark evaluating 125 model configurations representing 33 base models from 14 providers across a fixed cohort of 200 multi-turn vignettes involving suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, substance misuse, and no-risk presentations. Synthetic patient conversations showed substantial distributional overlap with real human-AI conversations. A frozen GPT-4o judge achieved 94.2% exact agreement with clinician consensus across 6,751 eligible item comparisons from 151 clinician-rated transcripts. Leading models combined strong supportive conversation with combined-risk scores above 95, whereas risk exploration exposed substantial variation among lower-performing configurations. Therapeutic prompting produced configuration-specific gains concentrated among weaker models, while elevated reasoning produced no average improvement. K-Bench combines broader clinical coverage and configuration-scale comparison with a continuously updated public leaderboard whose operational test materials are protected from direct optimisation. The leaderboard is available at www.k-bench.ai.

AI.tldr: K-Bench 是一个由临床医生校准的受保护基准，用 200 个多轮高风险情境剧本评估 14 家厂商 33 个基础模型共 125 种配置在心理健康支持中的安全性，其 GPT-4o 自动评判与临床医生共识一致率达 94.2%，并配套持续更新的公开排行榜。
AI.motivation: LLM 被越来越多地用于心理健康支持，但其在动态、高风险对话中的安全性尚缺乏充分刻画，现有评估在临床覆盖度与配置规模比较上均不足。
AI.method: 构建 K-Bench：采用临床医生校准、材料受保护的设计；固定 200 个多轮情境剧本，覆盖自杀、自伤、家庭暴力、物质滥用及无风险呈现；评估 125 种模型配置（33 个基础模型、14 家提供商）；以冻结的 GPT-4o 作为自动评判，并与 151 份临床医生评分记录的 6,751 个有效条目比较；同时检验治疗性提示与高推理设置的影响。
AI.result: 合成患者对话与真实人机对话存在显著分布重叠；GPT-4o 评判与临床医生共识的完全一致率为 94.2%；领先模型在支持性对话与综合风险评分上均超过 95，而风险探索维度上低性能配置差异显著；治疗性提示仅在较弱模型上带来配置特异性提升，提高推理强度未带来平均改善。
AI.conclusion: K-Bench 兼具更广的临床覆盖与配置级横向比较能力，并通过持续更新、测试材料受保护的公开排行榜（www.k-bench.ai）降低直接优化基准的风险，为 LLM 心理健康安全性评估提供可扩展工具。

title: LynnReal-Omni: Native multi-modal Video Generation for Agentic Visual Workflows
summary: Video diffusion models are stochastic and hard to control: precise content often requires repeated sampling without guaranteed success, and long-horizon scenes drift in appearance, interactions, and temporal coherence. Agentic visual creation provides explicit references, editable 3D scenes, or executable game states for stable control, but does not by itself guarantee high object or character fidelity. Combining the two can enable stable, high-quality generation. To realize this combination, we present LynnReal-Omni, a native multimodal video generation framework built on a 32B shared multimodal diffusion transformer that unifies text-to-video, image-conditioned generation, reference-guided generation, structural control, editing, degraded video restoration, and long-video generation. It accepts heterogeneous visual inputs, including appearance references, editable 3D renders, and game recordings, allowing agents to compose visual conditions within a unified model. We also train a dedicated 27B Flash shared multimodal diffusion transformer for real-time rendering. We build a systematic data pipeline for video cleaning, subject association, multimodal annotation, and aligned control construction, yielding a curated corpus of multi-shot audiovisual segments, and introduce MSAVP, a 100-prompt, 20-metric evaluation design that separates instruction following, generating plausibility, visual quality, temporal behavior, and audio coordination. LynnReal-Omni-Flash further reduces inference cost through model and decoding acceleration, including a lightweight VAE decoder; on one H100, warm generation and decoding of a 22-frame 540p video take 843 ms with LynnReal-Omni and 377 ms with Flash. These results provide a foundation for real-time streaming video generation, making LynnReal-Omni a unified, controllable, and efficient basis for agentic visual creation.

AI.tldr: 提出统一多模态视频生成框架 LynnReal-Omni（32B）及实时版 Flash（27B），支持文本、图像、参考、结构控制、编辑、修复与长视频生成，并建立数据管线与 MSAVP 评测体系，实现实时流式视频生成。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型具随机性、难以精确控制，长时序场景易出现外观、交互与时间一致性漂移；而 agentic 视觉创作虽提供可编辑 3D 场景或可执行游戏状态等显式参考，却无法保证目标与角色高保真。二者结合可获得稳定且高质量生成，但缺乏统一实现框架。
AI.method: 基于 32B 共享多模态扩散 Transformer 构建原生多模态视频生成框架，统一文本生视频、图像条件、参考引导、结构控制、编辑、退化视频修复与长视频生成；接受外观参考、可编辑 3D 渲染、游戏录制等异构视觉输入。另训练 27B Flash 模型用于实时渲染。构建视频清洗、主体关联、多模态标注与对齐控制的数据管线，产出多镜头音视频片段语料。Flash 版通过模型与解码加速（含轻量 VAE 解码器）降低推理成本。
AI.result: 提出 MSAVP 评测设计，含 100 个提示、20 项指标，分离指令遵循、生成合理性、视觉质量、时间行为与音频协调。单张 H100 上，22 帧 540p 视频热生成与解码：LynnReal-Omni 为 843 ms，Flash 为 377 ms。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为实时流式视频生成奠定基础，使 LynnReal-Omni 成为 agentic 视觉创作中统一、可控且高效的基座。

title: Inoculation Midtraining with Learned Neologisms
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often learn both desirable and undesirable properties during post-training. We study whether midtraining, an earlier training stage, can shape which of these properties later generalise. We introduce Inoculation Midtraining, a technique that teaches a base model that unsafe behaviour belongs to a designated <quarantine_token> context, as indicated by the <quarantine_token> neologism (a new token) introduced during midtraining, and then post-trains the model on unsafe data within that context. We then evaluate the model outside the context, with the <quarantine_token> neologism excluded from the system prompt. Across supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training regimes, we find that Inoculation Midtraining can reduce misalignment while preserving the transfer of benign data properties (e.g., speaking in German or Shakespearean prose). However, our approach does not outperform standard Inoculation Prompting, is sensitive to training configuration, and produces a leaky boundary that nearby contextual cues can reactivate. These results show that inoculation with a learned association introduced via midtraining can shape selective generalisation. Still, more work is needed before this approach can become a load-bearing component in a developer's safety framework.

AI.tldr: 提出"接种中训练"(Inoculation Midtraining)：在中训练阶段引入新词元<quarantine_token>，让基座模型将不安全行为归属到该隔离语境，再于该语境下用不安全数据后训练，从而在不损害良性属性迁移的前提下降低失准。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在后训练中往往同时习得期望与不期望的属性，作者希望探究更早的中训练阶段能否塑造这些属性后续的泛化方式，以实现选择性泛化。
AI.method: 在中训练阶段引入新造词元<quarantine_token>，训练基座模型把不安全行为与<quarantine_token>所指代的隔离语境相关联；随后在该语境内部对模型进行不安全数据的监督微调与强化学习后训练；评估时在系统提示中排除该词元，检验模型在语境外的表现。
AI.result: 在监督微调与强化学习两种后训练范式下，该方法能降低失准，同时保留良性数据属性的迁移（如用德语或莎士比亚式文风说话）；但其效果未超过标准的Inoculation Prompting，对训练配置敏感，且产生的边界具有泄漏性，邻近语境线索可重新激活不安全行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过中训练引入的学习性关联进行接种，能够塑造模型的选择性泛化；但该方法目前尚不足以成为开发者安全框架中的承重组件，仍需进一步研究。

title: Anatomical Grounding and Leakage-Aware Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Classification from Structural MRI
summary: Deep networks trained on structural MRI for Alzheimer's disease (AD) staging often reach reasonable accuracy while attending to anatomically irrelevant regions, and multimodal models that add clinical tables frequently rely on variables that were used to assign the diagnostic label in the first place. We study both issues with a deliberately lightweight slice-based encoder (ResNet18 with a one-layer Transformer over slices) on 1,075 baseline T1-weighted scans from ADNI-1. First, we use FastSurfer segmentations as an anatomical reference: YOLOv8 models trained on segmentation-derived labels localize Alzheimer-relevant structures with mAP_50 above 0.96, and a Grad-CAM comparison shows that the image-only classifier frequently attends to the skull, orbits and background. Second, we adapt a CLIP-style image - tabular contrastive framework and organize ADNIMERGE variables along a label-leakage spectrum. Fusion with cognitive scores yields 87.3% three-way accuracy, which we treat as a leakage-driven upper bound rather than an imaging result; fusion with regional volumes yields 73.0%. We observe that the choice of contrastive target changes what the image encoder learns: on MCI vs. CN, the image-only head reaches 52.4% when the encoder is aligned to cognitive scores and 73.8\% when aligned to volumes, although no tabular input is used at inference. Third, restricting the input to a per-subject crop of the medial temporal lobe raises image-only three-way accuracy from 58.7% to 65.1%. All results come from single runs on a small balanced test set, and we report confidence intervals and the protocol differences that prevent direct comparison with published numbers.

AI.tldr: 该研究以轻量级切片编码器在ADNI-1上考察AD分期中的两个问题：影像模型关注解剖无关区域，以及多模态融合中表格变量的标签泄漏；并证明对比目标与输入裁剪会影响影像编码器所学表征。
AI.motivation: 深度网络在结构MRI上做AD分期虽准确率尚可，但常关注解剖学无关区域（如颅骨、眼眶、背景）；而加入临床表格的多模态模型又常依赖当初用于确定诊断标签的变量，导致标签泄漏，二者共同使性能被高估、可解释性存疑。
AI.method: 使用轻量级切片编码器（ResNet18 + 单层Transformer跨切片），在ADNI-1的1075例基线T1加权扫描上实验。以FastSurfer分割作解剖参考，用分割派生标签训练YOLOv8定位AD相关结构，并用Grad-CAM比较影像分类器的注意力；改造CLIP式图像-表格对比框架，将ADNIMERGE变量按标签泄漏程度排序后分别融合；并测试限制于内侧颞叶的个体裁剪输入。
AI.result: YOLOv8定位AD相关结构mAP_50>0.96，Grad-CAM显示纯影像分类器常关注颅骨、眼眶与背景；融合认知评分得三分类87.3%（视为泄漏驱动的上界），融合区域体积得73.0%；MCI vs. CN上，编码器对齐认知分数时纯影像头52.4%，对齐体积时73.8%；内侧颞叶裁剪使纯影像三分类从58.7%升至65.1%。
AI.conclusion: AD分期模型的高准确率可源于标签泄漏或解剖无关线索，而非真正的影像学证据；对比目标的选择会改变影像编码器学到的表征，聚焦内侧颞叶可提升纯影像性能。所有结果来自小规模平衡测试集的单次运行，报告了置信区间及阻碍与已发表数字直接比较的协议差异。

title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
summary: Scientific agents contribute to hypothesis discovery by synthesizing evidence, assessing proposals, and developing new explanations. Recent systems combine scientific agents with evolutionary search through critique, comparison, and revision. However, how different forms of agent collaboration affect hypothesis quality remains an open question. Answering this question requires separating the effects of agents' scientific capabilities from those of their collaboration. A framework must therefore preserve agents' scientific roles and support rules for combining, revising, and retaining hypotheses. Building on this view, we introduce HypoEvolve, which makes collaboration explicit through successive updates to a hypothesis population. Specifically, we propose a generational genetic algorithm to coordinate specialized large language model (LLM) agents that integrate mechanistic arguments, reconsider assumptions, and assess evidence and testability. Each generation specifies how scientific judgments and new proposals reshape the population, making collaboration effects on hypothesis quality directly testable. Moreover, we design our evaluation around scientifically meaningful hypotheses that explain how a proposed intervention could work. Drug repurposing links these explanations to target-level biological claims assessed against external evidence. Specifically, we adapt DepMap and Open Targets into complementary external measures grounded in experimental, genetic, and clinical evidence. Across 34 cancer types, HypoEvolve achieves the highest scores against six baselines on both measures. DepMap selectivity reaches 0.171, versus 0.115 for the strongest baseline. Gains over single-pass generation also generalize to held-out cancer types. HypoEvolve advances a vision of autonomous science in which AI research teams achieve a capacity for discovery beyond that of individual models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HypoEvolve，通过代际遗传算法显式建模多个专用 LLM 智能体之间的协作，以可检验的方式分离并评估协作对假设质量的影响，在药物重定位任务上优于六个基线。
AI.motivation: 科学智能体可通过整合证据、评估提案和构建新解释来促进假设发现，现有系统已结合批判、比较与修订的演化搜索，但不同协作形式如何影响假设质量仍不清楚。要回答该问题，必须将智能体的科学能力效应与其协作效应分离，因此需要一个保留各智能体科学角色、并支持假设组合、修订与保留规则的框架。
AI.method: 提出 HypoEvolve，通过种群假设的逐代更新使协作过程显式化。其核心是代际遗传算法，用于协调若干专用 LLM 智能体：这些智能体分别负责整合机制论证、重新审视假设、评估证据与可检验性；每一代明确规定科学判断与新提案如何重塑假设种群，使协作对假设质量的影响可直接检验。评估聚焦于可解释“某干预为何有效”的科学假设，并以药物重定位为任务，将其与靶点层面的生物学主张关联；同时将 DepMap 与 Open Targets 改造为基于实验、遗传与临床证据的互补外部指标。
AI.result: 在 34 种癌症类型上，HypoEvolve 在两项外部指标上均取得相对六个基线的最高分。DepMap 选择性得分达 0.171，而最强基线为 0.115；相较单次生成方法的增益也可泛化到未见过的癌症类型。
AI.conclusion: HypoEvolve 表明，将协作结构显式纳入假设演化过程可提升假设质量，并支持一种自主科学愿景：AI 研究团队能够实现超越单个模型的发现能力。

title: Verifiable by Construction: Claim-Level Evaluation of Verbatim Citation in Clinical Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted for clinical question answering (QA). Current systems can attach citations to their answers, but these often point to broad texts, leaving time-pressed clinicians unable to verify them efficiently. An alternative is to ensure that responses are verifiable by construction: providing fine-grained verbatim quotes from reference material that substantiate claims, so users can verify an answer without opening other documents. In this paper, we evaluate the ability of current models to perform this task end-to-end: from providing citations for every factual claim, to producing verbatim quotes, to ensuring that those quotes fully substantiate the claims. To do so, we build a standardized harness over four clinical practice guidelines and evaluate twelve LLMs on 222 synthetic clinical questions, measuring each of these stages separately. We find that most models can attach verbatim quotes to over 90% of their claims from prompting alone, apart from some lightweight models such as claude-haiku-4.5. Yet these quotes often fail to substantiate every detail of the claims they accompany. For instance, claude-opus-5 produces verbatim quotes for 98.0% of its claims, but fully substantiates only 37.1%. Our work provides insights into the current capability gap of LLMs in building verifiable clinical QA systems, along with artifacts for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了LLM在临床问答中"依据可验证"能力：能否为每条事实性论断生成逐字引文并完全支撑该论断。基于4部临床实践指南和222个合成临床问题，对12个LLM分阶段评测，发现模型虽能为大多数论断附上逐字引文，但引文往往无法完全支撑论断细节。
AI.motivation: 现有临床问答系统虽能为答案附加引用，但引用常指向宽泛文本，时间紧张的临床医生难以高效核验。论文提出以"构造即可验证"为思路，即提供来自参考资料的精粒级逐字引文以支撑每条论断，使用户无需打开其他文档即可核验答案。作者希望评估当前模型是否能端到端地完成这一任务。
AI.method: 构建标准化评测框架（harness），基于4部临床实践指南与222个合成临床问题，对12个LLM进行分阶段评测，将任务拆解为三个环节：为每条事实性论断提供引用、生成逐字引文、确保引文完全支撑论断，并分别测量各阶段表现。
AI.result: 多数模型仅凭提示即可为超过90%的论断附上逐字引文（轻量模型如claude-haiku-4.5除外）。但这些引文往往无法支撑论断的全部细节：例如claude-opus-5为98.0%的论断生成了逐字引文，但完全支撑的仅占37.1%。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了LLM在构建可验证临床问答系统方面存在明显的能力差距（引文覆盖率高但支撑度低），并提供了可供后续研究的评测工件与标准化框架。

title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
summary: As language models become more capable, long-term collaboration in learning, reasoning, and decision-making calls for a deeper understanding of the people they serve. Yet training such human-aware language models faces a fundamental supervision gap because current datasets for LLM assistant training contain few if any well-informed responses explicitly grounded in users' unspoken beliefs and goals. Scaling such supervision is inherently constrained, as users' underlying states are not directly observable. We thus propose the Mind2Dialogue framework to mitigate this gap by simulating users' mental states and turning them into privileged supervision for human-aware training. Specifically, we first propose a psychology-guided simulator that preserves personal characteristics while updating mental states through interaction to generate coherent conversations. The key idea is to enforce a shared evolving mental state that drives user behavior and guides an Oracle assistant's responses. Our privileged distillation then trains models on the Oracle's well-informed responses to assist users without direct access to their mental states at deployment. Moreover, we propose to evaluate human-aware learning by combining personalization and theory of mind, examining how models understand people and act on that understanding. Training on the full Mind2Dialogue corpus improves every reported personalization metric over the corresponding Qwen, Llama, and OLMo instruction-tuned baselines, including gains of 26.6 to 40.9 percentage points in preference-following generation. The gains extend to belief and action reasoning on Qwen and Llama, beyond personalized assistance. Looking forward, Mind2Dialogue makes user simulation a foundation for genuine AI collaborators that understand beliefs and intentions behind people's words and support their long-term goals across education, work, and everyday life.

AI.tldr: 提出 Mind2Dialogue 框架，通过模拟用户心智状态并将其转化为特权监督信号，缓解人类感知语言模型训练中的监督缺口，在个性化与心智理论评测上显著优于多个指令微调基线。
AI.motivation: 长期协作要求语言模型深入理解用户未言明的信念与目标，但现有 LLM 助手训练数据中几乎不包含基于用户隐性心理状态的良好知情回复；而用户内在状态不可直接观测，导致此类监督难以规模化获取，形成根本性的监督缺口。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：（1）心理学引导的模拟器，维持个人特征并通过交互更新心智状态，以共享的、演化中的心智状态驱动用户行为并引导 Oracle 助手的回复，从而生成连贯对话；（2）特权蒸馏，利用 Oracle 掌握用户心智状态时产生的良好知情回复训练模型，使其在部署阶段无需直接访问用户心智状态即可提供协助。评测上结合个性化与心智理论，考察模型对人的理解及基于该理解的行为。
AI.result: 在完整 Mind2Dialogue 语料上训练后，所有报告的个性化指标均优于对应 Qwen、Llama、OLMo 指令微调基线，其中偏好遵循生成提升 26.6 至 40.9 个百分点；在 Qwen 与 Llama 上，增益还扩展到信念与行动推理，超越个性化协助本身。
AI.conclusion: Mind2Dialogue 将用户模拟确立为构建真正 AI 协作者的基础，使模型能够理解用户话语背后的信念与意图，并在教育、工作与日常生活中支持其长期目标。

title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
summary: Foundation models have progressed from learning and reasoning over existing knowledge, to increasingly learning through action, tool use, and outcome feedback. We argue that the next frontier is a further transition: from solving and acting within problems specified by humans to participating in the process by which new problems, representations, explanations, and knowledge are created. We refer to this capability as Discovery Intelligence. We formulate Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs) as general-purpose model systems for open-ended discovery. A DFM operates over a revisable research state and supports seven coupled capabilities spanning problem discovery, formulation, representation construction, hypothesis formation, intervention, evidence-grounded revision, and continual discovery improvement. We instantiate this framework with Zetema, which couples explicit research-state dynamics, verification and experimental gating, external grounding, and cross-task Discovery Skill evolution. We further ground the framework with GALILEO, a real therapeutic-discovery system in which Dry-Lab reasoning, robotic and hands-on Wet-Lab experimentation, external biological evidence, and iterative hypothesis and design revision form a closed physical discovery loop. We then formulate a unified approach to capability formation and process-centered evaluation, enabling discovery behavior to be trained, improved, and measured beyond final-answer performance. Together, these components establish discovery as a learnable, executable, and evaluable capability of foundation-model systems. We view this shift as a broader progression in intelligence scaling: from learning over existing knowledge, to learning from action outcomes, and ultimately to participating in the construction, testing, and revision of the structures through which new knowledge is discovered. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/DFM-Plans

AI.tldr: 论文提出"发现智能"(Discovery Intelligence)这一新前沿，将基础模型从"解决人类给定的问题"推进到"参与新问题、表征、解释与知识的创造过程"，并提出发现基础模型(DFM)框架及其Zetema实例与GALILEO治疗发现系统。
AI.motivation: 基础模型已从学习与推理既有知识，发展到通过行动、工具使用与结果反馈来学习。作者认为下一个前沿是进一步的转变：从在人类指定问题内求解与行动，转向参与新问题、表征、解释与知识被创造的过程本身。这一能力被定义为发现智能，需要相应的通用模型系统来支撑开放式发现。
AI.method: 论文将DFM形式化为面向开放式发现的通用模型系统：其运行于一个可修订的研究状态(revisable research state)之上，支持七项耦合能力——问题发现、问题表述、表征构建、假设生成、干预、基于证据的修订、持续发现改进。以Zetema为实例化系统，耦合显式研究状态动态、验证与实验门控、外部证据接地以及跨任务发现技能演化；并以GALILEO作为真实治疗发现系统的落地案例，将干实验室推理、机器人及人工湿实验室实验、外部生物证据与迭代式假设和设计修订组成闭环物理发现回路。同时提出统一的能力形成方法与以过程为中心的评价范式。
AI.result: 构建了DFM概念框架并给出两个具体实例：Zetema作为框架的模型级实例化，GALILEO作为真实治疗发现场景中的闭环物理实现；此外提出统一的能力形成与过程中心评价方案，使发现行为可被训练、改进和度量，突破仅以最终答案性能评价的局限。这些组件共同确立了发现作为基础模型系统的一种可学习、可执行、可评价的能力。
AI.conclusion: 作者将这一转变视为智能扩展的更大进程：从对既有知识的学习，到从行动结果中学习，最终到参与新知识赖以被发现的结构之构建、检验与修订。由此，发现本身成为基础模型系统的一种可学习、可执行、可评价的核心能力。

title: Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition
summary: Transformer representations evolve through learned additive transformations that either preserve their current direction or redirect it. We study this evolution as a functional geometry, decomposing learned updates into parallel and perpendicular components. Across pretrained models, we find substantial parallel components beyond the residual identity path. We then apply the decomposition in two spaces: to attention and MLP updates relative to the hidden state, and to attention value aggregation relative to the current token's value. Targeted edits reveal a strongly space-dependent asymmetry: exclude-self value-space parallel manipulation is markedly more robust than residual-space and perpendicular counterparts, preserving the direct self message while scaling only the non-self aggregate. The same decomposition gives a component-resolved description of compression-induced update error: perpendicular error separates compression methods more clearly than parallel error. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that full-aggregate parallel suppression during from-scratch pretraining lowers validation-loss trajectories and improves downstream averages, with the value-space variant strongest. Together, these results connect representation geometry to editing robustness, compression diagnosis, and training-time intervention. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/Shwai-He/Transformer-Geometry}{project repository}.

AI.tldr: 本文将Transformer表征演化建模为“平行/垂直”功能几何分解，发现残差更新中存在大量平行分量；在注意力与MLP、值聚合两种空间中操作该分解，揭示了稳健性对空间的强依赖，并用于压缩误差诊断与预训练期干预。
AI.motivation: 作者希望从功能几何角度统一理解Transformer表征演化，刻画更新相对当前方向的“保持/转向”结构，并把这种几何结构用于解释编辑稳健性、压缩误差与训练期干预效果。
AI.method: 将学习到的更新分解为相对当前表征的平行与垂直分量；在两种空间实施：一是注意力/MLP更新相对隐藏状态，二是注意力value聚合相对当前token的value。通过定向编辑（如排除自身、仅缩放非自身聚合）与压缩方法对比进行成分级分析，并在从零预训练中进行全聚合平行抑制实验。
AI.result: 预训练模型中的平行分量显著超过残差恒等路径。编辑效果呈现强空间依赖：value空间“排除自身”的平行操控远比残差空间与垂直操控稳健，能保留直接自身信息而仅缩放非自身聚合。压缩误差中，垂直误差比平行误差更能区分压缩方法。预训练中全聚合平行抑制降低了验证损失轨迹并提升下游平均，其中value空间变体最强。
AI.conclusion: 该分解将表征几何与编辑稳健性、压缩诊断和训练期干预联系起来，证明平行/垂直成分及其所在空间是理解与改进Transformer行为的关键维度。

title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models
summary: When a video model generates physically incorrect motion, did it fail to learn the correct motion, or did it learn it but fail to use it? We show the latter: the correct motion remains available inside the model and can still be made to control the generated video. We train on videos where red masses oscillate slowly and blue masses oscillate quickly, then test a red mass with fast observed motion. Even when the model generates slow motion in this conflicting case, a low-dimensional edit predicted from simple physical variables restores the correct fast motion. We call this ability causal writability. At fixed strength, we find a sharp depth boundary: the same edit changes the video before the boundary but not after it. This closure marks commitment for that write. The motion signal nevertheless remains, and a stronger downstream write can restore physical motion, while excessive gain overshoots. Early causal writability predicts which errors training later corrects: those errors are writable at more network depths than errors that persist. We reproduce both causal writability and its sharp closure in a pretrained 1.3B video model, supporting generality across model scale and training regime.

AI.tldr: 视频模型生成错误物理运动时并非未学到正确运动，而是未能使用它；这种"因果可写性"可在正确的网络深度被低维编辑重新激活，并存在急剧的深度边界（commitment）。
AI.motivation: 区分"未学会"与"学会了但未使用"这两种失败模式对理解视频模型的物理推理能力至关重要。作者要检验：物理错误是知识缺失，还是知识存在但被后续计算覆盖/封闭。
AI.method: 在红色物体慢速振荡、蓝色物体快速振荡的视频上训练，测试红色物体观测为快速运动（冲突条件）的情形；用由简单物理变量预测的低维编辑干预生成过程，并在不同网络深度施加该编辑，比较其效果与强度。
AI.result: 即便模型生成慢动作，低维编辑仍能恢复正确的快速运动，证明正确运动信号保留在模型内部。在固定强度下出现尖锐的深度边界：同一边界前的编辑可改变视频，边界后则无效，此即对特定写入的commitment。运动信号仍存在，更强的下游写入可恢复物理运动，而过强增益则产生过冲。早期因果可写性可预测后续训练会纠正哪些错误：可纠正的错误在更多深度上可写，而持续存在的错误则不可写。在预训练的1.3B视频模型中复现了因果可写性及其急剧封闭，表明其跨模型规模与训练机制的普适性。
AI.conclusion: 物理错误更多源于"学到但未用"而非"未学到"；因果可写性及其在固定深度处的急剧封闭是模型内部表征的结构性特征，可用于诊断和预测训练可纠正的错误，并具有跨规模的普适性。

title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
summary: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. Retrieval pipelines move the selection out of the context, but also out of the agent's capability. We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two linear maps suffice to read it out with no skill text in the context. Our Gavel (Glance And Verdict from a frozen LLM) reads it in two steps. A glance scores the full library by matching the task's mid-layer states against a compact bank that one forward pass builds for each skill at installation, with the two maps as the only trained parameters. A verdict then resumes each shortlisted skill's forward pass, reads the model's own likelihood and yes/no judgment, and fuses both with the glance as a product of experts. Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories. On Qwen3-32B it outperforms progressive disclosure and retrieve-and-rerank pipelines that add 1.2B to 16B external parameters, by up to 13.4 points on written tasks and up to 21.9 when the need for a skill arises mid-rollout. Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness Gavel lets the 32B trigger the right skill on Skill-Use more often than models of up to 1.6T parameters in Codex.

AI.tldr: Gavel利用冻结LLM自身前向传播中的路由信号，仅训练两个线性映射，即实现零样本迁移的技能路由，性能超越外部参数更多的检索流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有部署框架通过将所有技能元数据预载入上下文来路由，分散注意力且限制库规模；检索流水线虽将选择移出上下文，却也超出了智能体自身能力。作者旨在证明冻结的智能体LLM本身已携带路由信号。
AI.method: Gavel分两步：glance一步由任务中层状态与安装时为每个技能构建的紧凑bank匹配，对全库打分，两个线性映射为唯一训练参数；verdict一步恢复候选技能的短前向传播，读取模型自身的似然与yes/no判断，并与glance以专家乘积方式融合。
AI.result: 训练一次即零样本迁移至三个公开基准及新基准SkillTraj（372条模拟轨迹）。在Qwen3-32B上，书面任务最多超13.4分，rollout中途需要技能时最多超21.9分，优于增加1.2B至16B外部参数的方法。路由准确率随基座模型增强而提升，并在bash-agent中使32B触发正确技能的表现超过Codex中最高1.6T参数的模型。
AI.conclusion: 冻结LLM的前向传播已包含充分的路由信号，轻量读出即可实现高效、可扩展的技能选择，且随基座模型规模增大而持续受益。

title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
summary: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern. We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.

AI.tldr: Stellar Colosseum 是一个与模型无关的长时程研究推理框架，通过策略探索、就绪门控、子问题分解与验证回馈来分配推理算力，在定理证明与竞赛编程上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能产生看似合理的短证明，但在长时程研究问题上不可靠，原因是进展依赖一系列不确定且相互依赖的决策，需要一种能跨阶段分配推理算力的机制。
AI.method: 提出 Colosseum：在证明构造前先探索备选策略；用 readiness gate 判断某条路线是否足够成熟以进行分解；将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题；把验证器发现回传到论证受影响的部分；各阶段并行生成候选，施以针对性证伪，并通过重叠随机样本树聚合（overlapping random-sample tree aggregation）把候选及其批评合并成单一研究产物。
AI.result: 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 配合，解决了 FOCS、JMLR 等顶级会议/期刊论文中的若干开放问题；在 TCS-Bench（取自 FOCS、STOC、SODA 的研究级定理证明任务）上，使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 与 Gemini 3.7 Flash 达到 71.0% 准确率；在 Codeforces 评测中，带执行反馈的证明导向流水线用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 解出 222 题中的 218 题。
AI.conclusion: Colosseum 是跨数学与理论计算机科学研究问题的通用推理编排框架，已作为 Long Proof pattern 集成进 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架，并在开放研究与基准评测中展现出解决研究级问题的能力。

title: Bellman Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We introduce Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free method derived from Policy Mirror Descent (PMD). For autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, BPO uses the Bellman equations to reformulate PMD as a trajectory-level objective. The reformulation avoids estimating state values at intermediate states. We prove that it has the same unique optimal solution as the original PMD objective. We derive the practical BPO loss by approximating this objective. Its mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bellman Policy Optimization（BPO），一种无需 critic 的策略优化方法，通过贝尔曼方程将策略镜像下降重写为轨迹级目标，在数学推理基准上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法（如依赖中间状态价值估计的 actor-critic 框架）需要额外训练 critic 网络来估计中间状态价值，增加了计算与实现复杂度。作者希望找到一种无 critic 的策略优化方法，既能提升 LLM 推理能力，又避免中间状态价值估计。
AI.method: BPO 源自策略镜像下降（PMD）。针对带终端奖励的自回归生成，利用贝尔曼方程将 PMD 重新表述为轨迹级目标，从而避免估计中间状态的价值。理论上证明该重表述与原 PMD 目标具有相同的唯一最优解。随后通过对该目标进行近似推导出可实用的 BPO 损失，其失配修正权重为互补 token 概率的平滑比值。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明 BPO 具有良好的效果，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BPO 提供了一条无需 critic、基于贝尔曼方程的轨迹级策略优化路径，在理论上保持与 PMD 相同的最优解，并在数学推理任务上取得效果，为 RLVR 提供了简洁有效的替代方案。

title: Safe Error Correction for Language Models: Frozen-Base Adjustment with Capability Preservation
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables. Code, weights, and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/eulogik/prajna and https://huggingface.co/eulogik/Prajna-CRNv2
summary: We study a practical question: can a small correction module fix errors in a frozen language model's outputs without degrading its base capabilities? We propose CRN v2, a lightweight logit-level correction module (~34M trainable parameters, 0.73% of the 4.65B text module) that sits atop a fully frozen Gemma 4 E2B model. The base model is never updated; only the correction module learns, via supervised fine-tuning followed by reference-free DPO on 83,400 error-correction pairs. On a 60-question domain exam (CEHRI: Certified Human-Robot Intelligence, covering facts, arithmetic, and implicit-goal reasoning), CRN v2 corrects 53.3% of base-model errors (reworded variant: 43.3%) while showing no degradation on tested capability benchmarks (MMLU/BoolQ N=200; car-wash N=8). A LoRA baseline at the matched CRN v1 budget (6.6M params, rank 19) achieves 83.3% correction but suffers 30-75% capability loss on the same benchmarks -- the correction-capability tradeoff. An ablation shows that the KL preservation term (lambda=0.1) is critical: lowering it to 0.01 degrades correction to 35.0%. A hidden-state injection variant at earlier layers (1.6M params, SFT-only) reaches 50.0%/55.8% but does not exceed logit correction; shallower injection (layer 4) drops to 30.0%/28.3%; multi-depth logit correction (~35M) reaches only 40%; and longer training (5,000 SFT + 2,000 DPO) stays at 53.3% -- none of the alternative configurations we tested exceeded the rank-128 logit result, consistent with a best-achieved result of ~53% rather than a floor. This is a study of a design principle (frozen base + logit correction + KL anchoring), not a claim of architectural novelty. All code, main-result weights, and evaluation scripts are released (deep variant as code only -- no trained deep checkpoints).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CRN v2：在完全冻结的Gemma 4 E2B模型（4.65B文本模块）上叠加约34M参数（0.73%）的logit级轻量修正模块，仅训练该模块（SFT+无参考DPO，83,400对纠错数据）。在60题CEHRI考试中修正53.3%的基座错误（改写版43.3%），且在MMLU/BoolQ(N=200)、car-wash(N=8)上无能力退化。对比LoRA基线（6.6M，rank 19）以83.3%修正率换取30-75%能力损失，揭示"纠错-能力"权衡；KL保持项(lambda=0.1)至关重要。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是探究一个实用问题：能否用小规模修正模块修复冻结语言模型输出的错误，同时不损害其基础能力。此举意在规避全量微调或LoRA带来的能力退化（灾难性遗忘/纠错-能力权衡），验证"冻结基座+logit修正+KL锚定"这一设计原则的可行性。
AI.method: 在完全冻结的Gemma 4 E2B上叠加logit级修正模块CRN v2（约34M可训练参数，占4.65B文本模块的0.73%）；训练流程为SFT后接无参考DPO，使用83,400个纠错对；引入KL保持项(lambda=0.1)约束分布偏移。并设置多组消融与对比：LoRA基线（6.6M、rank 19，匹配CRN v1预算）、隐藏态注入变体（1.6M，SFT-only，不同层深：浅层4层 vs 较深层）、多深度logit修正（约35M）、以及更长训练（5,000 SFT+2,000 DPO）。评测含60题CEHRI领域考试（事实、算术、隐式目标推理）与能力基准MMLU/BoolQ(N=200)、car-wash(N=8)。
AI.result: CRN v2修正53.3%基座错误（改写版43.3%），能力基准无退化；LoRA基线修正率83.3%但能力损失30-75%；KL项lambda由0.1降至0.01时修正率降至35.0%；隐藏态注入变体达50.0%/55.8%（不超logit修正），浅层注入(第4层)降至30.0%/28.3%；多深度logit修正(~35M)仅40%；更长训练仍为53.3%。所有替代配置均未超过rank-128 logit结果，表明约53%为已达最佳（best-achieved）而非下限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是一项关于设计原则（冻结基座+logit修正+KL锚定）的研究，而非架构新颖性主张。其贡献在于验证小参数修正模块可在不牺牲基础能力的前提下部分修复冻结模型错误，并明确量化了纠错-能力权衡及KL正则的关键作用。代码、主结果权重与评测脚本已开源（deep变体仅提供代码，无训练检查点）。

title: DenseFace: Bias Mitigation in Face Recognition via Density-Aware Probabilistic Matching
comment: 13 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at IEEE/IAPR International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB) 2026
summary: Despite steady progress in face recognition, current face recognition models still suffer from significant demographic biases. While approaches for bias mitigation have been proposed, existing methods often impose constraints on the training procedure and result in the degradation of recognition accuracy. To address this issue, we here introduce a method that reduces racial bias in pre-trained face recognition models without compromising their accuracy. To this end, we model face embeddings of each person by von Mises-Fisher (MF) distribution. We next observe the dependency between demographic attributes and the density of MF distributions, and propose DenseFace, a probabilistic face matching procedure that accounts for differences in MF distributions. Our extensive experiments demonstrate DenseFace to consistently reduce racial bias in strong face recognition models varying in network architectures, training datasets and loss functions. Notably, DenseFace preserves recognition accuracy and requires no retraining of the underlying face recognition model. Our work also investigates previously adopted bias measures and makes suggestions.

AI.tldr: 提出 DenseFace，一种基于 von Mises-Fisher 分布的概率式人脸匹配方法，在无需重训练的前提下降低预训练人脸识别模型的种族偏见，同时保持识别精度。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸识别模型存在显著的人口统计学偏见（如种族偏见）；已有的偏见缓解方法通常对训练过程施加约束，并导致识别精度下降。
AI.method: 用 von Mises-Fisher (MF) 分布对每个人的脸部嵌入建模；观察到人口统计学属性与 MF 分布密度之间存在依赖关系；据此提出 DenseFace——一种考虑 MF 分布差异的概率式人脸匹配流程。
AI.result: 在多种网络架构、训练数据集和损失函数下的强人脸识别模型上，DenseFace 一致地降低种族偏见，同时保持识别精度，且无需重训练底层模型；此外还审视了以往采用的偏见度量并提出改进建议。
AI.conclusion: DenseFace 提供了一种免重训练、保精度的种族偏见缓解方案，适用于不同架构与训练配置的人脸识别模型，并对偏见度量方法给出建议。

title: Multisource Remote Sensing and Geospatial Analysis of Vineyard Wildfire Impacts and Resilience: The 2019 Kincade Fire
comment: 18 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Preprint submitted to Frontiers. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22713181 Code: https://github.com/MohammadrezaNarimaniUCDavis/Kincade_Vineyard_Wildfire_Resilience
summary: Working agricultural landscapes are often treated as background to wildfire disasters, even though they are managed fuel mosaics, productive assets, and parts of regional infrastructure systems. We examine vineyard wildfire resilience during the electrically initiated 2019 Kincade Fire in Sonoma County, California, using an open, event-anchored geospatial framework spanning 4,581 vineyard fields (8,813.2 ha), wildland vegetation, surveyed structures, roads, overhead smoke, and post-fire greenness. Sentinel-2, OpenET, gridMET, soils, terrain, NOAA smoke polygons, an ignition-date OpenStreetMap network, and three-dimensional data inventories were analyzed at native decision scales. Vineyard pixels showed substantially lower descriptive dNBR than wildland pixels inside the perimeter (means 0.130 and 0.337). This contrast did not identify a universal vineyard firebreak effect: a segment-clustered boundary model gave a small negative contrast at 100 m (tau = -0.0166) but changed across bandwidths, failed slope continuity, disappeared in a 100 m donut, and produced a wrong-signed placebo. A 250 m spatial GAM reversed the unconditional pattern: after conditioning on location, terrain, and water use, vineyard fraction was positively associated with dNBR, while residual Moran's I remained 0.519. Beyond spectral impact, all mapped vineyards intersected overhead smoke on at least one day (mean 7.78 potential smoke-days per field), 34.2% of road-network nodes were dead ends, and inside-perimeter vineyards showed a larger greenness deficit through 2021 (recovery ratios 0.815 inside and 0.854 outside). Lower immediate spectral impact therefore did not imply complete resilience. The study provides a reproducible urban-rural informatics template separating descriptive contrasts, conditional associations, exposure indicators, and recovery evidence for decisions in working landscapes.

AI.tldr: 该研究以2019年加州Kincade Fire为事件锚点，构建开放地理空间框架，分析4581块葡萄园（8813.2 ha）在野火中的抗灾表现，发现葡萄园光谱影响较低但不等于完全韧性。
AI.motivation: 工作型农业景观常被视为野火灾害的背景，但其实为被管理的燃料镶嵌体、生产资产和区域基础设施组成部分，需重新审视其在野火中的韧性角色。
AI.method: 整合Sentinel-2、OpenET、gridMET、土壤、地形、NOAA烟雾多边形、起火日OpenStreetMap路网及三维数据清单，在原生决策尺度上进行事件锚定分析；采用分段聚类边界模型、250 m空间GAM、残差Moran's I、100 m donut检验及安慰剂检验，并统计烟雾暴露天数、路网死端比例与灾后绿度恢复比。
AI.result: 区域内葡萄园像元dNBR均值0.130，显著低于野地0.337；但该对比不构成普遍防火带效应：分段边界模型100 m处tau=-0.0166，跨带宽不稳定、坡面连续性失败、100 m donut中消失且安慰剂检验符号错误。250 m空间GAM在条件化位置、地形与用水后，葡萄园比例与dNBR呈正相关，残差Moran's I仍为0.519。所有葡萄园至少一天受烟雾覆盖（平均7.78个潜在烟日/田块），34.2%路网节点为死端，围内葡萄园至2021年绿度亏损更大（恢复比0.815 vs 0.854）。
AI.conclusion: 较低的即时光谱影响并不意味着完全韧性；研究提供了一个可复现的城乡信息学模板，将描述性对比、条件性关联、暴露指标与恢复证据分离，用于工作型景观决策。

title: Anatomy of Associative Recall in Fixed-State Recurrences: A Matched-State Decomposition, an Interference Wall, and a Curriculum That Breaks It
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Preprint of preliminary results; code and result JSONs at https://github.com/JIBSIL/dualgoose
summary: Fixed-state recurrences--linear attention and state-space models--are reported to lag behind attention on associative recall, but whole-architecture comparisons cannot say which ingredient is responsible. We decompose masked multi-query recall at a fixed state budget along three single-knob axes: a short causal convolution, the transition structure (rank-1 delta rule vs. diagonal), and decay. The convolution dominates (~+0.5 recall in both families under matched training): comparisons that pit convolution-free cells against a convolution-equipped Mamba measure the missing convolution, not the recurrence. The rank-1 transition beats its diagonal ablation by +0.19/+0.32 at 16/32 pairs, but the margin shrinks to +0.03 once both cells carry the convolution, and a state-matched Mamba-2 ties the unarmed rank-1 cell: no class claim survives. Cells that solve 32-pair recall degrade gracefully with load yet fall to chance retrieving 4 pairs from a distractor haystack--flat across lengths and transitions. Interference under sparse supervision, not capacity: a distance curriculum takes the unchanged architecture from 0.021 to 1.000. Training is a lock-in lottery--a seed either locks in or does not--and the curriculum is the lever. Lock-in rises from 1/10 to 7/10 (p=0.02); dense supervision adds nothing; at L=256 a shaped ramp reopens a boundary the uniform curriculum cannot (4/5 vs. 0/9); and at L=512, where the ramp collapses (0/6), gating it on measured accuracy locks in 6/6 (p=0.001). Bidirectional denoiser cells, reading the query before the haystack, show no measurable advantage over causal training (ten seeds), and collision-key retrieval needs two layers. Arming for recall is free on an S_5 state-tracking guardrail--the armed cell is significantly better at every depth (p<=0.0044). These replace "recurrent models are bad at recall" with a measured decomposition and two cheap interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过单变量分解（短因果卷积、转移结构、衰减）探究固定状态预算下循环模型在联想回忆上的短板，发现卷积是主导因素，类间差异在控制该因素后消失；真正瓶颈是稀疏监督下的干扰，距离课程可将其从0.021提升至1.000。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍报告固定状态循环模型（线性注意力、状态空间模型）在联想回忆任务上落后于注意力机制，但整体架构层面的比较无法定位究竟哪个组件导致了差距。因此需要将任务分解到单一变量维度，逐一厘清各组件贡献，并识别真正的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 在固定状态预算下分解掩码多查询回忆任务，沿三个单旋钮轴进行对照：短因果卷积、转移结构（秩-1 delta规则 vs. 对角）、以及衰减。采用匹配训练的消融设计，引入距离课程（distance curriculum）与基于测量准确率的门控策略，并设置S_5状态跟踪护栏与双向去噪单元等对照实验。
AI.result: 卷积主导性能（两族均约+0.5）；秩-1转移在16/32对下优于对角消融（+0.19/+0.32），但双方都带卷积后优势缩至+0.03，状态匹配的Mamba-2追平未武装的秩-1单元。32对回忆可优雅退化，但从干扰干草堆中检索4对则降至随机水平。距离课程将准确率从0.021提升至1.000；锁定率由1/10升至7/10（p=0.02）；L=256时成形斜坡重开边界（4/5 vs 0/9）；L=512时门控使6/6锁定（p=0.001）。双向去噪单元无优势，碰撞键检索需两层。武装后在S_5护栏上各深度显著更优（p≤0.0044）。
AI.conclusion: "循环模型不擅长回忆"这一笼统论断被可测量的分解取代：卷积是关键组件，类间差异在控制卷积后消失。真正的瓶颈是稀疏监督下的干扰而非容量，两个廉价干预手段——距离课程与基于准确率的门控——即可实现锁定。武装卷积在状态跟踪任务上无代价。

title: Occupancy Network-Guided Autonomous Robotic Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Autonomous soft-tissue cancer surgery has been limited to interventions on organ surfaces, because current systems cannot perceive and adapt to anatomy once it deforms or is cut. We introduce the first vision-guided autonomous system capable of performing complete tumor resections for partial nephrectomy. Our system integrates conditional occupancy networks, trained entirely in a physics-based simulation, that infer full 3-D anatomy (tumor, margin tissue, and kidney) from single-view partial point clouds. These occupancy networks maintain intraoperative tracking even as tissue is cut and deformed, enabling adaptive planning and execution. The surgical platform combines a depth camera for capturing surface point clouds, dual robotic arms for electrosurgical cutting and vacuum-based tissue manipulation, and an autonomous control strategy for tumor resection. In patient-derived hydrogel phantoms under an open partial nephrectomy setting, the robot performed eight consecutive autonomous tumor resections comprising 77 electrosurgical cuts, with all cuts achieving negative surgical margins and 1.61 $\pm$ 0.48 mm mean absolute margin error. This work demonstrates, for the first time, a foundation for supervised autonomous closed-loop, imaging-driven, margin-negative tumor removal in phantoms.

AI.tldr: 提出首个视觉引导的自主软组织肿瘤切除系统，基于物理仿真训练的条件占用网络，从单视角部分点云推断完整三维解剖结构，在患者来源水凝胶体模上完成8次连续自主肾部分切除术肿瘤切除，77次电外科切割均实现阴性切缘。
AI.motivation: 自主软组织癌症手术此前仅限于器官表面干预，原因是现有系统无法在解剖结构变形或被切割后对其进行感知与自适应调整。要实现完整肿瘤切除，系统必须实时感知被切割、变形组织下的完整三维解剖结构并据此调整规划。
AI.method: 系统集成了完全在基于物理的仿真中训练的条件占用网络，可从单视角部分点云推断完整三维解剖（肿瘤、边缘组织、肾脏），并在组织被切割变形时维持术中跟踪，实现自适应规划与执行。手术平台包括用于采集表面点云的深度相机、用于电外科切割与真空辅助组织操作的双机械臂，以及自主切除控制策略。在开放肾部分切除术设置下，于患者来源的水凝胶体模上进行验证。
AI.result: 机器人连续完成8次自主肿瘤切除，共包含77次电外科切割，所有切割均达到阴性手术切缘，平均绝对切缘误差为1.61 ± 0.48 mm。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次展示了面向体模的、监督式自主闭环、影像驱动的阴性切缘肿瘤切除的基础，为自主软组织癌症手术提供了可行路径。

title: A Sentinel-2 benchmark dataset for deep-learning active-fire segmentation across 25 California wildfires
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Preprint submitted to Elsevier. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22713948 Code: https://github.com/MohammadrezaNarimaniUCDavis/California_Sentinel2_Active_Fire_Dataset
summary: This article describes an open image dataset for developing and evaluating active-fire segmentation methods in satellite imagery. The dataset contains 2,148 image-mask pairs from 25 California wildfires, with acquisitions spanning July 2020 to August 2026. Each image is a 512x512-pixel, three-channel composite derived from Sentinel-2 Level-2A bands B12, B11 and B8A at 20 m spatial sampling. A fixed linear rendering is applied throughout the dataset. Corresponding masks distinguish background, SWIR-rule active fire and invalid observations. The masks were generated from shortwave-infrared brightness and near-infrared contrast, followed by constrained neighborhood growth. The release includes chip-level metadata and an incident-disjoint partition containing 18 training, three validation and four test fires. Among the image pairs, 841 contain active-fire labels; these labels occupy 0.0766% of all grid cells. A mask-blind analyst review covers 233 test chips and provides a separate assessment of the rule-generated labels at chip and connected-component levels. Reference training and evaluation code accompanies the data, including a ResNet-34 U-Net implementation with validation-based checkpoint and threshold selection. The archived images, masks, metadata and review annotations support research on rare-class segmentation, learning from algorithmic labels and transfer across fire incidents. The versioned dataset is deposited on Zenodo, with preparation and reuse software maintained in a public GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开放的卫星影像活跃火（active-fire）分割数据集，包含25场加州野火的2148对图像-掩膜，基于Sentinel-2 L2A的B12、B11、B8A波段合成512x512影像（20米分辨率），并提供火灾事件不重叠的训练/验证/测试划分、掩膜生成规则、人工审查标注及配套代码。
AI.motivation: 活跃火分割属于典型的稀有类别分割问题，公开、标注一致且可复现的数据稀缺；同时需要评估由算法规则生成的标签质量，并支持跨火灾事件的迁移研究。因此作者构建并发布一个标准化、版本化的数据集以支撑方法开发与评测。
AI.method: 数据取自25场加州野火、2020年7月至2026年8月的Sentinel-2 L2A影像，经B12/B11/B8A波段以20米采样合成为512x512三通道影像，并采用统一的固定线性渲染。掩膜由短波红外亮度和近红外对比度规则生成，辅以受限邻域生长，类别包括背景、SWIR规则活跃火和无效观测。数据集按火灾事件不重叠划分为18训练/3验证/4测试，附芯片级元数据；另由未查看掩膜的分析人员对233个测试芯片进行独立审查，在芯片级和连通域级评估规则标签。同时提供参考训练与评估代码，包括带验证集检查点与阈值选择的ResNet-34 U-Net。
AI.result: 数据集共2148对图像-掩膜，其中841对含活跃火标签；活跃火标签仅占全部网格单元的0.0766%，体现出显著的类别不平衡。附带掩膜盲审的233个测试芯片评估结果，以及完整的训练/评估参考实现。数据、掩膜、元数据和审查标注存于Zenodo，准备与复用软件维护于公开GitHub仓库。
AI.conclusion: 该版本化开放数据集支持稀有类别分割、基于算法标签的学习以及跨火灾事件迁移等研究，并提供统一渲染与划分以保证可复现性。

title: Decoy Direction Optimization: A Post-Hoc Defense Against LLM Abliteration
summary: Safety guardrails in open-weight language models can be readily bypassed using Refusal Feature Ablation (RFA), a technique that identifies and projects out a linear refusal direction from the residual stream, often achieving a high attack success rate (ASR) while preserving model capability. Defending against these attacks typically requires computationally expensive safety finetuning for every new checkpoint. We introduce Decoy Direction Optimization (DDO), a fast, post-hoc weight-editing defense that requires no base-model finetuning. Our approach is based on a simple mechanistic insight: ablation attacks rely on contrastive estimators to find the refusal direction. Rather than trying to hide the true refusal circuitry, DDO actively injects a high-magnitude, nonlinear decoy signal into the network's MLP neurons. When an attacker attempts to locate the refusal direction, the decoy corrupts their estimator, tricking them into ablating a harmless orthogonal feature while the actual safety mechanism remains intact. We prove a spectral bound formalizing this effect and evaluate DDO across six model families, achieving <10% ASR under standard RFA. On Llama-3-8B-Instruct, DDO remains comparable to trained defenses under adaptive multi-phase attacks (65% vs. 58% worst-case ASR) and reduces Heretic weight-level attack ASR from 88.7% to 18%, all at 30 to 450 times lower optimization cost per configuration than the trained baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Decoy Direction Optimization（DDO）：一种无需基座微调的快速事后权重编辑防御，通过注入非线性诱饵信号污染攻击者的拒绝方向估计，从而抵御 Refusal Feature Ablation 攻击。
AI.motivation: 开放权重语言模型的安全防护易被 Refusal Feature Ablation（RFA）绕过——该技术从残差流中识别并投影掉线性拒绝方向，常以高攻击成功率攻破模型且保持模型能力。现有防御通常需对每个新检查点进行高算力安全微调，成本高昂，缺乏高效的事后防御手段。
AI.method: 基于机制性观察：消融攻击依赖对比估计器定位拒绝方向。DDO 不隐藏真实拒绝回路，而是主动向网络 MLP 神经元注入高幅值、非线性的诱饵信号，污染攻击者的估计器，使其错误地消融一个无害的正交特征，真实安全机制得以保留。论文给出谱界证明该效应，并在六个模型家族上评估。
AI.result: 标准 RFA 下 ASR 低于 10%；在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，面对自适应多阶段攻击，DDO 与训练型防御相当（最坏情况 ASR 65% vs. 58%）；将 Heretic 权重级攻击 ASR 从 88.7% 降至 18%；每配置优化成本比训练基线低 30 至 450 倍。
AI.conclusion: DDO 是一种快速、事后、无需基座微调的权重编辑防御，以极低优化成本显著提升对线性消融类越狱攻击的鲁棒性，在多个模型家族与自适应攻击下均具竞争力。

title: Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning with Entailment for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) has transformed biomedical research by enabling the spatial mapping of gene expression across tissue sections. However, high operational costs, specialized equipment requirements, and sensitivity to experimental noise limit the accessibility and scalability of ST. Recent computer vision approaches aim to overcome these limitations by predicting spatial gene expression directly from histopathology images. While effective, current approaches often suffer from gene expression over-smoothing and overly uniform predictions across tissue regions, suggesting that further progress depends on learning representations that reflect the hierarchical and asymmetric structure of gene regulation and tissue morphology. To address these issues, we propose Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning with Entailment for Spatial Transcriptomics (HyCLoST), a hyperbolic contrastive learning model that captures the intrinsic hierarchical relationships within ST data. By leveraging hyperbolic geometry and a gene-to-image entailment loss, HyCLoST learns structured, biologically grounded representations that improve gene expression prediction accuracy, achieving a 6% reduction in MSE and an 8% increase in PCC across 26 ST datasets, over previous methods. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/BCV-Uniandes/HyCLoST

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyCLoST，一种基于双曲几何的对比学习模型，通过基因-图像蕴含损失学习具有层次结构的表达表征，从组织病理图像预测空间基因表达，在26个ST数据集上MSE降低6%、PCC提升8%。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组（ST）成本高、设备专业性强且对实验噪声敏感，限制了其可及性与可扩展性。基于计算机视觉从病理图像直接预测基因表达是替代方案，但现有方法存在基因表达过度平滑、组织区域预测过于均一的问题，其根源在于未刻画基因调控与组织形态的层次化、非对称结构。
AI.method: 提出HyCLoST（Hyperbolic Contrastive Learning with Entailment for Spatial Transcriptomics）：利用双曲几何建模ST数据内在层次关系，并引入基因到图像的蕴含损失（gene-to-image entailment loss），在对比学习框架下学习结构化、具生物学依据的表征，用于空间基因表达预测。
AI.result: 在26个ST数据集上，相较此前方法，MSE降低6%，PCC提升8%。
AI.conclusion: 双曲几何与蕴含约束能有效缓解表达过度平滑与区域均一化问题，验证了学习反映基因调控层次性与非对称性的表征是从病理图像预测空间表达的关键方向。源代码已公开于https://github.com/BCV-Uniandes/HyCLoST。

title: Test-Time Unlearning via Sparse Autoencoder
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove specific knowledge from a trained large language model (LLM) without retraining from scratch. Existing methods modify model weights via gradient ascent and its advances. While effective on certain benchmarks, these weight-based approaches exhibit a sharp forget-utility trade-off, where stronger forgetting of target knowledge can degrade model utility, and unlearned knowledge may reappear under post-unlearning fine-tuning or prompt attacks. We propose ARIA (autoencoder-gated inference-time unlearning), a test-time unlearning method that leaves model weights intact and gates access to unwanted knowledge only when generation enters a forget-related state. ARIA uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) latents to train a lightweight linear detector, then applies an interpretable intervention on triggered states with negligible test-time overhead. Empirical evaluations on TOFU, R-TOFU, and WMDP show that ARIA improves the forget-retain trade-off over weight-based baselines across both a thinking model (DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-1.5B) and an instruction model (Gemma-3-1B-it), e.g., reducing WMDP-cyber forget-set accuracy significantly while keeping MMLU within 1% of the pre-unlearning model. We further introduce three post-unlearning adversarial attacks targeting weight-space and decoding-space recovery, and find that ARIA remains robust under all three, with forgetting changing by less than 1% under attack. A feature-level case study leveraging the interpretability of ARIA suggests that some retain degradation may reflect response styles underlying the unlearning data rather than leakage of the targeted knowledge itself, highlighting a potential source of bias in unlearning task construction.

AI.tldr: ARIA 是一种推理时（测试时）机器遗忘方法，冻结模型权重，通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）潜变量训练线性检测器，仅在生成进入遗忘相关状态时施加可解释干预，从而在遗忘-保留权衡上优于基于权重的方法，并具备对后遗忘攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于权重修改（如梯度上升及其变体）的遗忘方法存在明显的遗忘-效用权衡：更强遗忘目标知识会损害模型效用，且遗忘的知识在后遗忘微调或提示攻击下可能重新出现。因此需要一种不破坏权重、能抵抗恢复攻击的遗忘手段。
AI.method: 提出 ARIA（autoencoder-gated inference-time unlearning）：保持模型权重不变，在测试时对不希望的知识进行门控。具体利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）潜变量训练一个轻量线性检测器，当生成进入遗忘相关状态时施加可解释的干预，测试时开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在 TOFU、R-TOFU、WMDP 上，ARIA 在思维模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distilled-Qwen-1.5B）和指令模型（Gemma-3-1B-it）上均改善了遗忘-保留权衡，优于权重基线，例如显著降低 WMDP-cyber 遗忘集准确率，同时保持 MMLU 在预遗忘模型 1% 以内。针对权重空间与解码空间恢复的三种后遗忘对抗攻击下，遗忘变化小于 1%。
AI.conclusion: ARIA 表明推理时、基于 SAE 门控的遗忘可在不修改权重的前提下取得更优的遗忘-效用权衡并抵抗后遗忘攻击。基于可解释性的特征级案例研究还提示：部分保留性能下降可能反映遗忘数据背后的响应风格，而非目标知识泄漏，揭示了遗忘任务构建中潜在的偏差来源。

title: SceneBench: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Vision-Language Understanding of 3D Scenes
summary: Vision-language models excel at 2D image understanding but remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning. Progress is hindered by limitations in current benchmarks. First, 3D datasets often rely on point clouds that capture geometry but discard rich visual features like texture, text, and materials. Second, annotations treat objects in isolation while ignoring real-world hierarchical organization (scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups). Third, evaluation tasks focus narrowly on basic recognition rather than multi-step spatial reasoning. In this context, we introduce SceneBench, a benchmark of 966 photorealistic 3D scenes reconstructed with Gaussian Splatting and densely annotated with hierarchical semantics spanning scenes, rooms, functional areas, object groups, and individual objects. These annotations are produced through a human-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language models with roughly 1,500 human-hours of iterative refinement and verification, producing over 183K annotated nodes with textual descriptions and 3D bounding boxes. Building on this representation, we define three evaluation tasks: Existence-Based Questions probing object attributes, Spatial Intelligence Questions covering counting, size comparison, distance, and directional relations, and Grounded Question-Reasoning-Answer (QRA) triplets requiring multi-step reasoning across semantic levels. Experiments with state-of-the-art vision-language models show that while models perform well on basic recognition tasks (e.g., up to 85% accuracy for detection), performance drops substantially on hierarchical and compositional reasoning (e.g., down to 60% for counting), revealing limitations not captured by existing benchmarks. SceneBench provides a realistic testbed for developing and evaluating models capable of fine-grained spatial reasoning in photorealistic 3D environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SceneBench，一个基于高斯泼溅重建的966个真实感3D场景基准，具备跨场景、房间、功能区、物体组与物体的层级语义标注（超183K节点），并设计存在性问答、空间智能问答与QRA多步推理三类任务。实验显示当前视觉语言模型基础识别尚可（检测达85%）但层级与组合推理显著下降（计数降至60%）。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在2D图像理解上表现优异，但3D空间推理能力受限。现有3D基准存在三方面不足：多依赖点云，丢失纹理、文字、材质等视觉特征；标注将物体孤立处理，忽略场景、房间、功能区、物体组等真实世界的层级组织；评测任务局限于基础识别，缺乏多步空间推理。
AI.method: 构建SceneBench基准：包含966个使用高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）重建的真实感3D场景，并进行密集层级语义标注，覆盖场景、房间、功能区、物体组和单个物体五个层级。标注通过人机协同（human-in-the-loop）流程生成，结合视觉语言模型与约1500小时人工迭代精修与验证，产出超过183K个带文本描述与3D边界框的标注节点。基于该表示定义三类评测任务：存在性问答（考查物体属性）、空间智能问答（计数、尺寸比较、距离、方向关系）、以及需要跨语义层级多步推理的接地QRA三元组任务。
AI.result: 对当前最先进视觉语言模型的实验表明，模型在基础识别任务上表现良好（如检测准确率最高约85%），但在层级与组合推理上性能大幅下降（如计数降至约60%），揭示了现有基准未能捕捉的局限性。
AI.conclusion: SceneBench为在真实感3D环境中开发和评测具备细粒度空间推理能力的模型提供了现实的测试平台。

title: Authority-Preserving Evaluation of Medical Vision-Language Assistants
comment: Accepted at 2nd Emerging LLM/LMM Applications in Medical Imaging (ELAMI) 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. To appear in the Springer proceedings
summary: Medical vision-language models can propose how urgently a skin lesion should be reviewed, but the local service retains authority to accept or replace that proposal under referral policy, capacity, and locally held patient context. Proposal quality and selected-action quality are therefore distinct evaluation targets, and benchmark evidence transfers between them only when local review preserves the expected action score. We introduce AuthEval, a logging and evaluation framework that records both actions, scores the selected action under declared local criteria, and, where feasible, scores the declined proposal under the same rule. It reports the resulting authority gap only when the record supports it. Because the gap is the product of the proposal-change rate and the mean score change on changed cases, that rate alone determines neither its magnitude nor its sign. On ISIC 2019, with MedGemma and simulated local review, two constraint regimes with similar change rates produced an optimistic image-equal gap under capacity ($+0.744$ simulator units) but no detectable gap under safety. The declared evaluation unit also mattered: under mixed constraints the gap reversed from $+0.374$ to $-0.206$ when weighting shifted from image to lesion-aware cluster. AuthEval thus clarifies whether a study's records support claims about the model, the workflow, or both.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AuthEval 日志与评估框架，区分"模型建议质量"与"本地选定动作质量"，仅在记录支持时报告二者之间的 authority gap，并在 ISIC 2019 上验证该 gap 的大小与符号同时受约束机制和评估单元影响。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型只能对皮肤病变的复诊紧急度提出建议，最终动作由本地服务依据转诊政策、产能与本地患者情境决定是否采纳或替换。因此建议质量与选定动作质量是两类不同的评估目标，基准证据只有在本地复核保持预期动作得分时才能相互迁移；现有评估缺乏区分与量化这种差异的工具。
AI.method: 提出 AuthEval 日志与评估框架：同时记录提议动作与选定动作；按声明的本地准则为选定动作打分；在可行时用同一准则为被拒绝的提议打分；仅在记录支持时报告 authority gap。分析上将其分解为提议改变率与改变案例上平均得分变化的乘积。
AI.result: 在 ISIC 2019 上使用 MedGemma 与模拟本地复核：两种改变率相近的约束机制，在产能约束下产生乐观的 image-equal gap（+0.744 模拟器单位），而在安全约束下无可检测 gap。评估单元亦有影响：混合约束下，加权由图像转为 lesion-aware cluster 时，gap 由 +0.374 反转为 −0.206。
AI.conclusion: authority gap 的大小与符号不能由改变率单独决定；机制与评估单元共同塑造结论。AuthEval 可明确一项研究的记录究竟支持关于模型的、关于工作流的，还是两者的主张。

title: Efficient Reasoning Distillation: Small Video-Language Models via Synthetic CoT and Difficulty-Aware Fine-Tuning
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Published in MultiMedia Modeling (MMM 2026), LNCS 16412
summary: We present an efficient method to distill reasoning capabilities into compact video-language models (VLMs) for video question answering (VideoQA). Our approach fine-tunes a 2B-parameter model using only $\sim$900 uncertainty-selected examples, each augmented with synthetic chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales generated by a 4B teacher. Despite its minimal compute cost - under two hours on a single A100 GPU - our method enables the 2B model to outperform VLMs up to 4$\times$ larger, and generalize across CinePile, ActivityNet-QA, and MLVU, approaching the performance of its own 4B teacher. A key finding is that placing CoT rationales after the answer - contrary to standard prompting - substantially improves reasoning in compact models. This insight challenges prevailing CoT conventions and reveals new alignment strategies under limited model capacity. Our findings offer a practical blueprint for training deployable, reasoning-rich VLMs suited for mobile and edge applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效蒸馏方法，用约900个不确定性筛选样本和4B教师生成的合成CoT，将推理能力注入2B视频语言模型，性能超越最大4倍参数量的VLM，并发现"答案后的CoT"优于标准前置CoT。
AI.motivation: 面向移动与边缘部署场景，现有大型VLM推理能力强但算力开销高；需要以极低算力成本将推理能力蒸馏到紧凑视频语言模型中，用于VideoQA任务。
AI.method: 以2B参数的视频语言模型为学生，用4B教师模型生成合成思维链（CoT）理由；仅用约900个经不确定性筛选的样本进行微调，每条样本附加合成CoT；关键设计是将CoT理由置于答案之后而非标准的前置位置；整个训练在单张A100上耗时不到两小时。
AI.result: 2B模型性能超过参数量最多4倍的VLM，在CinePile、ActivityNet-QA和MLVU上具备泛化性，并接近其4B教师的表现；答案后置CoT的设计在紧凑模型中显著提升推理效果。
AI.conclusion: 该结果挑战了主流CoT范式，揭示了有限模型容量下的新对齐策略，为训练可部署、推理能力强的移动端与边缘端VLM提供了实用蓝图。

title: The record is part of the task: matched-record evaluation of text classifiers across maintenance, safety and recall reporting
comment: 37 pages (18-page article, 3 tables, 7 figures, plus a 19-page supplement with tables and figures numbered S1 onward)
summary: Many operational cases are documented more than once, at different workflow stages and for different purposes, yet model evaluations normally select one of these records before model comparison begins. We treat that selection as part of the evaluation and compare matched records of the same cases under fixed labels and splits in three systems: GE Aerospace repair events, NASA ASRS safety reports and NHTSA vehicle recalls. The design fixes, for any decision a classifier would support, the records that existed and could be read when it was taken, and compares them retrospectively, as written. Across the three GE fields, for events whose label comes from parts transactions independently of the narratives, held-out macro-F1 ranged from 0.33 to 0.91. A difference of 0.46 separated the customer report, written before shop work, from the technician report, written after diagnosis but before the transaction that generates the label. That difference is substantially larger than the representation and architecture differences tested on the same events. The public systems showed different patterns: the NHTSA defect summary remained strongest under every model family tested, whereas the ASRS analyst synopsis outperformed the reporter narrative under learned sequence models but not under lexical baselines. Secondary analyses showed that some model comparisons were also record-dependent. Evaluations should be run on the information available at the intended decision point and should report how both the record and the label were produced.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将"记录选择"纳入模型评估流程，利用GE航空维修事件、NASA ASRS安全报告和NHTSA车辆召回三个系统，在固定标签与划分下比较同一案例的匹配记录。结果显示记录选择带来的性能差异（GE字段宏F1差达0.46）远大于表示与架构差异，且模型比较本身也可能是记录依赖的。
AI.motivation: 现实中的运营案例常在不同工作流阶段、为不同目的被多次记录，但模型评估通常在比较开始前就选定其中一条记录，把选择当作既定前提而非评估的一部分。作者认为这一选择会显著影响结论，需要被显式地纳入评估设计。
AI.method: 将记录选择视为评估的一部分：在固定标签和固定数据划分条件下，比较同一案例的匹配记录。覆盖三个系统——GE航空维修事件、NASA ASRS安全报告、NHTSA车辆召回。实验设计固定"分类器做决策时已存在且可读"的记录，按原始文本进行回顾式比较。GE部分使用来自零件交易、独立于叙述文本的标签，以排除标签泄漏对记录比较的干扰。
AI.result: GE三个字段中，留出集宏F1范围为0.33至0.91。客户报告（车间作业前撰写）与技术员报告（诊断后、但在生成标签的交易之前撰写）之间相差0.46，远大于在同一批事件上测试的表示与架构差异。公开系统呈现不同模式：NHTSA缺陷摘要在所有测试的模型族下均最强；ASRS分析师摘要则在基于学习的序列模型下优于报告者叙述，但在词法基线中不占优。二次分析表明部分模型比较同样具有记录依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 评估应在预期决策点可获得的信息上进行，并应同时报告记录与标签的生成方式。记录选择不是中性的预处理步骤，而是评估设计中影响可比性的关键变量。

title: Spurious Tool Use: When RL Agents Learn the Wrong Reason to Act
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interleave natural language reasoning with external tools such as web search and code execution. These tool-use policies are often optimized via reinforcement learning (RL), which can amplify spurious correlations in the training data. In this work, we study when and why RL-trained agents learn shortcut tool-selection policies: invoking tools based on superficial prompt cues rather than genuine task requirements. We construct controlled synthetic environments combining factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks, and inject cues that are strongly correlated with specific tools during training but causally irrelevant to tool necessity. Across counterfactual evaluations where cues are present but the associated tools are not required, agents exhibit substantial shortcut behavior, with spurious tool invocation rates increasing by up to 39 percent. However, shortcut formation is not universal: across the conditions we test, it arises only when the agent has already learned to use the target tool reliably, suggesting that task competence, rather than dataset imbalance alone, is a key factor in shortcut learning. A swapped-cue analysis further shows that semantic alignment between cues and tools substantially amplifies this effect. To mitigate these failures, we introduce a dense, decision-level reward in which an LLM judge evaluates the necessity of each tool call. This tool-necessity reward effectively suppresses cue-driven tool use while preserving task performance, providing a practical approach to improving the robustness of LLM agent tool-use policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RL训练的大模型智能体为何会习得"捷径式"工具选择策略，发现该现象仅在智能体已掌握目标工具时出现，并可通过基于LLM评判的工具必要性稠密奖励有效抑制。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地将自然语言推理与外部工具（搜索、代码执行）交织使用，这类工具使用策略常通过强化学习优化，而RL会放大训练数据中的虚假相关。作者希望弄清RL训练智能体何时、为何会学到捷径式工具选择策略——即依据表层提示线索而非真实任务需求来调用工具。
AI.method: 构建受控合成环境，融合事实问答与数学推理任务，在训练中注入与特定工具强相关但对工具必要性无因果作用的线索；开展反事实评估（线索存在但无需该工具）与交换线索分析；并提出一种稠密的决策级奖励，由LLM评判者评估每次工具调用的必要性。
AI.result: 在反事实评估中，智能体表现出显著的捷径行为，虚假工具调用率最高提升39个百分点。捷径形成并非普遍现象：仅当智能体已可靠掌握目标工具时才出现，说明任务能力而非单纯数据不平衡是关键因素。交换线索分析显示，线索与工具之间的语义一致性会显著放大该效应。工具必要性奖励能有效抑制线索驱动的工具使用，同时保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: RL训练的智能体确实会习得捷径式工具选择策略，其形成依赖已有的工具使用能力，并被线索-工具的语义对齐放大；引入基于LLM评判的工具必要性稠密奖励是提升LLM智能体工具使用策略鲁棒性的实用方案。

title: ProtoLIP: From Sentence-Level to Object-Level Evidence Disentanglement
summary: Query-conditioned vision-language models enable fine-grained interpretation by revealing which visual content supports a given textual query and how this evidence changes across queries. However, semantically, sentence-level evidence does not necessarily decompose into object-specific contributions, while spatially, object-level evidence can remain entangled with co-occurring objects and surrounding scene context. Across multiple VLM architectures and independent benchmarks, we observe persistent object-level evidence entanglement. Moreover, exposed evidence maps do not necessarily correspond to the evidence that directly constitutes the model's prediction. To disentangle visual evidence at both semantic and spatial levels, we introduce ProtoLIP, a lightweight prototype-mediated evidence layer that organizes reusable visual prototypes into text-derived semantic families and uses coarse-to-fine evidence routing, where semantic families constrain prototype eligibility and the complete query determines fine-grained prototype contributions. Our studies show that ProtoLIP improves evidence localization and separation across query granularities, achieving average relative gains of 29% in Pointing and 43% in Energy across four object- and phrase-level OOD benchmarks. Its localization gains also transfer to independently pretrained VLMs, with larger improvements observed in several transfer settings. On the primary backbone, ProtoLIP also improves image-text matching discrimination while remaining competitive with a spatially supervised grounding model in object-level localization. Crucially, ProtoLIP constructs its image-text matching score directly from localized prototype evidence, enabling exact decomposition across prototypes, semantic families, and spatial evidence without spatial annotations or backbone retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProtoLIP，一种轻量级的原型中介证据层，通过文本导出的语义家族与由粗到细的证据路由，在语义与空间两个层面解耦视觉证据，提升多粒度证据定位与分离能力。
AI.motivation: 现有查询条件视觉语言模型存在"对象级证据纠缠"问题：语义上，句子级证据难以分解为对象特定贡献；空间上，对象级证据常与共现物体及场景上下文纠缠。此外，暴露的证据图未必等同于真正构成模型预测的证据。
AI.method: ProtoLIP构建可复用视觉原型，并将其组织为文本导出的语义家族；采用由粗到细的证据路由：语义家族约束原型候选资格，完整查询决定细粒度原型贡献。图像-文本匹配分数直接由定位后的原型证据构建，无需空间标注或骨干网络重训练。
AI.result: 在四个对象级与短语级OOD基准上，Pointing平均相对提升29%，Energy提升43%；定位增益可迁移到独立预训练的VLM，部分迁移设置提升更大；在主骨干上提升图文匹配判别力，并在对象级定位上媲美空间监督的grounding模型。
AI.conclusion: ProtoLIP通过原型中介的证据路由实现语义与空间层面的证据解耦，支持跨原型、语义家族与空间证据的精确分解，且无需空间标注或骨干重训练。

title: CLEAR: Cross-Source Evidence Adjudication for Large Language Models in Medicine
summary: Medical knowledge evolves continuously, whereas the parametric knowledge encoded in large language models (LLMs) is fixed at training time. External retrieval, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), can provide access to newly available evidence, but retrieved information may be irrelevant, incomplete, or conflicting. As a result, external retrieval can in turn degrade the factual accuracy and evidence grounding of LLM outputs. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{CLEAR}, an agentic framework for cross-source evidence adjudication in LLMs in medicine. CLEAR independently generates candidate answers from three complementary pathways---parametric knowledge, locally curated corpora, and dynamically retrieved evidence---reflecting three common sources of information available to LLMs. An aggregation verifier jointly evaluates the candidates, supporting evidence, provenance, and source-quality information to identify agreement and conflict across sources. An adjudication module then determines whether the current conclusion should be preserved or revised through complementary override-guard and challenge-audit mechanisms, while unresolved conflicts trigger targeted follow-up search and re-adjudication.

AI.tldr: 提出CLEAR：一个用于医学LLM跨源证据裁决的智能体框架，通过三路候选生成、聚合验证与裁决机制（override-guard、challenge-audit）以及冲突触发的定向再检索，缓解外部检索带来的不相关、不完整或冲突信息问题。
AI.motivation: 医学知识持续演进，而LLM的参数化知识固定在训练时刻；外部检索（含RAG）虽可引入新证据，但检索信息可能不相关、不完整或相互冲突，反而损害LLM输出的事实准确性与证据支撑性。需要一种机制对多源证据进行裁决。
AI.method: CLEAR智能体框架：1）从三条互补路径独立生成候选答案——参数化知识、本地精选语料、动态检索证据；2）聚合验证器联合评估候选答案、支撑证据、来源溯源与来源质量信息，识别跨源一致与冲突；3）裁决模块通过互补的override-guard与challenge-audit机制判定结论应保留还是修订；4）未解决冲突触发定向跟进检索与再裁决。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果或实验数据，未报告数据集、基线对比与性能指标。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR以多源候选生成、联合验证与冲突感知的迭代裁决为核心，旨在提升医学场景下LLM输出的事实准确性与证据可溯源性，并具备对未决冲突的持续追问能力。

title: BLINDSPOT: A Benchmark for Safety and Refusal Calibration in Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long-horizon interactions involving tool use, persistent state, evolving authorization, and external environment feedback. In such settings, safety failures may emerge only after multiple turns, yet existing evaluations often reduce agent behavior to task or attack success, obscuring whether an agent acts, refuses, or remains appropriately calibrated as the interaction evolves. We introduce Blindspot, a benchmark for trajectory-level safety calibration of long-horizon tool-using agents. Blindspot evaluates complete user-agent-environment trajectories through adaptive adversarial interaction, stateful tool execution, and execution-grounded adjudication. Its current instantiation contains 22 attack families and 35 scenarios across seven domains, yielding more than 2,500 long-horizon trajectories with an average interaction length of 14.7 turns. Each trajectory is assigned one of five outcomes: Safe Completion, Correct Refusal, Unsafe Completion, Over-Refusal, or Indeterminate. Unlike fixed attack datasets, Blindspot is an extensible live-simulation framework in which attacks, scenarios, tools, policies, domains, and agent configurations can be added without redesigning the evaluation pipeline. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs using eight metrics covering unsafe completion, appropriate refusal, benign utility, over-refusal, repeated-run robustness, and post-refusal failure. Preliminary results reveal substantial differences in safety-utility calibration across models and show that failures can emerge only after several initially safe interaction steps. These findings motivate treating agent safety as a trajectory-level property rather than a single-turn or binary success criterion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BlindSpot 基准，用于长时程工具型 LLM 智能体的轨迹级安全校准评估，通过自适应对抗交互、有状态工具执行与执行落地裁定，将每条完整轨迹判定为五类结果之一，并揭示安全失效可能仅在多轮安全交互后才出现。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多将智能体行为简化为任务成功或攻击成功，难以刻画智能体在长时程交互中是否行动、拒绝或保持恰当校准；而工具使用、持久状态、动态授权与环境反馈使安全失效可能延迟到多轮之后才显现，因此需要轨迹级的安全评估视角。
AI.method: BlindSpot 采用自适应对抗交互、有状态工具执行与执行落地裁定，对完整的用户—智能体—环境轨迹进行评估。当前实例包含 7 个领域、22 类攻击族、35 个场景，生成 2500+ 条长时程轨迹，平均交互长度 14.7 轮。每条轨迹被判定为 Safe Completion、Correct Refusal、Unsafe Completion、Over-Refusal 或 Indeterminate 五类结果之一。框架为可扩展的实时仿真系统，支持在不重构评估流程的前提下新增攻击、场景、工具、策略、领域与智能体配置。
AI.result: 使用覆盖不安全完成、恰当拒绝、良性效用、过度拒绝、重复运行鲁棒性与拒绝后失效等八项指标，评估了 13 个闭源与开源权重 LLM。初步结果显示不同模型在安全—效用校准上存在显著差异，且失效可能仅在若干初始安全交互步骤之后才出现。
AI.conclusion: 应将智能体安全视为轨迹级属性，而非单轮或二元成功标准；BlindSpot 为长时程工具型智能体的安全校准提供了可扩展的评估框架与实证依据。

title: Sequence Recognition in Bharatnatyam dance
comment: Accepted at 7th International Conference on Computer Vision and Image Processing (CVIP), 2022
summary: Bharatanatyam is the oldest Indian Classical Dance (ICD) which is learned and practiced across India and the world. Adavu is the core of this dance form. There exist 15 Adavus and 58 variations. Each Adavu variation comprises a well-defined set of motions and postures (called dance steps) that occur in a particular order. So, while learning Adavus, students not only learn the dance steps but also take care of its sequence of occurrences. This paper proposed a method to recognize these sequences. In this work, firstly, we recognize the involved Key Postures (KPs) and motions in the Adavu using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM), respectively. In this, CNN achieves 99% and SVM's recognition accuracy becomes 84%. Next, we compare these KP and motion sequences with the ground truth to find the best match using the Edit Distance algorithm with an accuracy of 98%.
