The paper contributes hugely to the state-of-the-art in the form of digital heritage, dance tutoring system, and many more. The paper addresses three novelties; (a) Recognizing the sequences based on the KPs and motions rather than only KPs as reported in the earlier works. (b) The performance of the proposed work is measured by analyzing the prediction time per sequence. We also compare our proposed approach with the previous works that deal with the same problem statement. (c) It tests the scalability of the proposed approach by including all the Adavu variations, unlike the earlier literature, which uses only one/two variations.

AI.tldr: 提出结合CNN识别关键姿态、SVM识别动作，并用编辑距离算法比对序列的Bharatanatyam Adavu动作序列识别方法，序列匹配准确率达98%。
AI.motivation: Bharatanatyam是最古老的印度古典舞，Adavu是其核心，包含15种Adavu及58种变体，每种变体由按特定顺序发生的动作与姿态（舞步）构成。学生不仅要学习舞步，还要掌握其出现顺序。已有工作仅基于关键姿态识别，忽略动作与序列信息，且通常只使用一两种变体，难以满足数字遗产保护与舞蹈教学系统等应用需求。
AI.method: 首先分别用卷积神经网络（CNN）识别Adavu中的关键姿态（KPs），用支持向量机（SVM）识别动作（motions）；随后将得到的KP序列与动作序列同真实标注（ground truth）进行比对，采用编辑距离（Edit Distance）算法寻找最佳匹配。此外，通过分析每条序列的预测时间衡量性能，并与处理同一问题的既有工作进行对比，且在全部Adavu变体上测试方法的可扩展性。
AI.result: CNN的关键姿态识别准确率达99%，SVM的动作识别准确率为84%；采用编辑距离算法进行序列最佳匹配的准确率为98%。同时对每条序列的预测时间进行了分析，并与已有工作进行对比，且在包含全部Adavu变体的条件下验证了可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出三项创新：(a) 同时基于关键姿态与动作识别序列，而非仅依赖关键姿态；(b) 以每条序列的预测时间衡量性能，并与同类问题既有方法对比；(c) 纳入全部Adavu变体以测试可扩展性，而非仅用一两种变体。研究在数字遗产、舞蹈教学系统等方面具有重要贡献。

title: Racing in Volume with Flow Ensembles
summary: Streaming 4D reconstruction has been demonstrated only indoors, on dense camera rigs surrounding subjects that move at human pace. Outdoor 4D reconstruction exists but relies either on cameras mounted on the moving vehicle itself, or on limited-coverage arrays observing quasi-static subjects offline. The case that actually matters for spectators is a fast-moving subject, watched from a sparse ring of allocentric cameras, streaming. No method targets this, and no benchmark exists to evaluate one. To this end, we introduce FastFlowGS, a streaming 4D Gaussian Splatting method for reconstructing fast-moving subjects from a small set of fixed external cameras, and Monaco4D, a photorealistic Unreal Engine 5 benchmark for high-speed outdoor reconstruction. FastFlowGS fuses sparse matches, semi-dense tracks, and dense optical flow by lifting each signal to 3D with geometric uncertainty and combining them through a Kalman-style temporal update. Monaco4D provides Formula 1 sequences under varied illumination from trackside, onboard, and drone viewpoints with dense ground truth. On CMU-Panoptic, FastFlowGS exceeds the strongest baseline by 12.6% VMAF at 35% greater efficiency. On Monaco4D, where existing streaming methods degrade severely, it improves dynamic-region PSNR by up to 18.6% with 28.3% lower per-frame optimization time. Dataset and additional details can be found at https://humansensinglab.github.io/monaco4d/.

AI.tldr: 提出流式4D高斯泼溅方法FastFlowGS与高速户外重建基准Monaco4D，解决稀疏外部相机下快速运动目标的流式4D重建问题。
AI.motivation: 现有流式4D重建仅限室内密集相机环、目标按人类速度运动；户外方案依赖车载相机或有限覆盖阵列离线观测准静态目标。观众真正关心的是：稀疏非自我中心相机环下对快速运动目标的流式重建，而当前无方法与基准针对该场景。
AI.method: FastFlowGS将稀疏匹配、半稠密轨迹与稠密光流分别以几何不确定性提升到3D，并通过Kalman式时序更新进行融合；同时构建Monaco4D——基于Unreal Engine 5的高保真高速户外重建基准，提供多光照条件下赛道边、车载与无人机视角的F1序列及稠密真值。
AI.result: 在CMU-Panoptic上，FastFlowGS以35%更高效率超越最强基线12.6% VMAF；在Monaco4D上，现有流式方法严重退化，而该方法将动态区域PSNR最多提升18.6%，每帧优化时间降低28.3%。
AI.conclusion: FastFlowGS与Monaco4D填补了稀疏非自我中心相机流式高速4D重建的方法与基准空白，在精度与效率上均显著优于现有方案。

title: Efficient One-to-Many Translation with Joint Multi-Stream Diffusion
summary: One-to-many machine translation (MT) is computationally expensive for autoregressive (AR) systems, which suffer from linear latency scaling with both sequence length and the number of target languages. We explore how diffusion can enable multilingual translation with a discrete diffusion framework that refines all target languages in parallel, achieving sublinear latency scaling with the number of targets, and supports deployment as a single unified model to replace multiple independent systems. Conditioned on a continuous semantic anchor rather than source tokens, our framework supports zero-shot transfer to unseen source languages without retraining, maintaining approximately $75\%$ of its supervised translation quality on zero-shot sources. We investigate the quality-latency frontier and find that with accelerated sampling, it achieves comparable supervised quality to AR baselines with a $2 \times$ speedup and $11.9\%$ better zero-shot BLEU. These results highlight the potential of joint multi-stream diffusion as a practical and flexible alternative for efficient one-to-many translation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于离散扩散的多语言（一对多）翻译框架，所有目标语言并行细化，实现亚线性延迟扩展，并支持零样本语言迁移。
AI.motivation: 自回归（AR）一对多机器翻译存在计算瓶颈：延迟随序列长度和目标语言数量线性增长，且多语言部署通常需要多个独立模型。
AI.method: 采用离散扩散框架，并行细化所有目标语言；以连续语义锚点（而非源语言token）为条件，从而无需重训即可零样本迁移至未见源语言；并使用加速采样以改善质量-延迟权衡。
AI.result: 延迟随目标数量呈亚线性扩展；单一统一模型可替代多个独立系统；零样本源语言上保留约75%的有监督翻译质量；加速采样下达到与AR基线相当的有监督质量且提速2倍，零样本BLEU提升11.9%。
AI.conclusion: 联合多流扩散是一对多翻译中实用且灵活的替代方案，兼具效率与灵活性。

title: ConGraspXL: Controllable Constraint-Conditioned Dexterous Grasping Motion Synthesis
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Dexterous grasping is usually conducted for specific tasks, leading to heterogeneous constraints such as specific approach directions, desired contact regions, specified wrist trajectories, and functional hand poses. Our previous work, GraspXL, achieves scalable grasping motion synthesis for diverse objects and hand morphologies, while lacking controllability for synthesis under such various task-driven constraints. In this paper, we propose ConGraspXL, which extends GraspXL with controllable constraint-conditioned grasp motion synthesis that accommodates diverse task-driven constraints and their combinations. We introduce a hierarchical constraint formulation, enable flexible constraint composition with a masked residual interface, and improve control precision with dynamic hand centers and feed-forward wrist guidance. Without losing the strong generalization capabilities of GraspXL, ConGraspXL enables precise and flexible controllability for various individual constraints and their combinations, providing a plug-and-play low-level grasp controller for downstream applications such as whole-body grasp completion, functional grasping, and human-motion imitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConGraspXL，在GraspXL基础上扩展出可控、约束条件的抓取动作合成框架，可处理多种任务驱动约束及其组合，并作为即插即用的底层抓取控制器。
AI.motivation: 灵巧抓取通常面向特定任务，需满足接近方向、期望接触区域、腕部轨迹、功能性手部姿态等异构约束。已有GraspXL虽能对多样物体和手部形态进行可扩展的抓取动作合成，但缺乏在这些任务驱动约束下合成的可控性。
AI.method: ConGraspXL在GraspXL基础上引入层次化约束表述，通过掩码残差接口实现灵活的约束组合，并利用动态手部中心和前馈腕部引导提升控制精度。
AI.result: 在不损失GraspXL强泛化能力的前提下，ConGraspXL对各类单独约束及其组合实现了精确且灵活的可控性。
AI.conclusion: ConGraspXL可作为即插即用的底层抓取控制器，服务于全身抓取补全、功能性抓取和人体动作模仿等下游应用。

title: Temporal-Attention Head Specialization During Video Diffusion Training
summary: Video diffusion transformers depend on temporal attention to coordinate information across frames, yet nearly everything known about this mechanism comes from analyzing trained models, so when and where temporal-attention structure forms during training remains poorly characterized. Population averages can also hide it, since a few specializing heads and a diffusing majority cancel in the mean. We therefore conduct a checkpoint-resolved census of every temporal-attention head across nine Open-Sora STDiT training runs spanning three model scales (306M to 1.03B parameters), scoring each head with an entropy-normalized measure of cross-frame attention concentration (CFAC) under a preregistered change-point and effect-size selection rule. The census reveals the sparse picture that averages obscure. Aggregate CFAC is flat or decreasing in every run, while a small minority of heads, roughly 4--13% in full-grid runs, develops pronounced concentration. Across seeds, the reproducible signal is positional but block-level. Selected heads repeatedly arise in the first temporal block, whereas individual head coordinates do not reproduce once block membership is accounted for. Among the analyzed 760M selected heads, attention maps converge to a small repertoire of local frame-routing motifs, self-frame diagonals and adjacent-frame bands, even when the responsible coordinates differ across runs. Correlation and ablation analyses do not establish a causal link to generated video quality, and we bound our claims accordingly. Beyond this STDiT family, the study contributes a transferable methodology. Checkpoint-resolved, per-head analysis under fixed selection rules can expose sparse temporal organization in other factorized video diffusion transformers and, with adapted routing metrics, in joint spatio-temporal architectures.

AI.tldr: 对九次Open-Sora STDiT训练（306M–1.03B）逐checkpoint普查所有时序注意力头，发现总体平均CFAC平坦或下降，仅少数头（约4–13%）形成集中跨帧注意；可复现信号是块级位置性（首个时序块），头坐标不可复现，注意力图收敛为局部帧路由模式，且与生成质量无因果证据。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer依赖时序注意力跨帧协调信息，但已有认识几乎全部来自对训练完成模型的分析，训练过程中时序注意力结构何时、何处形成仍缺乏刻画；同时总体平均会掩盖结构，因为少数专门化头与大量扩散头在均值中相互抵消。
AI.method: 对九个Open-Sora STDiT训练运行（三种规模，306M–1.03B参数）的每个时序注意力头进行checkpoint级普查；用熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度（CFAC）为每个头打分，并采用预注册的变化点与效应量选择规则。
AI.result: 总体CFAC在所有运行中平坦或下降，而少数头（全网格运行中约4–13%）出现显著集中。跨随机种子，可复现信号是位置性的但为块级：被选中的头反复出现在第一个时序块，而一旦考虑块归属，单个头坐标不可复现。在760M的被选头中，注意力图收敛为少量局部帧路由模式（自帧对角线与相邻帧带），即使负责的坐标在不同运行中不同。相关性与消融分析未建立与生成视频质量的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了稀疏的时序组织图景，并贡献了可迁移方法：在固定选择规则下进行checkpoint级、逐头分析，可揭示其他因子化视频扩散Transformer中的稀疏时序组织；在适配路由度量后，也可用于联合时空架构。

title: StalePO: Anchored Token-Level Preference Optimization using Legacy Post-Edits in Machine Translation
comment: Accepted to the 11th Conference on Machine Translation (WMT 2026)
summary: Machine translation systems are periodically upgraded to stronger models, but the available preference signal is human post-edits of an older system's outputs, which the newer model may already surpass. Moreover, collecting fresh post-edits for every new model is prohibitively expensive. We call this the Stale Preference problem. Standard DPO can fail in this setting: it may increase the likelihood of inferior post-edits, erode the model's existing quality, and fail to provide the per-token control needed to correct localized errors. We introduce StalePO, an objective derived from three requirements this regime imposes. Likelihood movement must be downward on both responses, the policy must be anchored to its own base response, and the KL constraint must apply at the token level. These requirements are jointly necessary. In ablations, each mechanism in isolation leaves the model's performance indistinguishable from the base model, and only their combination converts stale feedback into gains. On English-to-Hindi and English-to-Turkish localization data, StalePO improves the fraction of segments passing all LLM-as-judge MQM quality checks by 14.9 and 4.6 percentage points, respectively, with gains concentrated on style and fluency. A human evaluation under the same framework confirms these gains on English-to-Hindi, raising the fraction of segments passing all seven human checks by 13.8 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StalePO 方法,解决偏好数据陈旧问题,在机器翻译局部化场景中显著提升质量检查通过率。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译系统定期升级为更强模型,但可用的偏好信号是基于旧系统输出的人工后编辑,新模型可能已超越这些编辑;而为每个新模型收集新后编辑成本过高,即"陈旧偏好"(Stale Preference)问题。标准 DPO 在此设置下可能失效:它会提升劣质后编辑的似然、侵蚀模型已有质量,且缺乏纠正局部错误所需的逐 token 控制。
AI.method: 提出 StalePO,该目标由该场景下三个要求推导而来:似然移动必须在两个响应上都向下、策略必须锚定在其自身的基础响应上、KL 约束必须在 token 级别施加。这三个要求联合必要;消融实验显示单独使用任一机制都无法使性能区别于基础模型,只有三者结合才能将陈旧反馈转化为增益。
AI.result: 在英语到印地语和英语到土耳其语的局部化数据上,StalePO 分别将同时通过所有 LLM-as-judge MQM 质量检查的片段比例提升了 14.9 和 4.6 个百分点,增益集中在风格和流畅度方面。在相同框架下的人工评估也确认了英语到印地语的增益,将同时通过全部七项人工检查的片段比例提升了 13.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: StalePO 通过联合满足三项要求,有效将陈旧的人类后编辑偏好信号转化为机器翻译模型的质量增益,在自动与人工评估中均得到验证。

title: Mini-batch Sampling Strategies for Long-Tailed Image Classification: An Empirical Study on CIFAR-100-LT
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures, 17 tables. Code and per-run logs: https://github.com/SiyuYuan0117/longtail-sampling
summary: Real-world datasets often exhibit long-tailed class distributions, where a few head classes contain a large number of training samples while a large number of tail classes have only a few. The composition of each mini-batch, determined by the sampling strategy, governs which classes contribute to the stochastic gradient estimate, and therefore affects convergence behaviour and generalisation across the whole class spectrum. We provide a systematic theoretical and empirical comparison of four mini-batch sampling strategies for long-tailed image classification: uniform instance sampling, class-balanced sampling, square-root sampling, and progressively balanced sampling. We place all four in a unified bias-variance framework describing their effect on gradient estimation, which exposes the tension between unbiased optimisation of the empirical loss and fair representation of rare classes. We then evaluate them under controlled conditions using ResNet-32 on CIFAR-100-LT at three imbalance ratios (rho = 10, 50, 100), with every strategy sharing the same long-tailed subsets and initialisation within a seed. Progressive sampling improves tail-class accuracy by 25% relative to the uniform baseline at rho = 100 (13.5% versus 10.8%), consistently across all three seeds, while its overall accuracy is not distinguishable from that of uniform sampling given the seed-to-seed variation (40.0% versus 39.7%); the tail-class gain, not the overall gain, is the robust effect. At rho = 100, class-balanced sampling degrades accuracy on every class group, including the tail classes it is designed to help, which we attribute to overfitting caused by extreme oversampling of scarce data; at rho = 50 this failure is confined to head and medium classes. These results indicate that when rebalancing is applied during training matters as much as how much rebalancing is applied.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了长尾图像分类中四种小批量采样策略（均匀实例采样、类平衡采样、平方根采样、渐进平衡采样），在统一偏差-方差框架下分析其对梯度估计的影响，并用ResNet-32在CIFAR-100-LT（rho=10/50/100）上验证。渐进采样在rho=100时将尾部类准确率提升25%，但总体准确率提升不显著；类平衡采样反而因过度过采样导致过拟合而全面退化。
AI.motivation: 现实数据集常呈长尾类分布，少量头部类样本充足、大量尾部类样本稀缺。小批量组成由采样策略决定，进而影响哪些类参与随机梯度估计，关系到收敛行为与全谱类泛化。然而，关于各采样策略在长尾场景下效果的系统性理论与实证对比尚不充分，尤其在"如何采样"与"何时再平衡"的权衡上缺乏清晰认识。
AI.method: 作者提出统一的偏差-方差框架，刻画四种采样策略（均匀实例采样、类平衡采样、平方根采样、渐进平衡采样）对梯度估计的影响，揭示"经验损失无偏优化"与"稀有类公平表示"之间的张力。随后在受控条件下，用ResNet-32在CIFAR-100-LT上以三种不平衡比率（rho=10、50、100）进行实验，所有策略在同一随机种子内共享相同长尾子集与初始化，并以三个种子评估稳定性。
AI.result: 在rho=100时，渐进采样将尾部类准确率相对均匀基线提升25%（13.5% vs 10.8%），三个种子下一致；但其总体准确率与均匀采样在种子间波动下难以区分（40.0% vs 39.7%），说明稳健效应来自尾部类增益而非总体增益。在rho=100时，类平衡采样在所有类组上均导致准确率下降，包括其本应帮助的尾部类，作者归因于对稀缺数据的极端过采样引发过拟合；在rho=50时该退化仅限于头部和中部类。
AI.conclusion: 在长尾分类中，训练过程中"何时施加再平衡"与"施加多少再平衡"同样重要。渐进采样的收益主要体现在尾部类而非总体准确率，类平衡采样因过度过采样易过拟合而失效，表明再平衡策略的时序安排是关键设计维度。

title: How Humans and LLMs Read Gender into "Gender-Neutral" Physical Descriptions
comment: The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Yingjia-Wan/GAPA, and the predictor model is released at https://huggingface.co/alisa-yingjia-wan/gapa-predictor-olmo2-7b
summary: When foundation models describe people, recent work in AI fairness, accessibility, and ethics recommends avoiding inferred identity labels (e.g., "she", "his") in favor of seemingly "objective" physical descriptions (e.g., "short hair", "a defined jawline"). Yet whether such descriptive language achieves gender-neutral communication remains an open empirical question. To study this, we introduce GAPA (Gender Associations of Physical Attributes), a dataset of 316 common physical attributes drawn from diverse sources, paired with 14,706 gender-association ratings from 304 US-based annotators. Results show that physical descriptions carry structured and graded gender associations among readers, with more consistent and distinctive associations for women and men than for non-binary identities. Next, we evaluate 16 LLMs across model families, sizes, and post-training variants against human ratings. The models partially recover human associations but exhibit systematic alignment biases, including compressed rating distributions, weaker alignment for associations with men, and asymmetric abstention that disproportionately targets the non-binary category. Finally, we release the best-performing proxy model trained to predict humans' gender associations of descriptive language and demonstrate its utility through a sociolinguistic analysis of character descriptions in LitBank. Together, our findings provide the first empirical evidence that seemingly "objective" physical descriptions can retain systematic gender associations in human interpretation, and uncover systematic patterns of model-human misalignment. This challenges the assumption that replacing explicit gender labels with physical descriptions necessarily yields gender-neutral communication, and highlights downstream challenges in using such descriptions to communicate subjective identity categories in human-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAPA数据集（316个物理属性，14,706条性别关联评分，304名美国标注者），实证表明看似"客观"的物理描述在读者心中仍带有结构化、梯度化的性别关联；评测16个LLM发现其部分复现人类关联但存在系统性偏差；并发布最优代理模型，用于LitBank角色描述的 sociolinguistic 分析。
AI.motivation: AI公平性、无障碍与伦理领域近期建议避免使用推断性身份标签（如"她""他的"），改用看似"客观"的物理描述（如"短发""下颌线分明"）。但这类描述性语言是否真能实现性别中立沟通，仍是未解的经验问题，缺乏实证证据。
AI.method: 构建GAPA（Gender Associations of Physical Attributes）数据集：从多元来源采集316个常见物理属性，由304名美国标注者提供14,706条性别关联评分；随后对来自不同模型家族、规模与后训练变体的16个LLM进行评测，并与人类评分对比；最后训练并发布最优代理模型，用于预测人类对描述性语言的性别关联，并在LitBank角色描述上开展 sociolinguistic 分析。
AI.result: 物理描述在读者中携带结构化且梯度化的性别关联，女性与男性身份的关联更一致、更具区分度，非二元身份的关联较弱。16个LLM能部分复现人类关联，但存在系统性对齐偏差：评分分布被压缩、对男性关联的对齐更弱、且不对称弃答显著偏向非二元类别。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供实证证据表明看似"客观"的物理描述在人类解读中仍保留系统性性别关联，并揭示模型-人类对齐的系统性偏差模式。这挑战了"用物理描述替代显式性别标签即可实现性别中立沟通"的假设，并凸显在人机交互中用此类描述传达主观身份类别的下游挑战。

title: Register Tokens for Bounded-State Reasoning in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked tokens with bidirectional attention. Extending reasoning across generation chunks normally requires keeping earlier generated text in context. We ask whether a dLLM can instead continue reasoning after that text is cleared, using only a fixed-size carried state. We implement this state as a small number of register tokens: dedicated fixed-position tokens whose continuous hidden states are trained to carry reasoning progress across generation chunks. We post-train dLLMs to decode a chunk of text, clear it while preserving the register values, and continue decoding from the prompt and carried state. In our main comparisons on LLaDA and Dream, registers outperform discrete-text carry on every benchmark, with gains of up to 8.5 points on math and 19.5 points on code. Registers are especially effective for bounded code generation, where correct programs usually span several chunks. Finally, registers can be further refined with reinforcement learning on long-horizon reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出用少量register token作为跨生成块的固定大小连续状态载体，使掩码扩散语言模型在清除已生成文本后仍能延续推理，在LLaDA与Dream上刷新建模与代码基准。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过双向注意力迭代去噪掩码token生成文本。跨生成块延续推理通常需保留此前生成的文本作为上下文，这带来上下文增长与固定窗口限制的问题。本文探究dLLM能否在清除该文本、仅依赖固定大小携带状态的情况下继续推理。
AI.method: 将携带状态实现为少量register token：位于固定位置、其连续隐状态被训练用于跨生成块携带推理进度。对dLLM进行后训练：解码一个文本块，清除文本但保留register值，再从提示与携带状态继续解码。并在长时程推理任务上进一步用强化学习精炼register。
AI.result: 在LLaDA与Dream上的主要对比中，register在所有基准上均优于离散文本携带，数学最高提升8.5分，代码最高提升19.5分；在有界代码生成上尤为有效，正确程序通常跨越多个块。
AI.conclusion: 固定大小的register连续状态可替代长上文文本携带，有效支撑dLLM的跨块推理，且可通过强化学习进一步增强长时程推理能力。

title: Geometry vs Structure: Graph-Based Diagnostics for LiDAR Point-Cloud Simulation Fidelity
summary: Digital twins provide a scalable and cost-effective complement to real-world testing for validating autonomous-driving and advanced driver-assistance system (ADAS) sensor pipelines. However, quantifying their fidelity remains challenging, particularly for 3D LiDAR point clouds, where conventional geometric metrics may overlook important structural discrepancies. We present a graph-based framework for evaluating the structural fidelity of simulated LiDAR point clouds against real-world scans. While scan-level metrics such as Chamfer distance capture point-wise geometric similarity, they do not explicitly represent connectivity, topology, or object-level organization. Our framework constructs graphs from real and simulated point clouds, applies Louvain community detection to identify spatially coherent subgraphs, and matches corresponding communities using centroid proximity. For each matched pair, we compute $r_λ$, a bounded graph-spectral metric motivated by Weyl's inequality, and compare it with density-aware Chamfer distance (CDC) as a geometric baseline. Controlled perturbation experiments demonstrate that $r_λ$ is invariant to rigid transformations and robust to sensor noise while remaining sensitive to structural deformation. We evaluate the framework on 50 paired real and simulated LiDAR scans acquired using a Velodyne VLP-32C sensor and CARLA, respectively. The dataset contains more than 1,000 matched communities across four representative classes: vehicles, vegetation, trees, and building walls. The results show that geometric and structural measures capture complementary aspects of simulation fidelity, supporting graph-spectral analysis as an additional diagnostic layer for validating digital twins in ADAS and autonomous-driving applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于图的框架，通过Louvain社区检测与图谱度量r_λ评估仿真LiDAR点云的结构保真度，实验表明其与几何度量（CDC）互补，可作为数字孪生验证的额外诊断层。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生为自动驾驶与ADAS传感器管线的验证提供了可扩展、低成本的补充手段，但其保真度量化困难，尤其对3D LiDAR点云，传统几何度量可能忽略重要结构性差异（如连通性、拓扑与对象级组织）。
AI.method: 构建真实与仿真点云的图表示；采用Louvain社区检测识别空间连贯子图；基于质心邻近性匹配对应社区；对每对匹配社区计算受Weyl不等式启发的有界图谱度量r_λ，并与密度感知Chamfer距离（CDC）几何基线对比。通过受控扰动实验验证度量特性。
AI.result: 受控扰动实验显示r_λ对刚性变换不变、对传感器噪声鲁棒，同时对结构形变敏感。在50对真实（Velodyne VLP-32C）与仿真（CARLA）LiDAR扫描上评估，数据集涵盖车辆、植被、树木、建筑墙面四类，超过1000对匹配社区。结果表明几何与结构度量捕捉仿真保真度的互补方面。
AI.conclusion: 图谱分析可作为数字孪生验证的附加诊断层，补充现有几何度量，服务于ADAS与自动驾驶应用中的仿真保真度评估。

title: Attention Mean Fields Predict Average Representation Dynamics and Reveal Context-Specific Computation
summary: A language model's representation geometry is not predetermined; it evolves as the model runs. A faithful account of that geometry must capture that dynamic process, and so cannot be based solely on model-independent statistics such as co-occurrence. Here we introduce a mean-field analysis of attention. The average attention from one token to another defines a kernel that carries representations layer to layer and can be iterated through the network to model how the geometry is transformed. We condition this average two ways. Conditioned on a whole corpus, the kernel predicts the average-case evolution of representation geometry. Conditioned instead on a single context, it predicts the expected geometry for that context. A head's departure from that prediction, its \emph{mean-field deviation}, isolates the context-specific computation that the mean field misses. Under the corpus-conditional reading, the kernel yields an open-loop model: from the input embeddings and the frozen weights alone, we can iterate the kernel and the model's own MLPs over token representations, never consulting a measured deviation at any layer. The resulting prediction is highly accurate. In early training the model and its corpus mean field are indistinguishable. Replace every attention head with its mean field, and the substitution leaves the loss on real text unchanged. Around the onset of induction, the two diverge, and the gap widens as representations become contextualized. Under the context-conditional reading, deviation from the mean field is a task-agnostic measure of context-specific computation. The residual decomposes additively into unusual attention routing and contextualization of the transported values. Across controlled induction and few-shot settings, greater deviation tracks greater reliance on in-context information.

AI.tldr: 论文提出注意力的平均场分析：用平均注意力核刻画表示几何随层演化，并以语料条件与上下文条件两种方式读取该核，区分一般演化与上下文特定计算。
AI.motivation: 表示几何并非预设，而是随模型运行动态演化，仅靠共现等模型无关统计无法忠实刻画该过程，因而需要能捕捉动态过程的刻画方式。
AI.method: 定义token间平均注意力核，逐层传递表示并可迭代；在语料条件下得到开环模型（仅用输入嵌入与冻结权重迭代核与MLP），在上下文条件下定义平均场偏差，并将残差加性分解为注意力路由异常与传递值的上下文化。
AI.result: 语料条件下的迭代预测高度准确；训练早期模型与其语料平均场几乎不可区分，替换所有注意力头为平均场后真实文本损失不变；约在归纳头出现时两者开始分化且差距随表示上下文化而扩大。上下文条件下，偏差越大表示越依赖上下文信息。
AI.conclusion: 平均场为注意力与表示几何的演化提供了可迭代的刻画框架，既能预测平均情形，也能以偏差度量上下文特定计算，揭示模型偏离平均场的时机与程度。

title: Where Post-Training Quantization Breaks Text Embedders: A Measured Map Across Four Embedder Families
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Measurements, ledger and analysis code: https://github.com/ThakiCloud/skillret-ptq-measurements
summary: Weight-only post-training quantization is the cheapest way to shrink a retrieval embedder, and the received advice for applying it -- protect the embedding table, allocate bits by module sensitivity, prefer a ranking-aware objective over weight reconstruction -- was carried into LLM quantization largely intact. We test that advice on retrieval embedders directly, quantizing five checkpoints from four architecture families across a grid of bit widths and group sizes, and isolating the embedding, attention and feed-forward blocks at each width. Every heuristic fails to transfer as stated. The embedding table never emerges as the dominant isolated protection priority in any family, despite being the largest tensor in several of them. Module sensitivity does not survive as a transferable ordering: at INT4/g16 the spread between modules is too small to allocate against, at INT3 the ordering becomes family-dependent and joint damage stops being the sum of its parts, and at INT2 comparable reconstruction error accompanies retention ranging from 1.3 to 65.9 percent of full precision. A cheap reconstruction proxy is useful for screening uniform bit widths but substantially less reliable for choosing which tensors to protect; its apparent strength across the whole grid is a range-extension artifact. A distilled 109M student at INT3 holds 78.04 NDCG@10 in 68.4 MB and dominates the extreme-PTQ arm of its own 0.6B teacher, 297.9 MB at 64.46, on both size and quality -- but only inside the task it was distilled for. Sizes are byte counts of files that exist rather than arithmetic estimates, and the measurement repository carries the byte provenance for every one of them.

AI.tldr: 在检索嵌入模型上验证LLM量化经验，发现嵌入表保护、模块敏感度排序与重建代理等启发式均不成立；蒸馏小模型在特定任务内以更小体积超越教师极端量化。
AI.motivation: 权重-only 训练后量化（PTQ）是压缩检索嵌入器最廉价的手段，业界从嵌入模型迁移而来的三条建议（保护嵌入表、按模块敏感度分配比特、偏好排序感知目标）被原样带入 LLM 量化。作者希望直接检验这些建议对检索嵌入器是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 对来自 4 个架构家族的 5 个检索嵌入模型检查点进行量化，扫描不同比特宽度与分组大小的网格，并在每个宽度下单独隔离嵌入块、注意力块与前馈块；比较统一比特宽度与逐张量保护选择的效果，并用一个廉价的权重重构代理来考察其筛选与保护决策能力；同时对比一个蒸馏的 109M 学生模型与其 0.6B 教师模型的极端 PTQ 版本。
AI.result: 所有启发式均无法原样迁移：嵌入表在任何家族中都未成为主导的隔离保护优先级，尽管它是多个模型中最大的张量；模块敏感度排序不可迁移——INT4/g16 下模块间差异太小无法据此分配，INT3 下排序变为家族依赖且联合损伤不再等于各部分之和，INT2 下相近的重构误差对应 1.3%–65.9% 的保留率；重构代理可用于筛选统一比特宽度，但对选择保护张量可靠性明显更低，其在全网格上的表面强度是范围扩展伪影。蒸馏的 109M 学生在 INT3 下以 68.4 MB 达到 78.04 NDCG@10，在体积与质量上均优于其 0.6B 教师（297.9 MB，64.46）的极端 PTQ 版本，但仅限于其被蒸馏的任务内。
AI.conclusion: 面向检索嵌入器的权重-only PTQ 不能照搬 LLM 量化经验：保护嵌入表、模块敏感度分配与重建代理选择均被直接检验证伪，模块损伤具有家族依赖与不可加性。体积以实际文件字节数计量并附字节来源记录，蒸馏小模型在特定任务内可胜过教师的极端量化版本。

title: ParsHate: A Benchmark Dataset for Hate and Target Detection in Persian
summary: We introduce ParsHate, a manually annotated dataset of 10,000 Persian tweets spanning 2013-2022, representing the first decade-long benchmark for hate speech detection in Persian. The dataset contains 31% hateful content and supports both hate detection and multi-label fine-grained target identification across seven structured target categories. ParsHate also distinguishes explicit and implicit hate, marks explicit and implicit targets, and provides span-level rationales. Data collection combines random and score-stratified temporal sampling to reduce keyword-driven bias while preserving natural label distributions. Applying SOTA models for Persian hate-speech detection on ParsHate shows moderate performance (79% F1), especially with samples from earlier years, and low performance with target identification (25.5% macro-F1). This emphasizes the diverse sampling of hate speech in ParsHate and its challenging nature that requires more advanced methods for better performance. Dataset is made publicly available.

AI.tldr: ParsHate：首个覆盖2013–2022十年跨度的波斯语仇恨言论检测基准数据集，含10,000条人工标注推文，支持仇恨检测、七类多标签细粒度目标识别、显隐式仇恨与目标区分及跨度级依据标注。
AI.motivation: 波斯语仇恨言论检测缺乏长期、多样化且标注细致的基准数据集，现有数据多受关键词驱动偏差影响，难以反映真实标签分布与任务难度。
AI.method: 构建ParsHate数据集：10,000条波斯语推文，含31%仇恨内容；支持仇恨检测与七类结构化目标的多标签细粒度识别；区分显式/隐式仇恨及显式/隐式目标，并提供跨度级依据。数据采集结合随机采样与按分数分层的时序采样，以降低关键词偏差并保留自然标签分布。
AI.result: 将波斯语仇恨言论检测的SOTA模型应用于ParsHate，仇恨检测表现中等（79% F1），早期年份样本尤其吃力；目标识别表现较低（25.5% macro-F1）。
AI.conclusion: ParsHate体现了仇恨言论的多样采样及其挑战性，需要更先进方法提升性能；数据集已公开。

title: Negation Beyond the Verbal Channel: Temporal Multimodal Correlates in Dialogue
comment: To be submitted to the October 2026 cycle of ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
summary: Negation is typically modeled through its linguistic realization, although spoken interaction is accompanied by tightly coordinated nonverbal behavior. We ask whether contexts centered on spoken negation cues contain measurable multimodal behavioral information: whether they can be distinguished from matched control contexts without lexical or acoustic input, where this information occurs in time, which modalities carry it, and whether it extends to the dialogue partner. We study 27 human-human interviews conducted in virtual reality, comprising temporally aligned gaze, facial, head, body, hand, and finger behavior and 964 annotated negation cues. Treating classification as a predictive probe, we compare 20 time-series models while excluding lexical and acoustic information, and then systematically vary temporal context, interactional source, modality availability, and event timing. Across grouped 10-fold cross-validation, the strongest probes reach up to .75 mean held-out AUROC from speaker-side behavior. Temporal analyses show that predictive information is concentrated around cue onset but remains detectable over a broader surrounding interval, while dialogue-partner behavior carries weaker predictive information with a comparatively diffuse temporal profile. Ablation and timing perturbations further show that facial features produce the largest modality-ablation effect and that the trained probe is sensitive to the temporal organization of the observed events.

AI.tldr: 该研究将否定视为会话现象，检验仅凭多模态非语言行为能否识别否定语境。基于27场VR人机访谈中的注视、面部、头部、身体、手与手指时序数据及964个否定标注，用20种时序模型作为预测探针，在排除词汇与声学信息后，说话者侧行为可达到最高约0.75的平均留出AUROC。
AI.motivation: 否定通常仅通过语言实现来建模，但口语互动伴随高度协同的非语言行为；作者希望探究以口语否定线索为中心的语境是否包含可测量的多模态行为信息，以及这些信息出现的时间位置、由哪些模态承载、是否延伸至对话伙伴。
AI.method: 采集27场VR人-人访谈中时间对齐的注视、面部、头部、身体、手、手指行为与964个标注否定线索；将分类作为预测探针，比较20种时序模型并排除词汇与声学信息；系统变化时间上下文、互动来源、模态可用性与事件时序；采用分组10折交叉验证，并开展消融与时间扰动实验。
AI.result: 最强的探针在说话者侧行为上达到最高约0.75的平均留出AUROC；预测信息集中在否定线索起始点附近，但在更宽的周边区间内仍可检测；对话伙伴行为承载的预测信息较弱且时间分布相对分散；面部特征产生最大的模态消融效应；训练后的探针敏感于所观察事件的时间组织。
AI.conclusion: 否定语境包含可测量的非语言多模态行为信息，可在无词汇和声学输入时被时序探针识别；该信息具有明确的时间定位与模态差异，并部分延伸至对话伙伴，表明否定不仅是语言现象，也体现在协同的互动行为中。

title: Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery
summary: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 KoDialectBench（5 个地区、3 个维度、1000 条样本，以标识符哈希与评分代码发布，用户需自备授权语料重建），系统量化合成数据能恢复多少真实语料的监督信号，并证明该恢复度测量依赖于合成/评估流水线本身：真实数据增益在地区识别上被恢复 91.2%、理解任务仅 63.7%；生成任务上，标记词表指标给出 92.3%（方言度）与 119.3%（地区匹配，超过真实数据参照），而基于参照的生成指标仅 72.4%。构造-不相交对照实验显示，在完全相同训练规模下扣留 20% 标记类型会使标记词表上的恢复度从 91.8%/101.9% 骤降至 8.1%/25.6%，而三项与流水线无关的测量完全不下降；据此提出指标-构造覆盖度（MCC），并发现 MCC 从 0 升到 1 时测得的方言度恢复度单调上升，说明构造与评估清单共享会显著高估合成数据的恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 韩语方言语料存在但不可再分发：模型权重可公开，而基于原始数据复现训练与评估却不行。作者据此追问两个问题：合成数据能在多大程度上恢复这部分监督信号，以及这种恢复度能否独立于合成流水线本身被测量。
AI.method: 发布 KoDialectBench，覆盖 5 个地区、3 个评价维度共 1000 条样本，以标识符哈希与评分代码形式释放，使用户用自有授权副本重建条目。实验设计包括：多合成数据配置下的恢复度对照；标记词表指标与基于参照的生成指标对比；"精确形式、构造不相交"（construction-disjoint）对照分支，在规则中扣留 20% 标记类型，并在完全匹配的训练规模（8600 条）下比较；以及补充的评估器扫描（evaluator sweep），定义指标-构造覆盖度（MCC）并考察其与测得恢复度的关系。
AI.result: 恢复度强烈依赖评价维度：最优合成配置在地区识别上达到真实数据增益的 91.2%，而在理解任务上仅 63.7%。生成任务上的结论取决于指标：部署的标记词表指标报告方言度恢复 92.3%、地区匹配恢复 119.3%（后者甚至超过真实数据参照），而基于参照的生成指标仅 72.4%。作者进一步发现标记指标的打分清单完全被其变换规则可输出的清单所包含。在精确匹配训练规模（8600 条）下，构造不相交分支将被留出标记清单上的方言度恢复从 91.8% 压到 8.1%、地区匹配恢复从 101.9% 压到 25.6%，而三项与流水线无关的测量完全不下降。评估器扫描显示，MCC 从 0 增至 1 时，测得的方言度恢复度单调上升。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据对真实语料监督信号的恢复能力高度依赖评价维度与所选指标；当合成构造与评估清单共享（高 MCC）时，恢复度估计会被显著抬高，甚至出现超过真实数据参照的假象。因此，评估合成数据价值时必须区分与流水线无关的测量与受构造覆盖度影响的测量，并报告 MCC 等覆盖度信息，避免因构造—评估清单耦合而高估合成数据的实际效用。

title: Reasoning with Image Generation
comment: Accepted to COLM 2026. Code https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/reimagin and website https://hector.gr/reimagin/
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning has revolutionized natural language processing by enabling large language models (LLMs) to decompose problems into intermediate steps before answering. Yet confining reasoning to the textual domain presents limitations for tasks requiring direct manipulation of visual representations. Recent efforts augment multimodal LLMs with external visual expert tools such as depth estimation or object detection modules, but these remain fundamentally limited by their reliance on narrow, rigid operations that cannot flexibly generate or transform visual content. We propose ReImaGin, which leverages image generation models as a flexible visual reasoning mechanism for multimodal LLMs: unlike fixed-function tools, they accept natural language commands and can perform open-ended visual operations, like removing an occlusion or generating a floorplan from multiple disjoint views of a room. Across six diverse visual reasoning tasks including multi-view spatial reasoning and collision prediction, ReImaGin consistently outperforms both text-only reasoning and specialist vision-tool baselines, with gains of up to 25\%, demonstrating the advantage of flexible, generative visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReImaGin，将图像生成模型作为多模态 LLM 的灵活视觉推理机制，在六项视觉推理任务上超越纯文本推理与专用视觉工具基线，最高提升 25%。
AI.motivation: 思维链推理虽提升 LLM 的问题分解能力，但将推理局限于文本域，难以直接操作视觉表征；现有做法为多模态 LLM 接入深度估计、目标检测等外部视觉专家工具，然而这些工具操作狭窄、刚性，无法灵活生成或变换视觉内容。
AI.method: 利用图像生成模型作为可接受自然语言指令的通用视觉推理工具，执行开放式视觉操作（如去除遮挡、由房间的多个不连续视角生成平面图），并以此作为多模态 LLM 的推理机制。
AI.result: 在多视角空间推理、碰撞预测等六项多样化视觉推理任务上，ReImaGin 一致优于纯文本推理与专用视觉工具基线，增益最高达 25%。
AI.conclusion: 灵活、生成式的视觉推理相较固定功能的视觉工具与纯文本推理具有明显优势，图像生成模型可作为多模态 LLM 有效的视觉推理载体。

title: ReMova: Fine-tuning LLMs for English to Belarusian translation
summary: This paper presents a Belarusian-specific data-cleaning pipeline and fine-tuning for English-Belarusian machine translation. Our cleaning pipeline distinguishes itself from others by employing a correction tool that addresses the issue of the two orthographies of the Belarusian language, noise in the training data, interference from other languages and other misspelling issues common in Belarusian on the internet. A matched ablation on unfiltered training data shows substantial benefits from filtering for all fine-tuned models, with the LLM-based models gaining roughly twice as much from filtering as the dedicated encoder-decoder MT system, supporting the view that for Belarusian MT one of the primary bottlenecks is data quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出针对白俄罗斯语的专用数据清洗流程及英-白机器翻译微调方法，清洗流程通过纠错工具处理正字法、噪声、跨语言干扰等问题，消融实验表明过滤数据对微调模型有显著增益。
AI.motivation: 白俄罗斯语网络数据噪声严重，且存在两种正字法并存、跨语言干扰和拼写错误等问题，数据质量被视为白俄罗斯语机器翻译的主要瓶颈，因此需要专门的数据清洗方案。
AI.method: 构建白俄罗斯语专用的数据清洗流程，引入纠错工具以处理两种正字法、训练数据噪声、其他语言干扰及常见拼写错误；随后在清洗后数据上进行英-白机器翻译的微调，并开展匹配的消融实验，对比未过滤训练数据的效果。
AI.result: 在未过滤训练数据上的匹配消融实验显示，数据过滤对所有微调模型均有显著收益，其中基于大语言模型的模型获益约为专用编码器-解码器翻译系统的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 对于白俄罗斯语机器翻译，数据质量是主要瓶颈之一；面向该语言的正字法与噪声专用清洗对提升翻译模型性能至关重要。

title: Interpreting and Steering LLM Agents for Social Simulations
summary: Simulations based on large language models (LLMs) have proven to be powerful for understanding human behavior, making them valuable additions to the social scientific toolkit. However, LLMs are ultimately black boxes based on deep neural networks which limits their value for social science. This is because of a lack of (i) interpretability: i.e. the ability to assign clear mechanisms driving observed behavior; and a lack of (ii) steerability: i.e. the ability to mute or amplify specific theoretically meaningful mechanisms of action to drive specific model behavior. Here, we demonstrate how the black box could be opened up to further enrich LLM-based simulations. Specifically, we compare three types of methods: (1) prompt-based manipulation, (2) SAE-derived feature steering, and (3) probe-based direction steering and examine their utility for LLM-based social scientific simulations. We do so by interpreting and steering two foundational components of human behaviors, namely preferences (risk attitudes, altruism) and capabilities (divergent creativity, product innovation), operationalized using four classic economic and creative tasks implemented as natural-language interactions. Overall, our results show that SAE- and probe-based techniques often outperform basic prompt-based methods for steering LLM agents, although this advantage depends on the specific prompting strategy involved. Together, SAEs and probes constitute an effective pipeline for social scientists seeking to interpret and steer agents in social simulations: SAEs decompose agents' internal representations into human-readable features, after which probes can reliably shift agents' behaviors in specified directions. We discuss implications of these methods for future work using LLM agents for social scientific simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种LLM智能体操控方法（提示词操控、SAE特征引导、探针方向引导），在风险偏好、利他、发散性创造力与产品创新四类任务上验证其对社会科学模拟的可解释性与可控性。
AI.motivation: LLM模拟已成为理解人类行为的重要社会科学工具，但LLM本质是深度神经网络黑箱，缺乏（i）可解释性——难以明确行为背后的机制；（ii）可操控性——无法压制或放大理论上具有意义的特定作用机制以驱动模型行为。因此需要打开黑箱以增强LLM模拟的价值。
AI.method: 对比三类方法：（1）基于提示词的操控；（2）SAE（稀疏自编码器）衍生特征引导；（3）基于探针的方向引导。以自然语言交互形式实现四个经典经济学与创造力任务，对偏好（风险态度、利他主义）与能力（发散性创造力、产品创新）两大人类行为基础成分进行解释与操控。
AI.result: SAE与探针方法在引导LLM智能体方面通常优于基础提示词方法，但该优势取决于具体使用的提示策略。SAE与探针结合构成有效流程：SAE将智能体内部表示分解为人类可读特征，探针则可沿指定方向可靠地偏移智能体行为。
AI.conclusion: SAE与探针构成面向社会科学家的有效管线，可对模拟中的智能体进行解释与操控，为未来基于LLM智能体的社会科学模拟研究提供了方法启示。

title: The Neverwhere Visual Parkour Benchmark Suite
comment: 9 pages, 14 figures. Accepted to IROS 2026. Project page: https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/
summary: State-of-the-art visual locomotion controllers are increasingly capable at handling complex visual environments, making evaluating their real-world performance before deployment increasingly difficult. This work intends to narrow this train/evaluation gap by developing a collection of hyper-photo-realistic, closed-loop evaluation environments - The Neverwhere Benchmark Suite - comprised of over sixty 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions of urban indoor and outdoor scenes. Our goal is to encourage large-scale and reproducible robot evaluation by making it easier to create and integrate Gaussian splats-based reconstructions into simulated continuous testing setups. We also underscore the potential pitfalls of relying exclusively on 3D Gaussian-generated data for training, by providing policy checkpoints trained over multiple Neverwhere scenes and their performance when evaluated in novel scenes. Our analysis illustrates the necessity of sourcing diverse data to ensure performance. Code and data are available on the project page: https://ziyc.github.io/neverwhere-bench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Neverwhere Benchmark Suite，一套基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的超真实闭环评估环境，包含 60 余个城市室内外场景重建，旨在缩小视觉运动控制器的训练-评估鸿沟，并揭示仅用 3DGS 数据训练的策略在新场景泛化上的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉运动控制器在复杂视觉环境中能力不断增强，导致部署前评估其在真实世界中的表现愈发困难，训练与评估之间存在明显差距。
AI.method: 构建由 60 余个基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建的城市室内外场景组成的超真实闭环评估环境集合，并支持将高斯溅射重建便捷地创建与集成到连续测试框架中；同时在多个 Neverwhere 场景上训练策略检查点，并在新场景中评估其性能。
AI.result: 在多个 Neverwhere 场景上训练的策略在新场景中评估时表现出性能局限，表明仅依赖 3D Gaussian 生成数据进行训练存在潜在风险。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需要从多样化的数据来源收集数据以保证策略性能，并希望通过该基准推动大规模、可复现的机器人评估。代码与数据已公开。
